article.articleHeadline: DR Congo registrerer 600 ebolarelaterede dødsfald
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo records 600 Ebola-related deaths.
article.articleSummary: Epicenter in Bunia, capital of Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). As of the latest tally, 1,759 confirmed Ebola cases and 600 deaths have been recorded. The update covers through Tuesday, with 24 hours yielding 51 new cases and 20 deaths. WHO spokesperson Anne Ancia, the WHO representative in the DRC, said the outbreak is still growing and cannot yet be stabilized. Health facilities are stretched, with Ebola treatment centers at roughly 90% capacity. The data from the government, cited by Reuters, underscores ongoing transmission in eastern DRC, particularly Bunia, a central hub of the outbreak. Authorities warn that spread beyond Ituri remains a risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ関連死者600人を記録
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国東部で拡大中で、致死率が高く、医療体制が逼迫しており、国際的拡大リスクも指摘されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHO代表が流行はまだ制御できていないと発言し、治療施設が約90%の稼働率に達していることから、フルリスク評価（RRA）への移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak, DRC and Region, Situation Report #10, July 8, 2026
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the DRC, declared May 15 and linked to the Bundibugyo strain. As of July 7, the DRC reports 1,708 confirmed EVD cases and 580 deaths; Uganda has 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. On July 4, Uganda reported a confirmed Marburg case. The outbreak remains centered in Ituri, with additional cases in Haut-Uele, North Kivu and South Kivu; Uganda’s cases are linked to transmission from the DRC, while South Sudan is at high risk due to porous borders. International Medical Corps reports response across 89 facilities, including case management, IPC, screening and triage, risk communication and preparedness. They’ve conducted 121,777 screenings and treated 422 patients (132 confirmed); trained 2,208 personnel in EVD response. IMC uses a hub-and-spoke model, coordinating with MoH and partners to strengthen surveillance, contact tracing and risk communication to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、コンゴ民主共和国および周辺地域、状況報告書 #10、2026年7月8日
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認症例1,708例・死亡580例の大規模エボラアウトブレイクが継続し、ウガンダへの越境伝播およびマールブルグ病例も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉疫情失控！病毒入侵新省分死亡人數突破600大關 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo Ebola outbreak out of control! Virus invades newly created provinces; death toll surpasses 600.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to expand, with the death toll surpassing 600 and transmission spreading to new provinces. Official reports indicate 1,759 infections in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu; two more suspected cases were found in Kisangani, the capital of Tshopo Province, now the latest hotspot. One Kisangani case is linked to the initial Ituri cluster; the second appears unconnected geographically, signaling possible local transmission. Final laboratory confirmation is pending for both, after which they will be added to the official counts. The health ministry has deployed emergency teams to Kisangani to conduct contact tracing and boost community surveillance. The World Health Organization warns that high population movement is accelerating spread, and the outbreak remains unstable with continued expansion.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ疫情が制御不能に！ウイルスが新省に侵入、死者数600人突破

article.articleHeadline: New Congo province has suspected Ebola case as deaths hit 600, report says
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports suspected Ebola cases in a new province as the outbreak expands. As of July 8, 2026, the Ebola outbreak declared May 15 has infected 1,759 people and caused 600 deaths across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. Two additional cases in Kisangani, capital of Tshopo province, are not yet included in the official tally; one is linked to Niania health zone in Ituri, the other has no geographic link beyond Kisangani. Positive tests await confirmatory results and will be added to totals once validated. Response teams are boosting surveillance and contact tracing in Kisangani. Authorities had previously traced contacts in Tshopo and Haut-Uele. The past 24 hours brought 51 new cases and 20 new deaths. The World Health Organization says the outbreak remains unstable and expanding due to population movement.

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع إصابات إيبولا المؤكدة في الكونغو إلى 1759 منها 600 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in confirmed Ebola cases in Congo to 1,759, of which 600 have died.
article.articleSummary: On July 9, 2026, government data indicate an Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths. The totals reflect cases confirmed through Tuesday, per a daily situation report that records 51 new confirmed cases and 20 new deaths in the past 24 hours, signaling ongoing transmission within the country. The brief provides no breakdown of affected provinces, details on laboratory confirmation methods, infection sources, or distinctions between imported or exported cases. The numbers underscore the persistence of the outbreak and the ongoing need for surveillance, case management, and public health response to contain transmission and care for patients.

article.articleHeadline: New DRC province reports Ebola case as deaths surge
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) expands with a new province, Kisangani in Tshopo, reporting suspected cases as the death toll reaches 600. Since the outbreak was declared on 15 May, 1,759 people have been infected across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu; two Kisangani cases are not yet fully counted—one linked to Niania in Ituri, the other without a geographic link beyond Kisangani. Positive test results are awaiting confirmatory testing before being added to official totals. Response teams have begun strengthening surveillance, contact tracing and containment measures in Kisangani. In the previous 24 hours, 51 new cases and 20 new deaths were documented. Authorities had been tracing exposures in two provinces not previously affected: Tshopo and Haut-Uele. The World Health Organization says the outbreak has not stabilised and continues to expand due to population movement.

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa aprova medicamento pediátrico contra doença de Chagas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa approves a pediatric drug for Chagas disease.
article.articleSummary: On 9 July 2026, Brazil's National Health Surveillance Agency (Anvisa) approved Lampit for pediatric treatment of Chagas disease, indicated for patients from newborns weighing at least 2.5 kg up to under 18 years. Chagas disease is caused by the parasite Trypanosoma cruzi and is a major neglected tropical disease in Brazil, driving significant cardiac and digestive complications that can be fatal. The approval expands access to antiparasitic therapy for children. Lampit works as an antiparasitic, with a mechanism that triggers the production of substances that damage the parasite, promoting its elimination from the body. The release highlights the disease's neglected status in Brazil, underscoring the impact on vulnerable populations and the public health importance of pediatric treatment options.

article.articleHeadline: എട്ട് ദിവസം; സംസ്ഥാനത്ത് ഒരുലക്ഷത്തിലേറെ പേർക്ക്‌ പകർച്ചവ്യാധി
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Eight days; more than one lakh people infected with a contagious disease in the state.
article.articleSummary: Kerala, India, reports a sweeping outbreak. As of the eighth day of the month, 106,000 people tested positive for a contagious illness in government hospitals. The breakdown includes fever (84,658), vomiting (19,428), dengue fever (834), chickenpox (675), influenza (661), measles (197), typhus (12), chikungunya (9), and amoebic meningitis (2). Also listed are Shigella (34), and other diseases. There were 30 deaths in a week; last month’s toll was 241, with 71 deaths whose lab results are still pending. Shigella-related cases led to a school closure delay in Thrikkunnapuzha; in Kozhikode and Malappuram, two children died from Shigella in a month. In Wayanad’s Sultan Bathery, 164 students with symptoms were tested, 6 confirmed. Monsoon-season conditions and gaps in pre-monsoon cleaning have intensified dengue spread; vitamin A distribution to children has been disrupted, and essential medicines are in short supply across hospitals.

triage.headline_ja: 8日間で州内10万人以上が感染症に感染――ケララ州で公衆衛生警戒

triage.notes: 複数の感染症(デング熱、水痘、インフルエンザ、麻疹、シゲラ症、チクングニア熱、アメーバ性髄膜炎等)が同時に報告されており、モンスーン期の衛生状態悪化と医薬品・ビタミンA供給の途絶が状況を悪化させている。国際的拡大の兆候はないが、州内の公衆衛生システムへの負荷が高く、続報の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Secretaria de Saúde de Araçatuba promove campanha Julho Amarelo com testagem contra hepatites virais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Araçatuba Health Department Promotes Yellow July Campaign With Testing for Viral Hepatitis.
article.articleSummary: Araçatuba, Brazil, launches the Yellow July Campaign to boost prevention, early diagnosis, and treatment of viral hepatitis. From July throughout the month, free rapid tests for Hepatitis B and Hepatitis C are offered at Basic Health Units (UBSs) and the Specialized Ambulatory Service (SAE) during regular hours. Until July 28—the World Day Against Viral Hepatitis—tests are also available to patients with appointments at the Auxilium Health Specialty Center, Dona Ida Street 1,350, Aviação neighborhood. Health teams from the Family Health Strategy (ESF), dental services, and e-Multi will educate patients on hepatitis via dialogued sessions and visuals during UBS visits and integrative groups. Secretary Lucila Bistaffa emphasizes expanding diagnosis; tests are simple, safe, and free year-round in the municipal network, with Hepatitis B vaccination available at UBSs. Hepatitis viruses can be asymptomatic for years, making early diagnosis crucial.

article.articleHeadline: മഴക്കാല രോഗങ്ങളെ അകറ്റാം; ഈ നാല് ശീലങ്ങൾ പതിവാക്കൂ | Avoid monsoon diseases; adopt these four habits
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avoid monsoon diseases; adopt these four habits.
article.articleSummary: Monsoon season increases humidity and standing water, raising risks of mosquito-borne and gastrointestinal illnesses. Reported diseases during the period include viral fever, diarrhea, food poisoning, dengue fever, malaria, typhoid, hepatitis A, and Elippani, with higher susceptibility for children, the elderly, pregnant women, diabetics, and those with weakened immunity. Four practical habits from Dr. Akshay Chipare of Vensor Hospital in Poone emphasize prevention: 1) ensure safe drinking water—prefer filtered, boiled, or scientifically purified water and avoid unknown sources or ice from dirty water; 2) eat freshly cooked, hot meals to prevent stomach infections; 3) prevent mosquitoes by eliminating small water held indoors/outdoors, covering water containers, and using repellents or nets; 4) seek prompt medical care for fever, diarrhea, or body aches instead of self-medicating, as delays can worsen illness during the monsoon.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季の病気を避けよう:この4つの習慣を身につけて

article.articleHeadline: الأمم المتحدة: 45 من عاملي الإغاثة والإستجابة لفيروس الإيبولا أُصيبوا في الهجمات بجمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: United Nations: 45 aid and Ebola-response workers were injured in attacks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks in eastern DRC persist, with 45 aid and Ebola-response workers injured amid 76 security incidents targeting response teams in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. The UN OCHA warns rising violence undermines containment as the outbreak, first reported in mid-May, continues to spread. As of Monday, authorities reported 1,708 confirmed Ebola cases across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with cases also in Boga Health Zone in Ituri, signaling geographic expansion. An Ebola treatment center in Butembo, North Kivu, was set on fire by unknown attackers, prompting renewed calls to protect health workers and facilities. OCHA emphasizes safeguarding the humanitarian and health response to ensure contact tracing, case management, and lifesaving care can proceed.

article.articleHeadline: 省人大常委会执法检查组赴果洛州开展包虫病防治条例执法检查
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee Enforcement Inspection Team Visits Guoluo Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture to Conduct Enforcement Inspection of the Echinococcosis Prevention and Control Ordinance.
article.articleSummary: From July 1–3, 2026, the Qinghai Provincial People’s Congress Standing Committee enforcement inspection team conducted enforcement inspections of the Qinghai Province Echinococcosis Prevention and Control Ordinance in Guoluo Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, visiting Maqin County, Gande County, and Dari County. Inspectors examined key sites—water sources, drinking points, township health clinics, veterinary stations, disease-control centers, police stations, and schools—to assess source-water protection, ordinance publicity, stray-dog management, and hydatid disease health education. They held discussions with grassroots epidemic prevention workers and teachers to gather feedback. The team urged strict legal accountability, refined annual assessment indicators, and full mobilization of local departments. Key measures include enforcing dog tethering and de-worming, stray-dog capture/disposal, safe processing of diseased cattle and sheep viscera, improved pastoral water protection, and wild-host monitoring to interrupt transmission. Strengthen grassroots teams, standardize screening and follow-up, protect severe/low-income patients, and establish cross-sector, data-sharing, bilingual outreach (on horseback and in schools) to foster active prevention and broad community involvement.

In the past 24 hours, 51 new infections and 20 new deaths were reported, with totals as of Tuesday, July 7, 2026. Health authorities continue surveillance, response, and containment efforts to curb transmission. France has dispatched 20 tons of humanitarian aid to support the DRC Ebola response, coordinated by the French crisis and support center, delivered to Ituri Province on July 7, 2026. The package includes 12 tons of infection prevention and control equipment for facilities housing patient contacts and 8 tons of medicines to bolster the health system and care for the most vulnerable, supporting local authorities and United Nations efforts in outbreak containment.

article.articleHeadline: 灾后次生疫病风险怎么防 医生提醒→
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How to prevent the risk of post-disaster secondary infectious diseases: Doctors Remind
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-09, Guangxi, China faces elevated risk of post-disaster secondary infectious diseases after prolonged heavy rainfall and floods. Floodwaters carry sewage and pathogens; residual mud and standing water foster bacteria, viruses, and parasite eggs, the main transmission risk. Dr. Yang Jun, Deputy Chief of Public Health at Nanning Second People’s Hospital, urges orderly environmental cleanup and disinfection to block the source, including removing standing water and cleaning from clean to dirty areas. Flood-damaged items such as cotton furniture, sofas, carpets, and water-soaked wooden furniture should be discarded; spoiled or water-logged foods and bottled drinks (opened or unopened) should also be discarded. Food safety and personal hygiene are critical: avoid raw foods and ensure all ingredients are thoroughly cooked. These measures aim to prevent post-disaster infectious disease spread in Guangxi.

triage.headline_ja: 災害後の二次感染症リスクをどう防ぐか 医師が注意喚起

article.articleHeadline: Julho Amarelo: SMS de Feira de Santana acompanha mais de 1,7 mil pacientes com hepatites virais e amplia ações de prevenção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yellow July: Feira de Santana Municipal Health Secretariat monitors more than 1,700 patients with viral hepatitis and expands prevention actions.
article.articleSummary: Feira de Santana's Municipal Health Secretariat, via Epidemiological Surveillance, intensifies the Yellow July campaign to raise awareness of viral hepatitis. The Municipal Reference Center for STI/HIV and Viral Hepatitis now tracks 1,708 patients from Feira de Santana and partner municipalities, including 836 with hepatitis B and 872 with hepatitis C. In 2026, 56 new patients joined the service, housed at the Specialized Health Center Dr. Leone Coelho Leda (CSE). The center provides free multidisciplinary care, with follow-up across all treatment stages. Testing expanded through the municipal network, totaling 4,739 rapid hepatitis tests in 2026 (2,351 for hepatitis B, 2,388 for hepatitis C). In 2025 (Jan–Jul), 3,525 tests were performed (2,008 B, 1,517 C). Vaccination against hepatitis A and B is offered; prevention messages emphasize not sharing sharp objects and using condoms. On July 28, educational sessions will inform patients about prevention, diagnosis, and treatment access under the campaign’s broader public health rollout.

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉死亡病例达600例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches 600.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) totals 1,759 laboratory-confirmed cases and 600 deaths. Ituri Province, North Kivu Province, and South Kivu Province are the main affected areas, with 285 recoveries and 750 patients currently in isolation or hospital care. Health facilities in the three provinces are nearing capacity, with North Kivu bed occupancy exceeding 100%. Separately, Kisangani, the capital of JoPo Province, reported two PCR-positive Ebola cases; one is linked to Ituri Province, while the other has no identified epidemiological link outside Kisangani. These two cases have not yet been included in the national total, pending confirmatory retesting and further epidemiological investigations. JoPo Province borders Ituri and North Kivu; Kisangani is a major commercial city and transport hub in northeast DRC.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola deaths in DR Congo reach 600
article.articleSummary: 600 deaths and 1,759 confirmed Ebola cases reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of July 8, 2026, in an outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus. The outbreak, declared May 15, is the DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak, spanning 37 health zones in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. About 750 patients are in isolation or hospitalization, with a bed occupancy rate of 94%. The response faces constraints including community resistance to post-mortem sampling, insufficient treatment capacity, gaps in contact tracing, limited supplies, insecurity, and restricted access in areas affected by armed groups. The update was released by health authorities late Wednesday.

article.articleHeadline: Saúde promove Campanha de Mobilização contra Hepatites Virais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Promotes Mobilization Campaign Against Viral Hepatitis
article.articleSummary: Rio Preto, Brazil launches the Mobilization Campaign Against Viral Hepatitis on July 13–14, 2026, 10:00–15:00 at Praça Dom José Marcondes. A mobile unit will offer rapid serological hepatitis tests to the public with no appointment, and flu vaccination will be available. All municipal health units will intensify hepatitis testing during the campaign to reach those never tested, enabling early diagnosis and treatment. Waiting-room education and prevention-supply distribution will cover transmission, prevention, diagnosis, and treatment. Viral hepatitis involves liver inflammation and can be silent but progress to cirrhosis or cancer if untreated. Rapid tests are safe, confidential, and yield results in minutes for immediate referral. The campaign is part of Julho Amarelo, concluding on World Hepatitis Day, July 28.

article.articleHeadline: 레메디, 인도 결핵퇴치에 휴대용 엑스레이 750대 추가 공급
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Remedi to Supply 750 Additional Portable X-ray Units for TB Elimination in India
article.articleSummary: India’s National TB Elimination Programme (NTEP) has added 750 Remedi KA6 portable X-ray units to its mobile TB diagnostic network. This brings the KA6 fleet deployed across roughly 2,300 public healthcare facilities for 'find-and-treat' TB services. Remedi previously delivered 1,534 units last year; in the first half of 2026 the company reported about KRW 4 billion in revenue. NTEP’s large, multi-year procurement aims to expand mobile screening, moving away from hospital-centred diagnosis toward on-site rural diagnostics. India remains the world’s TB hotspot, accounting for about 25% of global TB patients in 2024 per WHO Global TB Report 2025. India’s TB incidence fell from 237 per 100,000 in 2015 to 187 per 100,000 in 2024, a 21% drop. Remedi plans to strengthen local sales and begin local assembly to support ongoing, multi-year bidding.

article.articleHeadline: Confirmed Ebola deaths in DR Congo hit 600
article.articleSummary: 600 Ebola deaths and 1,759 confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 51 new cases and 20 deaths reported in the prior 24 hours. The government notes two Kisangani cases awaiting validation; one linked to Nia-Nia in Ituri province, the other with no geographic link beyond Kisangani. Ituri remains the hardest-hit of the three eastern regions affected. Healthcare workers in Ituri protest pay delays since the outbreak was declared on May 15, with some suspending work by Tuesday, though no official strike yet. The response includes enrollment for clinical trials for Bundibugyo virus treatment, despite no approved vaccine. The outbreak, which prompted a WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern declaration in May, is believed to have spread through mining towns Mongbwalu, Rwampara and Bunia before reaching neighboring provinces.

article.articleHeadline: 45 nhân viên cứu trợ và ứng phó dịch Ebola bị thương trong các vụ tấn công ở CHDC Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 45 aid workers and Ebola-response personnel wounded in attacks in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: 45 aid workers and Ebola-response personnel have been wounded since the outbreak began in mid-May in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu), as violence against responders escalates. The UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) said partners have recorded 76 security incidents affecting Ebola responders and other aid workers across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. On 6 July, unidentified attackers raided an Ebola treatment center in Butembo, North Kivu, and set part of the facility on fire. As of 6 July, Congo reported 1,708 confirmed Ebola cases and 580 deaths across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, with new cases reported in Boga Health Zone, Ituri. The World Health Organization says the community health risk remains very high, with ongoing transmission exceeding current response capacity. OCHA and WHO stress protecting health workers and facilities to sustain surveillance, case finding and lifesaving care.

article.articleHeadline: Hà Tĩnh lấy mẫu giám sát vi-rút dịch tả lợn châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ha Tinh collects samples for African swine fever virus surveillance.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever virus surveillance sampling conducted in Ha Tinh Province, Vietnam, by the Region III Veterinary and Animal Husbandry Office in cooperation with Ha Tinh Planting and Breeding Office and local authorities, at three centralized slaughterhouses: Cam Trung, Thach Tan, and Thach Huong (in Cam Trung commune and Ha Huy Tap ward). In this round, 90 samples were collected; a second phase is planned for August 10–13, 2026. The province, where pig farming remains dominant with a total herd of over 351,700, reported ASF outbreaks in 31 of 69 communes/wards during the first half of 2026, with 1,591 pigs infected, dead, and culled, totaling 133.6 tons. Surveillance aims to monitor ASFV circulation, enable early warning and epidemiological assessment, determine the virus’s distribution, and safeguard biosafety during pig movement and slaughter. ASFV spreads rapidly, affects all pig ages, near 100% mortality, and there is no specific treatment.

The coordinated effort involves the Phnom Penh Municipal Authority, district authorities and the Phnom Penh Municipal Health Department, with Governor Khuong Sreng endorsing the measures. Regular mosquito-control spraying is being carried out to protect residents’ well-being and prevent dengue transmission. The operation aligns with a ministry press release on rainy-season prevention, rapid hospital referral, and eliminating mosquito breeding sites. Officials warn that the El Niño phenomenon may raise mosquito numbers and dengue cases in the Asia-Pacific region. Public cooperation is emphasized, calling for active participation by individuals, families and communities.

article.articleHeadline: South African pharmaceutical firm develops potential Ebola treatment
article.articleSummary: Xylomed Pharmaceuticals, Mauritius-headquartered, has developed an oral Ebola therapeutic and plans a double-blind, randomised Phase 3B trial in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), Uganda and South Sudan to determine efficacy in treating Ebola. The candidate is a repurposed, simple chemical molecule that purportedly prevents EBOV replication and has a safety profile established from prior use. The trial aims to confirm efficacy quickly and could enable treatment at home if effective, including in children as young as two. The study carries an estimated €35 million (R655 million) budget, with partnerships with universities in South Africa, Botswana and Europe to recruit patients across DRC, Uganda and South Sudan. Ebola outbreaks have fatality rates up to 70% and typically affect around 10,000 people per outbreak, highlighting the high costs and funding challenges for African pharma.

article.articleHeadline: Climate change could make infectious diseases harder to contain
article.articleSummary: Bangkok, Thailand—Climate change is making infectious diseases harder to contain, said Subramanian Swaminathan, president of CIDS India, at APAC-IRIDS. Population displacement from extreme weather now affects about 250 million people internally over the past decade; climate-driven food insecurity could raise hunger and malnutrition by about 20% by 2050. A 1°C local temperature rise could increase Salmonella disease by 5–10%, with Salmonella spread via contaminated water or undercooked food. Warmer conditions may also worsen antimicrobial resistance: a 10°C rise could lift resistance in Escherichia coli by 4.2%, Staphylococcus aureus by 2.7%, and Klebsiella pneumoniae by 2.2%. Droughts concentrate soil antimicrobial compounds, pushing pathogens to evolve; a 10-year study found grassland soils show a 24% increase in antimicrobial resistance genes with long-term warming. Calls for climate-resilient systems, prudent antibiotic use, sanitation, water and sewage improvements, smarter diagnostics, and a global One Health framework through multilateral cooperation.

article.articleHeadline: सावधान! डेढ़ लाख खाली प्लॉट बने खतरा, डेंगू केसेज में दूसरे नंबर पर भोपाल, जानें बचाव | 1 Lakh 5 Thousand Vacant Plots Pose Threat Dengue Cases Bhopal Ranks Second How To Protect Yourself
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Caution! One and a half lakh vacant plots pose a threat; Bhopal ranks second in dengue cases; learn how to protect yourself.
article.articleSummary: On July 9, 2026, Bhopal, the capital of Madhya Pradesh, faces a resurgence of dengue fever. In the past week, five new dengue cases were reported, elevating total infections in the city to 44 and ranking Bhopal second in the state for dengue cases. The primary concern is not the case count but the city’s roughly 150,000 vacant plots. Stagnant rainwater in these plots provides an ideal breeding ground for Aedes mosquitoes that transmit dengue. The health department’s major challenge is conducting larval surveys and destroying larvae across these plots to curb transmission. The report underscores that controlling mosquito breeding sites is crucial to managing the outbreak in Bhopal while the rest of Madhya Pradesh trails behind in case numbers.

triage.headline_ja: 注意!15万の空き地が脅威に、ボパールがデング熱症例数で州内2位に、予防法を知る
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の季節的な流行報告であり、症例数(44件)も限定的で、インドでは毎年発生する地域流行的事象のため、特段の異常性や国際的懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 毎年インドで発生する季節性デング熱の地方記事。ボパール市内の空き地対策(蚊の発生源対策)に焦点を当てた予防啓発記事であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya outbreak declared in two Samar villages
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreak declared in Gandara, Samar province; Barangays Ngoso and Catorse de Agosto placed under Code Red following a sharp rise in infections. As of Morbidity Week 27 (28 June–4 July), 84 suspected chikungunya cases were recorded, attack rate 23 per 1,000 population. Of cases, 46 were women and 38 men, median age 30, suggesting exposure during routine household or outdoor activities. The Gandara Rural Health Unit classifies the spike as a localized outbreak. Chikungunya is a mosquito-borne viral disease transmitted by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus (also vectors for dengue and Zika); mosquitoes bite mainly during the daytime and breed in containers with stagnant water. Symptoms typically include sudden fever and severe joint pain. Under Code Red, healthcare workers in the two barangays are to report for duty; ongoing symptom surveillance and coordination with Provincial and Regional Epidemiology and Surveillance Units aim to contain the outbreak. No laboratory confirmation details are provided; cases are described as suspected.

triage.headline_ja: サマール州の2つの村でチクングニア熱の集団発生を宣言
triage.triage_reason: サマール州の2バランガイでチクングニア熱の局地的アウトブレイクが宣言され、コードレッド対応が取られているが、規模は限定的で国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はない。今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 84例の疑い症例、致死例や重症例の報告なし。地域保健ユニットが対応中で、地域・州疫学サーベイランス部門と連携している。ラボ確認情報はまだ得られていない。

article.articleHeadline: DOH warns of leptospirosis risk as Typhoon Inday brings heavy rains
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis risk rises in the Philippines as Typhoon Inday (Bavi) brings heavy rains and possible flooding in low-lying areas. As of 4 a.m. July 9, 2026, the typhoon’s center was about 925 km east of Northern Luzon, with maximum sustained winds of 175 km/h, gusts to 215 km/h, moving west-northwest at 20 km/h and still inside the Philippine Area of Responsibility. Leptospirosis cases have increased by 1% from 2,461 cases recorded during the same period last year. The bacterial disease is transmitted through floodwater or soil contaminated with urine from infected animals, entering the body via open wounds or mucous membranes. The Department of Health advised avoiding floodwaters when possible; if exposure is unavoidable, wear boots, cover wounds with waterproof bandages, and wash with clean water and soap, then seek medical advice for possible preventive treatment. Mag-ingat sa baha. Iwasan ang leptospirosis.

triage.headline_ja: 台風インダイによる大雨でレプトスピラ症リスクが上昇とフィリピン保健省が警告
triage.triage_reason: 台風による洪水に伴う季節性のレプトスピラ症注意喚起であり、症例数も前年同期比1%増とほぼ横ばいのため深刻・異常とは言えないが、今後の洪水拡大による症例増加の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 台風による洪水を契機とした毎年恒例の公衆衛生上の注意喚起。症例数の増加率は小さく、現時点では通常のサーベイランス範囲内と考えられる。台風の進路・被害拡大状況を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: ตรังคัดเลือก อปท. ดีเด่น ป้องกันโรคพิษสุนัขบ้า ดัน "สัตว์ปลอดโรค คนปลอดภัย" ปี 2569
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trang selects outstanding local administrative organizations to prevent rabies, promoting "Rabies-free animals, safe people" in 2569.
article.articleSummary: Trang Province selects outstanding local administrative organizations for rabies prevention under the Thailand Rabies Awards 2026, promoting the slogan “Rabies-free animals, safe people.” On July 9, 2026, a provincial-level screening committee chaired by the Trang governor convened to assess submissions from local governments for fiscal year 2569 (2026) to recognize exemplary rabies prevention and control work. The effort aims to honor authorities with proven impact and to nominate Trang’s top performers to compete at the national Thailand Rabies Awards 2026. Awards were divided into two categories: Municipal—Kuan Kun Subdistrict Municipality in Si Kao District; and Tambon Administrative Organization (TAO)—Na Khaosia TAO in Nayong District. Selected winners will advance to the national competition under Department of Local Administration regulations, intended to boost community awareness and sustainable rabies management across Trang.

triage.headline_ja: トラン県、狂犬病予防の優秀地方自治体を選定 「動物は病気ゼロ、人は安全」2026年推進
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は狂犬病予防活動の表彰制度に関する行政広報であり、実際の症例発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病予防表彰制度に関する行政広報であり、疾患発生報告ではないため対象国発生事例として扱わない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: H5N1 "Bird Flu" spreads to Australia
article.articleSummary: Australia confirms six local H5N1 high-pathogenicity avian influenza cases after two migratory seabirds near Esperance, Western Australia, and a migratory giant petrel near Hawks Nest, New South Wales, indicating spread to the east coast; further cases are expected. H5N1 has devastated poultry and wildlife since 2020, with about 280 million birds killed or culled 2021–2024 and over 100 human infections and 10 deaths globally; the first human outbreak occurred in Hong Kong in 1997 (18 cases, 6 deaths). The current sub-variant, clade 2.3.4.4b, is highly contagious. Transmission occurs via direct contact with infected fluids and airborne routes, and through untreated meat and dairy; vaccines/antivirals exist but limited effectiveness. Infected animals are culled and quarantined. Migratory seabirds drive spread; a large Australian outbreak could threaten wildlife, farming, and human risk for those handling infected animals. Australia had a 2024 case in a returned traveller from India.

triage.headline_ja: H5N1「鳥インフルエンザ」がオーストラリアに拡大
triage.triage_reason: H5N1の深刻な影響や異常性は認められるが、発生地域はオーストラリアであり、監視対象国（香港・インドは歴史的言及/渡航歴のみで現行発生地ではない）に該当しないためモニタリング対象外と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はオーストラリアにおける渡り鳥由来のH5N1拡大。香港は1997年の過去の人感染事例として言及、インドは2024年にオーストラリアで確認された帰国者由来症例の出身地として言及されており、いずれも現在の発生地ではないため対象国リストには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Baguio courts encourage mask-wearing amid rise in COVID-19 cases
article.articleSummary: Baguio City’s Regional Trial Courts (RTC) and Municipal Trial Court in Cities (MTCC) issued a joint memorandum urging voluntary mask-wearing for all entrants to the Hall of Justice (Main) and Hall of Justice (CA Annex) to curb a rise in COVID-19. The advisory follows reports of increasing cases in Metro Manila and after a Baguio court employee tested positive. The memorandum, distributed to all RTC/MTCC courts and offices in Baguio City and the Office of the Regional Court Manager, seeks to reduce transmission in enclosed courtrooms and offices. Quezon City Epidemiology and Surveillance Division reported confirmed COVID-19 cases rising from 23 (May 21–June 10) to 84 (June 11–July 1, 2026). Health authorities note about 86% of new cases are outpatient with mild symptoms (cough, colds, fever) and 14% require hospitalization.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19症例増加を受け、バギオの裁判所がマスク着用を推奨
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19症例の増加が報告されているが、大部分が軽症で致死率等の深刻な情報はなく、通常の季節的増加の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 既知の疾患(COVID-19)で、症例の86%が軽症の外来対応であり、既存の対策（マスク着用推奨）で対応可能とみられる。フィリピン国内（Quezon City、Baguio）での局地的な増加であり、フルRRAの必要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 36 Kasus HIV/AIDS Ditemukan di Bolmut, ASN Turut Terinfeksi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 36 HIV/AIDS Cases Found in Bolmut, Civil Servants Also Infected.
article.articleSummary: Bolmut District Health Office in Bolaang Mongondow Utara, North Sulawesi, Indonesia, reports 36 HIV/AIDS cases over the past five years, with 3 deaths and 33 patients on treatment or under monitoring. Distribution spans six districts: Bolangitang Timur (13), Bintauna (7), Bolangitang Barat (5), Pinogaluman (4), Kaidipang (3), and Sangkub (1); gender among cases is 23 men and 10 women. Most infections involve residents who work outside the region and return, with additional exposure among sex workers and several civil servants. Mobility and risky behaviors are identified as key risk factors. Authorities urge routine health checks, greater reproductive health awareness, avoidance of risky behaviors, and periodic screenings. Emphasis is placed on early detection and therapy adherence to improve quality of life for people living with HIV and to reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 北ボラアンモンゴンドウ県(ボルムット)でHIV/AIDS36件確認、公務員も感染
triage.triage_reason: 過去5年間で36件という慢性的・地域的なHIV流行報告であり、急性の公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 5年間の累積データであり急性アウトブレイクではない。地域保健当局による通常の公衆衛生対応・啓発活動の範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: Los ganaderos pierden 994 millones de euros desde el inicio de la peste porcina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Livestock farmers lose €994 million since the start of swine fever.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever continues to devastate Spain’s pig sector, with losses totaling €994 million since the outbreak began, and €265 million in Catalonia over the last seven months. Estimates by Unió de Pagesos and Unión de Uniones compare mid-year pork prices to production costs: live-weight pork at €1.18/kg, production cost €1.34/kg (down 3.4% year on year), and prices 30.2% below last year, though a recent rise to €1.31/kg offers little relief as weekly infections persist. Internationally, pork export volume rose 0.8% in January–March to about 2.745 million tonnes, but value fell 3.4% to €8.486 billion, driven by ASF effects in Spain and Germany. China, the main destination, fell 34.2% to €199.1 million; Japan dropped 63%. Market concentration increases in Catalonia’s integrator sector (215 firms), led by Vall Companys (9.7%), Selección Batallé (6.2%), and Premier Pigs (5.7%).

triage.triage_reason: スペイン（カタルーニャ）における豚熱（ASF）による経済的損失を扱う記事であり、人の健康への影響はなく、また発生国であるスペインは対象国リストに含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: 600 وفاة.. الإيبولا يواصل الانتشار في الكونغو الديمقراطية - الوطن
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 600 deaths... Ebola continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - Al-Watan
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 600 deaths and 1,759 cases reported across eastern Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu since the outbreak was declared on May 15. Suspected cases have been reported in a new province, underscoring ongoing expansion. A government status update notes that the total excludes two cases in Kisangani, the capital of Chobo Province; one case is linked to the Niania Health Zone in Ituri, while the other has no clear geographic link outside Kisangani. Positive test results are undergoing confirmatory testing and will be added to official totals once validated.

triage.headline_ja: 600人死亡…エボラ、コンゴ民主共和国で拡大続く - アル・ワタン

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo registrerer 600 ebolarelaterede dødsfald
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo records 600 Ebola-related deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of July 9, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 1,759 confirmed Ebola cases and 600 Ebola-related deaths, with nearly 1,800 people infected in total. The figures come from the national government and were reported by Reuters overnight, underscoring an ongoing Ebola outbreak in DR Congo and the substantial public health burden. The article notes the near-1,800 infection count but provides no regional breakdown, laboratory confirmation details, or infection source in the excerpt. The data emphasize the continuing challenge Ebola poses to DR Congo’s surveillance and response efforts.

article.articleHeadline: Padang siapkan Kelurahan Siaga Tuberkulosis untuk cegah penularan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Padang prepares Tuberculosis Alert Villages to prevent transmission.
article.articleSummary: Padang, West Sumatra, is launching Tuberculosis Alert Villages in all Kuranji District kelurahan to speed TB case finding and break transmission. The initiative, Kelurahan Siaga Tuberkulosis, coordinates sub-district government, police security units, village cadres, posyandu, and puskesmas to trace TB patients. Health official Srikurnia Yati noted that early detection is the biggest hurdle in eliminating TB in Kuranji, which estimates 789 TB cases for 2026; by June only 219 cases (27.8%) had been found. The program will intensify screening and case finding, while ensuring identified patients receive standard treatment, as the success of elimination depends on finding cases early. TB bacteria is Mycobacterium tuberculosis. Treating patients promptly reduces transmission and helps move toward elimination.

triage.headline_ja: パダン市、結核感染防止のため「結核警戒集落」を準備
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病である結核に対する通常の公衆衛生対策（早期発見プログラム）の発表であり、異常性・国際的拡大リスク・緊急の社会的関心は認められない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の風土病であり、地方自治体レベルでの通常のケース発見・治療プログラムに関する記事。突発的なアウトブレイクではない。

article.articleHeadline: DRC confirms 1,708 Ebola cases, 580 deaths since outbreak
article.articleSummary: DRC reports 1,708 confirmed Ebola cases and 580 deaths since the outbreak began, with 280 recoveries and 680 currently hospitalized. Contact and patient follow-up stands at 75.2% across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. The eastern DRC outbreak unfolds amid years of conflict and displacement, with parts of North Kivu and South Kivu under partial M23 rebel control. Another health worker in Ituri contracted Ebola. Surveillance, treatment, public awareness and community support activities continue. In May, WHO declared the DRC and Uganda Ebola outbreaks a public health emergency of international concern. Last week, WHO launched the PARTNERS clinical trial in the DRC to evaluate two experimental Bundibugyo virus disease treatments—MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir—and to assess potential combination therapy. No approved treatments exist across all Ebola virus types; trial selection followed safety and prior evidence.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱累計1,708症例・580人死亡を確認
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した大規模エボラ流行であり、症例・死亡数が多く、紛争地域での対応困難さや医療従事者感染など公衆衛生・国際的懸念が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダにも言及しているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRC国内（Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu）が主題。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola deaths in DR Congo reach 600
article.articleSummary: DRC Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak: 600 deaths and 1,759 confirmed cases. About 750 patients are in isolation or hospital care, bed occupancy 94%. Declared May 15, this is the DRC's 17th Ebola outbreak, affecting 37 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. Response constrained by community resistance to post-mortem sampling, insufficient treatment capacity, gaps in contact tracing, limited supplies, insecurity, and restricted access in armed-group areas. The World Health Organization has added the Bundibugyo Ebola virus molecular diagnostic test to its Emergency Use Listing and launched a clinical trial to evaluate potential treatments for Bundibugyo virus disease. Update current as of 2026-07-09.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死者数、600人に到達
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行が継続中(600死亡、1,759症例)、37保健区に拡大、治安・アクセス制約により対応が困難であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: DRC第17回目のエボラ流行、Bundibugyoエボラウイルス。WHOがEUL診断キット追加、治療薬の臨床試験開始。治安不安・住民の抵抗・接触者追跡の不備など対応上の重大な課題あり。

article.articleHeadline: Integrating environmental and clinical surveillance for typhoid: insights from a prospective wastewater surveillance study in urban India
article.articleSummary: Typhoid fever (Salmonella enterica serovar Typhi) in Vellore, Tamil Nadu, India, is studied through integrated environmental and clinical surveillance before the introduction of a typhoid conjugate vaccine (TCV). From 12 Dec 2022 to 30 Jun 2023, wastewater surveillance collected 723 grab samples and 723 Moore swabs at 50 sites, concentrating with Nanotrap A beads for grab samples and using Moore swabs as passive samplers. S. Typhi was detected by multiplex qPCR targeting ttr, staG, and tviB. Concurrent hospital-based surveillance captured blood culture-confirmed typhoid cases as part of the VeVact TyphiBEV trial (cluster-randomised). Researchers computed wastewater positivity proportions, clinical incidence rates, and performed spatial hotspot analysis; Bayesian INLA-based mixed-effects spatiotemporal models quantified associations between wastewater detection and typhoid incidence, informing baseline burden and vaccine impact assessments in an endemic urban setting.

triage.headline_ja: 腸チフスに関する環境サーベイランスと臨床サーベイランスの統合：インド都市部における前向き下水サーベイランス研究からの知見
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は腸チフスワクチン導入前の研究デザインに基づく学術的サーベイランス研究であり、新規のアウトブレイクや異常事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は腸チフスの流行地であるインド・タミルナードゥ州ヴェロールにおける通常の疾病負荷評価・ワクチン効果評価のための研究報告であり、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではないため対象国のverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة العالمية تحذر: فيروس إيبولا يهدد بالتوسع أكثر في الكونغو مع استمرار الإصابات الجديدة وتحديات ميدانية تعرقل جهود السيطرة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization warns: Ebola virus threatens to widen further in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as new infections continue and on-the-ground challenges hinder containment efforts.
article.articleSummary: As of July 9, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 1,708 cases and 580 deaths, according to government data. WHO's representative in the DRC, Anne Ancia, says the outbreak remains uncontained and is still in the transmission phase, with cross-regional movement fueling spread. Health facilities are strained, with Ebola treatment centers about 90% full. Ancia also notes Mongbwalu mineworkers who contract Ebola are not seeking care in the town itself but travel elsewhere, spreading infection. Persistent population mobility, ongoing insecurity, and a fragile health system complicate containment, hampering surveillance, isolation, and rapid response. Authorities warn that without effective health and field interventions to halt inter-regional transmission, numbers are likely to rise in the coming period.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが警告：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスがさらに拡大の恐れ、新規感染が続き現場の課題が封じ込めを妨げる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の症例・死亡者数が多数に上り、WHOが未制圧かつ拡大リスクを警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 致死率が高く（約34%）、鉱山労働者の移動による地域間拡大や治療センターの逼迫が報告されており、封じ込めの困難さが強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Death Toll in DR Congo Climbs to 600 as Outbreak Continues to Spread
article.articleSummary: 600 deaths and 1,759 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of the latest update, with 750 patients in isolation and bed occupancy at 94%. The Bundibugyo strain, declared May 15, is spreading across 37 health zones in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo; monoclonal antibody and antiviral therapies are under investigation, without confirmed efficacy. Transmission is linked to wildlife (fruit bats); human infection occurs via direct contact with infected fluids, with an incubation of 2–21 days and early flu-like symptoms that can progress to vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, bleeding, and organ failure. Response challenges include resistance to post-mortem sampling, limited supplies, insecurity restricting access, and incomplete contact tracing. The WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, and efforts focus on expanded testing, international support, and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱によるコンゴ民主共和国の死者数が600人に上昇、アウトブレイクは拡大を続ける
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した大規模エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクであり、死者600人・症例1,759件、37保健区に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み。承認済みワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しないブンディブギョ株による流行で、治安上の問題によりアクセスや接触者追跡が不完全な状況。フルリスク評価（RRA）への移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola deaths in Congo reach 600
article.articleSummary: 600 Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) amid a Bundibugyo outbreak; 1,759 confirmed cases and 750 patients in isolation or hospitalisation, bed occupancy at 94%. Declared May 15, the outbreak is the DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak, affecting 37 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. Response is hampered by community resistance to post-mortem sampling, insufficient treatment capacity, gaps in contact tracing, limited supplies, insecurity, and restricted access due to armed groups. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or specific treatment; WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Transmission from wildlife to humans occurs via direct contact with infected bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle pain, severe headache, sore throat, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, and bleeding in severe cases. Outbreak confirmed in DRC and Uganda in May 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者数が600人に達する
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した大規模なエボラ流行（600人死亡、1759人感染確認）であり、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例が確認されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・特異的治療法がないBundibugyo株であり、治安悪化や武装勢力による対応制限も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Health: Red Cross receives 20 vehicles for Ebola response in
article.articleSummary: Twenty donated vehicles to Congo Red Cross for Ebola response in Bunia, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of Congo. Eighteen brand-new Land Cruisers arrived from Belgium on a chartered flight, and two more vehicles arrived from Dubai two weeks earlier, bringing the total to 20. The fleet, donated by the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC) to Congo Red Cross via Uganda, will support emergency Ebola response operations in Bunia. The vehicles were received through Entebbe International Airport, the nearest entry point to Bunia, with IFRC regional fleet lead Nathan Kimani confirming the arrangement. This donation signals cross-border logistical support to front-line teams in the DRC Ebola response as activities continue.

triage.headline_ja: 保健:赤十字社、エボラ対応のため車両20台を受領
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ対応への物資支援に関する記事であり、新規発生や感染状況の悪化を示す情報はないが、既知のエボラアウトブレイクが継続中であることを示唆するため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ対応のための車両支援に関するロジスティクス情報であり、新規感染者数や死亡者数などの疫学的詳細は含まれていない。DRC・Ituri州Buniaでの既存エボラアウトブレイク対応が継続中であることを示す。

article.articleHeadline: Raw pork warning grips Phrae after deadly ear fever toll
article.articleSummary: Phrae province in upper northern Thailand tightened measures against raw pork after Streptococcus suis infections and deaths placed the province at the top of the region's risk list. On July 9, 2026, Phrae Governor Somchai Lertprasittiphan chaired a meeting of the provincial communicable disease committee at the Phrae Provincial Public Health Office to break the transmission cycle linked to raw or undercooked pork. Attendees included Dr Nopparat Watcharakhajornkul, the provincial public health doctor, and committee members. The illness, locally known as 'ear fever' or 'raw pork fever,' is associated with consuming raw pork dishes and handling contaminated pork products. In severe cases, it can lead to hearing loss or death. Authorities pledged tougher action against raw pork dishes to reduce illness and fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: 生豚肉への警告、致死的な『耳の熱』による死亡でプレー県が緊張
triage.triage_reason: 豚レンサ球菌症（Streptococcus suis）による死亡例が発生し重症化（難聴・死亡）が確認され、州政府が対策委員会を招集するなど行政の関心が高まっているため、スクリーニング基準（重症度・曝露継続）と社会的関心が該当する。
triage.notes: Streptococcus suis感染はタイ北部で既知の風土病であり、生豚肉喫食習慣に起因する食品媒介感染症。ヒト-ヒト感染や国際拡大の可能性は低いが、地域内での重症化・死亡例増加により行政が対応を強化している。国際的リスクは限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Financial Times: Ебола у ДР Конго је генерална проба за нову пандемију
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Financial Times: Ebola in the DRC is a general rehearsal for a new pandemic.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused 86 confirmed deaths. The Financial Times calls the outbreak a general rehearsal for a future pandemic, set against declining international health funding and eroding public trust in science. The article notes that it is unlikely the Ebola virus alone will spark the next pandemic, but highlights how reduced investment in global health can undermine outbreak response. It additionally suggests that future pandemics may be driven by Western pharmaceutical companies seeking profits as health spending falls. The piece does not provide detailed laboratory confirmation information or explicit infection sources, nor mention imported/exported cases. It frames the Congo outbreak as a cautionary example of how funding cuts and skepticism toward science could shape future global health.

triage.headline_ja: フィナンシャル・タイムズ：DR コンゴのエボラ流行は新たなパンデミックに対する総リハーサルである
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱による86人の死亡確認が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）およびWPRO基準（重症度・流行しやすさ）に該当するため、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は国際的な保健資金削減とパンデミック論評が主旨であり、詳細な疫学データ（症例数、感染経路、地域拡大状況）は不足している。続報でのエボラ流行状況の具体的確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Speech by Commissioner Lahbib at the European Parliament on the Ebola Outbreak in Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda
article.articleSummary: On 9 July 2026, Ebola is spreading in DRC and Uganda, with Bunia, Ituri, as the epicentre. The EU prioritises solidarity and coordination: ECDC says EU risk is low, but vigilance remains; Health Security Committee issued a common EU approach, and France demonstrated rapid response for an imported case. The EU has mobilised about EUR 493 million for humanitarian aid, vaccines, treatments and health security, including EUR 100 million for preparedness and EUR 16.5 million for diagnostics. CEPI receives EUR 39.3 million for broadly protective filovirus vaccines; EUR 15 million supports WHO and frontline partners; more than 590 tonnes of essential supplies have been shipped to eastern DRC via eight EU Humanitarian Air Bridges. Multilateral funding through Pandemic Fund, Gavi and Global Fund supports the Global Health Resilience Initiative. The call remains for sustained financing and respect for International Humanitarian Law, with ongoing surveillance, exit screening and community trust.

triage.headline_ja: ラビブ欧州委員が欧州議会でコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのエボラ出血熱流行について演説
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダでエボラ出血熱が拡大し、フランスへの輸入症例も発生。EUが多額の資金・物資を投入し国際的な公衆衛生対応が進行中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・フランスも記事の主題国だが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。フランスは輸入症例のみで発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ascienden a 600 muertes por ébola en RD del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll rises to 600 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 9 July 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 600 Ebola deaths and 1,759 confirmed cases from the Bundibugyo strain. About 750 patients remain in isolation or hospitalization, with bed occupancy at 94%. The outbreak, declared on May 15, is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the country and has affected 37 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Response efforts continue amid challenges including community resistance to post-mortem sampling, limited treatment capacity, gaps in contact tracing, supply shortages, insecurity, and restricted access due to armed groups. Laboratory confirmation is ongoing as cases accumulate, underscoring sustained strain on health services in the affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ死者数600人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で死者600人、致死率も高く、37保健地域に拡大、医療体制逼迫と治安不安により国際的懸念が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 第17次エボラ流行、Bundibugyo株。ベッド稼働率94%、接触者追跡の遅れ、武装勢力による アクセス制限など対応課題が多い。

article.articleHeadline: কঙ্গোতে ইবোলায় মৃত ৬০০ ছাড়াল, বাড়ছে সংক্রমণ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 600 dead from Ebola in Congo as infections rise.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 600 deaths with 1,759 infections. A government update published July 8, 2026 shows 51 new infections and 20 deaths in the previous 24 hours, as of July 7, 2026. Two additional suspected cases in Kisangani, capital of Tshopo Province, await laboratory confirmation; one traces to Niaya-Nia village in Ituri where the outbreak began, while the other’s exposure source remains unclear. Ituri remains hardest hit, with health workers in salary disputes over delayed pay and inadequate protective gear during the response. A trial regimen for Bundibugyo Ebola is underway, though no licensed vaccine exists for this strain. The outbreak initially spread in Mongbwalu, Rwampara, and Bunia before crossing into neighboring provinces; the WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in May as authorities mobilized to contain the spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ死者600人超、感染拡大続く
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ流行はWHOがPHEICを宣言済みで、死者600人超・感染1759人と深刻化し、新たな州（キサンガニ）への拡大や医療従事者の対応困難も報告されているため、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にルワンダ（Kigali Province等）が含まれるが、記事本文はDRC国内（イトゥリ州、ツォポ州キサンガニ）の状況を主に述べており、ルワンダでの発生は記載がないため対象国リストにも該当せず除外。ワクチン未承認・医療従事者の給与未払い等、対応能力への懸念も強い。

article.articleHeadline: Halálos vírus szabadult el, az egyik leggyilkosabb járvány terjedhet el, brutális halálozási arányok már most
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A deadly virus has been unleashed; one of the deadliest outbreaks could spread, with brutal mortality rates already.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola Bundibugyo strain in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in Bunia with spread to surrounding areas. There have been 1,708 laboratory-confirmed infections and 580 deaths, making it the most severe Bundibugyo outbreak to date. The World Health Organization states the outbreak remains in a growth phase and has not stabilized; high population mobility is a key driver of transmission. Ebola treatment centers are operating near full capacity, with up to 90% occupancy. Infected workers from the Mongbwalu mining town frequently seek care in other towns, further spreading the virus. The response is hindered by ongoing military conflict, security concerns, and a weak health system in the DRC. It remains uncertain whether the deadly virus will continue to spread.

triage.headline_ja: 致死性ウイルスが拡散、最も致命的な流行の一つが広がる可能性、既に凄惨な死亡率
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ(ブンディブジョ株)の大規模流行が進行中で、致死率が高く、紛争・脆弱な医療体制により国際的拡大リスクが高いためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 1,708例の検査確定例と580人の死亡が報告され、過去最大規模のブンディブジョ株流行。紛争地域での対応が困難で、鉱山労働者の移動が感染拡大の要因となっている。

article.articleHeadline: Confirmed Ebola deaths in DR Congo hit 600
article.articleSummary: Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reach at least 600 with 1,759 confirmed cases, as of July 9, 2026. Government data released on Wednesday show 51 new cases and 20 deaths in the prior 24 hours. Two Kisangani cases are awaiting validation; one is linked to Nia-Nia village in Ituri province where the outbreak began, the other has no geographic link beyond Kisangani. Ituri remains the hardest-hit of DRC’s three eastern provinces. Healthcare workers in Ituri threaten to walk off over delayed payments, with wages/bonuses unpaid since the outbreak was declared on May 15; some have already stopped working, though no official strike has been declared. The reported figures reflect confirmed infections and fatalities, with testing ongoing to validate linked cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ確定死者数600人に達する
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクで死者600人、症例1,759件と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、医療従事者の離脱リスクによる対応能力低下も懸念されるためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: Ituri州の医療従事者への賃金未払いによる離職・ストライキの動きがあり、アウトブレイク対応能力に影響する可能性がある点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Ученые доказали значение Каспия в глобальной динамике птичьего гриппа
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists have proven the Caspian Sea's significance in the global dynamics of avian influenza.
article.articleSummary: Twenty-year analysis of avian influenza data led by Dagestan State University shows the Caspian Sea as a crucial ecological hub linking Eurasia and Africa in the global dynamics of bird flu. Genomic analysis of mass die-offs of colonial seabirds on northern Caspian islands in 2022–2023 reveals intercontinental exchange of viral material, confirming the Caspian region as a significant node for viral movement and a key site for early warning. The findings support more precise epidemiological monitoring, biodiversity protection, and risk assessments for veterinary, poultry, livestock, and human health in the Caspian region. Funded by the RNF-Dagestan program, the work involved Dagestan State University, Caspian Nature Protection Center, Astrakhan Nature Reserve, the Institute of Virology, and the Veterinary University of Vienna. Led by Alimurad Gadzhiev, the study enhances international collaboration and preparedness for zoonotic threats.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者たちがカスピ海の鳥インフルエンザ世界的動態における重要性を証明
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はカスピ海地域における鳥インフルエンザの生態学的研究成果を報告する学術的内容であり、対象国での実際の感染発生事例を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア・ダゲスタン州立大学等による20年間のカスピ海地域鳥インフルエンザ生態学研究の成果報告。発生地域にタイ・アフリカが含まれるが、記事の主題はカスピ海（ロシア）の野生鳥類での事例であり、対象国リストに該当する国での発生事例ではない。

article.articleHeadline: What Is Leptospirosis? BMC Warns of Waterborne Disease That Spreads Through Floodwater
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis, a bacterial illness caused by Leptospira, poses rising risk in Mumbai during the monsoon as floodwater mixes with drainage water. Transmission occurs when skin or mucous membranes contact water or soil contaminated by urine from infected animals (rats, dogs, cattle, pigs); entry can occur via cuts or through eyes, nose, or mouth. As the monsoon floods expand, city hospitals report increasing patient numbers. The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) issued an advisory and urged residents to avoid flooded streets, using waterproof boots and covering wounds before entering flooded areas. High-risk groups include pedestrians, sanitation workers, and clean-up personnel. Common symptoms: fever, red eyes, and muscle pain. People with fever after floodwater exposure should seek evaluation at municipal hospitals or Balasaheb Thackeray Medical Centre for treatment.

triage.headline_ja: レプトスピラ症とは？BMC、洪水を通じて広がる水系感染症について警告
triage.triage_reason: 毎年モンスーン期にムンバイで発生する既知の風土病であり、BMCが注意喚起している段階。国際的拡大や渡航制限の可能性は低いが、季節性の患者増加傾向が見られるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: モンスーン期の風土病的発生であり、BMCによる注意喚起・対策が既に取られている。重症例数や死亡者数の詳細情報が記事中にないため、severityは不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع وفيات إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 600
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rise to 600.
article.articleSummary: Deaths from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have reached 600, with 1,759 confirmed cases. Health authorities reported 51 new infections and 20 new fatalities in the past 24 hours. The World Health Organization said the deadly Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus in eastern DR Congo is expanding, as containment pressures persist to speed up testing and identify effective treatments. There are currently no vaccines or approved therapies for the Bundibugyo strain. The outbreak remains active in the eastern regions, highlighting the need for enhanced laboratory capacity, rapid diagnosis, and intensified public health responses to limit transmission. The article emphasizes ongoing challenges in managing the Bundibugyo-driven outbreak within the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラによる死者が600人に増加
triage.triage_reason: 大規模なエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクで死者600人・症例1759件に達し、ワクチン・治療法が確立されていないため、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: ワクチン・承認された治療法が存在しないブンディブギョ株による流行拡大中で、致死率・症例数ともに深刻。WHOも拡大を確認しており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Vai Ebola var sasniegt Eiropu? Ekspertu prognoze
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Can Ebola reach Europe? Expert forecasts.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, could theoretically reach Europe, the Middle East, and Asia within 30 days via infected travelers, according to Japanese researchers using a global air-travel model. The analysis incorporated data for over 11,000 airports, 569,000 routes, and about 330 million travelers, identifying Belgium, France, the United Arab Emirates, Turkey, Kenya, and South Africa as likely entry hubs. The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control deems the immediate risk to the EU as very low (below 1%), requiring roughly 24,000 travelers from the outbreak zone for one importation. By mid-June, Bundibugyo-confirmed cases exceeded 780 with 181 deaths. No vaccine or specific treatment exists for Bundibugyo; transmission requires close contact with bodily fluids, not airborne. WHO and the EU view large-scale spread outside Africa as unlikely, though vigilance is essential.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱はヨーロッパに到達するか？専門家の予測
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで発生中のブンディブギョ株エボラ出血熱の症例数(780超)・死亡者数(181)が多く、国際的な航空機モデルによる伝播リスクが指摘されているため、IHR基準複数該当と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダで発生中のブンディブギョ株エボラ出血熱について、日本の研究者による航空旅客データを用いた国際拡散リスク予測を報じている。対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ECDCはEUへの直接的リスクを低いと評価しているが、致死率が高く(約23%)、公衆衛生上の懸念は大きい。

article.articleHeadline: Doctors warn of a hidden monsoon threat in Mumbai: Why Leptospirosis is being mistaken for viral fever, dengue and malaria
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis, a bacterial zoonotic infection, poses a hidden monsoon threat in Mumbai as heavy rainfall, floods and stagnant water create conducive conditions for transmission. The bacteria survive in water and wet soil contaminated with urine from infected animals, notably rats. Doctors warn that fever after floodwater exposure is often mistaken for ordinary viral fever, dengue or malaria, delaying correct diagnosis and allowing organ involvement. The National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC) notes leptospirosis as an important zoonotic disease in India, with cases tending to rise after heavy rainfall and flooding. As Mumbai's monsoon continues, heightened clinical vigilance is needed to distinguish leptospirosis from other febrile illnesses and ensure timely medical evaluation.

triage.headline_ja: 医師らが警告：ムンバイの隠れたモンスーン脅威 ― レプトスピラ症がウイルス性熱、デング熱、マラリアと誤診されている理由
triage.triage_reason: 毎年のモンスーン季節に見られる既知の風土病について、誤診への注意喚起を促す一般的な医療啓発記事であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常な公衆衛生事象の報告ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は具体的な症例数・アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、モンスーン季節における鑑別診断の重要性を説く医療啓発記事である。既知の季節性疾患であり、新規性・異常性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع إصابات "إيبولا" في الكونغو إلى 1708 حالات وسط تحذيرات من استمرار التفشي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rise to 1,708 cases amid warnings that the outbreak will continue.
article.articleSummary: As of July 9, 2026, Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have reached 1,708 confirmed cases and 580 deaths. Government data released midweek show the outbreak remains uncontrolled, still in a transmission phase rather than containment. The World Health Organization representative in Congo warned that ongoing transmission is driven by population movement between regions, contributing to broader spread of the virus. The report underscores persistent transmission dynamics and the challenge of limiting spread amid cross-regional mobility, emphasizing the need for sustained surveillance, rapid isolation of cases and rigorous contact tracing to curb transmission and prevent further escalation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染者が1708例に増加、流行継続への警告相次ぐ
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRCで1708例・580死亡と大規模化し、地域間移動による感染拡大が継続中で、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 致死率は580/1708で約34%と高く、WHOも流行の未制御状態を認めている。継続的なモニタリングと詳細なリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh báo nguy cơ virus lở mồm long móng chủng SAT-1 xâm nhập Việt Nam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning: Risk of SAT-1 foot-and-mouth disease virus entering Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: SAT-1 foot-and-mouth disease virus presents a clear entry risk for Vietnam as cross-border animal and product movements intensify. SAT-1 has been detected in Gansu and Xinjiang, China, roughly 400 km from Vietnam’s border, underscoring a tangible incursion threat. Existing FMD vaccines offer near-zero cross-protection against SAT-1, meaning vaccination would not shield herds if SAT-1 were introduced. Vietnam has not recorded SAT-1, but its livestock are fully susceptible and current vaccines do not confer protection; early detection and tight coordination among veterinary authorities, vaccine producers, and farmers are essential. SAT-1, while not new, has circulated in the Middle East, Europe, and more recently China and Mongolia since 2025–26, increasing risk for East and Southeast Asia. Symptoms resemble other serotypes: fever, excessive salivation, vesicles and ulcers in mouth, feet, and teats; calves may suffer myocarditis and sudden death. Lab typing or sequencing confirms infection; vaccines must be strain-matched; maintain herd immunity >80%; enforce strict biosafety in sampling and transport; emphasize surveillance and cross-sector collaboration.
