article.articleHeadline: Ebola health workers strike in hardest-hit Congo towns as outbreak intensifies
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-09, Ebola in eastern DRC intensifies amid health worker strikes over unpaid benefits and deteriorating conditions, complicating containment of an outbreak that has infected more than 1,700 people and killed at least 600 nationwide. In Ituri province’s Bunia and neighboring Rwampara, 847 confirmed Ebola infections have been recorded, about half the country’s total. Treatment centers are at a saturation point per WHO; 118 patients were admitted on Tuesday, more than twice June’s average. Striking workers include long-standing unpaid staff; authorities say payment issues relate to banking transfers. Kisangani reports two suspected cases with preliminary PCR positives: one linked to the Nia-Nia outbreak, the other with no geographic link, raising urban transmission concerns. More than 12,400 contacts are under daily monitoring across 37 zones; UNICEF aims to reach about 900,000 households, and Direct Relief is shipping IV fluids and medicines to sustain care.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ最悪の被害都市で医療従事者がストライキ、エボラ流行が激化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ感染者1,700人超・死亡600人超と大規模な公衆衛生危機であり、医療従事者ストライキによる対応能力低下、都市部（キサンガニ）への拡大懸念など複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当する。
triage.notes: ルワンダ（Kigali Province, Republic of Rwanda）は発生地域に含まれるが、記事本文はDRC国内の状況（Ituri州Bunia、Kisangani）に限定されており、ルワンダでの発生は言及されていないため対象国リストに含まれるが除外。ルワンダは対象国リストにも含まれていない。都市部キサンガニでの疑い例は地理的関連が不明な感染源であり、都市間伝播の懸念が高まっている点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: ปทุมธานี ประกาศ เขตควบคุมพิเศษ 3 อำเภอ หลังผลแล็บยันหมาจรจัดไล่กัดคน 'ติดพิษสุนัขบ้า'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pathum Thani declares three districts as special control zones after lab results confirm rabies in stray dogs that chased and bit people
article.articleSummary: Rabies confirmed in a white stray male dog in Pathum Thani Province, triggering outbreak zones across Lat Lum Kaew, Sam Khok, and Mueang Pathum Thani districts. The dog, observed in Ku Bang Luang Subdistrict (Moo 7 and 9), bit two people and several dogs on July 5, 2026. It was sedated, captured, and died July 6; heads tested confirmed rabies by Pathum Thani Livestock Office. Zones declared under Rabies in Animals Act. Affected areas include Ku Bang Luang (Moo 7–9), Rat Haeng (Lat Lum Kaew) and parts of Bang Toey, Bang Luang, Ban Chang in the three districts. Effective July 7–Aug 5, 2026. Two people bitten; 10 dogs bitten; seven dogs vaccinated and quarantined; first dose given; four-dose schedule with 4-day intervals. Vaccination drive within 5 km, prioritizing 1 km. Public urged to avoid contact with strays and seek vaccination. Hotlines: 02-967-9770, 02-581-6454 ext 305.

triage.headline_ja: パトゥムタニー県、野良犬が人を襲い噛んだ後の検査で狂犬病感染が確認され、3郡を特別管理区域に指定
triage.triage_reason: タイの地方における野良犬の狂犬病確認事例で、地方自治体が通常の防疫措置（隔離・ワクチン接種・区域指定）を実施しており、国際的拡大リスクや異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はタイで地方流行的に発生する疾患であり、地方自治体（畜産局）が既存法（Rabies in Animals Act）に基づき通常対応を実施している。人への感染例（発症）は報告されておらず、噛まれた2名も予防的処置の対象。ルーチンの公衆衛生対応と判断。

article.articleHeadline: В африканской стране число умерших от Эболы достигло 600
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In an African country, the death toll from Ebola has reached 600.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) reaches 600 lab-confirmed deaths, with 20 fatalities in the last 24 hours. Total lab-confirmed cases stand at 1,759, up 51 from the previous day; the case fatality rate is 34.1%. Currently, 750 patients are under observation in hospitals and isolation facilities. The outbreak began in mid-May in eastern DRC and Uganda, with the epicenter in DRC’s Ituri Province. The weekly bulletin from the Ministry of Communications and Media provides ongoing updates on transmission and case burden, confirming lab-confirmed deaths. The article does not specify infection sources or details on imported/exported cases. Public health authorities continue to monitor patients as the outbreak persists in Ituri and neighboring regions.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのある国でエボラによる死者数が600人に達した
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクで死者600人・致死率34.1%と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、DRC・ウガンダにまたがる国際的拡大の懸念があるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。エピセンターはDRCのイトゥリ州。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : deux cas confirmés à Kisangani, une ville jusque-là épargnée par l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: two confirmed cases in Kisangani, a city that had so far been spared from the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Two confirmed Ebola virus disease cases have been identified in Kisangani, the capital of Tshopo Province, DRC. One patient is linked to Nia-Nia health zone in Ituri, the outbreak epicenter; the other shows no geographic link beyond Kisangani. Both samples tested positive by RADIONE PCR; confirmatory RT-PCR using Altona technology is ongoing, with additional investigations underway. These two cases are not yet counted in the outbreak’s cumulative tally but are expected to be added in forthcoming situation reports once validated. Kisangani operations are underway to establish and strengthen all pillars of the response. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, declared May 15 by the Ministry of Public Health. As of July 7, the outbreak had 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths (case fatality 34.1%), across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu; Tshopo had not been affected prior to these cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：キサンガニで2例確認、これまで流行の影響を受けていなかった都市で発生
triage.triage_reason: 進行中の第17次エボラ流行（致死率34.1%）が、これまで感染のなかったチョポ州キサンガニに拡大し、うち1例は感染経路不明であるため、国際的拡大リスクと異常事態としてフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 1例は感染経路（疫学的リンク）が特定されておらず、未検出の感染連鎖が存在する可能性があるため、さらなる地理的拡大の懸念あり。確定患者数（累計1,759例、死亡600例）には未だ反映されていない新規例。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго число умерших от лихорадки Эбола возросло до 600 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, the death toll from Ebola fever has risen to 600 people.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo have climbed to 600, with 1,759 laboratory-confirmed cases and 750 recoveries as of July 9, 2026. The Ministry of Communications and Media reports the outbreak continues in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, where epidemiological surveillance and medical care are being strengthened. Currently 285 patients are under treatment. The statement notes that treatment outcomes are improving, with about 750 recoveries accounting for nearly 94% of patients discharged from treatment centers. Ongoing response efforts aim to curb transmission through frontline clinical care, surveillance, and supportive services across the three provinces.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ熱による死者数が600人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクで死者600人、確定症例1,759例に達しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクがあるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: イトゥリ州、北キブ州、南キブ州にまたがる継続的なアウトブレイク。死亡率は依然高いが回復率も改善傾向（退院者の約94%が回復）。

article.articleHeadline: 全球醫藥焦點：剛果伊波拉疫情擴大、減肥藥市場競爭白熱化 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global Medical and Pharmaceutical Spotlight: Ebola Outbreak in Congo Expands, Weight-Loss Drug Market Competition Heats Up
article.articleSummary: As of July 9, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to expand. WHO and DRC figures show more than 1,700 confirmed Ebola cases and nearly 600 deaths, driven by the Bundibugyo strain. There is no proven effective treatment or vaccine, and transmission is being amplified by frequent population movement, hindering containment. In parallel, the global obesity-drug market remains competitive, with Kailera Therapeutics' oral HRS-7535 achieving primary efficacy in Chinese trials but causing high rates of nausea and vomiting, sending its stock lower. In renal disease news, FDA recently approved Trutakna from Vera Therapeutics for IgA nephropathy. Politically, Erica Schwartz is set to testify before the U.S. Senate on July 15 as the prospective CDC director.

triage.headline_ja: 世界医薬品フォーカス：コンゴのエボラ疫病拡大、減量薬市場の競争激化 - 民視新聞網
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が拡大し、1,700例超・死者600人近くに達しており、有効な治療法・ワクチンがなく人口移動により感染拡大リスクが高いため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴのエボラ疫病拡大が主題。米国・中国への言及は減量薬治験やCDC長官候補の議会証言など別トピックであり、エボラ発生地域には該当しないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Нападат медици с мачете заради дезинформацията за ебола в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Medics attacked with machetes over Ebola misinformation in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is being hampered by misinformation that has sparked violence against health workers. Since mid-May, the outbreak has infected more than 1,700 people and killed about 580, according to government data. In Bunia, volunteers from the Red Cross were attacked with fists, spades, and machetes while conducting a safe burial for a person who died of Ebola; the crowd believed the coffin was empty. The assault reflects broader misinformation including claims that Ebola does not exist, that health teams are spreading the disease, or that responders are profiting. BBC Verify documented 12 instances of community resistance, including attacks on facilities and interference with safe burials; the true number is likely higher. Ebola transmits through direct contact with infected fluids, and bodies remain highly contagious after death, necessitating strict burial procedures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラに関する誤情報を理由に医療従事者がマチェーテで襲撃される
triage.triage_reason: エボラアウトブレイクで1,700人以上感染、580人死亡という深刻な公衆衛生被害があり、誤情報による医療従事者への暴力や安全な埋葬妨害がヒト-ヒト感染拡大リスクを高めているためIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 誤情報による安全な埋葬妨害と医療従事者への暴力が感染拡大リスクを増大させており、対応能力の低下が懸念される。BBC Verifyによると地域社会の抵抗事例は少なくとも12件確認されているが実数はさらに多い可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Число смертей от Эболы в ДР Конго достигло 600
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola in DR Congo has reached 600.
article.articleSummary: 600 confirmed Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with more than 1,750 cases and a 34.1% case-fatality rate as of July 9, 2026. In the last 24 hours, 20 deaths were reported; 750 patients remain under hospital or medical isolation. The outbreak began May 15 in eastern DR Congo and Uganda, with the epicenter in Ituri Province. By July 6, DR Congo had 1,560 confirmed cases, CFR 32.4%. Authorities link rising transmission to the Bundibugyo lineage, for which no vaccine or treatment exists, and note that the situation is complicated by ongoing armed conflict in the region. Reported by the Ministry of Communications and Media in its weekly X bulletin.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱による死者数が600人に達した
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行(死者600人、症例1750件超、致死率34.1%)がワクチン・治療法のないBundibugyo系統によるもので、武力紛争地域での対応困難という国際的懸念事項があり、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として記載されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。武力紛争によりワクチン未承認のBundibugyo系統の流行が対応を困難にしている点が重要な懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: 广西疾控：暴雨灾区传染病疫情总体平稳，需重点防范五类疾病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guangxi CDC: The infectious disease situation in flood-affected areas is generally stable; focus on preventing five categories of diseases.
article.articleSummary: Guangxi, China, after Typhoon Measak-triggered floods, sees a generally stable infectious-disease picture but heightened risk of enteric, vector-borne, and respiratory illnesses in affected areas. The Guangxi Center for Disease Control and Prevention has activated a comprehensive post-disaster surveillance system: daily case analysis from clinics, symptom sentinel reporting at temporary medical points and resettlement sites, and zero-report protocols for diarrhoea, fever, and rash to enable rapid detection; active health patrols; intensified drinking-water quality testing; and vector-density monitoring. If signals arise, rapid outbreak investigation and targeted control are deployed. Environmental sanitation focuses on flooded areas, resettlement sites, markets, and schools, addressing water-source contamination, standing water, pests, and moldy foods. Five priority disease categories are emphasized: enteric diseases (dysentery, typhoid, cholera, hepatitis A, norovirus), foodborne illnesses from spoilage/contamination, vector-borne diseases (dengue, chikungunya, Japanese encephalitis), water-borne leptospirosis, and respiratory infections (influenza, Mycoplasma pneumoniae) in crowded shelters. Preventive guidance includes boiled water, safe food handling, mosquito protection, wound care, masking, and prompt medical care for fever or cough.

triage.headline_ja: 広西疾病予防管理センター：豪雨被災地の感染症状況は概ね安定、5種類の疾病への重点的な予防が必要
triage.triage_reason: 台風・洪水後の公衆衛生対応として広西CDCが監視体制を強化しているが、現時点で具体的な症例数や異常な流行報告はなく、予防的な注意喚起にとどまる。
triage.notes: 記事は台風後の洪水被災地における感染症サーベイランス体制強化に関する予防的報告であり、具体的な症例急増や異常事態は報告されていない。続報で実際の症例数動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Antalet döda i ebola har passerat 600 i Kongo-Kinshasa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola has surpassed 600 in Kongo-Kinshasa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has claimed more than 600 lives in the Kongo-Kinshasa region, with 20 new deaths reported in the last 24 hours. As of Wednesday evening, 1,759 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases have been recorded. In Kisangani, two suspected Ebola cases were detected in a city that previously had no confirmed cases; one is linked to the Niania health zone in Ituri Province, though further testing is needed before it is counted in official statistics. The World Health Organization warns that movement of people between areas is driving transmission and hindering containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国（キンシャサ）でエボラによる死者数が600人を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の死者数が600人を超え、確定症例1,759件、キサンガニなど新地域への拡大の兆候があり、WHOも人の移動による感染拡大を警告しているため、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: キサンガニでの新規疑い症例は未確定であり、続報の確認が必要。WHOが人の移動による感染拡大への懸念を表明している点は重要。

article.articleHeadline: കോംഗോയിൽ എബോള ബാധിച്ച് മരിച്ചവരുടെ എണ്ണം 600 ആയി; ശമ്പളമില്ലാത്തതിൽ പ്രതിഷേധിച്ച് ആരോഗ്യപ്രവർത്തകർ സമരത്തിൽ | Ebola Death Toll Surpasses 600 in DRC as Cases Rise
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll has reached 600 in Congo; health workers are on strike over unpaid salaries.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 600 deaths and 1,759 confirmed cases, with 51 new cases and 20 deaths in the last 24 hours. In Kisangani, the capital of Chopo Province and one of Congo’s largest cities, two suspected cases await laboratory confirmation; results are pending and will be added to official tallies. One case is linked to Ni-Ni village in Ituri province; the second case has no clear geographic link, signaling further spread. Frontline health workers in Ituri are striking over unpaid salaries, with many already stopping work as pay remains unsettled since the outbreak began on May 15; concerns include safety equipment shortages and perceived discrimination. The Bundibugyo strain has prompted clinical trials for vaccines, though no licensed vaccines exist. Reports also indicate spread to mining towns Mongbwalu, Rampar, and Bunia. If the strike continues, fatalities are likely to rise.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラによる死者数が600人に到達;給与未払いに抗議し医療従事者がストライキ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ死者600人・症例1759人と規模が大きく、大都市キサンガニへの拡大や医療従事者ストライキによる対応能力低下があり、国際的拡大リスクも懸念されるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株はワクチン未承認であり、医療従事者ストライキが継続すれば感染拡大・死亡増加のリスクが高い。キサンガニなど新規地域への拡大兆候にも注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes pacu pelacakan kontak erat 100 persen guna putus rantai TB
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health steps up 100 percent close-contact tracing to break the chain of TB transmission.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Ministry of Health announced a shift to mandatory 100% contact tracing of TB patients' families and close contacts to break transmission and accelerate elimination by 2030. In Jakarta, Deputy Health Minister Benjamin Paulus Octavianus urged this tracing, leveraging the Free Health Check Program (CKG), portable X-ray, and rapid tests, with 2026 funding secured. Local governments, private facilities, professional bodies, and community cadres are urged to participate. Based on 2024 data, Indonesia accounts for about 10% of global TB cases, with roughly 1.08 million ill and 126,000 deaths. The program rests on four pillars: mass case finding via CKG, immediate treatment for patients, preventive therapy for contacts, and cross-sector collaboration to village level. Symptomatic individuals or those exposed should visit the nearest puskesmas. BKPK head Asnawi Abdullah noted a five-year positive trend (notified cases +31%, treated +27%), yet stigma, remote access, and adherence remain challenges.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、結核の感染連鎖を断つため濃厚接触者の100%追跡を強化
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病である結核に対する政府の既存対策強化に関する報道であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 結核はインドネシアにおいて既知の風土病であり、本記事は新規異常事態ではなく既存の公衆衛生対策プログラムの強化に関する報道。

article.articleHeadline: एचआईवी का नया हॉटस्पॉट बनता पंजाब! युवाओं में बढ़ रहे संक्रमण ने बढ़ाई चिंता जीएमसी जम्मू की लैब पर बढ़ा दबाव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Punjab emerges as a new HIV hotspot! Rising infections among young people have heightened concerns, increasing pressure on GMC Jammu's lab.
article.articleSummary: Punjab is emerging as an HIV hotspot with rising infections concentrated among 25–30-year-olds; women and children are affected as well. In February 2026, GMC Jammu's Microbiology Laboratory gained NABL accreditation, becoming the state's first NABL-accredited virology lab, boosting testing capacity and reliability. Consequently, the lab now handles HIV test samples from Punjab districts including Hoshiarpur, Pathankot, Jalandhar, Rupnagar (Ropar), Moga, Batala, Nawanshahr, and Kapurthala. Health experts attribute transmission mainly to injection drug use via needles, along with unsafe sexual practices and delay in testing. The report emphasizes laboratory confirmation and signals a need for targeted public health interventions to curb the spread in Punjab.

triage.headline_ja: HIVの新たなホットスポットとなるパンジャブ州!若者の感染増加が懸念を高め、GMCジャンムーの検査室への負荷が増大
triage.triage_reason: パンジャブ州で若年層を中心にHIV感染が増加している地域的傾向が報告されているが、規模や公衆衛生への深刻な影響度など詳細情報が不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: HIVは既知の慢性感染症であり、IHR基準における急性公衆衛生事象としての性質は低いが、注射薬物使用や性行為による地域的な感染拡大傾向が報告されている点でWPRO基準に該当する。続報で感染規模や対策状況を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Число жертв вспышки лихорадки Эбола в ДР Конго увеличилось до 600
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo has risen to 600.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has 1,759 confirmed cases, 600 deaths, and 285 recoveries, yielding a 34.1% case fatality rate. The figures, cited by RIA Novosti from the DR Congo Ministry of Information and Communications, reflect official data on the ongoing outbreak. On 24 June, France reported its first Ebola case, illustrating widening international reach. The article also cites Russian infectious-disease expert Darya Namazova, who says the risk of Ebola spreading to Russia and other developed countries remains low. The report does not provide further transmission details or infection source within DR Congo. The count underscores ongoing mortality despite recoveries, as reported.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行による死者数が600人に増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が1,759症例・600死亡（致死率34.1%）に達し、既にフランスへの国際的拡大も報告されており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: フランスでの症例は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、国際的拡大のエビデンスとして重要。感染源やヒト-ヒト感染の詳細は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Deaths In Democratic Republic Of Congo Surpasses 500
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has infected 1,759 people and caused 600 deaths since the May 15 declaration. Suspected cases have been reported in Kisangani, the capital of Tshopo province, with two cases awaiting formal validation; one case is linked to the Niania health zone in Ituri, while the other has no clear geographic link beyond Kisangani. Positive test results are undergoing confirmatory testing and will be added to the official total. Response teams are strengthening surveillance, contact tracing, and containment in Kisangani. In the previous 24 hours, 51 new cases and 20 new deaths were recorded. The World Health Organization says the outbreak has not yet stabilised and continues to expand, driven by population movement. Affected eastern provinces include Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死者数が500人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の感染者1,759人・死者600人に達し、WHOも未収束かつ拡大継続中と表明しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 発生地域にマリ(Mali)が含まれているが、記事サマリー中で言及がなく主題はDRCのみのため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Број жртава еболе у Демократској Републици Конго достигао 600
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola victims in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 600.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 600 deaths in the current outbreak, with suspected cases reported in an additional province. The government reports 1,759 confirmed infections across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu since the outbreak was declared on May 15. Two new cases from Kisangani, capital of Tshopo Province, are not yet included in the official tally: one linked to the Nyani Health Zone in Ituri, where early cases emerged, and the other with no clear geographic link to previously affected areas. Positive Kisangani test results are undergoing confirmatory analyses before inclusion in official counts. Health teams have intensified surveillance, contact tracing, and other measures in Kisangani. In the past 24 hours, 51 new Ebola cases and 20 new deaths were reported. The WHO warns the outbreak remains uncontrolled, with population movement increasing transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラの死者数が600人に達した
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で複数州にわたり拡大し、死者600人・感染者1,759人に達し、新たな州(Tshopo)への拡大も疑われる制御不能な状況であり、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: WHOは本アウトブレイクが制御不能な状態にあると警告しており、Kisanganiでの新規症例確認・接触者追跡が進行中。続報でTshopo州への拡大確定状況を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: HIV di Jawa Tengah Capai 1.704 Kasus sepanjang 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HIV in Central Java Reaches 1,704 Cases Throughout 2026
article.articleSummary: Central Java records 1,704 new HIV cases in 2026 through April 30, bringing the eight-year provincial total to 41,743. Over the past five years, transmissions are dominated by men who have sex with men (MSM). Governor Ahmad Luthfi plans to instruct relevant regional agencies to implement early prevention steps in line with central government regulations. Per Presidential Regulation No. 111 of 2025, nonmilitary threats include LGBT issues. Zulfachmi, Head of the Central Java Health Office, notes MSM-driven transmission and high-frequency sexual contact as key drivers. Age distribution in 2026: 25–29 (265), 30–34 (244), 20–24 (235), 35–39 (194), 40–44 (180), 45–49 (152), 50–54 (125), 60+ (123), 55–59 (82), 15–19 (81), 0–4 (13), 5–9 (5), 10–14 (5). By district, Semarang City leads with 229 cases, followed by Banyumas (107) and Pati (98); Temanggung (20), Magelang (22), Purworejo (22), and Wonosobo (24) report the fewest.

triage.headline_ja: 中部ジャワ州、2026年のHIV症例が1,704件に達する
triage.triage_reason: HIVは既知の風土病的疾患であり、継続的なサーベイランスデータの報告に過ぎず、突発的な公衆衛生上の異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 地方政府による通常のHIVサーベイランス報告であり、MSM層における継続的感染が中心。新興感染症や急性アウトブレイクではないためEBSシグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Hàng nghìn người nhiễm giun sán ở Khánh Hòa: Chuyên gia cảnh báo những thói quen nhiều người vẫn mắc
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thousands of people infected with parasitic worms in Khánh Hòa Province: Experts warn about habits that many people still engage in.
article.articleSummary: Khánh Hòa Province, Vietnam, reports a surge in helminth infections. From March 1 to July 8, 2026, Khánh Hòa Tropical Diseases Hospital in Nha Trang tested 12,541 people for worm infections, with 3,427 positive results: 2,049 Toxocara canis/cati (dog- and cat-roundworm), 699 Fasciola hepatica (liver fluke), and 635 Strongyloides stercoralis (strongyloidiasis). All cases are treated per national guidelines. Experts warn habits such as eating raw vegetables from livestock areas, consuming undercooked meat, and close contact with pets drive transmission. Preventive measures include cooking food thoroughly, washing produce, avoiding raw aquatic greens in farming regions, handwashing with soap, regular deworming of dogs/cats, and proper disposal of pet waste. Potential severe outcomes include biliary disease and liver complications from liver fluke; respiratory and systemic effects from roundworms; and possible CNS involvement from strongyloides.

triage.headline_ja: カインホア省で数千人が寄生虫感染:専門家が多くの人が続けている習慣に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: 慢性的な食習慣由来の寄生虫感染症の増加報告であり、ヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大の可能性は低いが、長期的な曝露リスクが継続しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 感染経路は食習慣（生野菜、加熱不十分な肉、ペットとの接触）による人畜共通寄生虫症で、ヒト-ヒト感染は想定されない。地域の風土病的な性質が強く、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Число погибших от лихорадки Эбола в ДР Конго достигло 600 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola fever in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 600.
article.articleSummary: On July 9, 2026, the Ebola fever outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths, with 285 recoveries, yielding a case fatality rate of 34.1%. Earlier tallies reported 580 deaths. The World Health Organization classified the DRC–Uganda Ebola outbreak as extraordinary and posing a danger to other countries, with regional risk assessed as high. The article notes the outbreak in the DRC and neighboring Uganda but provides no details on transmission sources, clinical symptoms, or laboratory confirmation methods. No information on imported or exported cases is given. The report underscores the ongoing public health threat and cross-border risk in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱による死者数が600人に達した
triage.triage_reason: WHOが「異常」かつ他国への波及リスクありと分類した大規模エボラ流行で、致死率34.1%と深刻。IHR基準の複数該当が明確でありフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。感染経路・臨床症状・検査確認方法の詳細は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: V mozku našli ženě 38 parazitů. Vzácná nákaza jí způsobila záchvaty i psychózu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 38 parasites found in a woman's brain. A rare infection caused her seizures and psychosis.
article.articleSummary: Neurocysticercosis with 38 brain foci diagnosed in a Welsh woman after years of headaches and seizures. Britka Lowri Denmanová of Carmarthenshire found a one-meter tapeworm in 2010; stool tests were negative. MRI and CT showed 38 brain foci. Doctors believe infection occurred during a 2007, three-month trip to India, likely from ingesting tapeworm eggs in contaminated food, despite avoiding pork. Neurocysticercosis is rare in the UK; transmission can occur via contaminated food or water and poor hygiene. Treatment included two weeks of antiparasitic therapy and corticosteroids; improvement gave way to relapse with brain swelling around dying parasites, causing severe neurological and psychiatric symptoms, including anxiety, paranoia, and psychosis, leading to six weeks in a neuropsychiatric unit with no surgical removal. Since 2017 she has had no seizures but will require lifelong antiepileptics; parasites calcified and non-active. Dr. Brendan Healy called the case extraordinary; UK and US specialists were consulted; BBC reported.

triage.headline_ja: 女性の脳内に38匹の寄生虫が発見される。まれな感染症が発作と精神病を引き起こした
triage.triage_reason: 2007年にインド渡航中に感染したとされる単発の個人症例報告であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の脅威ではない。
triage.notes: 本症例は2007年のインド渡航時に感染したとされる個人の既往症例報告であり、現在インドで発生している公衆衛生イベントではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Число смертей от Эболы в ДР Конго достигло 600
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 600.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 600 confirmed deaths, with total fatalities surpassing 600 and confirmed cases over 1,750 (up 51). The case-fatality rate is around 34.1%. In medical facilities and isolation centers, 750 patients are under observation. The outbreak began May 15 in eastern DRC and Uganda, with the epicenter in Ituri Province. By July 6, confirmed DRC cases had risen to 1,560, with a CFR of 32.4%. Authorities attribute the surge to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which vaccines or effective therapies are not available, and note that ongoing armed conflict worsens the response. The WHO has deployed additional medical teams and diagnostic supplies. Local authorities urge strict hygiene, isolation of the sick, and public risk communication to prevent further spread, including cross-border concerns with Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴでのエボラ死者数が600人に達した
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRコンゴとウガンダで拡大し死者600人・致死率34%超、有効な治療法/ワクチンがなく武力紛争下で対応が困難なため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として記載されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ワクチン・有効治療法が存在しないBundibugyo株であること、武力紛争が対応を困難にしている点が重大。

article.articleHeadline: 感染源不明！香港入境20多歲男染M痘Ib型　疾管署籲速打2劑疫苗 - OwlNews
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unknown source of infection! Man in his 20s entering Hong Kong contracted mpox type Ib; CHP urges rapid two-dose vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Four new mpox cases confirmed in Taiwan: two locally acquired and two imported, ages 20s–40s. Onset after mid-May; symptoms include genital, limb and trunk rash with fever, chills and fatigue. One imported case, a man in his 20s arriving from Hong Kong, was genomically confirmed as Monkeypox virus Ib lineage; infection source under investigation; the other three infections are Clade II. By end-June 2026, about 110,000 people had at least one vaccine dose, with ~78,000 fully vaccinated; ~31,000 have not completed the second dose. Two-dose vaccination offers ~90% protection; one-dose ~40–80%. High-risk individuals are urged to complete two-dose vaccination; post-exposure vaccination can be given within 4 days of contact, or within 14 days if exposure occurred, with self-paid options in eight travel-medicine hospitals. Taiwan CDC notes 19 mpox cases this year (15 domestic, 4 imported) and Ib-type circulation in 63 countries.

triage.headline_ja: 感染源不明！香港から入境した20代男性がM痘（サル痘）Ib型に感染　台湾疾病管理署は2回接種のワクチン接種を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 台湾で感染源不明のMpox Ib系統（より重症度が高いとされるクレード）の輸入例が確認され、Ib型は既に63か国で流行しており国際的拡大リスクが高いため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 事案の主体は台湾（Taiwan）における新規4例（国内2例・輸入2例）であり、対象国リストにTaiwanは含まれない。香港は感染源候補として言及されているのみで、香港内での発生が確認された記述ではないためverified_locationsには含めなかった。Ib型のヒト-ヒト感染拡大が懸念されるため注視が必要。

Kisangani lab results are awaiting confirmatory analyses to be integrated into official counts. Health teams have intensified surveillance, contact tracing, and control measures in Kisangani. The World Health Organization warns the outbreak is not under control, with population movement continuing to drive transmission risk.

article.articleHeadline: 感染源不明！香港入境20多歲男染M痘Ib型　疾管署籲速打2劑疫苗 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unknown source of infection! Man in his 20s who arrived in Hong Kong contracted mpox type Ib; Taiwan CDC urges rapid two-dose vaccination - Minshi News Network
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports 4 new mpox cases in July 2026: 2 locally transmitted and 2 imported. Among the imported case, a man in his 20s arriving from Hong Kong tested positive for mpox Type Ib by genome sequencing; the infection source is under investigation. The other three cases are Clade II. Symptoms included genital, limb and trunk rash with fever and fatigue; onset since mid‑May. By end‑June, about 110,000 people in Taiwan had at least one vaccine dose, roughly 78,000 were fully vaccinated, leaving about 31,000 awaiting a second dose. Two-dose vaccination offers about 90% protection; one-dose about 40–80%. High‑risk groups are urged to complete two-dose vaccination; post‑exposure vaccination is advised within 4 days of contact, or within 14 days if exposed while asymptomatic. Since 2022, Taiwan has 535 confirmed mpox cases (496 local, 39 imported); this year by July 6, 19 cases (15 local, 4 imported), all male aged 20–50. Globally, Ib-type mpox has been detected in numerous countries.

article.articleHeadline: Smrtonosni virus se ne zaustavlja: Ebola odnela već 600 života, sada se pojavila u novoj provinciji - SZO u punoj pripravnosti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The deadly virus shows no signs of stopping: Ebola has already claimed 600 lives, and now it has appeared in a new province — WHO on full alert.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo persists, with 600 deaths among 1,759 confirmed cases since the epidemic was declared on May 15, across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. New transmission has emerged in Kisangani, the capital of Tshopo province, prompting heightened concern about spread to a major urban center. One confirmed patient is linked to the Njani health zone in Ituri, where the current outbreak began; a second patient has no clear epidemiological link yet, and authorities are investigating possible transmission routes. Kisangani test results are awaiting final confirmations before being added to official statistics. Health teams have intensified surveillance, case-finding, and contact tracing. In the last 24 hours, 51 new cases and 20 deaths were reported. WHO remains on full alert, citing population movement as a driver of expansion.

triage.headline_ja: 止まらぬ致死性ウイルス：エボラで既に600人死亡、新たな州でも発生 — WHOは全面警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が継続し死者600人・症例1759件に達し、大都市キサンガニへの新規伝播が確認されたためWHOが全面警戒。IHR基準複数該当、国際的拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: How to treat a dog bite: Essential first aid and rabies vaccine guide
article.articleSummary: New Delhi: WHO guidance after bites from dogs, cats, monkeys, foxes or mongooses stresses rabies prevention. Rabies is almost always fatal once symptoms appear; quick first aid and vaccination prevent infection. WHO exposure categories: Category 1—licking intact skin; Category 2—scratches or minor bites that do not bleed; Category 3—deep or bleeding wounds, bites on the head, neck or face, requiring both rabies vaccine and HRIG around the wound. First aid: wash the wound for 10–15 minutes under running water with soap; apply povidone-iodine; avoid home remedies. Rabies vaccine schedule: five doses on Day 0, 3, 7, 14, 28; tetanus and antibiotics may be prescribed. Incubation is typically 15–90 days, sometimes years. If vaccinated within 3 months previously, boosters may not be needed; re-exposure within five years may require boosters; after five years restart. Hydrophobia—fear of water—occurs as nerves are affected; survival after symptoms is rare. Prompt wound cleaning and vaccination are the most effective protection.

triage.headline_ja: 犬に噛まれた時の対処法:応急処置と狂犬病ワクチンの基本ガイド
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクや症例報告ではなく、狂犬病予防に関する一般的な啓発・ガイダンス記事であるため、シグナルとして扱う必要はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定の感染症発生事例ではなく、犬咬傷後の応急処置と狂犬病ワクチン接種に関する一般的な健康啓発記事である。具体的な症例数や発生状況の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: 广西:灾区传染病疫情总体平稳 多举措筑牢防控屏障
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guangxi: The infectious disease outbreak in disaster-stricken areas remains generally stable; multi-pronged measures to strengthen the prevention and control barrier.
article.articleSummary: Guangxi, China, after Typhoon Matsa-induced floods, reports that infectious disease activity in disaster-stricken areas remains generally stable. In Jinxiu Yao Autonomous County, Laibin City, along S206 road at Changdong Township’s Qingshan Village, flood-recovery work is underway. On July 6, a breach of Liulan Reservoir dam in Hengzhou, Nanning, flooded downstream areas; authorities activated an emergency monitoring and prevention system. Current indicators show no abnormal trends; overall infectious disease outbreaks are under control. A dual protection approach—monitoring and environmental remediation—has been deployed. Monitoring includes daily case review and dynamic alerts from disaster-area medical facilities; symptom sentinel points at temporary clinics and resettlement sites; strict diary and zero-report requirements for diarrhea, fever, and rash; proactive health patrols; intensified drinking-water quality testing and vector density surveillance to ensure early detection and targeted response. Environmental measures target flooded zones, shelters, markets, and schools to mitigate water contamination, standing water, vector breeding, and moldy foods.

triage.headline_ja: 広西：被災地の感染症流行は総じて安定、多角的措置で防疫バリアを強化
triage.triage_reason: 台風・洪水後の感染症サーベイランス状況報告であり、記事は「感染症の流行状況は総じて安定・制御下にある」と明言。異常な病原体や症例急増は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 疾患名は「Unknown Illness」だが実際には特定疾患の発生ではなく、洪水災害後の感染症サーベイランス・予防管理体制に関する行政報告。台湾は発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では言及されておらず除外。

article.articleHeadline: Jumlah korban tewas Ebola di Kongo capai 600 orang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in Congo reaches 600
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo’s ongoing Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) has 1,759 laboratory-confirmed cases and 600 deaths. About 750 patients are in isolation or hospital, with overall bed occupancy at 94%. Declared May 15, the outbreak is the 17th Ebola event in the country and spans 37 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces. Response efforts continue amid significant challenges, including community resistance to postmortem sampling, limited treatment capacity, gaps in contact tracing, shortages of supplies, and security constraints that hinder access in conflict-affected areas. Figures are based on a July 8, 2026 health update released on July 9, 2026, underscoring persistent difficulties in containment and the need for sustained public health measures in the three eastern provinces.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者数、600人に達する
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（1,759症例、600死亡）であり、複数州にまたがり拡大、封じ込めに重大な課題があるためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: 17回目のエボラ流行で、Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivuの3州37保健区域にまたがる大規模アウトブレイク。病床占有率94%、地域住民の遺体検体採取への抵抗、治安上の制約など封じ込めに深刻な課題あり。

article.articleHeadline: Nakes RD Kongo Mogok Kerja di Tengah Wabah Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo health workers go on strike amid Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: On July 9, 2026, health workers in the Democratic Republic of Congo who care for Ebola patients staged a work stoppage in protest of unpaid salaries and bonuses from the local government. The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to rise rapidly over the past several months. Since May 2026, the World Health Organization has designated Ebola as a global health emergency to prevent the spread of this dangerous disease. The strike highlights ongoing challenges in outbreak response as authorities work to manage cases and protect frontline staff amid the health alert. No case counts are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ流行の中で医療従事者がストライキ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がWHOにより国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態に指定されており、医療従事者のストライキが対応能力に影響を及ぼす懸念がある。IHR基準複数該当と社会的関心の高さからフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 症例数は本文に記載なし。WHOが2026年5月からエボラを国際的緊急事態と宣言している点は既存情報として重要。医療従事者のストライキは対応能力低下のリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola responders strike in DR Congo as treatment centres reach saturation point
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo worsens as Ituri health workers strike over unpaid benefits and deteriorating conditions, with treatment centers at a saturation point. More than 1,700 infections and at least 600 deaths; Ituri records 847 confirmed infections—nearly half of the national total. On Tuesday, facilities admitted 118 patients, over twice the June average, as WHO notes saturation but cannot confirm stabilization. Two suspected Ebola cases in Kisangani returned preliminary PCR positives, underscoring cross-provincial spread, while the virus has reached Boga in southern Ituri, with over 12,400 contacts under daily observation across 37 health zones. The strike followed talks with authorities; payment issues described as technical and being resolved. The health system remains strained, jeopardizing routine vaccinations and antenatal care. Direct Relief is sending 170 pallets of IV fluids; a treatment center in Kitatumba was arson-attacked, raising security concerns.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ対応要員がストライキ実施—治療センターは飽和状態に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は1,700人以上の感染、600人以上の死亡に達し、複数州への拡大、医療従事者のストライキ、治療施設の飽和、治安悪化（放火事件）など深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念がありIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 発生地域にLombardia（イタリア）が含まれるが、記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州、キサンガニ、ボガ）でのエボラ流行であり、イタリアへの拡大は言及されていないため除外。国際的な人道支援（Direct Relief）や治安悪化（放火事件）など、フルリスク評価が必要な複合的懸念事項がある。

article.articleHeadline: 90% Vaccination, Yet 750 Measles Deaths: Why Children Keep Dying In India's Neighbouring Bangladesh
article.articleSummary: Bangladesh faces its biggest measles outbreak in years, with more than 120,000 confirmed and suspected cases since mid-March and nearly 750 deaths, mostly children. Despite vaccination rates above 90%, the surge began in March after disruptions linked to the political transition, with UNICEF citing vaccine delays, and combining with COVID-19-era gaps, overcrowding, and Eid travel. Mymensingh Medical College Hospital reports an overwhelmed children’s ward with about 130 patients for 32 beds. Four-month-old Arafat, admitted with measles, developed pneumonia and heart failure, requiring oxygen. The outbreak poses an imported risk to India’s border states along a 4,000-km frontier—West Bengal, Assam, Tripura, Meghalaya, and Mizoram—where measles could spark local outbreaks if vaccination coverage remains low. Measles is extremely contagious; unvaccinated individuals can infect up to 9 of 10 contacts, with infants and malnourished children at greatest risk.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチン接種率90%でも麻疹による750人の死亡:インド隣国バングラデシュで子供が死亡し続ける理由
triage.triage_reason: バングラデシュで数年来最大規模の麻疹流行（12万人超の症例、750人死亡）が発生しており、インド国境5州への越境拡大リスクがあるため、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 実際の流行発生国はバングラデシュ（対象国リスト外）。インド国境州（西ベンガル、アッサム、トリプラ、メガラヤ、ミゾラム）は越境流入リスクとして言及されているが、記事内でインド国内での確定症例発生は報告されていないため、verified_locationsには含めなかった。今後インド国内での症例発生報告があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 感染源不明！香港入境20多歲男染M痘Ib型 疾管署籲速打2劑疫苗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unknown source of infection! Man in his 20s who recently entered Hong Kong contracted Mpox type Ib; CHP urges rapid two-dose vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) in Taiwan: Four new confirmed cases—two locally transmitted and two imported—bring this year’s total to 19 (as of July 6), with 15 local and 4 imported infections; all patients are men aged 20–50 who developed rashes on the genitals, limbs, and trunk, plus fever, chills, and fatigue after mid-May. One imported case is a man in his 20s who recently entered from Hong Kong and is infected with clade Ib mpox; the infection source remains under investigation. The other three cases are clade II. Vaccination coverage shows about 110,000 people with at least one dose, roughly 78,000 with two doses, and about 31,000 yet to receive a second dose. Two-dose vaccination offers ~90% protection; one-dose offers ~40–80%. High-risk individuals should complete two-dose vaccination; post-exposure vaccination is advised within 4 days of contact, or within 14 days if exposed but asymptomatic. Free two-dose vaccination is available at eight travel-medicine hospitals nationwide; paid options exist elsewhere.

triage.headline_ja: 感染源不明！香港から入境した20代男性がM痘（サル痘）Ib型に感染 疾管署は2回接種のワクチン接種を急ぐよう呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 台湾で今年19例目となるMpox感染例が確認され、うち1例は感染源不明のまま香港から入境した男性でクレードIb型（より重篤とされる系統）。地域内で局地感染も継続しており、国際的拡大リスクと異常性の両方が該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾におけるMpox感染拡大（局地15例・輸入4例）であり、香港は輸入症例の渡航歴として言及されているのみで、香港/中国本土での発生を示す記述はないため対象国リストには該当なしと判断した。台湾は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Disease control teams dispatched to Hengzhou, Binyang after flooding
article.articleSummary: Flooding in Guangxi’s Nanning region after Typhoon Maysak prompts deployment of hundreds of disease-control workers and thousands of sanitation staff to Hengzhou and Binyang counties. As of 9 July 2026, authorities warn elevated risk of infectious diarrhea, typhoid, influenza, allergic reactions from contaminated water, poor sanitation, and larger mosquito populations. Since Monday, disease prevention teams conducted surveillance, disinfection, and environmental hygiene work; on Wednesday, an additional 300+ professionals were sent to Yunbiao and Xiaoyi in Hengzhou and Gantang in Binyang. Disinfectants and testing reagents have been procured to support flood-related health work. Overall, more than 4,200 sanitation workers and 1,300 vehicle trips have been deployed to clear debris and restore hygiene. The Guangxi CDC reports stable infectious disease activity with no abnormal trends; an emergency surveillance system monitors drinking-water quality, symptoms, and vectors to enable early detection and rapid response if outbreaks occur.

triage.headline_ja: 洪水後、恒州・賓陽に疾病対策チームを派遣
triage.triage_reason: 台風後の洪水を受けた予防的な疾病対策措置であり、現時点でGuangxi CDCは感染症活動の異常なし・安定と報告しているが、今後の水系感染症・媒介動物増加のリスクは継続するため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は洪水後の予防的な公衆衛生対応（消毒・監視強化）を報じており、実際の感染症アウトブレイクの発生は確認されていない。CDCは感染症動向を『安定・異常なし』と報告している点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Monsoon wellness: Tips to stay ahead of flu, dengue and waterborne diseases
article.articleSummary: Monsoon season brings rises in influenza, dengue, malaria, and waterborne infections such as typhoid, cholera and gastroenteritis. Humidity fuels mosquitoes, bacteria, and viruses, increasing risk for homes and communities. Practical steps cut the risk: wash hands before eating, drink clean or filtered water, avoid cut fruits and exposed street foods, and favor freshly cooked meals. For mosquitoes, empty containers that collect rainwater, wear full-sleeve clothing at dawn and dusk, and use repellents or nets at home. If fever, body aches, or persistent cough occur, stay home to prevent spread; high fever with severe body pains, rashes, vomiting or dehydration warrants prompt evaluation, as early dengue diagnosis can prevent complications. Support wellness with regular sleep, stress management, vitamin C-rich fruits, vegetables, protein, and probiotic foods like curd, plus staying hydrated. Simple habits make monsoon wellness attainable.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン時の健康管理：インフルエンザ、デング熱、水系感染症を予防するコツ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の一般的な健康啓発記事であり、特定の異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は具体的な発生事例やデータを伴わない、モンスーン季節に伴う一般的な予防啓発記事であるため、シグナルとしては扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : deux cas confirmés à Kisangani, la Tshopo interdit l'entrée des corps sans vie en provenance d'autres zones touchées
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: two confirmed cases in Kisangani; Tshopo bans entry of dead bodies from other affected areas.
article.articleSummary: Two confirmed Ebola cases in Kisangani, Tshopo province, one linked to the Nia-Nia health zone in Ituri. Three bodies were found in the province—one in a morgue and two at the city’s entry points—leading Governor Paulin Lendongolia to sign a July 3 decree banning entry of corpses from Ebola-affected areas. Kisangani authorities initiated strengthened riposte measures: systematic temperature checks and hand washing/disinfection for travelers from affected zones; Ebola checkpoints quadrupled to four at Avakubi, Bafwasende, PK23 and PK13. About fifteen people are in quarantine due to contact with intercepted corpses. INSP confirms two positive Ebola cases in Kisangani. The 17th Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 1,759 confirmed cases, 600 deaths, and 750 recoveries, with Ituri, Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu officially affected; Haut-Uele has two imported cases in Wamba. As of 9 July 2026, authorities continue the response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：キサンガニで2例確認、ツショポ州は被害地域からの遺体搬入を禁止
triage.triage_reason: DRCの第17次エボラアウトブレイクが新たにキサンガニ市（ツショポ州）へ拡大し、累計1,759症例・600死亡と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、遺体搬入禁止など渡航・移動制限措置も既に実施されているため。
triage.notes: 第17次エボラ流行はイツリ州、北キブ州、南キブ州で公式に確認されており、今回新たにツショポ州キサンガニ市（都市部）への拡大が確認された点が特に懸念される。遺体を介した感染拡大の可能性があり、約15名が接触者として隔離中。

article.articleHeadline: Cegah Rabies, KPKP Jakarta Barat Terus Sterilisasi Kucing
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To Prevent Rabies, West Jakarta's KPKP Continues Sterilizing Cats.
article.articleSummary: Rabies prevention drives sterilization efforts by West Jakarta's Department of Food Security, Maritime and Agriculture (KPKP Jakbar). In the first half of 2026, KPKP Jakbar sterilized 524 male cats using castration with minimal incisions; after surgery, cats are marked with an ear tip. Tanti, head of the Livestock and Animal Health Section, stated they collaborate with communities, including the Sehati Cat Lovers Community (KPKS). For stray cats, the program uses Trap-Neuter-Return (TNR): catch, neuter, and release back to their original habitat. The initiative emphasizes rabies prevention as a key objective in Jakarta Barat (West Jakarta). The report is dated 2026-07-09.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病予防のため、西ジャカルタKPKPは猫の避妊手術を継続実施
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病予防を目的とした猫の去勢・避妊プログラムに関する日常的な行政活動の報告であり、実際の感染事例や異常な公衆衛生事象は記載されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病の発生報告ではなく、予防的な動物避妊プログラムの活動報告である。感染症イベントとしてのシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirosis Cases Rise in Mumbai: Why Doctors Say It's Often Misdiagnosed
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis cases rise in Mumbai during the monsoon, with doctors warning the bacterial infection is often misdiagnosed as viral fever, delaying treatment and raising the risk of serious complications. Mumbai's monsoon brings heavy rains, waterlogged streets, and overflowing drains, creating environments where Leptospira bacteria spread via water contaminated with urine from infected animals, particularly rats. Unlike dengue and malaria, which are mosquito-borne, leptospirosis is contracted through contaminated water. The misdiagnosis contributes to delayed care and worsened outcomes; doctors urge heightened clinical suspicion during the season and timely laboratory confirmation to differentiate from common viral febrile illnesses. The report highlights ongoing seasonal risk in Mumbai, with no specific case counts or fatalities provided in the text.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイでレプトスピラ症の症例が増加:医師が誤診多発を指摘する理由
triage.triage_reason: ムンバイでモンスーン期の季節性レプトスピラ症増加が報告されているが、具体的な症例数・死亡者数は不明であり、毎年繰り返される季節的事象と考えられるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: モンスーン期のムンバイにおける季節性レプトスピラ症の増加と誤診問題を扱う記事。具体的な症例数・死亡者数のデータなし。毎年繰り返される既知の季節的公衆衛生課題であり、国際的な拡大リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ghi nhận ca tử vong đầu tiên do sốt xuất huyết tại Gia Lai
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First Dengue Fever Death Reported in Gia Lai
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever death reported in Gia Lai Province, Vietnam — the first dengue fatality of 2026 in Bien Ho commune, Tiên Sơn 2 hamlet. The patient, L.V.Ph, 37, with type 2 diabetes, developed fever on 26 June and was hospitalized 30 June at Military Medical Hospital 15, then Gia Lai General Hospital; rapid NS1 antigen test was positive. He died en route to Cho Ray Hospital on 5 July. From year start to 6 July, Bien Ho had 36 dengue cases across 14 of 40 hamlets; June saw 20 cases, early July six, with three active outbreaks. Two weeks before death, two nearby cases were reported. Authorities intensified environmental sanitation, outbreak control, and insecticide spraying; 32 households were inspected and 12 water containers with larvae treated. Breteau index and other vector measures exceeded thresholds, signaling ongoing transmission risk. PAHO cautions dengue reflects environmental change’s impact on global public health.

triage.headline_ja: ザーライ省で今年初のデング熱による死亡例を確認
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでは季節性のデング熱流行は例年発生しており異常性は低いが、Breteau指数の閾値超過や継続的な媒介蚊対策の必要性から、感染拡大リスクを注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 地方レベルでの季節性デング熱流行。地元当局が消毒・駆除対応を実施中で、国際的な支援要請や渡航制限の兆候はない。継続的な媒介指数超過が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Бројот смртни случаи на ебола во Демократска Република Конго достигна 600
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 600.
article.articleSummary: 600 deaths from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with the outbreak declared on May 15, reaching 1,759 confirmed cases in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. Two new suspected cases reported in Kisangani, the capital of Tshopo Province, not yet included in official totals. One case linked to Nyani health zone in Ituri; the second with an unclear geographic link. Kisangani test results are awaiting confirmation. Health authorities have intensified surveillance, contact tracing and outbreak control in Kisangani. In the last 24 hours, 51 new Ebola cases and 20 new deaths were recorded. The World Health Organization warns the outbreak is not yet under control, with population movement increasing transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱による死者数が600人に達した
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクで死者600人、確定症例1,759例に達し、新規地域（キサンガニ）への拡大疑いも報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ガーナは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事本文はコンゴ民主共和国のみを扱っており、ガーナでの発生は言及されていないため除外した。WHOはアウトブレイクが未制御であり、人口移動により感染リスクが増大していると警告している。

article.articleHeadline: 埃博拉阴影下，非洲还能去吗？游客更应该警惕这种病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Under the shadow of Ebola, can we still travel to Africa? Tourists should be more vigilant about this disease.
article.articleSummary: As of July 5, 2026, Congo (Kinshasa) reports an ongoing Ebola outbreak in the east with over 500 deaths and rising weekly cases; a June 24 imported case in France involves a doctor returning from the outbreak area. For travelers, malaria remains a far greater threat than Ebola in sub-Saharan Africa: about 280 million infections and over 600,000 deaths annually; the DRC has the highest malaria burden, accounting for roughly 20% of China’s imported malaria this year. Fever, muscle pains and diarrhea can mimic Ebola, underscoring the need for early diagnosis and treatment. Ebola transmits via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids; no universal cure, and only Zaire ebolavirus has an approved vaccine (Bundibugyo ebolavirus has none). Prevention centers on mosquito avoidance (nets, screens, repellents) and yellow fever vaccination in high-risk areas; cholera vaccine may be advised in certain travel contexts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの影に覆われる中、アフリカへの渡航は可能か？旅行者はむしろこの病気に警戒すべき
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で500人以上の死者を出すエボラ出血熱の流行が継続し、フランスへの輸入症例も発生しており、国際的拡大のリスクが認められるためフルRRAに進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: フランスへの輸入症例（医師）が報告されているが、フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。中国は輸入マラリア症例の統計文脈で言及されているのみで、当該アウトブレイクの発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Only a matter of time? Health Department strengthens Ebola preparedness
article.articleSummary: Outbreaks continue in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with health authorities warning that the risk of spread to other countries will persist if outbreaks are not contained. South Africa has implemented emergency response structures and identified 36 hospitals to treat Ebola patients, with thousands of healthcare workers having received specialised training. Deputy Director-General Dr Anban Pillay emphasized that these facilities feature dedicated infectious-diseases units, requisite equipment, and staff experienced with handling these kinds of cases, enabling an effective response. Health Minister Aaron Motsoaledi announced the strengthened readiness. The article highlights ongoing Ebola activity in Africa and international risk, noting the country’s proactive measures to bolster preparedness and containment capabilities.

triage.headline_ja: 時間の問題か？保健省がエボラ対策準備を強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でエボラ出血熱の流行が継続しており、他国への拡大リスクが明示的に指摘されているため、IHR基準に複数該当しフルRRAへの移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行継続および南アフリカの備え強化を扱っているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダ・南アフリカは対象外のためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: L'UNICEF salue la guérison de plus de 250 patients d'Ebola, dont des
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNICEF welcomes the recovery of more than 250 Ebola patients, including some.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of Congo, has seen more than 250 people officially declared recovered as of July 8, 2026, including very young children treated at Nyakunde Ebola Treatment Center and in Bunia. UNICEF regional director Gilles Fagninou, on-site assessment, highlighted clinical victories among Congolese teams, noting a 3-month-old and a 9-month-old child recovered and thriving. While these successes boost morale, the overall epidemiological situation remains worrisome, with ongoing transmission challenges and rising logistical and funding needs to contain the outbreak. UNICEF warns the current transmission pace could outstrip existing response capacity and is engaging with Congolese authorities to accelerate the response. The article underscores continued vigilance, care at treatment centers, and the importance of sustained support to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: UNICEF、250人以上のエボラ患者の回復を歓迎、その中には幼い子どもも含まれる
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でエボラウイルス病の継続的な感染拡大が報告されており、国際機関(UNICEF)が対応能力を上回る可能性を警告しているため、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は致死率が高く国際的に懸念される疾病であり、UNICEFが資金・物流面での支援強化を訴えていることから、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Kisangani : deux cas qui fissurent le récit du " périmètre tenu "
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kisangani: two cases that undermine the narrative of the 'contained perimeter'.
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola cases were confirmed in Kisangani, DR Congo, as of July 7, 2026; one case is linked to Nia-Nia in Ituri. Lab confirmation used a RADIONE PCR test, validated by RT-PCR. Officials cite decentralized diagnostics enabling rapid detection beyond usual hotspots. The link via Route Nationale 4, a 340-km corridor, raises concerns that transmission has moved beyond Ituri and North Kivu toward Kisangani, though no downstream spread is yet confirmed. Kisangani, a million-strong Congo River city, lies downstream toward Mbandaka and Kinshasa, a river corridor historically associated with spread. Officially three provinces are considered affected, but Kisangani’s cases are not included in the provincial tally, complicating risk perception and resource allocation. The outbreak is Bundibugyo ebolavirus; no vaccine or licensed treatment exists for this strain; containment relies on detection, contact tracing, and isolation in a dense urban setting. OMS notes the scale is not yet fully established.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニでのエボラ:『封じ込め区域』の物語を揺るがす2症例
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ(ブンディブギョ株、ワクチン・治療薬なし)がイトゥリ州から人口100万人規模の都市キサンガニへ拡大した可能性があり、コンゴ川回廊を通じてムバンダカ・キンシャサへの伝播リスクも指摘されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: キサンガニの症例は州別集計に含まれておらず、WHOも規模を未確定としている。ワクチン・承認治療薬が存在しないブンディブギョ株であり、密集都市部での封じ込めが課題。続報での感染範囲確定が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Gia Lai ghi nhận ca tử vong do sốt xuất huyết đầu tiên trong năm 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gia Lai records its first dengue fever death in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Gia Lai Province, Vietnam, reports its first dengue fever death for 2026. A male resident of Tiên Sơn 2 hamlet, Bien Ho commune (born 1999) with preexisting insulin-dependent diabetes mellitus died after dengue infection. Onset 26 June with fever, fatigue and headache; he self-medicated for three days, was admitted 30 June to Gia Lai Military Hospital and transferred to ICU. Dengue NS1 antigen test was positive; diagnoses included dengue fever with diabetic ketoacidosis and multiple organ/electrolyte disturbances. He deteriorated and died en route to higher-level care; the body was returned home on 6 July. CDC Gia Lai notes Bien Ho had 36 dengue cases since January across 14 of 40 hamlets, with two nearby households reporting cases in the past two weeks. Local health authorities conducted two rounds of larval source reduction and will continue environmental cleaning campaigns in affected villages.

triage.headline_ja: ザーライ省、2026年最初のデング熱死亡例を確認
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は当該地域で流行が続く既知の感染症であり単発の死亡例だが、基礎疾患のある個人の重症化例であり、地域内での持続的な感染拡大がみられるため継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムの季節性流行疾患であり、本症例は基礎疾患（糖尿病）を有する患者の重症化・死亡例。地域では36例の累計症例があり、地方当局が防除活動を実施中。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: La epidemia de ébola alcanza los 600 fallecimientos y se acerca a los 1.800 casos confirmados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic reaches 600 deaths and is approaching 1,800 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 July 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths (20 new since the previous balance), with 750 recoveries and 285 patients currently in treatment. The three officially affected provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu—continue intensified surveillance, contact tracing, early detection, isolation, and stronger treatment capacity, with about 94% of discharged patients having recovered. About 80% of identified contacts are under monitoring to detect new infections and interrupt transmission. The latest report also records two Ebola cases in Kisangani, capital of Tshopo province, outside the three affected provinces; one linked to Nia-Nia health zone, the origin of the second under investigation. The outbreak’s geographic delimitation remains unchanged. Cross-border cooperation with Uganda has intensified, including a mission in Rwampara to bolster joint surveillance and rapid response, supported by INSP/COUSP and partners.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が死者600人に達し、確定症例は1,800人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確定症例1,759人・死者600人に達する大規模なエボラ流行が継続しており、新たな州（Tshopo州キサンガニ）への拡大やウガンダとの越境協力も報告されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: "Malaria - Hoffnung in Sicht" - Doku | 09.07.2026, 09:50 Uhr | ARTE
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria - Hope on the Horizon
article.articleSummary: Malaria remains one of the world's deadliest diseases, killing more than 600,000 people each year, most of them children, with Europe having historic resonance. A turning point arrives as Oxford-led researchers develop a new vaccine, R21/Matrix-M, aimed at the WHO-prescribed 75% efficacy. Prior to this, more than 140 vaccines failed to reach approval, with only RTS,S (Mosquirix) licensed, albeit expensive and limited in supply. As data from Phase 3 trials in thousands of African children were evaluated, Serum Institute of India began mass-producing millions of affordable doses before WHO clearance—a high-stakes gamble to deliver rapid access. The ambitious plan sought to deploy the vaccine in the 2024 malaria season, pending stringent quality controls. The piece offers an exclusive, gripping look into malaria vaccine science and its race against time.

triage.headline_ja: 「マラリア - 見えてきた希望」 - ドキュメンタリー | 2026年7月9日 09:50 | ARTE

article.articleHeadline: Ghi nhận ca tử vong đầu tiên do sốt xuất huyết tại Gia Lai
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First dengue fever death recorded in Gia Lai Province.
article.articleSummary: As of 9 July 2026, Gia Lai Province, Vietnam, reports its first dengue fever death of 2026. The patient, L.V.Ph., 37, from Tien Son 2 hamlet, Bien Ho Commune, had type 2 diabetes. Onset occurred 26 June with fever, fatigue and headache; he initially self-treated, was admitted 30 June to Military Hospital 15, then transferred to Gia Lai General Hospital with a positive dengue NS1 antigen rapid test. Despite intensive treatment, he died en route to Cho Ray Hospital on 5 July. Epidemiology: Bien Ho recorded 36 dengue cases through 6 July across 14 of 40 villages/hamlets; June had 20 cases, early July six more; three active outbreaks in the commune. Near the patient’s residence, two dengue cases occurred in the preceding two weeks. Response: authorities conducted environmental sanitation, outbreak control, and insecticide spraying; 32 households were inspected, 12 water containers with larvae found. Breteau index and mosquito density exceeded Ministry of Health thresholds in Tiên Son 2 hamlet, signaling ongoing transmission without aggressive control.

triage.headline_ja: ザーライ省でデング熱による最初の死亡例を記録

article.articleHeadline: 600 dead in DR Congo Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak has reached 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths as of July 9, 2026, yielding a case fatality rate of 34%. In the DRC, 285 recoveries and 304 suspected cases remain under investigation. The northeastern outbreak spans four provinces but is centered in Ituri, driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus, a rare strain with no approved vaccines or treatments. Uganda reports two deaths and 17 recoveries among 20 confirmed cases. The DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak began May 15 after several deaths in Ituri. A trial started July 2 in the DRC evaluating MBP134 (monoclonal antibody) and remdesivir, alone and in combination. Ebola spreads through close contact and infected bodily fluids, highlighting ongoing transmission and the need for targeted public health measures.

triage.triage_reason: 致死率34%、死者600人、稀な株（Bundibugyo型）でワクチン・治療薬未承認、ウガンダへの国際的拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するためフルRRAへ移行。

article.articleHeadline: Nicht eingedämmt: Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo erreicht die Millionenstadt Kisangani
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Not yet contained: Ebola outbreak in the Congo reaches Kisangani, a million-strong city.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches Kisangani. The National Institute of Public Health confirmed two positive tests in Kisangani; RT-PCR confirmation is pending. One patient is linked to Nia-Nia health zone in Ituri; the other has no clear link outside Kisangani. Surveillance and contact tracing have been intensified. There are 1,759 confirmed infections and 600 deaths (34.1% CFR). In the last 24 hours, 51 new cases and 20 deaths; Kisangani cases are not yet included. The Bundibugyo variant causes this 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC, affecting Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. WHO says the outbreak is not contained; population movement may drive spread. Transmission is via direct contact with blood, body fluids, contaminated objects, or corpses; vaccines and treatments are approved only for the Zaire variant. Authorities tightened border controls and banned travel from eastern provinces, including Kinshasa and Tshopo, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele; gatherings banned.

triage.headline_ja: 封じ込め未達:コンゴのエボラ流行、人口100万都市キサンガニに到達
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC第17次流行として拡大し、致死率34%超・大都市キサンガニへの拡大・渡航制限措置も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: WHOが未封じ込めと表明し、人口移動によるさらなる拡大リスクを指摘。Bundibugyo変異株はワクチン・治療薬の対象外(Zaire株のみ承認)であり、対応能力に懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkab Agam bentuk nagari peduli TB paru tingkatkan temuan penyakit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Agam Regency Government establishes Nagari Peduli TB Paru to boost pulmonary TB case detection.
article.articleSummary: Pulmonary tuberculosis (TB) detection drive launched in Lubuk Basung, Agam Regency, West Sumatra, Indonesia, as 46 of 92 nagari (villages) form a nagari peduli TB paru program to boost case finding. Spearheaded by the Agam Health Office, the phased program follows a 37% detection rate for TB pulmonary in the previous year, with 890 cases identified in 2025 against a target of 2,435 set by West Sumatra provincial and central authorities. The first stage covers 46 nagari after coordination with village heads and will be rolled out soon. TB, caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis, is infectious and presents with a cough lasting three weeks or more, shortness of breath, fever, and weight loss; untreated TB undermines immunity and elevates transmission. TB can be cured with a six-month course of anti-tuberculosis medications if patients complete treatment.

triage.headline_ja: アガム県政府、結核発見強化のため「TB肺結核ケア村」プログラムを設立

triage.notes: 結核は地域流行病であり、本記事は西スマトラ州アガム県の恒常的な症例発見プログラムの開始を報じるもので、突発的な公衆衛生危機ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Rajesh Sharma health update: MS Dhoni actor remains under observation after insect bite as the infection spreads to...
article.articleSummary: As of 9 July 2026, Rajesh Sharma remains under medical observation in Kolkata after a suspected insect bite during a Prabhas film shoot at Ramoji Film City. The bite—likely from a bug or poisonous spider—initially seemed minor, but six hours later he developed severe pain in the right leg and a high fever. Returning to Kolkata, he was admitted to Manipal Hospital, Dhakuria, where doctors report rapid infection progression from toes to the knee, with large blisters and breathing difficulties. He is under constant supervision and not yet out of danger, with a further medical bulletin expected in coming days. Sharma, a veteran actor with two decades in Hindi and Bengali cinema, has appeared in Khosla Ka Ghosla, No One Killed Jessica, The Dirty Picture, Special 26, M.S. Dhoni: The Untold Story, Toilet: Ek Prem Katha, and Bajrangi Bhaijaan. He also stars in Pritam and Pedro, released on JioHotstar on 3 July 2026, directed by Rajkumar Hirani.

article.articleHeadline: Parceria entre Prefeitura e Desbravadores leva ação educativa contra arboviroses e escorpiões em Naviraí - CSN1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Partnership between the City Hall and Pathfinders leads an educational campaign against arboviral diseases and scorpions in Naviraí - CSN1
article.articleSummary: Naviraí, Brazil—A public health education campaign targeting endemic arboviral diseases and scorpions was conducted by the City Hall’s Health Surveillance Nucleus and Vector Control sector, in partnership with the Seventh-day Adventist Church’s Pathfinder Club Atalaias do Sul, under the project “Health in Focus—Transforming Habits and Saving Lives.” On Saturday, July 4, Pathfinder youth received technical training on the Aedes aegypti life cycle, key breeding sites, and control strategies for Dengue, Zika, and Chikungunya, including a bench with live larvae and microscopy for vector observation. The session also covered scorpion species in the municipality, their habitats, preventive measures, and first aid for domestic stings. On Sunday, July 5, ACEs and Desbravadores conducted door-to-door outreach in Jardim Progresso, Atenas, and Jardim Alvorada, inspecting for vectors and scorpion refuges. City officials emphasized ongoing youth-led health promotion and expansion of the program with additional partners.

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya outbreak in Samar town prompts massive cleanup drive
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreak in Gandara town, Samar, Philippines, reports 84 confirmed cases concentrated in Barangays Ngoso and Catorse de Agosto, with red code alerts in those villages since June 30. First suspected cases were detected in May, and infections rose steadily. The virus is transmitted by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes; typical symptoms include sudden high fever, severe joint pain, headache, muscle pain, rash, and fatigue, with joint pain potentially lasting weeks to months. Local health authorities monitor all 69 Gandara barangays, while 67 remain under surveillance to prevent spread. There is no antiviral treatment; management is supportive, emphasizing rest, hydration, and fever/pain relief. Because chikungunya can resemble dengue, patients should seek care to rule out dengue before taking NSAIDs such as ibuprofen or aspirin. Prevention focuses on mosquito control—eliminating stagnant water, cleaning surroundings, unclogging canals, destroying breeding sites—and personal protection. Follow official health channels for updates.

triage.notes: 記事は単一の町（Gandara, Samar）内での局地的アウトブレイクを報じており、死亡例や重症例の報告はない。デング熱との鑑別が課題として言及されているが、感染症名としてはチクングニアが主題。地域内の他バランガイ（67カ所）は監視下にあり、拡大の可能性を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai Rains Trigger Surge In Leptospirosis Cases, BMC Issues Urgent Warning: Why You Should Be Worried?
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis drives heightened risk in Mumbai as the monsoon floods persist, with the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation issuing a fresh advisory and an orange alert for more rain. The bacterial infection Leptospira spreads via floodwaters contaminated by animal urine, notably rats. Historical data show Mumbai’s vulnerability: about 286 cases in 2022; over 335 cases in the first five months of 2023; and roughly 140 cases in the first half of 2024. Early symptoms resemble viral fever: high fever, severe headache, chills, muscle pain, fatigue, nausea, and red eyes; misdiagnosis with dengue, malaria, or chikungunya is common. If untreated, leptospirosis can cause kidney or liver failure, meningitis, respiratory complications, multi-organ failure, or death. Preventive measures include avoiding floodwater, wearing waterproof footwear, covering wounds, hand hygiene, changing wet clothes, safe drinking water, and seeking prompt care if fever develops after floodwater exposure or persists 24–48 hours.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイの豪雨でレプトスピラ症患者が急増、BMCが緊急警告を発令：なぜ懸念すべきか？
triage.triage_reason: ムンバイでは毎年モンスーン期にレプトスピラ症が増加する既知の季節性事象であり、地域行政（BMC）が既に注意喚起・対応を行っている。国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクは低く、新規性・異常性も乏しいため、フルRRAには至らないが今後の患者数推移は注視が必要。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症はムンバイのモンスーン期に例年発生する既知の風土病的パターンであり、BMCが既に警報を発出し対応中。デング熱・マラリア・チクングニアとの誤診リスクが指摘されているが、これらは併存疾患としての言及であり、本記事の主題はレプトスピラ症の季節性増加に関する地域内公衆衛生情報である。

article.articleHeadline: 飛機播毒｜一家四口遊澳門染三病毒　兩孩發高燒服藥隱瞞病情照飛　機上狂嘔吐腹瀉遍佈座位網民怒斥：蓄意播毒
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Airplane Poisoning: A Family of Four Visiting Macau Contract Three Viruses; Two Children Develop High Fevers, Take Medication, and Conceal Their Illness to Board; Onboard, Vomiting and Diarrhea Spread Across Seats; Netizens Decry It as Deliberate Poisoning.
article.articleSummary: A family of four visiting Macau is alleged to have contracted three pathogens—Salmonella infection, COVID-19, and Coxsackievirus. After returning to Shanghai, they were diagnosed; two children developed high fever and persistent diarrhea. They reportedly concealed illness to board a Shanghai Airlines flight home. On the journey, the younger child’s diarrhea worsened, with fecal leakage onto seats, blankets, and cushions; the parents apologized to crew. In Macau, the siblings received IV fluids and ceftriaxone, while hospital staff initially suspected food poisoning. The family stated that everyone wore masks and had limited contact with others. Netizens condemned the conduct as deliberate poisoning and feared wider transmission as the airline continued routes to Zhangjiajie, Shenyang, Changsha, and Urumqi. Public health notes Salmonella is typically foodborne, causing fever and GI symptoms, with higher risk for young children and other vulnerable groups.

triage.headline_ja: 飛行機で病気拡散｜4人家族がマカオ旅行で3つの病原体に感染　2人の子供が高熱で薬を服用し隠して搭乗　機内で嘔吐・下痢が座席に広がる　ネット民は「故意の感染拡散」と非難

triage.notes: 記事は単一家族（4人）の個別感染事例を報じるゴシップ的な内容。サルモネラ、COVID-19、コクサッキーウイルスの重複感染が疑われるが、これは食中毒や個人の体調不良に起因する可能性が高く、アウトブレイクの兆候はない。Zhangjiajie、Shenyang、Changsha、Urumqiは航空便の運航先として言及されているのみで、感染発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: RD Congo. Épidémie d'Ebola : le bilan atteint 600 morts, selon l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Ebola outbreak death toll has reached 600, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: 600 Ebola-related deaths and 1,759 confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) since the current outbreak began, according to a WHO situation update dated July 7, 2026. The epicenter is Ituri province in the North-East, bordering South Sudan and Uganda, with the virus also present in nearby North Kivu and South Kivu where areas are controlled by the M23 group. In neighboring Uganda, 2 deaths and 20 confirmed cases are reported. Ebola is transmitted via contact with bodily fluids and causes hemorrhagic fever. The 17th DRC outbreak, declared May 15, is driven by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no vaccine or approved treatment. A clinical trial of two treatments began July 2, and WHO granted emergency use authorization for the first molecular diagnostic test. Persistent insecurity and fragile health systems complicate response; the outbreak could last months.

triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行(600人死亡、1,759症例確定)がDRコンゴで継続中であり、ウガンダへの越境拡大やワクチン・治療法未確立、治安不安定による対応困難など、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。M23武装勢力による治安不安定が対応を複雑化させている点も重要。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola outbreak death toll reaches 600
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak has reached 600 deaths with 1,759 confirmed cases amid ongoing community transmission across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, with the virus now detected in Tshopo (Kisangani)—the first spread outside the original zone; two cases linked to Ituri’s Nia‑Nia health zone. The Bundibugyo virus strain concentrates in Ituri, accounting for over 90% of cases and 84% of deaths since the outbreak was declared on May 15. The epidemic spans 37 health zones; about 750 people have recovered, 285 remain in care. Of 430 confirmed deaths investigated as of July 5, roughly 400 occurred before patients reached treatment facilities, highlighting delays in surveillance, referral and clinical access. WHO Africa warns that surveillance and referral systems lag behind transmission, signaling persistent challenges as new areas experience transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、死者数600人に到達
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC複数州で拡大し死者600人・確定症例1,759人に達し、新地域(Tshopo)への拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。

article.articleHeadline: Breakfast leaves 26 students ill at Telangana residential school
article.articleSummary: 26 students fell ill after breakfast at Chenchu Tribal Government Residential School in Mannanur Village, Amrabad Mandal, Nagarkurnool district, Telangana, reporting diarrhoea. They were admitted to Mannanur Government Hospital, then moved to Achampet Area Hospital due to bed shortages; some pupils said insects were seen in the khichdi served. This follows a separate case at Kamareddy Gurukul School where 33 students were hospitalised after lunch. The National Human Rights Commission has directed Telangana to investigate more than 800 suspected food-poisoning incidents in gurukul schools, with around 48 deaths across 886 incidents in the state. Parents protested over inadequate hospital facilities as authorities respond to ongoing food-safety concerns in Telangana’s government residential schools.

triage.headline_ja: テランガーナ州の寄宿学校で朝食後に26人の生徒が体調不良
triage.triage_reason: 個別事案自体は小規模だが、州全体で886件・48名死亡という食中毒多発の背景があり、国家人権委員会が調査指示を出すなど社会的・行政的関心が高いためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 食中毒（食品衛生）事案であり、感染症のヒト-ヒト感染リスクは低いが、州内で繰り返し発生し死亡例もあるため公衆衛生上の懸念として注視対象とする。

article.articleHeadline: ದ.ಕ.ದಲ್ಲಿ 2026 ರಲ್ಲಿ 53 ಇಲಿ ಜ್ವರ ಪ್ರಕರಣ ದಾಖಲು | 53 rat fever cases recorded in 2026 in D.C.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dakshina Kannada district records 53 rat fever cases in 2026
article.articleSummary: Dakshina Kannada district reports 53 leptospirosis (rat fever) cases from January 1 to June 30, 2026, across Mangaluru (20), Bantwal (14), Belthangady (9), Puttur (7) and Sullia (3). Last year in the same period, 86 cases were recorded; officials say it is not yet certain that cases are rising. Leptospirosis is caused by Leptospira bacteria, transmitted mainly via the urine of rats and cats that contaminates water and soil. Symptoms include chills, high fever, headache, red eyes, body aches, abdominal pain, and vomiting. The disease spikes during the monsoon when drains and waterlogged pits become breeding grounds; infections can affect dogs and livestock as well. Rural workers in areca nut and rubber plantations, farming, and forest-edge areas, and urban residents with contaminated sewer water are at risk. Free treatment is available at primary health centers and the district hospital. Increasing numbers of foreign cats, which do not prey on rats, may contribute to rodent populations.

triage.headline_ja: ダクシナ・カンナダ県で2026年に53件のレプトスピラ症（鼠咬熱）を記録
triage.triage_reason: 例年発生している地域流行性疾患であり、前年同期より症例数は減少（86→53）しており、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
