article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll hits 600 in DR Congo as virus reported in new province
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths, with 750 recoveries and 285 patients under care as of July 9, 2026. The outbreak, declared May 15, is concentrated in 37 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, with Ituri accounting for more than 90% of cases and over 84% of deaths. Two cases were detected in Kisangani, Tshopo province, linked to the Nia-Nia health zone in Ituri, indicating spread to a new area. WHO Africa reports a growing number of community deaths and sustained transmission into previously unaffected zones. Of 430 confirmed deaths investigated by July 5, about 400 occurred before patients reached treatment facilities, underscoring delays in case detection, referral, isolation and access to clinical care.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ死者数600人に達し、新たな州でウイルス確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクは1,759症例・600死亡と大規模化し、新たな州（Tshopo州キサンガニ）への拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: Ituri州が症例の90%以上を占めるが、Tshopo州キサンガニへの拡大が確認され地理的拡大が進行中。地域社会内での死亡増加や治療施設到達前の死亡が多く、症例探知・隔離体制に課題がある。WHO Africaが継続的に報告しており国際的関与が既に存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Число смертей от вируса Эбола в Конго достигло 600
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from the Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 600.
article.articleSummary: Lab-confirmed Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have reached 600, according to Armenpress citing Reuters. Since May 15, 1,759 people in the eastern provinces of Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu have been infected. These figures appear in a government report published on the evening of July 8. The case fatality rate stands at 34.1%. Currently, 750 patients are under medical care in hospitals and isolation centers. The report indicates the outbreak remains centered in eastern DRC, with ongoing transmission and a substantial fatality burden as of July 8–9, 2026. No details on infection source or imported/exported cases are provided.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラウイルスによる死者数が600人に達した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目が該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）し、致死率34.1%・症例1,759人・継続的な人-人感染が確認されているためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日以降、東部のイトゥリ州・北キブ州・南キブ州で1,759人が感染し、うち600人が死亡（致死率34.1%）。現在750人が病院・隔離施設で治療中。感染源や越境事例についての詳細は記事に記載なし。継続的なモニタリングとフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Indonesia eyes 100 pct TB contact tracing to eliminate disease by 2030
article.articleSummary: Indonesia aims to eliminate TB by 2030 with 100 percent contact tracing for families and close contacts, expanding from treating illness to preventing transmission. The policy uses the Free Health Screening (CKG) program, portable X-ray units, and rapid diagnostic tests, with 2026 funding secured. Indonesia remains among the highest TB burdens, accounting for about 10 percent of global TB cases, with roughly 1.08 million infections and 126,000 deaths annually (2024). The four-pillar strategy centers on expanding case detection via CKG, ensuring prompt treatment for confirmed patients, providing preventive therapy for close contacts, and strengthening cross-sector collaboration to the village level. TB case notifications rose 31 percent and patients treated rose 27 percent, driven by case finding and CKG expansion. Challenges include detecting infections among high-risk groups, reducing social stigma, improving access in remote areas, and ensuring treatment completion. The ministry is developing domestically produced TB-PCR kits, vaccine research, and expanding microbiology labs.

triage.triage_reason: 既知の慢性的流行病である結核に関する政策発表記事であり、異常性や急性の公衆衛生上の脅威、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の風土病であり、本記事はインドネシア保健省の疾病撲滅政策・戦略発表に関する内容。新規アウトブレイクや異常事態ではないためDISMISS。

article.articleHeadline: 全程都在喷屎"，查出有多种病毒感染，航司回应一家四口乘机入境检疫异常
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "They were spraying feces the whole trip" — multiple viral infections detected; airline responds to a family of four whose flight into the country triggered abnormal entry quarantine.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-07-03, a Macau-based family of four traveling to Shanghai triggered quarantine procedures after fever prompted entry health checks. Shanghai hospital testing reportedly confirmed multiple viral infections among the passengers. An online post claimed the younger brother contaminated in-flight surfaces with fecal matter, leading to concerns about spread. Chinese Customs instruct travelers with fever, vomiting, diarrhea, or diagnosed infectious diseases to declare health status and cooperate with temperature checks, epidemiological surveys, sampling, and laboratory testing; concealing information or enabling transmission may incur legal or criminal liability. The airline said disinfection was conducted per national entry-exit hygiene standards, with no reported impact on subsequent flights. Authorities have not yet observed further transmission linked to the incident. Public health guidance underscores strict quarantine compliance for imported cases and ongoing monitoring of travelers.

triage.headline_ja: 「ずっと便中で嘔吐・下痢していた」―複数のウイルス感染が判明、家族4人の入国検疫異常に航空会社が対応

article.articleHeadline: 600 Killed as Ebola Outbreak Worsens in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has 600 confirmed deaths and at least 1,759 infections as of 9 July 2026. Transmission is centered in the eastern provinces of Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, with suspected cases under investigation in Kisangani, raising fears of wider spread beyond the original epicentre. The World Health Organization warns the outbreak is expanding due to population movement, while health teams intensify surveillance, contact tracing and testing. The current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment, though experimental vaccines and therapies are being evaluated. The response is hampered by protests from frontline healthcare workers over delayed salaries and unpaid allowances, threatening disruptions to treatment, safe burials and surveillance at a critical stage.

triage.notes: 承認されたワクチン・治療法がなく、医療従事者の未払い賃金抗議が対応を妨げている点が懸念材料。Kisanganiでの疑い例調査中で、感染拡大の可能性がさらに高い。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola outbreak spreads to fourth province as death roll reaches 600
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to a fourth province, Kisangani in Tshopo, as 1,759 infections are reported across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu since May 15, with the death toll reaching 600. Two suspected Kisangani cases were identified: one linked to Niania health zone in Ituri, the other with no confirmed epidemiological link to the outbreak; both are undergoing confirmatory testing before tally inclusion. Authorities have intensified surveillance, contact tracing, and other control measures in Kisangani to curb spread. In the latest 24 hours, 51 new cases and 20 new deaths were recorded. The World Health Organization warns the outbreak is expanding, with population mobility driving transmission.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola salgınında bilanço ağırlaşıyor | NTV Haber
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The toll from the Ebola outbreak is worsening | NTV News
article.articleSummary: As of 9 July 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths, up from over 500 deaths reported three days earlier. Since May, the outbreak has affected four provinces, with the majority of cases concentrated in Ituri province in the northeast, a region with armed groups and rich mineral resources. A total of 285 patients have recovered, while 304 suspected cases remain under investigation. Health authorities confirm the outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus; there is currently no approved vaccine or specific treatment for this strain. On 2 July, two experimental therapies began clinical trials in Congo, representing the first potential treatment options amid the ongoing outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行で被害が深刻化している | NTVニュース

article.articleHeadline: Sơn La không để bệnh lao âm thầm cướp đi sức khỏe của người dân
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Son La Province will not allow tuberculosis to silently steal the people's health.
article.articleSummary: Son La Province intensifies tuberculosis (TB) control to prevent transmission, prioritizing screening, early detection, modern diagnostics, and bringing TB services to highland communities. At Son La Lung Hospital, patient-friendly spaces and guidance assist elderly and rural residents through examinations. A patient with pulmonary TB reports improvement after two months of treatment, underscoring that adherence enables cure; delays and drug-resistant TB remain challenges. TB is predominantly pulmonary (80–85%) and spread via respiratory droplets, not heredity. Prevention includes masking and good hygiene. The hospital uses bronchoscopy and GeneXpert, and applies a 2X strategy combining chest X-ray with GeneXpert for community screening. Annually, the hospital treats thousands, with over 2,000 inpatients; bacteriological cure/relapse around 94%, and completion around 96%. Screening in high-risk sites found 61 TB cases and 491 latent infections among 8,100 people. Since 2021, provincial health-insurance has improved access; future plans include expanding diagnostics, infection control, and outreach.

article.articleHeadline: Baguio courts advise mask use amid rising Covid-19 cases
article.articleSummary: Baguio City Regional Trial Court (RTC) and Municipal Trial Court in Cities (MTCC) advised judges, court personnel, and litigants to wear face masks inside court premises amid rising Covid-19 cases as of 2026-07-09 and a court employee’s infection. In a July 8, 2026 joint memorandum, masking is voluntary but required for all entering the Hall of Justice and annex at the summer courthouse of the Court of Appeals, as part of reinstated health protocols to curb transmission in crowded courtrooms. The move follows reports of increasing Covid-19 cases in Metro Manila and the local infection. Quezon City data show confirmed cases rising from 23 (May 21–June 10) to 84 (June 11–July 1, 2026); about 86% managed as outpatients with mild symptoms like colds and fever, 14% hospitalized. The memorandum was distributed to all Baguio City RTC and MTCC courts and the Office of the Regional Court Manager.

triage.notes: COVID-19は既知の病原体であり、症例の86%は軽症で外来管理。マニラ首都圏及びバギオでの局地的増加に対する予防的措置であり、パンデミック相当の新規事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll in Congo reaches 600, as new cases suspected in...
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 1,759 laboratory-confirmed cases and 600 deaths as of July 9, 2026. Two new suspected cases were reported in Kisangani, Tshopo province, where cases had not been recorded before. Of these, one case is linked to the Nia-Nia health zone in Ituri province—the area where the first cases were reported—while the other has no apparent geographical connection to known outbreaks; investigations are underway. The Congolese government declared a fresh Ebola outbreak on May 15; this outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo virus, which has no approved vaccine or treatment. Last week, treatment trials began. Containment has been hampered by a funding gap, attacks on health centers, and ongoing conflict in eastern Congo, the outbreak’s epicenter. Health workers in Bunia are preparing for scheduled Ebola clinical trials at the Evangelical Medical Center.

triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の死者600人・確定症例1759人と重大な公衆衛生影響があり、未感染地域(Tshopo州)への拡大疑いや治療法未承認、紛争・資金不足による対応困難も確認されるためフルRRAへ進める。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα στο Κονγκό: 600 νεκροί σε 1.759 κρούσματα σύμφωνα με τον ΠΟΥ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo: 600 deaths in 1,759 cases, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 1,759 confirmed cases with 600 deaths, according to WHO as of July 7, 2026. Uganda reports 20 cases and 2 deaths. The 17th outbreak in the DRC, declared May 15, is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, which has no vaccine or approved treatment. The epidemic centers in Ituri province in northeast DRC near the South Sudan and Uganda borders, with spread also to North and South Kivu where the M23 armed group operates. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids, causing hemorrhagic fever. On July 2, clinical trials began for two therapies targeting this strain, and the WHO granted emergency use authorization for the first molecular diagnostic test. WHO warns the true scale may be greater, as treatment centers function at about 90% capacity amid substantial humanitarian needs and ongoing security and access challenges.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱：WHOによると1,759症例中600人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の大規模エボラ流行（600人死亡、致死率高い）がウガンダにも拡大しており、ワクチン・治療薬がないBundibugyo株であること、治安・アクセス問題により対応が困難であることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境拡大が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。治療センターの稼働率が約90%であり、真の規模はさらに大きい可能性がWHOにより指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Жертвите на ебола в ДР Конго надхвърлят 600, съобщи СЗО
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in DR Congo exceeds 600, WHO reports.
article.articleSummary: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has caused 600 deaths and 1,759 confirmed cases since it began, according to WHO data compiled on July 7. The 17th DRC outbreak, declared May 15, is driven by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no vaccine or treatment. In neighboring Uganda, there are 2 deaths among 20 confirmed cases. The epicenter is Ituri Province in the northeast, bordering South Sudan and Uganda; the virus is also present in North Kivu and South Kivu, regions largely controlled by the anti-government group M-23. WHO warns the outbreak continues to expand and its true scale is not yet known, with treatment centers operating at ~90% capacity. Trials of two potential treatments began on July 2, and the first molecular diagnostic test has been authorized for emergency use.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : un déficit de 20 millions de dollars freine la riposte à la 17e épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: a $20 million shortfall slows the response to the 17th Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of July 7, 2026, COUSP Situation Report No. 054 records 1,759 confirmed Ebola cases and 600 deaths (case fatality 34.1%) across 37 health zones in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. In the previous 24 hours, 51 new cases and 20 deaths (55% in the community) were reported, mainly in Ituri; two additional cases in Kisangani, Tshopo, are under validation and not yet in the tally. A $20 million funding shortfall hampers all response pillars, leading to shortages of essential medicines, medical supplies, ambulances, isolation facilities, and a need for 20 more treatment centers. North Kivu centers operate at 137% capacity; 112 health workers have been infected, including 35 deaths. Contact tracing stands at 80% (goal 95%), with laboratory delays in Nord-Kivu. Despite recent funding from the government ($20M), World Bank ($73M), and UK ($26M), insecurity from CODECO and ADF and high population mobility risk geographic spread. Bundibugyo-strain Ebola in Bunia, Ituri, is highlighted in visuals from May 16, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：2000万ドルの資金不足が第17次流行への対応を遅らせる
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認症例1,759例・死亡600例に達する大規模なエボラ流行が継続しており、資金不足・治安悪化・医療従事者感染など対応能力の逼迫と地理的拡大リスクが認められるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率34.1%、医療従事者112名感染（うち35名死亡）、North Kivuの治療センターは定員137%で稼働、接触者追跡率80%（目標95%未達）、CODECO・ADFによる治安悪化と人口移動により地理的拡大リスクあり。資金不足（2000万ドル）が対応の障壁となっている。

article.articleHeadline: Vorsicht bei der Fernreise: Dengue-Fieber ist nicht nur auf den Malediven auf dem Vormarsch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be careful when traveling abroad: Dengue fever is not only on the rise in the Maldives.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is rising not only in the Maldives but across popular travel destinations. Mosquito transmission drives the increases. In Sri Lanka, since the start of the year tens of thousands of dengue cases have been reported, including Colombo, Gampaha, and Galle. In Thailand, dengue numbers have risen since 2025, affecting Phuket, Krabi, and Bangkok. Indonesia, including Bali, remains a dengue-relevant area. Beyond Asia, the Caribbean and Latin America are affected, with Brazil, Mexico, Peru, and Colombia reporting more dengue cases. Protection includes repellents with DEET or Icaridin, long light-colored clothing, sleeping under mosquito nets, and staying in air-conditioned or well-protected rooms; some vectors bite during the day, so evening protection alone is insufficient. A3M notes the Maldives trend is not a panic trigger but highlights health risks for long-haul travel, per Samed Kizgin.

triage.headline_ja: 長距離旅行時の注意:デング熱はモルディブだけでなく増加傾向
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は東南アジアや中南米で季節的に流行している既知の感染症であり、本記事は旅行者向けの一般的な注意喚起記事であって、異常な発生や新規シグナルを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はモルディブ、スリランカ、タイ、インドネシア、ブラジル、メキシコ、ペルー、コロンビアなど複数国のデング熱増加傾向を紹介する旅行者向け一般情報記事であり、特定国での急性アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。対象国のうちタイ・インドネシア・ブラジルのみ具体的地域名（バンコク、プーケット、バリ等)が言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: Man dies of Covid-19 in Andhras Kadapa
article.articleSummary: Kadapa, Andhra Pradesh, July 9, 2026: A 46-year-old man from Masapeta died of Covid-19 four days after high-dose antibiotic treatment failed to control his symptoms. He was admitted for severe breathlessness and cough and was an alcoholic. An X-ray showed bilateral lung damage consistent with pneumonia. With no improvement after four days of antibiotics, doctors performed a chest CT that confirmed Covid-19 infection. Containment measures—sanitisation and tracing of primary and secondary contacts in Kadapa—were undertaken. Kadapa District Medical & Health Officer Ravi Babu confirmed the death, noting the infection was identified by imaging after antibiotic therapy failed. The report documents a fatal Covid-19 case in the district and describes subsequent public health steps, without indicating a broader outbreak.

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en RDC : le bilan de l'épidémie atteint 600 morts
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the death toll from the epidemic reaches 600.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 600 deaths and 1,759 confirmed cases since the start of the current epidemic, according to a WHO situation report dated July 7. In neighboring Uganda, two deaths and 20 confirmed cases are reported. The outbreak epicenter is Ituri province in the northeast, bordering South Sudan and Uganda; the virus is also present in North Kivu and South Kivu, where provincial capitals and large areas are controlled by the M23 armed group. Treatment centers are operating at about 90% capacity, exerting pressure on the response. Challenges to containment include population movements, ongoing insecurity, and a fragile health system; humanitarian needs remain high, including protection of civilians, access to food, and essential health services.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：DRCでの流行、死者数600人に達する

article.articleHeadline: Kongo'da Ebola Ölü Sayısı 600'e Yükseldi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in Congo has risen to 600.
article.articleSummary: As of July 9, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths, with 285 recoveries and 304 suspected cases under investigation. The four northeastern provinces are affected, with the majority of infections in Ituri, a region with armed groups and rich mining resources. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. On July 2, two experimental therapies entered clinical trials. The outbreak began in May 2026, and three days earlier the death toll had surpassed 500.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ死者数が600人に増加

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll in DR Congo reaches 600
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-09, DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak has 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths. Two new suspected cases were reported in Kisangani, Tshopo province, marking spread to areas previously unaffected. One of the suspected cases is linked to Nia-Nia health zone in Ituri province, where initial cases were reported; the other case has no apparent connection to known outbreaks and is under investigation. The government declared a fresh outbreak on May 15, with the current strain identified as Bundibugyo virus, a rarer form with no approved vaccine or treatment. Clinical treatment trials began last week in hopes of improving outcomes. Containment is hampered by a funding gap, attacks on health centers, and ongoing conflict in eastern Congo, the outbreak’s epicenter.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのエボラ出血熱、死者600人に達する

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : plus 180 décès suspects d'Ebola signalés à Lopa en un mois, les communautés en alerte se mobilisent
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: More than 180 suspected Ebola deaths reported in Lopa in one month, as alert communities mobilize.
article.articleSummary: More than 180 suspected Ebola-like deaths were reported in Lopa, Djugu, Ituri, DR Congo, over June–July 2026, according to local civil society leader Lotsima Latchu Fredy. The figure signals ongoing challenges in the Ebola response, including unpaid frontline teams, insufficient logistics, and delays in dignified burials; authorities had not responded at publication. Community initiatives, such as the LORI cultural association’s awareness campaign in Bakombe, aim to reduce transmission by educating residents on transmission modes, reinforcing preventive measures, and strengthening collaboration with health workers. Official figures for the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC show 1,561 confirmed cases, 506 deaths, and 253 recoveries, with Ituri as the epicenter. As of 9 July 2026, the outbreak remains concentrated in Ituri, prompting urgent calls for rapid intervention by health authorities and partners.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州：ロパで1か月に180人超のエボラ疑い死亡例が報告され、地域社会が警戒態勢を強化

triage.notes: 記事では当局からの公式反応がないことが指摘されており、対応の遅れや資金・物流不足が懸念材料。第17次エボラ流行の公式統計（1,561症例、506死亡、253回復）はイツリ州が震源地であることを示す。

article.articleHeadline: Chandipura Virus Outbreak : ഗുജറാത്തിൽ ഭീതി പടർത്തി ചാന്ദിപുര വൈറസ് ; എന്താണ് ചാന്ദിപുര വൈറസ്? ലക്ഷണങ്ങൾ അറിയാം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chandipura Virus Outbreak: Fear Grips Gujarat; What Is Chandipura Virus? Know the Symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus (CHPV) outbreak in Gujarat triggers alarm after a six-year-old Rajasthan native dies at Himatnagar Civil Hospital in Sabarkantha district; the child, admitted four days earlier in severe condition, tested positive for CHPV. CHPV is a Rabdoviridae family virus that primarily affects children under 15 and causes acute encephalitis syndrome (AES) with rapid progression to brain swelling and high mortality. Diagnosis relies on RT-PCR detecting viral RNA, with supportive serological tests. The incident follows previous CHPV outbreaks in Gujarat in 2024 that caused multiple deaths, prompting intensified containment and control measures by local health authorities and the state government. The case underscores imported exposure into Gujarat from Rajasthan and the ongoing risk of CHPV outbreaks, particularly during monsoon seasons.

triage.headline_ja: チャンディプラウイルス感染症の発生：グジャラート州で恐怖が広がる。チャンディプラウイルスとは？症状を知る

article.articleHeadline: Ебола в ДР Конго взе 600 жертви, СЗО предупреждава за разрастване на епидемията
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo has claimed 600 lives, WHO warns of the outbreak's spread.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has claimed 600 lives, with 1,759 confirmed cases reported by WHO as of July 7, per Congolese health authorities. The outbreak, 17th in DRC and declared May 15, is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, transmitted by contact with bodily fluids causing hemorrhagic fever, and has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. In neighboring Uganda, 20 confirmed infections have been reported, with 2 deaths. The main epicenter is Ituri province in the northeast, bordering South Sudan and Uganda; the virus has also been detected in North Kivu and South Kivu, where areas are under M23 control. Authorities warn that movement, insecurity, and weak health systems hinder control; centers are operating at 90% capacity, heightening humanitarian needs for civilians, food, and essential services. On July 2, two potential treatments began trials, and the first molecular diagnostic test received emergency use authorization.

article.articleHeadline: UFMG identifica antígenos que podem levar à criação de vacina universal contra a malária | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UFMG Identifies Antigens That Could Lead to the Development of a Universal Malaria Vaccine | Radio Itatiaia
article.articleSummary: Malaria researchers at Brazil's UFMG identified a set of antigens that could enable a universal malaria vaccine. In a Nature-published study led by Camila Barbosa and Luna de Lacerda, with Caroline Junqueira, they used immunopeptidomics to map Plasmodium vivax proteins recognized by the immune system, identifying 453 peptides from 166 parasite proteins, many previously unconsidered as vaccine candidates. Unlike surface proteins, these targets are highly conserved, reducing mutation risk and broadening protection. They found 71% of the proteins are shared across Plasmodium species and 75% appear in multiple life-cycle stages, suggesting protection against diverse parasite forms. Validation occurred in patient samples, animal models, and populations in Brazil, Mali, and the United States. CD8+ T cell responses were robust, with two antigens conferring protection experimentally. The findings could guide next-generation malaria vaccines and were highlighted by Nature for their potential impact.

triage.headline_ja: UFMG、マラリア万能ワクチン開発につながる可能性のある抗原を特定 | ラジオ・イタチアイア

triage.notes: 記事はマラリアワクチン研究（基礎研究）に関する内容で、ブラジル・マリ・米国はワクチン候補の検証に使われたサンプル提供地域であり、実際の感染症発生地域ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue Prevention Tips: कहीं आपके घर में तो नहीं पनप रहे जानलेवा मच्छर? Dengue-Chikungunya से बचने के लिए आज ही अपनाएं ये Safety Tips
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Prevention Tips: Could deadly mosquitoes be thriving in your home? To prevent Dengue and Chikungunya, adopt these safety tips today.
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases are rising, with symptoms including fever, chills, loss of appetite, severe bone pain, intense abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding from the nose or gums, breathing difficulties, and weakness. Prevention centers on eliminating mosquito breeding around the home: avoid standing water in containers, pots, coolers, and discarded tires; promptly empty and discard any standing water; clean coolers daily and, if water remains, add kerosene oil to deter larvae; keep water storage tanks covered and avoid prolonged exposure. Wear long-sleeved clothing, and use mosquito repellent for children; sleep under a mosquito net at night. If dengue occurs, stay hydrated with water and fluids and eat light meals; do not take medicines without a doctor’s advice. The guidance targets dengue and chikungunya prevention during the rainy season and emphasizes household hygiene as of 2026-07-09.

article.articleHeadline: 世界盃2026︱8強大戰英格蘭隊在即　挪威隊驚爆「流感危機」領隊證實發燒咳嗽有齊
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Cup 2026: Quarterfinal clash with England looming as Norway hit by influenza crisis; manager confirms fever and cough.
article.articleSummary: Norway’s national football team is facing an influenza outbreak ahead of their World Cup 2026 quarterfinal against England. Several players are reporting flu-like symptoms, including coughing and hoarseness; one Crystal Palace forward had fever and missed training before the opener against Iraq, and another player sat out the Round of 16 win over Brazil. Coach Subagan confirmed the squad is affected, noting fever in only one player while others have coughs and sore throats. He attributed the spread to a grueling schedule, continuous air travel, and venue changes, with the team’s movements to Boston, New Jersey, and Dallas contributing to reduced immunity in the 50-plus players. No laboratory confirmation is reported in the article. The infection source is described as travel-related fatigue rather than a confirmed outbreak, and Norway continues preparations for the England clash.

article.articleHeadline: YSR Kadapa: 46-Year-Old Man Dies Of COVID-19
article.articleSummary: In YSR Kadapa district, a 46-year-old man died of COVID-19 four days after admission to a local hospital for severe breathlessness and cough, an official said on Thursday. He was noted to be alcohol-dependent. An X-ray showed that both lungs were completely damaged, resulting in pneumonia. Despite four days of high-dose antibiotic treatment with no improvement, doctors suspected a coronavirus infection, and a chest CT subsequently confirmed the COVID-19 diagnosis. Kadapa District Medical & Health Officer Ravi Babu stated that containment measures, including sanitisation of the area and tracing of the deceased's primary and secondary contacts, have been undertaken already.

article.articleHeadline: 猴痘｜41歲男確診 赴台旅遊有「高風險接觸」 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkeypox | 41-year-old man diagnosed; high-risk exposure during Taiwan trip | am730
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox case in Hong Kong: a 41-year-old man with high-risk exposure during a Taiwan trip has been diagnosed and isolated at Queen Mary Hospital. Illness began July 2 with fever and genital rash; July 3 groin lymphadenopathy. He had not received monkeypox vaccination. Epidemiology center is conducting contact tracing and investigations and will notify the World Health Organization and Taiwan health authorities. The case is not yet linked to previously reported Hong Kong monkeypox cases. Since 2022, Hong Kong has recorded 93 monkeypox cases (74 locally acquired, 19 imported), all male; the majority involved high-risk sexual activity, including sex with strangers or unprotected sex. The patient is stable in isolation; no domestic transmission confirmed at this time.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : contre la souche Bundibugyo, la RDC teste ses premières armes dix-neuf ans après sa découverte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: against the Bundibugyo strain, the DRC tests its first countermeasures nineteen years after its discovery.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease is being tackled in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as a first global clinical countermeasure effort amid an outbreak of 1,759 cases and 600 deaths. On July 2, 2026, the WHO-backed PARTNERS trial began in the DRC to test two candidates against the Bundibugyo strain: the monoclonal antibody MBP134 and the antiviral remdesivir, given alone or in combination. More than 1,200 doses are available. The Bundibugyo strain was first identified in 2007 in Uganda, and there is no vaccine or approved treatment for it to date; by contrast, the Zaïre Ebola strain has the Ervebo vaccine and validated monoclonal antibodies. Africa CDC aims to have vaccines and therapeutics available by year-end 2026. Results are awaited, with surveillance, contact tracing, and supportive care continuing.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ブンディブギョ株に対し、DRCが発見から19年後に初の対抗策を試験

article.articleHeadline: 獨遊台灣曾有高風險接觸　41歲漢返港染猴痘需隔離
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 41-year-old man who returned to Hong Kong after a solo trip to Taiwan contracted monkeypox and needs to be quarantined.
article.articleSummary: A confirmed monkeypox case in Hong Kong: a 41-year-old man, unvaccinated, is in isolation at Princess Margaret Hospital with stable condition. He traveled solo to Taiwan during the incubation period and had high-risk exposure there, with infection not ruled out as Taiwan-associated. Onset occurred July 2 (fever and genital rash), with groin lymphadenopathy by July 7; he sought care at the Department of Health’s Male Social Hygiene Clinic and was admitted for isolation. No epidemiological link to prior Hong Kong cases has been found yet. The Centre for Health Protection continues epidemiological investigations and will notify the WHO and Taiwan health authorities. Since 2022, Hong Kong has recorded 93 monkeypox cases: 74 locally acquired and 19 imported; all cases have been male, with the vast majority reporting high-risk sexual activity.

triage.headline_ja: 台湾へ単独旅行した41歳男性が香港帰国後に猴痘（エムポックス）感染、隔離へ

article.articleHeadline: 一家四口澳门食物中毒靠布洛芬强上飞机回上海，一路喷射......飞机座位全是！_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A family of four in Macau suffered food poisoning, relied on ibuprofen to force themselves onto a flight back to Shanghai, vomiting all the way... the plane seats were all covered in vomit!
article.articleSummary: A four-member family from Macau suffered food poisoning with vomiting and high fever, refused further medical care, and relied on ibuprofen to pass immigration checks before boarding a Shanghai-bound flight. After takeoff, fever rebounded and vomiting intensified, forcing a delay as the plane carried ongoing gastrointestinal symptoms. Online posts triggered widespread condemnation for drug-assisted quarantine evasion and knowingly boarding a potentially infectious flight, with calls for airline disinfection and accountability. The piece outlines four concerns: delaying medical care; using fever-reducing drugs to bypass screening; severe gastrointestinal illness in a closed cabin raising transmission risk of pathogens such as Salmonella or Norovirus; and the public’s reaction to perceived public-safety disregard. Later, it was confirmed that the sister and husband had Salmonella, the sister and brother had Coxsackie virus, and the sister also had COVID-19. East China Eastern Airlines had not commented as of publication. Macau to Shanghai context highlighted.

article.articleHeadline: El balance de la epidemia de ébola en RDC asciende a 600 fallecidos Ensegundos República Dominicana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic toll in the DRC rises to 600 deaths - Ensegundos Dominican Republic
article.articleSummary: 600 Ebola-related deaths and 1,759 confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of July 7, according to WHO. The outbreak’s epicenter is Ituri Province in the northeast, bordering South Sudan and Uganda, with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu, where large areas are controlled by the M23 group. Uganda reports 2 deaths and 20 cases. Transmission is via contact with bodily fluids, causing viral hemorrhagic fever. The 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC, declared May 15, is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no vaccine or treatment. A two-drug clinical trial began on July 2 targeting this variant, and emergency use authorization was granted for the first molecular diagnostic test. Treatment centers operate at about 90% capacity amid displacement and insecurity, with ongoing humanitarian needs and a potential multi-month duration.

article.articleHeadline: RDC: Regardez comment les équipes d'hygiène désinfectent un hôtel à Bunia après la détection d'un cas d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Watch how hygiene teams disinfect a hotel in Bunia after the detection of an Ebola case.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak: 1,759 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo as of 9 July, with 600 deaths (case fatality rate 34%). Since the outbreak began in mid-May, 750 recoveries have been reported. Affected provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo. In Bunia, hygiene teams disinfect a hotel after detection of an Ebola case. Uganda reports 20 cases (2 deaths, 17 recoveries) and 1 hospitalized case. Central African Republic has deployed medical teams at the border with the DRC to prevent potential Ebola spread.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:ブニアでエボラ症例確認後、衛生チームがホテルを消毒する様子
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で1,759例・600死亡の大規模エボラ流行が継続し、ウガンダにも越境拡大している国際的公衆衛生上の重大事案であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Las muertes por ébola en Congo superan los 600 y surgen nuevos casos sospechosos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola deaths in Congo surpass 600, and new suspected cases emerge.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has killed about 600 people, with 1,759 confirmed cases nationwide. Two new suspected cases are reported in Kisangani, in Tshopo Province, a region not previously affected. One suspected case is linked to the Nia-Nia health zone in Ituri Province, where the first infections were detected; the other has no apparent link to known outbreaks, triggering further investigation. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, was declared on May 15 after weeks of undetected spread and currently has no approved vaccine or treatment. Therapeutic clinical trials began last week. Containment faces major challenges, including funding gaps, attacks on health facilities, and ongoing armed conflict in eastern Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者数600人超、新たな疑い症例も発生
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱によるDRCでの死者600人超・確認症例1,759件に加え、新地域(キサンガニ)での疑い症例発生と武力紛争下での封じ込め困難があり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチン・治療法がなく、治療用臨床試験開始直後の段階。武力紛争と医療施設への攻撃が封じ込めを阻害している点も重要なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Πάνω από 600 νεκροί από τον Έμπολα στο Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 600 dead from Ebola in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EBOV), Bundibugyo strain, is driving the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri province near the borders with South Sudan and Uganda. As of 7 July, WHO reports 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths in DRC, with spread to North and South Kivu. In neighboring Uganda, 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths have been recorded. Declared the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC on 15 May; the current epidemic may last many months. The virus transmits via contact with bodily fluids and causes hemorrhagic fever; existing treatment centers are operating at about 90% capacity. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or approved therapy; two therapies entered clinical trials on 2 July, and WHO granted emergency use for the first molecular diagnostic test. In Africa, more than 15,000 deaths from Ebola have occurred in the last five decades.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラによる死者600人超
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱(ブンディブギョ株)によるDRC第17次アウトブレイクで1,759症例・600人死亡、ウガンダにも越境拡大しており、IHR基準の複数該当が明確なため。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンへの越境拡大リスクがあるが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。ワクチン・治療法未承認、治療センター稼働率90%と管理体制が逼迫している点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Megszólalt a szakértő a halálos vírusról: fékezhetetlen gyorsasággal terjed a járvány
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The expert has spoken about the deadly virus: the outbreak is spreading at an unstoppable pace.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Bunia, Ituri Province, driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The disease remains deadly with no effective treatment or cure for the Bundibugyo strain. DR Congo’s fragile health system and high population mobility hinder containment. WHO’s Bunia-based local representative Anne Ancia says the situation is not yet stabilised, with efforts at near-maximum capacity. Ebola treatment centers are running at about 90% occupancy. A major transmission driver is migrant movement of workers from the Mongbwalu mining town to other settlements in search of care, spreading infections. Ongoing insecurity and armed conflict further hamper response. The outbreak poses a potential global health threat, underscoring the need for intensified surveillance, resources, and public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家が致死性ウイルスについて発言：感染爆発は制御不能な速さで拡大している
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がDRCイツリ州で拡大し、治療センターが90%稼働、封じ込めが不安定な状況であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 鉱山労働者の移動が感染拡大の主要因とされ、武力紛争による対応の困難さも指摘されている。WHOが現地代表を通じて状況の不安定さを認めている点は重要。

article.articleHeadline: Monsoon Health | বর্ষায় ডায়ারিয়ার ভয়, ভুলেও এই খাবারগুলি খাওয়াবেন না সন্তানকে
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monsoon Health | Fear of diarrhea during the monsoon season, never feed these foods to your child.
article.articleSummary: Rotavirus, Norovirus, and Adenovirus infections surge in North Bengal during the monsoon, per ICAR, with children bearing the brunt due to weaker immunity. To shield kids, experts warn against a monsoon diet that fosters infections: half-cooked eggs or meat risk Salmonella; seafood can accumulate toxins during the rains; street-side cut fruits and beverages may carry E. coli and Salmonella, increasing typhoid and jaundice risk; carbonated drinks impede digestion and supply artificial sugars; leftovers more than 24 hours stored in the fridge can rapidly foster bacterial growth once taken out; raw salads (cabbage, lettuce) may harbor parasite eggs or fungi; packaged foods like chips, chocolates, and processed meats (sausages, salami) may reduce immunity. Emphasize personal hygiene and handwashing before meals; if needed, consult a doctor to design a child’s diet chart to keep them healthy during monsoon.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン健康情報｜雨季の下痢の恐怖、子供に絶対食べさせてはいけない食品
triage.triage_reason: 個別症例や実際のアウトブレイク報告ではなく、モンスーン期の一般的な食事健康アドバイス記事であり、具体的な感染事例や公衆衛生上の異常事態は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: आंध्र प्रदेश के कडप्पा में कोविड-19 से एक व्यक्ति की मौत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One person dies of COVID-19 in Kadappa, Andhra Pradesh.
article.articleSummary: 46-year-old man dies of COVID-19 in Kadappa, Andhra Pradesh, after four days of high-dose antibiotic treatment with no improvement. He presented with severe breathlessness and cough; chest X-ray showed extensive bilateral lung damage with pneumonia. Despite antibiotics, COVID-19 was suspected and chest CT confirmed infection. Following confirmatory imaging, sanitation and contact tracing were implemented to identify exposures. This single fatal case underscores COVID-19 risk in Andhra Pradesh and highlights the role of CT in diagnosis when radiographs show bilateral lung involvement; no further details on other cases or outbreak status were provided.

triage.headline_ja: アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州カダパで新型コロナウイルス感染症により1人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 単一死亡例の報告であり、COVID-19自体は既知の疾患で異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められず、続報や集団発生の情報もない。
triage.notes: 単発の死亡例報告であり、アウトブレイクや集団感染を示す情報は記事中に含まれていない。COVID-19は既知の疾患であり新規性・異常性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Doença humana é detectada em macacos na Amazônia e acende alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Human disease detected in monkeys in the Amazon raises alarm.
article.articleSummary: HBV detected in neotropical wild primates in the Brazilian Amazon, signaling reverse zoonosis. A study coordinated by the University of Salford and UFAM analyzed 88 primates across 28 species in two zones: Rondônia and Mato Grosso (areas with heavy human disturbance) where HBV was found in 17 of 49 monkeys, and along the remote upper Japurá River in Amazonas state where 39 samples from 11 species were negative. Sequencing identified HBV genotypes A and D in primates, identical to endemic human strains circulating in northern Brazil. Transmission is linked to increased human–wildlife contact due to deforestation; precise biological mechanisms remain under investigation. Authors warn of potential viral adaptation in primates and possible re-entry into human populations, calling for proactive epidemiological surveillance and preventive barriers to monitor wildlife and local communities.

triage.headline_ja: アマゾンの猿からヒトの疾患が検出され警戒強まる
triage.triage_reason: ヒトB型肝炎ウイルスが野生霊長類に検出された「逆人獣共通感染症」の学術研究であり、現時点でヒトの症例増加や公衆衛生上の緊急事態は報告されていないが、将来的なヒトへの再侵入リスクが指摘されているため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術研究（英国Salford大学とアマゾナス連邦大学の共同研究）に基づくもので、ヒトの感染事例そのものを報告するものではない。森林伐採による人間と野生動物の接触増加が背景にあり、今後のサーベイランス強化が求められている。

article.articleHeadline: Epidémie d'Ebola en RDC : le bilan atteint 600 morts, selon l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DRC: the death toll has reached 600, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: 600 deaths from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, per the World Health Organization’s latest tally for 9 July 2026, based on Congolese health authorities. Ebola spreads through contact with the fluids of infected individuals or their bodies, and the report confirms ongoing transmission in the DRC as authorities monitor the situation. The article excerpt does not provide laboratory confirmation details, infection sources, or information on imported/exported cases. The death toll reflects the cumulative count to date, underscoring the severity of the outbreak in the DRC as of the published date.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行:WHOによると死者数は600人に達した
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱によるDRCでの死者600人という重大な公衆衛生被害が報告されており、IHR基準の複数該当が想定されるためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes Ubah Strategi TB, Kontak Erat Kini Wajib Dilacak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Changes TB Strategy; Close Contacts Must Now Be Traced.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia will adopt a TB control strategy mandating 100% tracing of family and close contacts to interrupt transmission and accelerate TB elimination by 2030. Deputy Health Minister Benjamin Paulus Octavianus said tracing must be 100 percent, expanding beyond diagnosed patients to the surrounding environment using the Free Health Check Program (CKG), portable chest X-rays, and rapid tests. Budget for 2026 implementation is secured; local governments, private facilities, professional bodies, and community cadres are urged to collaborate. Indonesia remains among the world’s TB burdens, accounting for about 10% of global TB cases in 2024, with roughly 1.08 million cases and about 126,000 deaths. Four main strategies: mass case tracing via CKG, immediate treatment for patients, preventive therapy for close contacts, and strengthened cross-sector collaboration to the village level. Citizens with TB symptoms or contact history should promptly visit the nearest puskesmas.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、結核対策戦略を変更 濃厚接触者の追跡を義務化
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病である結核に対する政策・戦略変更に関する報道であり、異常な発生や急激な公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の風土病でありインドネシア政府の政策発表記事。突発的な感染症イベントではなく通常のサーベイランス・対策強化の一環。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll in DRC hits 600, WHO reports
article.articleSummary: 600 Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) from the Bundibugyo strain; 1,759 confirmed cases since the outbreak was declared in mid-May, with 285 recoveries and 304 suspected under investigation. As of 9 July 2026, case fatality rate about 34%. The outbreak spans four northeastern provinces, with the epicenter in Ituri Province. The virus has crossed the border to Uganda, which has recorded two deaths and 20 cases (17 recovered). No vaccines or licensed treatments exist for Bundibugyo; authorities launched a clinical trial on 2 July to test MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir, alone and in combination. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids of infected persons or contaminated materials. The DRC declared its 17th Ebola outbreak on 15 May in Ituri, a region long plagued by conflict.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ死者数が600人に到達、WHOが報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行(1,759症例、死者600人、致死率34%)が国境を越えてウガンダに拡大しており、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高いと判断される。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境感染が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。ワクチン・承認治療薬が存在せず、臨床試験段階であることも懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolan skördar fler offer - 600 avlidna
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Claims More Victims - 600 Dead.
article.articleSummary: 600 people have died in the ongoing Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, according to new WHO figures. A total of 1,759 confirmed infections have been reported. The outbreak began in May and has affected four provinces, with Ituri province in the northeast hardest hit. Two deaths have been reported in neighboring Uganda. The current outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. WHO notes that clinical trials of vaccines and therapeutics have begun in Bunia, in eastern DRC. Public health authorities are monitoring cross-border spread across Central and East Africa and scaling up response measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがさらなる犠牲者を出す - 死者600人
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（死者600人、感染1,759例）が複数州に拡大し、ウガンダへの越境感染も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの死亡例も報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・治療薬の臨床試験がブニアで開始されている点も注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: காங்கோவில் எபோலா தொற்றுக்கு 600 பேர் பலி!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 600 people killed in Ebola outbreak in Congo!
article.articleSummary: As of 9 July 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 1,759 Ebola infections and 600 deaths in an outbreak attributed to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with no approved vaccine or treatment. Officials say 600 fatalities and 1,759 total cases have been recorded nationwide, with two new suspected infections in the Kisangani area of Shobo province. The World Health Organization notes the virus had circulated for weeks before Congo formally declared an outbreak on 15 May. Researchers have begun work on investigations and countermeasures, but progress is hampered by funding shortages, attacks on health centers, and ongoing eastern Congo conflicts. The outbreak continues to threaten neighboring regions, including Sudan; international surveillance efforts—including by India and other countries—are being intensified to monitor and contain the spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染により600人死亡！
triage.triage_reason: DRCで希少なブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス株による大規模流行（1,759症例、600死亡）が発生しており、ワクチン・治療法が未承認で、新たな州への拡大や国際的拡散リスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: 承認されたワクチン・治療法がないブンディブギョ株による流行で、資金不足・医療施設への攻撃・東部紛争により対応が阻害されている。スーダンへの拡大懸念やインド等による国際監視強化の記載があるが、実際の症例発生は現時点でDRCのみと判断。東京・日本の地域情報は記事内容と関連性が確認できず、誤付与と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 750 guéris contre 600 décès, les guérisons surclassent la mortalité - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 750 recovered against 600 deaths, recoveries outnumber fatalities - ACP
article.articleSummary: As of 9 July 2026, Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) in the Democratic Republic of Congo shows 1,759 confirmed cases across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, with 750 recoveries and 600 deaths (case fatality rate 34.1%). Contact tracing is strong at 80%. Surveillance has extended to Tshopo, with two Kisangani cases, including one linked to the Nia-Nia health zone; immediate response measures are underway in Kisangani, keeping affected provinces at three. Clinically, 750 recoveries underscore treatment effectiveness, including five Ituri patients (CT Sota, CTE Rwampara, Mongbwalu, Nyakunde) declared recovered after negative tests. Decentralization of diagnostic capacity enables rapid confirmation, even beyond usual transmission zones, as demonstrated by the early signal in Kisangani.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：回復750人 対 死亡600人、回復が死亡数を上回る - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認症例1,759件・死亡600人（CFR34.1%）の大規模エボラ流行が継続中で、新たにチョポ州・キサンガニへ拡大しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクがあるため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にルワンダ（キガリ州）とメキシコ（チワワ州）が含まれるが、記事サマリーではこれらの地域での発生に言及がなく、Bluedotの誤った地域付与と判断し除外した。イタリ州、北キブ州、南キブ州、チョポ州（キサンガニ）は全てDRC国内のためDRCとしてまとめた。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola : deux cas confirmés à Kisangani, la Tshopo rejoint les provinces touchées par l'épidémie | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola: two confirmed cases in Kisangani, the Tshopo joins the provinces affected by the outbreak | mediacongo.net.
article.articleSummary: Two confirmed Ebola virus disease cases in Kisangani mark the expansion of the 17th outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo to Tshopo Province. One patient is epidemiologically linked to the Nia-Nia health zone in Ituri Province, the outbreak epicenter, while the second case has no known linkage to other clusters outside Kisangani, raising concerns of local transmission. Response teams have intensified surveillance, contact tracing, monitoring of exposed individuals, patient care, and community sensitization to contain spread. Declared on May 15, 2026, the outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain. As of July 7, 2026, INSP reports 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths. Kisangani is the northeast country’s major urban hub and a key transport junction, elevating the risk of spread to other provinces and prompting heightened vigilance among authorities and communities.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：キサンガニで2例確認、チョポ州が流行影響州に加わる
triage.triage_reason: DRCの第17次エボラ流行が主要都市キサンガニ(チョポ州)へ拡大し、感染経路不明な二次感染例も確認されており、致死率も高く国際的拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 既存のDRCエボラ流行(第17次、ブンディブギョ株)の地理的拡大事例。累計1,759例・600死亡と致死率が高く、キサンガニは交通の要衝であるため他州への拡散リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola v Kongu sílí: Už přes 600 mrtvých, desítky nakažených přibývají každý den
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo is intensifying: More than 600 dead already, dozens of new cases are reported each day.
article.articleSummary: As of July 9, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) intensifies, with 1,759 confirmed cases and at least 600 deaths. On Wednesday, 51 new infections and 20 deaths were reported. The transmissible Bundibugyo variant has no approved vaccines or proven treatments, though two potential therapies are entering early clinical trials since last Thursday. Early symptoms resemble flu, then progress to gastrointestinal and internal bleeding and organ failure. ECDC and WHO assess the risk of spread beyond the affected area as low. The IFRC warned in mid-June that the peak may still be ahead and could last up to a year; since then, cases have more than doubled and deaths more than tripled. Two suspected Ebola cases in the Czech Republic: Patrick LaRochelle in Prague’s Bulovka Hospital (May 21–June 10) was not confirmed; a Czech soldier returning from Congo (May 22) was also not confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラが激化：死者すでに600人超、感染者は毎日数十人ずつ増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ(Bundibugyoバリアント)の症例・死者数が急増しており、ワクチン・治療法未確立で重症度・公衆衛生影響が深刻なため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: チェコでの疑い例（プラハ、兵士）は非確定であり、記事の主題はあくまでDRCでのエボラ流行。ECDC/WHOは域外拡大リスクを低いと評価しているが、致死率・拡大速度の観点からPICKUPと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus HIV di Balikpapan Meningkat, Dinkes Tekankan Peran Keluarga dalam Pencegahan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HIV Cases in Balikpapan Rise, Health Office Emphasizes the Role of Families in Prevention.
article.articleSummary: As of July 9, 2026, Balikpapan City in Indonesia reports rising new HIV/AIDS cases, per the Balikpapan City Health Office (Dinkes). Exact counts are not disclosed, but officials note an upward trend linked to greater mobility as Balikpapan becomes a metropolitan hub drawing people from other regions. Prevention efforts are emphasized to start at home, with families urged to educate, supervise, and maintain dialogue with children to deter risky health behaviors. Dinkes head Alwiati also addressed LGBT discussions, affirming Indonesia’s religious and cultural norms while stressing that HIV prevention requires community and familial engagement beyond healthcare services. Epidemiological notes reference various HIV risk-factor categories, highlighting ongoing surveillance of the outbreak in Balikpapan.

triage.headline_ja: バリクパパンでHIV感染者数が増加、保健局が予防における家族の役割を強調
triage.triage_reason: HIVは既知の風土病的感染症であり、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内であるため、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: HIVは慢性的な風土病であり、地方保健当局による通常の予防啓発活動の一環と考えられる。急性の公衆衛生上の脅威ではない。

article.articleHeadline: BMC Leptospirosis Warning: Stay Safe During Monsoon
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis advisory issued for Mumbai during monsoon. Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) urges residents exposed to rainwater, stagnant water, or mud to seek medical advice and take preventive medication within 24 to 72 hours to reduce risk of Leptospira infection. Transmission occurs via cuts or wounds in contact with contaminated water; heavy rainfall and waterlogging raise exposure. Free medical consultations and preventive medicines are available at BMC Hindu Hruday Samrat Balasaheb Thackeray Clinics, BMC dispensaries, health centres, and municipal hospitals across Mumbai. Symptoms may include fever; fever can be due to leptospirosis, dengue, or malaria, so seek immediate medical attention rather than self-medicate. For prevention, avoid walking through stagnant water if cuts exist; wear rubber boots if unavoidable; wash and dry feet after contact with rainwater. No case counts are provided; emphasis on early treatment and community awareness.

triage.headline_ja: BMC、モンスーン期のレプトスピラ症に警戒呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 毎年モンスーン期に発出される定例的な予防啓発情報であり、症例数の報告もなく、異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: ムンバイ市当局による毎年恒例の季節性注意喚起。具体的な症例数や異常な流行拡大の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll in Congo reaches 600, as new cases suspected in previously unaffected province
article.articleSummary: Two new suspected Ebola cases have been reported in Kisangani, in the Tshopo province, marking spread to areas previously unaffected, as Congo’s outbreak tallies reach 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths. The government’s latest report confirms the Kisangani cases while nationwide counts stand at 1,759 confirmed infections and 600 fatalities. The article provides no details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or any imported/exported cases. The development signals ongoing transmission with expansion into new districts, and authorities continue surveillance and response efforts across affected regions as of 2026-07-09.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者数600人に到達、これまで感染のなかった州でも新規症例疑い

triage.notes: 既存の大規模アウトブレイクが未感染州（Tshopo州Kisangani）へ拡大している点が重要。症状・検査確認・感染源の詳細は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: 26 Students Fall Ill In Food Poisoning At Gurukul School
article.articleSummary: 26 students of the Tribal Welfare Boys Gurukul School at Mannanur in Amrabad mandal, Nagarkurnool district, Telangana, fell seriously ill after breakfast in a suspected food poisoning incident on 9 July 2026. They were shifted to Government Hospital Achampet for treatment. Some students alleged inadequate drinking water at the hostel, raising concerns over basic facilities. Authorities are monitoring the students' conditions, and the exact cause of the suspected food poisoning has not yet been confirmed, with investigations underway into possible food or water contamination. The incident underscores potential food safety risks in school settings and prompts scrutiny of cafeteria practices and water supplies. As of the report, no exact source has been released.

triage.headline_ja: グルクル学校で26人の生徒が食中毒で体調不良
triage.triage_reason: 単一施設内での食中毒疑い事案であり、感染症としての国際的拡大リスクや異常性は認められず、局所的な公衆衛生事案にとどまる。
triage.notes: 食中毒（食品由来疾患）であり感染症のヒトーヒト伝播事案ではないため、感染症危機管理の観点からは優先度が低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolan skördar fler offer
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola claims more victims.
article.articleSummary: As of July 9, 2026, Ebola claims more victims in Central and East Africa. The Kinshasa-Kongo outbreak began in May and has affected four provinces, with Ituri in the northeast hardest. Three days ago about 500 people died, and 1,759 have been laboratory-confirmed infected. Two deaths have been reported in neighboring Uganda. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no vaccine or specific treatment. According to the World Health Organization, clinical trials of vaccines and treatments have begun in Bunia, in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. The report underscores the ongoing outbreak and the urgent need for surveillance, containment measures, and further clinical development.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがさらなる犠牲者を出す
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で500人死亡、1,759人感染確認という大規模アウトブレイクで、ワクチン・治療法のないBundibugyo株が原因、ウガンダへの越境拡大も報告されており、IHR基準を複数満たす。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Τουλάχιστον 600 νεκροί στο Κονγκό - Στο 90% η πληρότητα των κέντρων θεραπείας
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: At least 600 dead in the Democratic Republic of the Congo — treatment centers at 90% capacity.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 July 2026, WHO reports at least 600 deaths and 1,759 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with neighboring Uganda reporting 2 deaths and 20 confirmed cases. The outbreak, the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC, was officially declared on 15 May and centers on Ituri in the northeast near South Sudan and Uganda; it continues to spread, with true extent not yet captured. Treatment centers are operating at about 90% capacity, straining the health response. The epicenter is Ituri, with spillover into North Kivu and South Kivu, whose capitals and large areas are controlled by the M23. The Bundibugyo strain is involved; there is no vaccine or approved treatment for this strain. On 2 July, two therapeutic candidates began clinical trials, and WHO granted emergency use authorization for the first molecular diagnostic test. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids, causing hemorrhagic fever.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国で少なくとも600人死亡、治療センターの稼働率90%に
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（600人以上死亡、1,759症例）でウガンダへの越境拡大が確認されており、ワクチン・治療法未承認の株であることからIHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（対象国リスト外）への越境伝播が報告されているが、対象国リストにUgandaが含まれないためverified_locationsには含めない。M23武装勢力による支配地域が対応を困難にしている点も注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Λ.Δ. Κονγκό: Τουλάχιστον 600 νεκροί από Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: At least 600 dead from Ebola.
article.articleSummary: 600 deaths and 1,759 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo as of 7 July, with Uganda reporting 2 deaths and 20 confirmed cases. The outbreak centers in Ituri province in northeastern DRC, bordering South Sudan and Uganda, with spread to North and South Kivu areas controlled by the M23 insurgency. Population movement, ongoing insecurity, and fragile health systems complicate control efforts. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or approved treatment. Clin ical trials for two therapies began on 2 July, and the WHO has granted emergency use authorization for the first molecular diagnostic test. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC; the most deadly prior outbreak (2018–2020) caused about 2,300 deaths among 3,500 cases. Authorities warn the real scale is not yet fully known and humanitarian needs remain high, with response centers operating at roughly 90% capacity.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴ:エボラ出血熱による死者少なくとも600人
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRコンゴで600人死亡・1,759症例確認、ウガンダにも越境拡大しており、ワクチン・治療法未承認の株で紛争地域での対応困難という深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であるため。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例確認は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRコンゴの17回目のエボラ流行であり、M23紛争地域での対応が複雑化している。ワクチン・承認治療法がないBundibugyo株であることも懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo Demokratinėje Respublikoje per Ebolos protrūkį mirė 600 žmonių
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 600 people died in an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: 600 people have died in the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of July 9, 2026, with 1,759 confirmed cases since the outbreak began in May. The case fatality rate is about 34% in the DRC. The northeast outbreak spans four provinces, most extensively in Ituri, and is caused by the Bandibado strain, for which there are no approved vaccines or proven treatments. So far, 285 have recovered, while 304 suspected cases remain under investigation. Uganda reported two additional deaths among 20 confirmed cases, with 17 recoveries. On July 2, two potential treatments—monoclonal antibody MBP134 and remdesivir—entered trials, tested individually and in combination. Ebola spreads by close contact and body fluids. The outbreak was declared May 15 in Ituri amid armed conflict.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行で600人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準すべて該当する大規模エボラ流行（死亡600人、CFR34%、新規株、隣国ウガンダへの拡大）であり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも二次感染が報告されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。Bandibadoという新株の名称や承認ワクチン不在の情報は続報での確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Julho Amarelo alerta para prevenção e diagnóstico precoce das hepatites virais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yellow July raises awareness about the prevention and early diagnosis of viral hepatitis.
article.articleSummary: Yellow July raises awareness about prevention and early diagnosis of viral hepatitis in Brazil. Many infections are silent until advanced-stage complications such as cirrhosis, liver failure, or hepatocellular carcinoma. Regular testing is essential for early detection, as hepatitis can progress without symptoms. Hepatitis A (transmitted via contaminated water/food and poor sanitation) is preventable by vaccination; vaccines for A and B are safe, effective, and provided free by the Brazilian Unified Health System (SUS). Hepatitis B and C can be transmitted through blood and bodily fluids; B can become chronic and is controllable with ongoing antiviral therapy; C can become chronic but has highly effective treatment with cure in most cases, though there is no vaccine. The emphasis is on early diagnosis, vaccination, testing, and seeking care at health units. National health professionals encourage vaccination up-to-date and testing, especially for those with risk exposures.

triage.headline_ja: 「イエロー・ジュライ」、ウイルス性肝炎の予防と早期診断への意識向上を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: これは特定の疾病発生を報告するものではなく、ブラジルにおける啓発キャンペーン（予防接種・早期診断の推奨）に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であるため。
triage.notes: 記事は疾病アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、啓発キャンペーン(Julho Amarelo)に関する内容であり、トリアージ対象のシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Norvegia colpita da un virus respiratorio: possibili cause e come può influire contro l'Inghilterra
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Norway Hit by a Respiratory Virus: Possible Causes and How It Could Affect England.
article.articleSummary: As of July 9, 2026, Norway’s national football squad is struck by a summer respiratory virus, sidelining players ahead of a quarterfinal with England. Several teammates report cough, hoarseness, breathlessness, fatigue, and abdominal pain; Jorgen Strand Larsen also developed fever, and Pedersen could not play in the Round of 16 against Brazil. Professor Francesco De Rosa, director of Infectious Diseases at Molinette Hospital (AOU Città della Salute e della Scienza di Torino) and an associate professor at the University of Turin, told Gazzetta Active that respiratory viruses can circulate in summer for various reasons, impacting multiple players. The pathogen’s name is not specified in the article. The piece highlights the unusual timing but notes an outbreak affecting the Norwegian squad, underlining how respiratory infections can disrupt international sports schedules and performance.

triage.headline_ja: ノルウェー、呼吸器ウイルスに見舞われる：考えられる原因とイングランド戦への影響
triage.triage_reason: サッカー選手数名の呼吸器症状に関する報道で、病原体も特定されておらず、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）はいずれも記事の主題（ノルウェー代表チームの感染）に該当しない。Brazilは対戦相手として言及されているのみで発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola death toll reaches 600 as suspected cases emerge in new province
article.articleSummary: As of 9 July 2026, Congo's Ebola death toll stands at 600, with 1,759 confirmed cases nationwide. Two suspected cases were detected in Kisangani, Tshopo province—the first possible spread to that area. One suspected case is linked to Nia-Nia health zone in Ituri province, where the outbreak began; the second has no known connection to any previously affected area. The outbreak was officially declared on May 15 after undetected spread. The current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Last week, clinical trials to test potential treatments began. Efforts to control the outbreak are hampered by funding shortages, attacks on healthcare facilities, and ongoing conflict in eastern Congo, where most cases have been reported.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者数が600人に達し、新たな州で疑い例が発生
triage.triage_reason: エボラ死者600人、確認例1759件に達し、これまで感染が報告されていなかったTshopo州（Kisangani）へ疑い例が拡大しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）に該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株による流行で承認済みワクチン・特異的治療法がなく、資金不足・医療施設への攻撃・東部コンゴの紛争が対応を妨げている。新規州（Tshopo）への拡大が確認された疑い例のうち1件は既知の感染地域との関連が不明であり、感染源の追跡が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Epidémia eboly v Konžskej demokratickej republike si už vyžiadala 600 životov
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has already claimed 600 lives.

The report highlights ongoing transmission and the need for containment measures amid limited therapeutic options.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、死者数がすでに600人に達する
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱(ブンディブギョ株)によるDRC・ウガンダ両国での深刻な公衆衛生被害と国際的拡大リスクがあり、承認されたワクチン・治療法がないためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの感染例も報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。承認された治療薬・ワクチンがなく、致死率約34%と高い。臨床試験が開始されたばかりで今後の推移に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: 285 guéris, 600 morts, 750 malades en isolement, ce que révèle vraiment le bilan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 285 recovered, 600 dead, 750 patients in isolation, what the real tally reveals.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) with 1,759 confirmed cases as of July 7, yielding 600 deaths, 285 recoveries, and 750 patients still in isolation or under care. Global case fatality among confirmed cases stands at 34.1%, though the Bundibugyo strain—against which there is no approved vaccine or treatment—keeps mortality high. The 750 patients in treatment underscore strained capacity: roughly 700 beds across ~20 treatment centers, with occupancy reported above 94% as of July 5; ambulance shortages noted in Ituri. Authorities highlight surveillance gains, with tests rising from about 30 per day to more than 2,000. The DHIS2 database remains subject to cleaning and harmonization, so figures may evolve. WHO’s Anne Ancia cautions that the situation has not yet stabilized.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ:回復285人、死亡600人、隔離中750人、実際の集計が明らかにすること
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株、承認済みワクチン・治療薬なし）でDRC複数州にわたり1,759症例・死亡600人、病床占有率94%超と医療体制が逼迫しており、国際的拡大リスクと深刻な公衆衛生影響が認められる。
triage.notes: WHOも状況未安定と警告。ワクチン・治療薬未承認のブンディブギョ株であり、致死率34.1%と高く、治療施設の病床占有率も逼迫していることから継続的な監視とフルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de ebola na RDC provocou 600 mortes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in the DRC caused 600 deaths.
article.articleSummary: 600 deaths and 1,759 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) as of July 7, per WHO, with Uganda reporting 2 deaths and 20 confirmed cases. The outbreak—the DRC’s 17th Ebola event since May 15—centers in Ituri province in the northeast near South Sudan and Uganda, with transmission also in North and South Kivu where armed groups control large areas. triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ流行、600人死亡

article.articleHeadline: 600 dead in DR Congo Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak has reached 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths as of 9 July 2026 (WHO). The outbreak, centered in Ituri province and spanning four provinces, is driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola strain with no approved vaccines or treatments. In DRC, 285 recoveries and 304 suspected cases remain under investigation. Uganda reports two deaths and 17 recoveries among 20 confirmed cases. Transmission remains ongoing amid population movement and insecurity. The case fatality rate in DRC is 34%. About 700 beds across 22 treatment centres exist, with plans for 300 more; centres operate at ~90% capacity. More than 10,000 contacts are being monitored (82% followed up; 95% needed). Lab capacity has expanded from 30 tests per day in Kinshasa to more than 2,000 daily in decentralised labs. WHO seeks $115 million for the response (32% received). South Kivu has seen clashes with M23, raising displacement fears.

article.articleHeadline: Θεωρίες συνωμοσίας και επιθέσεις κατά γιατρών και εθελοντών για τον Έμπολα: Η κατάσταση στο Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Conspiracy theories and attacks on doctors and volunteers over Ebola: The Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola misinformation in Democratic Republic of the Congo is hindering outbreak response. False rumors and conspiracy theories have fueled attacks on health workers and volunteers, including a Red Cross volunteer, Daniel Uiruoth Welo, assaulted at a Bunia cemetery during a burial when locals believed the coffin was empty. Government data report outbreak exceeding 1,750 cases and 600 deaths since May. Rumors claim Ebola does not exist or that health workers intentionally infect people; BBC Verify counted 12 resistance incidents, seven confirmed by social media videos, including assaults on treatment units. On July 1, a treatment center in the Bafouabangko area was set on fire, police officer killed in clashes over a suspected Ebola death. Ebola spreads via direct contact with infected fluids; safe burials are essential. Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or therapy, though WHO is trialing two therapies. Attacks and misinformation hinder care-seeking and keep the situation critical.

triage.headline_ja: エボラをめぐる陰謀論と医師・ボランティアへの攻撃：コンゴ民主共和国の現状
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で1,750例超・600人以上の死者を出すエボラ流行が続いており、誤情報による医療従事者への暴力や治療施設への放火など対応が阻害されている深刻な公衆衛生事案であるため。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株には承認されたワクチン・治療法がなく、WHOが治療薬の試験を実施中。誤情報・暴力により安全な埋葬や治療アクセスが妨げられ、感染拡大リスクが高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉疫情夺600人命

article.articleHeadline: El número de muertos a causa del brote de ébola en RDC llega al...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from the Ebola outbreak in the DRC reaches ...
article.articleSummary: As of July 9, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 1,759 cases and 600 deaths, with 750 recoveries and 285 hospitalized; 51 new cases and 20 deaths were reported in the last day, and contact tracing stands at 80%. Two cases were detected in Kisangani, capital of Tshopo province, adjacent to Ituri and North and South Kivu provinces. One Tshopo case is linked to Ituri’s Nia-Nia health area; investigations continue and affected provinces remain. Authorities have reinforced surveillance and urged residents to report symptoms. In Tshopo, July 3 measures restricted corpse entry after three Ebola deaths were found there; checkpoints have risen at Avakubi, Bafwasende, PK23 and PK13 to prevent spread to Kisangani. Uganda reports two deaths. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo, with no approved vaccine or treatment; WHO declared a PHEIC. DRC has Ebola experience dating to 1976 in Yambuku.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行による死者数が600人に達し、感染確認例は1750人を超える
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した進行中のエボラ流行で、死者600人・症例1759人に達し、新規発生地域（キサンガニ）への拡大やウガンダでの死亡例も報告されており、国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの死亡例報告があるが、記事の主題は主にDRC国内の流行状況であり、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため除外。WHOによるPHEIC宣言済みで、承認されたワクチン・治療法がない点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: 2 Penyebab Amandel Meradang, Infeksi Virus Paling Sering
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two Causes of Tonsillitis: Viral Infections Are the Most Common.
article.articleSummary: Viral infections are the leading cause of tonsillitis. Inflammation of the palatine tonsils produces sore throat, enlarged red tonsils, and painful swallowing. ENT specialist Vindina Rettha Arianingrum of RSPI Sulianti Saroso in Jakarta notes that about 75% or more of upper respiratory tract infections are viral, caused by pathogens such as influenza viruses and rhinoviruses. These viruses can trigger tonsil swelling and throat discomfort. The transmission is highly contagious through respiratory droplets released when coughing, sneezing, or speaking in close proximity. The remarks were shared during an Instagram talk show with Indonesia's Ministry of Health (Kemenkes). This underscores the viral origin of most tonsillitis cases and the role of droplet transmission.

article.articleHeadline: 自治区疾控局发布健康提示：灾后重点防范五类高发疾病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Autonomous Region CDC Issues Health Tips: Post-disaster Focus on Preventing Five Major High-Incidence Diseases
article.articleSummary: Following Typhoon Maysak-caused flooding in Guangxi, the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Center for Disease Control and Prevention issued post-disaster health tips on July 8, 2026, highlighting five high-incidence disease risks. No case counts are given. (1) Enteric/infectious diarrhea threats include bacterial dysentery, typhoid, cholera, hepatitis A, and norovirus gastroenteritis; prevention centers on safe water and hand hygiene—do not drink floodwater or contaminated foods, wash hands frequently. (2) Foodborne diseases arise from spoiled or flood-contaminated foods; ensure thorough cooking, utensil disinfection, separate raw and cooked foods, and pest control. (3) Vector-borne diseases risk dengue fever, chikungunya fever, and Japanese encephalitis; prevent bites with long clothing, repellents, bed nets, and reduced outdoor exposure. (4) Water-borne leptospirosis risk after floodwaters; incubation 1–2 weeks; early signs include fever, fatigue, calf pain, lymphadenopathy, and conjunctival congestion. (5) Respiratory infections such as influenza and Mycoplasma pneumoniae; crowding in shelters warrants masks, hand hygiene, and distancing. Report symptoms to settlement medical staff promptly.

triage.triage_reason: 実際の症例発生ではなく、台風による洪水後の一般的な疾病予防に関する行政機関からの注意喚起であり、具体的な患者数や異常な流行は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は台風メイサック後の洪水を受けた広西チワン族自治区CDCによる予防啓発であり、具体的な症例報告は含まれない。対象国リストに含まれる国での実際の感染症発生事例ではないため、地域検証の観点からverified_locationsは空とする（中国国内の一地方における注意喚起情報のため、疾病発生報告としての重みは低い）。

article.articleHeadline: What's Hot Today 09 July 2026 - Ebola Death Toll Climbs, U.S.-Iran Tensions Explode, Morocco Eyes France and Major Investments Boost the Kingdom
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) worsens, with about 600 deaths attributed to the Bundibugyo strain. As of 9 July 2026, the World Health Organization classifies the outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The virus continues to spread in eastern DRC, while neighboring countries stay on high alert to prevent cross-border transmission. There is currently no approved vaccine or specific treatment for the Bundibugyo strain, complicating response efforts. Health authorities warn the situation remains extremely difficult as insecurity in several affected regions slows key containment activities, including patient isolation and contact tracing. Ongoing transmission underlines the need for strengthened surveillance and laboratory confirmation to prevent further cases and to limit regional spread.

article.articleHeadline: 埃博拉:中非共和国边境处于戒备
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The Central African Republic border is on high alert.
article.articleSummary: Facing Ebola threats from eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, the Central African Republic (CAR) has heightened alert in Haut-Mbomou’s Obo town near the Ituri border. Authorities have deployed surveillance teams, stationed health personnel at border posts, and set up emergency treatment centers to prevent cross-border transmission as the DRC reports spread in Ituri. As of July 9, 2026, CAR reports no confirmed Ebola cases. CAR Health Minister Dr. Pierre Somsé, alongside the Pasteur Institute director, plans an on-site inspection with WHO support. The public is urged to report suspected cases, maintain hand hygiene, avoid contact with the ill, and seek care promptly at health centers. Border communities express concern over potential disruptions to trade with the DRC amid ongoing outbreak dynamics and cross-border movement.
