article.articleHeadline: 41歲男子確診猴痘　潛伏期前往台灣旅遊曾有高風險接觸
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 41-year-old man diagnosed with monkeypox; traveled to Taiwan during the incubation period and had high-risk exposure.
article.articleSummary: On July 9, 2026, Hong Kong reported a confirmed monkeypox case: a 41-year-old man diagnosed and isolated at Queen Mary Hospital; he remains in stable condition. He developed fever and a rash since July 2, with lymphadenopathy on July 7. He sought care at the Department of Health’s Male Social Hygiene Clinic and was subsequently admitted for isolation. The patient had not received monkeypox vaccination prior to illness and had traveled to Taiwan during the incubation period, with high-risk exposure there; infection could have been acquired in Taiwan. The Centre for Health Protection states there is currently no epidemiological link to previously confirmed local Hong Kong monkeypox cases.

article.articleHeadline: Zastrašujuće brojke iz Afrike: Epidemija ebole odnijela 600 života
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarming figures from Africa: The Ebola epidemic has claimed 600 lives.
article.articleSummary: As of July 9, 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has caused 600 deaths in the latest outbreak, with 1,759 confirmed infections nationwide. Two new suspected cases were reported in Kisangani, in Tshopo Province; one case is linked to the Nia-Nia health zone in Ituri Province (where the first cases appeared), while the second has no clear link to known hotspots. The government declared the outbreak on May 15 after weeks of transmission without official disclosure. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Last week, clinical trials for treatments began as researchers launched a long-awaited study. Containment is hampered by funding shortages, attacks on health facilities, and ongoing conflict in eastern Congo, the outbreak’s epicenter.

article.articleHeadline: Ova dva smrtonosna virusa mogu u početku izgledati kao grip: Ne ignorišite prve simptome upozorenja
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: These Two Deadly Viruses May Initially Look Like the Flu: Do Not Ignore the Early Warning Signs.
article.articleSummary: Ebola and hantavirus infections may begin with flu-like symptoms, making early recognition and strict infection prevention crucial. In Canada, hantavirus is nationally reportable, with 4–5 confirmed cases annually, mostly from rodent exposure in agricultural areas; Andes virus can spread person-to-person. Hantavirus strains in the Americas cause hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome, while European/Asian strains cause hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome. Incubation is 2–4 weeks; early signs include fever, headache, myalgias, and abdominal pain. Diagnosis relies on serology and PCR by the National Microbiology Laboratory in Winnipeg. No antiviral or vaccine exists for hantavirus; treatment is supportive. Ebola outbreaks persist in Central and West Africa; Bundibugyo ebolavirus has a 30–50% case-fatality in the current DRC epidemic. Transmission via bodily fluids and contaminated surfaces; vaccines exist for Zaire ebolavirus, and two antivirals have reduced mortality for some strains, but none for Bundibugyo. Strict PPE-based infection control remains essential.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll in DR Congo rises to 600 as WHO intensifies response
article.articleSummary: As of 9 July 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths (case fatality rate ~34%), with 285 recoveries and 304 suspected cases under investigation. Ituri Province remains the epicentre, and infections span four northeastern provinces, with cross-border spread to Uganda (20 confirmed cases, 2 deaths; 17 recoveries). The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, a rare variant with no approved vaccines or licensed treatments. Congolese authorities began a clinical trial on 2 July to evaluate MBP134 (monoclonal antibody) and remdesivir, alone and in combination, as potential therapies. Ebola is a severe viral haemorrhagic disease transmitted through direct contact with bodily fluids or contaminated materials. Containment, surveillance, and cross-border coordination are critical to prevent wider regional spread.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴでのエボラ死者数、600人に増加 WHOが対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRコンゴで大規模流行(1,759症例・600死亡)し、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダも影響を受けているが、対象国リストに含まれていないためverified_locationsには含めていない。ワクチン・治療薬未承認の稀な株(Bundibugyo)による流行であり、致死率約34%と高い。WHOが対応を強化している点からも国際的関心が高い事案。

article.articleHeadline: Россиян предупредили о риске подцепить "зуд купальщика" при отдыхе на воде
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russians warned about the risk of contracting swimmer's itch during water recreation.
article.articleSummary: Swimmer's itch (cercarial dermatitis) poses a risk for Russians swimming in freshwater bodies with stagnant or slow-moving water and abundant waterfowl. Cercariae, larval flatworms (schistosomes), penetrate the skin but do not mature in humans; red, itchy welts and blisters develop, lasting two to three weeks. Protection measures include swimming only in designated areas with regular laboratory water quality monitoring and avoiding contact with waterfowl; after bathing, thorough drying and a soap shower at home. Separate health notes report detection of Vibrio parahaemolyticus and Vibrio vulnificus DNA off Turkey; illness stems from raw or undercooked seafood and can occur from contaminated water as well. Travel advisories warn Bali, Indonesia, and other resort zones harbor various locally transmitted infections, compounded by acclimatization. The article emphasizes prevention and awareness for travelers and residents engaging in water recreation and seafood consumption.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア人に水泳中の「水泳者のかゆみ」感染リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: ロシアにおける一般的な水浴・食品衛生の予防啓発記事であり、特定の国でのアウトブレイクや異常事態を報告するものではない。対象国での具体的な発生報告もない。

article.articleHeadline: 497 guéris d'Ebola notifiés en trois jours en RDC - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 497 Ebola recoveries reported in three days in the DRC - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) recoveries in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surged in three days, rising from 253 to 750 (an increase of 497), representing about 94% of treated patients. The reported recoveries span Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces. Health authorities, with technical and financial partners, are intensifying measures to halt transmission. The three-day surge follows the 4 July and 7 July epidemiological reports. The record-high clinical performance stems from two pillars of modern emergency medicine: early intensive supportive care in Ebola Treatment Centers, underpinned by large-scale hydro-electrolyte replacement to stabilize vital functions; and the launch in early July of the randomized PARTNERS clinical trial, coordinated by the National Institute of Biomedical Research (INRB) and the World Health Organization (WHO).

triage.notes: 本記事は既知の進行中のエボラ流行における回復者数の増加を報告するもので、新規発生や急激な悪化を示すものではないが、疾患の重篤性と継続的な国際支援の必要性からPICKUPと判定した。

article.articleHeadline: बच्चों में दो सप्ताह से अधिक बुखार-खांसी आए तो कराएं टीबी जांच
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: If children have fever and cough for more than two weeks, get a TB test.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) in children is being highlighted in Bahraich, Uttar Pradesh, India, under the National TB Elimination Program (NTEP). Authorities emphasize that fever, cough, and weight loss persisting in children for more than two weeks warrant prompt TB testing, as treatment is available. A workshop at the Chief Medical Officer’s Office, part of the WHP Pediatric Program, aimed to strengthen district-level capabilities in pediatric TB diagnosis, screening, and treatment management. Key speakers included District TB Officer Dr. M.L. Verma, Master Trainer Dr. Paritosh Tiwari, and WHO Consultant Dr. Deepak Chaturvedi. The article does not provide case counts or laboratory confirmation details, but underscores the importance of timely screening and management of pediatric TB during ongoing public health efforts as of July 9, 2026.

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa aprova registro de novo medicamento para doença de Chagas em crianças
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa approves registration of a new drug for Chagas disease in children.
article.articleSummary: Anvisa has authorizedLampit® (nifurtimox) for pediatric treatment of Chagas disease in Brazil, via Resolution RE 2,631/2026 published in the Diário Oficial da União. The medicine is indicated for children from birth (minimum 2.5 kg) to under 18 years. Nifurtimox is a synthetic antiparasitic that promotes intracellular free radical generation, damaging Trypanosoma cruzi and stopping replication, aiding elimination from blood and tissues. In Brazil, public health sources estimate 1.9–4.6 million people are infected. Chagas disease is classified by the World Health Organization as a neglected tropical disease, historically affecting socially vulnerable populations and receiving limited pharmaceutical investment in vaccines and new drugs. Transmission occurs via triatomine bugs (barbeiros); infected feces contact humans after biting. The disease often remains silent early, with serious chronic manifestations decades later, including cardiopathies such as cardiomegaly and digestive tract megacolon and megaesophagus.

article.articleHeadline: Congo: el brote de ébola ya dejó 600 muertos y la OMS advirtió que la epidemia sigue expandiéndose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: the Ebola outbreak has already claimed 600 lives, and the WHO warned that the epidemic continues to spread.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's 17th Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola virus, has about 600 deaths as the WHO warns the epidemic continues to spread and its true magnitude remains undetermined. The outbreak centers in Ituri province in the northeast near the borders with South Sudan and Uganda, with cases also in North Kivu and South Kivu where insecurity and M23 control hinder response. Declared May 15, the outbreak is stressing health facilities, with treatment centers operating at roughly 90% capacity. There is currently no vaccine or approved treatment for Bundibugjo EBOV. On July 2, the WHO initiated a clinical trial of two experimental therapies and authorized emergency use of the first molecular diagnostic test for detection. In Uganda, 2 deaths and 20 confirmed cases are reported, underscoring cross-border transmission and ongoing humanitarian needs such as food and health services.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ:エボラ出血熱の流行ですでに600人が死亡、WHOは流行が拡大し続けていると警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが600人の死者を出し、ウガンダへの越境伝播も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンへの越境伝播が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRC国内でもイトゥリ州を中心に北キブ・南キブ州で治安悪化（M23支配地域）が対応を妨げている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: 25 Warga Cianjur Meninggal Akibat TBC, 4.643 Pasien Jalani Pengobatan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 25 Cianjur Residents Die from Tuberculosis, 4,643 Patients Undergoing Treatment
article.articleSummary: In Cianjur Regency, West Java, Indonesia, tuberculosis (TB) cases reached 5,763 from January to June 2026, with 25 deaths and 4,643 patients currently undergoing treatment. The Cianjur Health Department notes deaths occurred among patients already on treatment, predominantly adults. TB treatment lasts about six months, and medications are provided free at all public health centers (puskesmas). Case distribution spans nearly all districts, with higher incidence in densely populated areas, especially Cianjur and Karangtengah. Transmission is airborne via droplets when coughing, sneezing, or talking. Beyond treatment, authorities stress socialization, contact tracing, and outreach to detect cases early, aiming to curb transmission and meet Indonesia’s national TB elimination target by 2030.

triage.headline_ja: チアンジュール住民25人が結核で死亡、4,643人が治療中
triage.triage_reason: 結核はインドネシアで地方流行状態にあり異常な事象ではないが、死亡者数と患者数の規模から継続的なモニタリングが望ましい。
triage.notes: 結核はインドネシアの風土病であり、国家的な排除目標(2030年)に向けた既存対策の一環として報告されている。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、地域内の感染管理・早期発見の継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa aprova novo tratamento infantil para combater doença de Chagas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa Approves New Pediatric Treatment to Combat Chagas Disease.
article.articleSummary: Chagas disease: Anvisa approved Lampit (nifurtimox) for pediatric use in Brazil, expanding access through the SUS and hospitals. The registration, formalized by Resolution 2.631/2026 and published in the Diário Oficial da União (Official Journal of the Union), covers patients from newborns weighing at least 2.5 kg to under 18 years. Nifurtimox acts as an antiparasitic by generating substances that damage Trypanosoma cruzi and eliminate the parasite. Chagas remains one of the neglected diseases, disproportionately affecting low-income and socially vulnerable populations; estimates suggest 1.9–4.6 million Brazilians are infected. Transmitted by the triatomine bug known as the barbeiro, the disease can be silent for years before causing chronic, irreversible damage to the heart, esophagus, or intestines. The pediatric approval seeks to slow progression and prevent adult sequelae, enhancing early treatment options within Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: アンヴィザ(ANVISA)、シャーガス病治療のための新しい小児用治療薬を承認
triage.triage_reason: 新規アウトブレイクではなく、既知の顧みられない熱帯病に対する規制当局の新薬承認に関する報道であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は新薬の規制承認に関する内容であり、アウトブレイクや症例急増の報告ではないため、シグナルトリアージ対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Com queda de até 88%, Cruzeiro do Sul comemora redução nos casos de dengue e malária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With a drop of up to 88%, Cruzeiro do Sul celebrates reduction in dengue and malaria cases.
article.articleSummary: Dengue and malaria cases in Cruzeiro do Sul, Acre, Brazil, dropped sharply in January–July 2026 compared with the same period in 2025. Probable dengue cases fell 88%—from 2,367 in 2025 to 179 in 2026 (weeks 1–27). Malaria cases declined by about 48% between January 1–July 6, 2025 (1,536 cases) and the same period in 2026 (797). Authorities attribute the gains to drier conditions and improved community access, enabling intensified vector surveillance and active case finding. The Municipal Health Secretariat’s Vector Control Division, led by Leonís Messias, notes sustaining preventive actions are essential, including sealing water tanks, removing water-collecting containers, and allowing endemic agents into residences. With continued rainfall decline, teams can reach remote ramais and villages, aiming to maintain reductions through the dry season and reinforce Cruzeiro do Sul as a reference in vector-borne disease response in the Vale do Juruá.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱・マラリア症例最大88%減少、クルゼイロ・ド・スルが成果を祝う
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・マラリア症例が大幅に減少しているという内容であり、公衆衛生上の懸念や異常事態ではなく、むしろ改善傾向を示す前向きなニュースである。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・アクレ州クルゼイロ・ド・スルにおけるデング熱・マラリア症例の減少を報告するもので、リスク増大の兆候はない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、内容が症例減少という良好な傾向のため、シグナルとしては見送り。

article.articleHeadline: Produtor obrigado a abater 82 vacas por tuberculose bovina, recomeça do zero e volta a produzir 450 litros de leite por dia - CompreRural
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Producer forced to cull 82 cows due to bovine tuberculosis, starts from scratch and returns to producing 450 liters of milk per day - CompreRural.
article.articleSummary: Bovine tuberculosis forced a Santa Catarina dairy producer in Braço do Norte to cull 82 cows after official tests confirmed infection, with an initial cull of 27 animals and remaining animals reduced to 10 before the herd was fully removed to halt disease spread. The farm entered a sanitary hiatus, then restarted production thanks to indemnities from Fundesa, the Santa Catarina State Fund for Animal Health, which supported restructuring, restocking, and ongoing dairy operations. By 2025, Fundesa had disbursed about BRL 20 million in indemnities to producers in similar cases. The operation now yields about 450 liters of milk per day, symbolizing recovery and continuity. The case highlights how structured animal-health programs and timely compensation enable rapid disease control, protect the regional dairy supply, and sustain small-to-mid-sized farms.

triage.headline_ja: 牛結核により82頭の乳牛を淘汰した生産者、ゼロから再出発し1日450リットルの牛乳生産に復帰 - CompreRural
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州における牛結核の家畜対応と経済復興を伝える記事であり、ヒトへの健康影響や公衆衛生上の懸念は記載されていない。
triage.notes: 家畜(牛)の結核による淘汰と州基金による補償・営農再開の話題で、公衆衛生上のヒト感染事例やアウトブレイクの記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: 46-Year-Old Man Dies Of COVID-19 in Kadapa,AP
article.articleSummary: 46-year-old man dies of COVID-19 in Kadapa, Andhra Pradesh, as of 9 July 2026, four days after admission when high-dose antibiotics failed to control his symptoms. Kadapa District Medical & Health Officer Ravi Babu said the patient, who had a history of alcohol addiction, was admitted for severe breathlessness and cough. An X-ray showed bilateral lung damage with pneumonia, and the illness did not subside after four days of antibiotics, prompting doctors to suspect a coronavirus infection. A chest CT scan subsequently confirmed COVID-19 infection, Babu added. Containment measures, including sanitisation and tracing of primary and secondary contacts, have been undertaken by local authorities. The report underscores the fatal outcome despite antibiotic therapy and confirms laboratory-diagnosed COVID-19 in this Kadapa case.

triage.headline_ja: アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州カダパで46歳男性がCOVID-19により死亡
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19による個別の死亡例であり、既知の流行性疾患の単発症例報告に留まる。異常性や国際的拡大の兆候はなく、地域の通常対応（消毒・接触者追跡）で管理されている。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既に世界的に流行が収束・地方風土病化しており、単発の重症死亡例は通常の医療対応範囲内と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: 聖嬰現象助長病媒蚊繁殖　疾管署籲：落實「這些事」防登革熱 | LIFE生活網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: El Niño phenomenon fuels breeding of disease-carrying mosquitoes; Taiwan CDC urges: implement these measures to prevent dengue fever | LIFE Lifestyle Network
article.articleSummary: El Niño may strengthen in coming months, raising temperatures and rainfall, increasing extreme weather and potentially accelerating dengue transmission. Warmer conditions can shorten Aedes aegypti larval cycles and the virus incubation in mosquitoes, while heavy rainfall creates abundant standing water that boosts breeding sites. In Taiwan, 83 dengue cases have been confirmed through July 6, including 7 locally acquired in Kaohsiung; 76 imported cases from Southeast and South Asia (Indonesia 21, Maldives 14, Vietnam 11). Globally, dengue remains severe with about 1.44 million cases by May, concentrated in the Americas (Brazil leading) and rising numbers in Vietnam, Malaysia, Sri Lanka, Cambodia, Bangladesh, Laos, with multiple serotypes circulating. Prevention emphasizes post-rain cleanup of standing water via “4-steps”: patrol, overturn, clean, and drain containers; outdoor protection with light-colored clothing and approved repellents (DEET, Picaridin, IR-3535). Seek medical care for dengue-like symptoms and report travel history; return travelers should inform airport quarantine if symptomatic.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョ現象が媒介蚊の繁殖を助長　台湾疾病管理署、登革熱予防のための対策実施を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 台湾での季節性登革熱対策に関する一般的な注意喚起記事であり、新規の異常な流行を報告するものではないが、世界的な症例数増加（ブラジル、ベトナム、インドネシア等）への言及があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事は台湾疾病管理署によるエルニーニョと登革熱媒介蚊繁殖に関する季節性の予防啓発記事。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ブラジル・ベトナム・インドネシアは世界的な症例増加国として言及されているが、いずれも既存の流行状況の一環であり新規異常事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo: Ebola death toll climbs to 600 - Blueprint Newspapers Limited
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Ebola outbreak has reached 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths (case fatality rate 34%), as of July 9, 2026, per WHO. Ituri Province remains the epicentre, with spread across four northeastern provinces. The death toll rose by more than 100 in three days; 285 patients have recovered, while 304 suspected cases remain under investigation. Neighboring Uganda reports infections, including two deaths and 17 of 20 confirmed patients recovered. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no approved vaccines or specific treatments. DRC declared its 17th Ebola outbreak on May 15. Transmission occurs via close contact with infected individuals or bodily fluids, making early detection and isolation critical. Clinical trials begun July 2 are evaluating MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir, alone and in combination.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラ死者数が600人に到達
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で1,759症例・600死亡（致死率34%）に達し、隣国ウガンダにも越境拡大しており、承認されたワクチン・治療薬がないため国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも感染者・死者が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めない。承認ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないブンディブギョ株による第17次流行であり、越境拡大が既に発生している点で警戒度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: El número de muertos a causa del brote de ébola llega al umbral de los 600, con más de 1.750 casos confirmados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of deaths due to the Ebola outbreak has reached the 600 mark, with more than 1,750 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths, with 750 recoveries, according to the Congolese National Institute of Public Health (INSP). In the last 24 hours, 51 new cases and 20 deaths were reported; 285 patients remain hospitalized and contact tracing stands at 80%. Two new cases were detected in Kisangani, capital of Tshopo province, linked to the Ituri area’s Nia-Nia, with three provinces affected: Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. North and South Kivu are partially controlled by the M23 rebel group. One Kisangani case is connected to Ituri’s Nia-Nia area. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; the strain is Bundibugyo, with no approved vaccine or treatment. Uganda reports two deaths; Congo reinforces surveillance and border controls, including temperature screening and increased checkpoints to prevent spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行で死者数が600人に到達、確定症例は1,750件超
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言済みの大規模エボラ流行であり、複数州への拡大・国境を越えたウガンダへの伝播が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEICを宣言済みのBundibugyo株によるエボラ流行。ウガンダでも死者2名報告されているが対象国リストに含まれず、記事主題はDRCの流行であるためDRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。ワクチン・治療法未承認、M23反政府勢力が一部支配する地域での対応の困難さも懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa aprova medicamento para tratar doença de Chagas em pacientes pediátricos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa approves a drug to treat Chagas disease in pediatric patients.
article.articleSummary: Anvisa approves Lampit (nifurtimox) for treating Chagas disease in pediatric patients in Brazil, including newborns weighing at least 2.5 kg up to under 18 years. Chagas disease is caused by Trypanosoma cruzi and is a neglected illness that predominantly affects vulnerable populations in Brazil, with potential for high morbidity and mortality. Infected individuals may remain asymptomatic for years, and if untreated can progress to severe cardiac and digestive complications. Lampit is an antiparasitic whose action involves generating substances that damage the parasite, enabling elimination from the body. The registration expands therapeutic options for children and infants, reflecting ongoing public health efforts to address pediatric Chagas disease. The article does not specify case counts or reported outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: Anvisa、シャーガス病の小児患者向け治療薬を承認
triage.triage_reason: 薬事承認に関する内容であり、新規発生や異常な感染拡大等は報告されておらず、公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 本記事は薬事承認（治療薬の適応拡大）に関する報道であり、感染症のアウトブレイクや症例数の急増を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Minst 600 døde av ebola i Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: At least 600 died of Ebola in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: New Ebola infections and deaths have been reported in Congo, bringing the death toll to 600. Congolese authorities declared a fresh Ebola outbreak on May 15 after the disease had spread for weeks without official detection, according to WHO. Total confirmed Ebola cases in the country reach 1,759. The outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Efforts to combat the virus have been hampered by funding constraints, attacks on health facilities, and the ongoing conflict in East Congo, where the outbreak is concentrated. The situation highlights ongoing challenges in surveillance and response, underscoring the public health risk in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラにより少なくとも600人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（死者600人、確定症例1,759例）で、承認されたワクチン・治療法がないブンディブギョ株が原因であり、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療法未承認のブンディブギョ株による流行で、東コンゴの紛争地域が中心のため対応が困難。資金不足・医療施設への攻撃も報告されており、WHOによる正式な発生宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Outbreak of Ebola in the DRC Poses Major Health Risk - The Borgen Project
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), concentrated in Ituri Province’s Mongbwalu and North Kivu. Declared May 15 by the Congolese Health Ministry; as of roughly a month later, over 1,200 infections and 360 deaths. No cure or vaccine for this Bundibugyo strain; symptoms overlap with malaria/typhoid, and testing delays persist with results taking days in Bunia as kits are scarce. Origin suspected in Mongbwalu due to fruit bats; hospitals underresourced, with temporary shelters in Ituri and North Kivu. International response includes pledges of millions of dollars from the US, South Africa, and EU; WHO delivered more than 11 tons of medical supplies; MONUSCO established an air bridge from Bunia. CDC considers US risk low; several countries have travel bans, including Canada’s 90-day ban. Worsening humanitarian crisis and food insecurity amplify outbreak impact.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が発生、重大な健康リスクをもたらす - The Borgen Project
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が発生し、1200人以上が感染、360人以上が死亡。ワクチン・治療法がなく、既に複数国が渡航制限を実施しており、国際的な支援も動いている重大事案。
triage.notes: 米国・南アフリカ・カナダは資金拠出や渡航制限の実施国として言及されているのみで、発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。ワクチン・治療法が存在しないブンディブギョ株であること、致死率が高いこと（360/1200超）、複数国が渡航制限を既に実施していることから緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Assam reports 147 JE, AES cases, 10 deaths this year; govt steps up response
article.articleSummary: Assam reports 147 Japanese Encephalitis (JE) and Acute Encephalitis Syndrome (AES) cases with 10 deaths this year. On July 9, Health Minister Ashok Singhal said districts have nodal officers; medical colleges and district hospitals coordinate treatment; ICU beds are reserved for JE/AES; SOPs issued; and stocks of medicines, oxygen and diagnostics ensured. JE vaccination has begun and is in routine infant immunisation, with adult vaccination underway and about 75% of targeted areas covered. Campaigns are active in Dhubri, Sribhumi, Bongaigaon, Charaideo, Majuli and Sonitpur; immunisation drives in Barpeta, Bajali, Darrang, Kamrup, Nalbari and Karbi Anglong. Officials note hotspots shift between districts; the public is urged to seek care promptly and use mosquito nets. Private-hospital JE treatment is subsidised with Rs 1 lakh aid, though delays arise when initial care occurs in under-equipped facilities. Seasonal rises are linked to heavy monsoon, paddy farming, waterlogging and pig-rearing.

triage.headline_ja: アッサム州、今年のJE・AES症例147件、死亡10人を報告；政府が対応強化
triage.triage_reason: インド・アッサム州における日本脳炎(JE)/急性脳炎症候群(AES)の季節性発生であり、既に地域政府が体系的な対応（SOP、ワクチン接種、医療資源確保）を実施している。異常性や国際的拡大の兆候はなく、毎年の風土病的流行として引き続き経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: JEはアッサム州で毎年モンスーン期に発生する風土病であり、今回の報告も季節性の範囲内。政府はワクチン接種（対象地域の約75%カバー）やICU確保など既に体系的対応を実施しており、外部支援の必要性は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkab Agam Bentuk Nagari Peduli TB Paru untuk Genjot Capaian Temuan Kasus TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Agam Regency Government Establishes a Pulmonary TB Care Nagari to Boost TB Case Finding
article.articleSummary: On 9 July 2026, in Lubuk Basung, Agam Regency, West Sumatra, a phased Pulmonary Tuberculosis (TB) Care Nagari program named Nagari Peduli TB Paru was launched to boost TB case finding. In the first phase, 46 of 92 nagari will participate after coordination with village heads, with a launch soon. The effort targets raising TB case finding, as the previous year’s achievement was only 37% of the 2025 target of 2,435 cases set by provincial and central authorities; Agam identified 890 cases. TB is caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis. Pulmonary TB presents with a prolonged productive cough for three weeks or more, shortness of breath as disease worsens, fever, weight loss. TB remains a high-burden disease globally, nationally and locally. TB is curable with six months of anti-tuberculosis treatment; vigorous detection and treatment are needed to reach targets.

triage.headline_ja: アガム県政府、結核症例発見率向上のため「結核ケア・ナガリ」プログラムを開始
triage.triage_reason: 結核対策プログラムの通常の行政的取り組みに関する記事であり、異常な発生や急性の公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の高負担疾患であり、地域の症例発見率向上のための通常の公衆衛生プログラムに関する記事。緊急のシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حصيلة الوفيات بسبب الإيبولا في الكونغو إلى 600 - بوابة الشروق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death toll from Ebola in Congo rises to 600 - Shorouk Portal
article.articleSummary: Death toll from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo rises to 600, with total laboratory-confirmed cases reaching 1,795 nationwide. In the latest government update, two new suspected cases were recorded in Kisangani, in Tshopo Province; one case is linked to the Nianya health zone in Ituri Province where initial cases were reported, while the other has no clear geographic link and is under investigation. The outbreak, first declared on May 15, is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with no licensed vaccine or treatment. Containment has been hindered by funding gaps, attacks on health facilities, and ongoing conflict in eastern Congo, complicating surveillance, laboratory confirmation, and transmission tracing as authorities continue to assess and respond to new cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱による死者数600人に上昇 - シュルーク・ポータル
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の死者が600人、確定症例1,795例に達し、紛争地域での封じ込め困難という深刻かつ国際的関心の高い事案であるため。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにある中国四川省・Nianya（中国座標）は地理コード付与の誤りと考えられ、実際のNianyaはイトゥリ州（DRC）の保健区域を指すため除外した。資金不足、医療施設への攻撃、東部紛争が対応を妨げており、外部支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemie de Ebola în RDC: Bilanţul deceselor a ajuns la 600 de morţi, potrivit OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in the DRC: The death toll has reached 600, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 600 deaths and 1,759 confirmed cases since the current epidemic began, according to a WHO briefing published July 7. In neighbouring Uganda, authorities report 2 deaths and 20 confirmed cases. The 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC is centered in Ituri province in the northeast, near the borders with South Sudan and Uganda. Declared May 15, the outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. The World Health Organization warns the true scale remains uncertain and the outbreak could last for months. Treatment centers are operating at about 90% capacity, placing substantial strain on the response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行：WHOによると死者数が600人に達した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事態、国際的拡大＝ウガンダへの越境）に加え、WPRO基準も複数該当し社会的関心も高いため、フルリスク評価に進むべき事案。

article.articleHeadline: Child with Chandipura virus infection dies in Gujarat's Sabarkantha
article.articleSummary: Six-year-old Rajkumar Damor, a resident of Udaipur, Rajasthan, died at Himmatnagar civil hospital in Sabarkantha district, Gujarat, with a confirmed Chandipura virus (CHPV) infection. Seven suspected CHPV patients, all children aged 2–11, were admitted between June 26 and July 9. One more child who died yesterday is awaiting test confirmation; another deceased child tested negative. Two girls (2-year-old from Rajasthan and 3-year-old from Sabarkantha) with suspected CHPV are under treatment and awaiting reports; a 3-year-old boy tested negative and was discharged, while a 3-year-old girl’s report is awaited. Affected children come from Rajasthan and Gujarat’s Banaskantha, Panchmahal, and Sabarkantha districts; a dedicated CHPV ward has been opened on the ground floor. CHPV, a Rhabdoviridae member, causes sporadic acute encephalitis syndrome (AES) outbreaks in western/central/southern India, especially during the monsoon; transmission via sandflies, mosquitoes, ticks; CFR 56–75%; no specific treatment or vaccine. A 2003 Andhra Pradesh AES outbreak involved 329 suspected cases and 183 deaths; CHPV suspected.

article.articleHeadline: Épidémie d'Ebola en RDC: le bilan atteint 600 morts, selon l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DRC: the death toll has reached 600, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: 17th Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), declared May 15, has reached 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths, according to a WHO situation update dated July 7, 2026. The epicenter is Ituri province in the northeast, bordering South Sudan and Uganda; virus circulation extends into nearby North Kivu and South Kivu amid ongoing insecurity and population displacement. In neighboring Uganda, authorities report 20 confirmed cases and two deaths. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no vaccine or approved specific treatment. A clinical trial evaluating two treatments for this strain began on July 2, and the WHO has granted emergency-use authorization for the first molecular diagnostic test. Treatment centers are operating at about 90% capacity, underscoring persistent humanitarian needs, including civilian protection, food security, and essential health services.

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes KBB Ajak Warga Kenali Bahaya Penyakit Zoonotik Sejak Dini
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bandung Barat Regency Health Office Calls on Residents to Recognize the Dangers of Zoonotic Diseases Early.
article.articleSummary: Bandung Barat Regency Health Office urges residents to recognize zoonotic diseases early, citing transmission from animal bites, sudden-death poultry, and standing water contaminated with rat urine. A two-day Zoonotic Disease Prevention Education Workshop was held July 9–10, 2026 at the Bandung Barat Regent’s Office, organized by the District Health Office with PortKesmas and RCCE, and involving the Department of Animal Husbandry, the Communications and Informatics Office, PMI, health promoters, Nahdlatul Ulama, Muhammadiyah, and media. The event aims to strengthen public communication and regional readiness against zoonoses such as rabies, avian influenza, anthrax, and leptospirosis, and to train personnel to counter misinformation. Dr. Enung Masruroh notes lessons from COVID-19 (2020) and the 2007 Cimahi avian influenza outbreak nearby, underscoring proactive preparedness before outbreaks.

article.articleHeadline: मुंबई में भारी बारिश के बीच बीएमसी का अलर्ट, लेप्टोस्पायरोसिस से बचाव की एडवाइजरी जारी | BMC urges citizens to take precautions against Leptospirosis during monsoon
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: BMC alert amid heavy rains in Mumbai; advisory issued to prevent leptospirosis.
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis alert in Mumbai as heavy monsoon rains flood areas and create stagnant water. Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) warns that rainwater and mud, especially with open wounds, raise infection risk. The Public Health Department instructs anyone who has traversed floodwater or mud to seek medical advice and take preventive medicines within 24–72 hours. Leptospira bacteria in contaminated mud and rainwater can enter through skin cuts, and leptospirosis can be severe or fatal if untreated. Free medical guidance, checkups, and preventive drugs are available at Hindu Hriday Samrat Balasaheb Thackeray Clinic, BMC dispensaries, health centers, and municipal hospitals. Authorities urge spreading awareness. Fever in monsoon could signal leptospirosis, dengue, or malaria. After exposure, wash and dry feet thoroughly; wear rubber boots when walking in water; do not self-medicate—consult a doctor promptly.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A total mess before Norway's quarterfinal! Viral infections, hotel noise, and players' disputes erupt simultaneously.
article.articleSummary: World Cup quarterfinal: Norway to face England in Miami on Saturday after Norway upset Brazil for their best-ever World Cup finish, while England defeated Mexico. The squad has been hit by influenza-like illness as of Tuesday night, with goalkeeper Orjan Nyland confirming several players unwell; Strand Larsen missed the group-stage opener with fever, and defender Pedersen also could not play Brazil’s knockout match. Coach Ståle Solbakken was seen coughing, but the team doctor Ola Sand and Solbakken downplay severe illness, stating only mild symptoms and that all players are largely fine. Internal friction emerged as forward Alexander Sørloth’s father disclosed the striker is irritable when substituted. The team filed a formal FIFA complaint about the five-star Darma Hotel in Lauderdale-by-the-Sea over noise and logistics and moved to a new hotel, coordinated by captain Ødegaard in about two-and-a-half hours; overall, the squad seeks to optimize readiness for the crucial match.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll hits 600 in DRC amid insecurity, strained health system
article.articleSummary: 600 deaths and 1,759 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) as of July 9, 2026, in an outbreak driven by the Bundibugyo species, which has no approved vaccines or treatments. In the DRC, 285 patients have recovered, 304 suspected cases are under investigation, and the case fatality rate stands at 34%. The outbreak spans four provinces but concentrates in Ituri, where the 17th Ebola outbreak was declared on May 15 after deaths in armed, mineral-rich Ituri. Across the border in Uganda, two deaths have been reported and 17 of 20 confirmed cases have recovered. Trials began July 2 in the DRC evaluating MBP134 monoclonal antibody and the antiviral remdesivir, alone and in combination. Ebola spreads via close contact and infected bodily fluids, and health authorities warn the outbreak remains in expansion as authorities monitor true scale.

article.articleHeadline: Le nombre de décès liés au virus Ebola en RDC atteint les 600 | L'actualité
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from the Ebola virus in the DRC has reached 600 | L'actualité
article.articleSummary: As of 9 July 2026, the latest Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed 600 people and produced 1,759 confirmed cases. Two new suspected cases were detected in Kisangani, Tshopo province, an area previously untouched. One suspected case is linked to the Nia-Nia health zone in Ituri province, where earliest cases were reported; the other case has no clear geographic link, investigators say. Authorities declared the outbreak on May 15 after undetected spread, caused by the rare Bundibugyo virus, for which there is neither a vaccine nor an approved treatment. Clinical trials began last week in response to the outbreak. Response is hampered by funding shortages, attacks on health centers, and ongoing conflict in eastern DRC, the outbreak's epicenter.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Epidemic - Support for the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC)
article.articleSummary: Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with Ituri Province identified as the focus and the latest outbreak described as the hardest-hit to date. France delivered 20 tons of humanitarian aid on July 7, 2026, coordinated by the Crisis and Support Center. A 12-ton package of infection-prevention equipment for homes of contacts of infected individuals was handed to Solidarités International; an 8-ton supply of medicines was provided to NGOs ALIMA and Première Urgence Internationale to bolster local health services and protect the most vulnerable. The aid supports ground actors, including local, regional, and UN health workers engaged in outbreak containment. France thanks humanitarian partners, the European Union, and Association Tulipe for donations of medicines.

article.articleHeadline: DPRD DKI Soroti Temuan 16 Siswa SMP Terpapar HIV di Jakarta Timur
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DKI Jakarta Regional People's Representative Council Highlights Finding of 16 Junior High School Students Exposed to HIV in East Jakarta
article.articleSummary: Sixteen students at a single junior high school in East Jakarta have been detected with HIV, drawing serious scrutiny from the DKI Jakarta Regional House of Representatives. Some affected youths are under 17, with investigators suggesting they may have fallen into risky peer networks, including motorcycle-racing gangs, signaling broader adolescent social issues in Jakarta. In a working meeting on RKPD 2026, Sekretaris Komisi E Justin Adrian Untayana described the finding as an iceberg and urged expanded prevention through education, enhanced surveillance, and stronger family involvement. He also proposed sanctions against families of students involved in street fighting (tawuran), including withdrawal of social assistance to bolster parental accountability. He cited a prior Duren Sawit case of a 14-year-old to illustrate weak parental supervision. Emphasizes collaboration among government, schools, and families to curb youth risk behaviors and HIV exposure.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola moving faster than the response, head of Africa CDC warns
article.articleSummary: Eastern DRC's Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak has reached over 1,700 confirmed cases and 580 deaths, with Uganda reporting 20 cases and 2 deaths. The outbreak, first declared in May, is intensifying as treatment centers reach saturation; contact tracing covers about 60% of cases, leaving thousands of contacts undiscovered and transmission chains at risk. The Bundibugyo variant lacks an approved vaccine or specific treatment; trials for therapies are underway. Africa CDC launched a six‑month, $518 million regional plan, but less than half is funded. As Dr. Jean Kaseya warns, a worst-case scenario of about 66,000 cases by September remains possible if response is not accelerated. Absence of vaccines/treatments compounds challenges: early detection, isolation, and community engagement become critical, while insecurity, displacement, and limited resources hinder tracing, adding pressure on neighboring Uganda with border/trade disruptions.

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola di RD Kongo Tembus 600 Korban Jiwa, Penularan Masih Meluas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo surpasses 600 deaths, transmission remains widespread.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 600 deaths, with 1,759 confirmed cases reported by WHO since mid-May, and a case-fatality rate of about 34%. The outbreak is concentrated in Ituri Province, notably Bunia, with spillover into Uganda where two deaths have occurred among 20 confirmed cases. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus species drives transmission; there is no approved vaccine or treatment for this strain. Clinical trials of monoclonal antibody MBP134 and the antiviral remdesivir began on 2 July. Factors hindering control include population movement, ongoing insecurity, and fragile health systems; health facilities are operating at 90% capacity, and follow-up on 82% of 10,000 contacts falls short of the 95% target. WHO seeks $115 million, only 32% funded. Separately, clashes in South Kivu involving M23 raise concerns about civilian protection and potential refugee exodus.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、死者600人を突破、感染拡大続く
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を3つ満たし（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事態、国際拡大）、WHOも資金要請を行うなど深刻な国際的懸念事案であるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境伝播が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。南キブ州のM23紛争は別事案として言及されており、エボラの感染拡大とは直接関係しない。

article.articleHeadline: 廣西​養豬場數千頭死豬泡水2天 部分已發黑
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thousands of dead pigs at a Guangxi pig farm floating in water for two days, some have already turned black.
article.articleSummary: As of July 9, 2026, floods in Guangxi’s Nanning city (Binyang County) inundated a private pig farm, Jinghua Breeding Co., leaving thousands of pigs dead. The owner estimated about 4,500 pigs present before the deluge, with 2,000–3,000 believed dead and losses around 5 million yuan. Video footage circulating on July 8 showed carcasses floating for up to two days, some blackened, with cleanup hindered by still-rising waters. Local authorities confirmed the situation and warned that rapid decay in heat and standing water could trigger environmental contamination and zoonotic risks. Officials emphasized the difficulty of rescue and disposal until floods recede and called for transparent handling. The incident underscores potential public health risks from swine fever and foot-and-mouth disease spreading through contaminated water and farmland, threatening nearby residents and food safety.

triage.headline_ja: 広西の養豚場で数千頭の豚が死亡、水没2日で一部黒変
triage.triage_reason: 洪水による家畜大量死亡事故であり、口蹄疫や豚熱等の感染症発生そのものは確認されていない。環境汚染・人獣共通感染症リスクへの懸念言及のみで、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は洪水による豚の大量死亡という災害事故が主題であり、口蹄疫やアフリカ豚熱等の感染症発生を直接報告するものではない。当局は汚染水を介した感染症拡大リスクに言及しているが、実際の発生確認情報はなく、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Eboladoden in Congo lopen op tot 600 terwijl virus nieuwe provincie bereikt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola deaths in Congo rise to 600 as the virus reaches a new province.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-09, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 1,700 confirmed Ebola infections and 600 deaths from the Bundibugyo variant, with about 750 recoveries and nearly 300 patients still being treated. The outbreak, first identified mid‑May, remains centered in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, but two new cases in Kisangani in Tshopo province are linked to the Nia‑Nia health zone in Ituri. Ituri accounts for more than 90% of cases and over 84% of deaths. The WHO warns the virus is spreading to previously affected areas, with new health zones appearing in Ituri and North Kivu. A major challenge is late case detection, causing deaths before patients reach treatment facilities. Rapid recognition, safe isolation and prompt care are crucial to curb transmission and prevent further spread, underscoring the fragility of health systems in remote areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ死者600人に、ウイルスは新たな州へ拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC複数州で拡大し、致死者600人・感染1700人に達し新州へ波及しているため、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高いと判断。
triage.notes: WHOが新規健康ゾーンへの拡大を警告しており、早期検知の遅れが課題とされている。続報でのケース増減・地理的拡大の推移を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Itajaí inicia preparação para uso do método Wolbachia no combate à dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Itajaí begins preparations for the use of the Wolbachia method in the fight against dengue.
article.articleSummary: As of July 9, 2026, Itajaí, Brazil, begins preparations to deploy the Wolbachia method to curb transmission of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The city enters the communication and community mobilization phase prior to the planned release of Aedes aegypti mosquitoes carrying the Wolbachia bacterium. Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes are intended to reduce human infection by hindering the viruses that cause dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The approach emphasizes engagement with residents and stakeholders to ensure acceptance and success of the release program. The article frames this as an innovative vector-control strategy and notes that the initial phase focuses on information dissemination and community involvement before field releases.

triage.headline_ja: イタジャイ、デング熱対策としてウォルバキア法の使用に向けた準備を開始
triage.triage_reason: 既知の媒介蚊対策プログラムの準備段階に関する通常の公衆衛生活動報告であり、異常な流行や新規リスクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング・ジカ・チクングニアの予防的ベクター対策（ウォルバキア法導入準備）の広報段階についてであり、感染急増や異常事態を示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: En pleine épidémie d'Ebola, les hygiénistes du CTE de Bunia durcissent leur grève et fragilisent la riposte - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amid an Ebola outbreak, the hygienists at Bunia's Ebola Treatment Center intensify their strike and undermine the response
article.articleSummary: Frontline health workers in Ituri, the epicenter of a Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak, intensified a strike on July 9, 2026, at Bunia’s Ebola Treatment Center (CTE) in the CME Hospital, protesting long-overdue salaries and arrears. Hygienists halted activities, demanding immediate payment before resuming work and rejecting further negotiation until compensation is settled. The action coincides with spillover protests by other outbreak responders, including teams at Rwampara General Hospital near Bunia, signaling broad disruption to case management, prevention, and epidemiological surveillance. The Health Ministry was in Bunia to oversee response operations, but no official statements had been issued at press time. The protests threaten to undermine containment efforts in Ituri, the province hardest hit by Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行の最中、ブニアのエボラ治療センターの衛生担当者らがストライキを強化し、対応を弱体化させている
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で進行中のエボラ流行において、対応要員のストライキが症例管理・サーベイランスを阻害しており、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクを伴うシグナルと判断される。
triage.notes: ルワンダ（Kigali Province）は発生地域として付与されているが、記事本文はDRCイトゥリ州のエボラ流行とブニアでの対応妨害のみを扱っており、ルワンダでの発生には言及がないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Waded through Mumbai rainwater? BMC issues leptospirosis advisory -- Symptoms, crucial 72-hour window & more | Mint
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis advisory for Mumbai issued by the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) on July 9, 2026. Post-monsoon floodwater can harbor Leptospira from infected animals’ urine (rats, stray dogs, horses, livestock); the bacteria can enter via minor skin cuts or mucous membranes. If untreated, Weil’s disease may develop, causing acute kidney injury, liver failure, respiratory distress, internal bleeding, meningitis, and death. Anyone who waded through floodwater should seek medical advice and begin prophylaxis within 24–72 hours of exposure, with the 72-hour window described as critical to neutralize bacteria before organ damage. Wash exposed skin with soap, monitor for early symptoms, and follow risk-level guidance to determine treatment. While heavy rainfall is possible, the advisory underscores avoiding stagnant water, especially in Mumbai suburbs such as Vasai and Virar.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイの雨水を歩いた方へ？BMCがレプトスピラ症に関する注意喚起を発表──症状、重要な72時間の猶予など
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン後の洪水に伴う季節性のレプトスピラ症予防に関する行政からの定例的な注意喚起であり、症例急増や異常な流行を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 毎年モンスーン期にムンバイ市当局(BMC)が発表する定例の公衆衛生アドバイザリーであり、具体的な症例数や集団発生の情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Grávida de 38 semanas, Patricia Leitte testa positivo para influenza B após noite com falta de ar | Gshow
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patricia Leitte, 38 weeks pregnant, tests positive for influenza B after a night with shortness of breath | Gshow
article.articleSummary: Brazilian former Big Brother participant Patricia Leitte, 38 weeks pregnant, tested positive for influenza B after a night of cough, runny nose, shortness of breath, and contractions. Around 5:30 a.m., she posted about waking since early morning and later confirmed the influenza B diagnosis, stating that treatment has begun and that everything will be fine. She is in the final week of her second pregnancy, preparing for the arrival of Isaac Lucca. The article highlights ongoing pregnancy challenges and her public updates on social media. No case counts, deaths, or outbreak details are provided, and the report does not specify an infection source or any imported/exported cases. Location context: Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: 妊娠38週のパトリシア・レイッチさん、呼吸困難の夜を経てインフルエンザB型陽性に | Gshow

triage.notes: 個人の健康状態に関する芸能記事であり、感染症サーベイランスの対象となるアウトブレイク情報ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en República Democrática del Congo deja 600 muertos, según la OMS | Noticias RCN
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo leaves 600 dead, according to the WHO | RCN News
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused 600 deaths and 1,759 confirmed cases since May 15, per the WHO. The epicenter is Ituri Province in northeastern DRC, bordering South Sudan and Uganda; the virus has spread to North Kivu and South Kivu, areas with significant M23 rebel influence complicating assistance. Uganda reports 20 cases and 2 deaths. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC, caused by the Bundibugyo variant, a rare strain with no licensed vaccine or proven treatment. On July 2, a clinical trial began with two therapies targeting this variant, and emergency-use approval was granted for the first molecular diagnostic test to detect it. The WHO warns the true magnitude remains uncertain, with treatment centers operating at about 90% capacity and ongoing humanitarian needs amid insecurity and displacement. Transmisssion is via contact with bodily fluids, causing hemorrhagic fever, with a historic context of Africa-wide fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、WHOによると死者600人に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで大規模流行(600名死亡、1,759症例)し、国境を越えてウガンダにも拡大しており、ワクチン・治療法未確立の希少株であることから国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻な影響がある。
triage.notes: ウガンダ(Uganda)も感染確認地域として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。M23反乱軍の影響による治安不安が対応を困難にしている点も注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 600 dead in DR Congo Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) shows 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 confirmed deaths across four northeastern provinces, mainly Ituri. Uganda reports two Ebola deaths; 17 of 20 confirmed patients in Uganda recovered. DR Congo case fatality rate 34% (285 recovered; 304 suspected under investigation). Declared mid-May; outbreak remains in expansion phase with no approved vaccines or treatments for this strain. A clinical trial of MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir began July 2 in DRC, testing efficacy alone and in combination. Transmission via close contact and exposure to infected bodily fluids. About 700 beds across 22 Ebola treatment centres, with 300 more planned; centres at ~90% capacity. Over 10,000 contacts monitored, 82% follow-up; 95% needed. Lab capacity rose from 30 tests/day in Kinshasa to >2,000/day in decentralised labs. WHO appeals for $115 million; only 32% funded. Security clashes in South Kivu (M23) worsen humanitarian needs.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで600人死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が拡大期にあり、確定症例1,759例・死亡600例・致死率34%、ウガンダへの越境感染も確認されており、国際的拡大リスクと重大な公衆衛生インパクトが認められるため。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの感染拡大が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。WHOは1億1500万ドルの資金アピールを行っているが資金充足率は32%にとどまる。南キブ州ではM23との衝突により人道状況が悪化。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes Catat 452 Kasus Kusta pada Anak hingga Pertengahan 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Records 452 Leprosy Cases in Children by Mid-2026
article.articleSummary: Indonesia’s Ministry of Health reports 452 childhood leprosy cases by mid-2026, approaching the 487 cases recorded for all of 2025. Dr. Prima Yosephine, Director of Communicable Diseases, warns of a rising pediatric leprosy trend and reiterates a target to keep child cases under 5% of total. Despite more pediatric detections, leprosy-related disability declined to 316 cases by mid-2026, down from 932 in 2025. WHO data from 2024 cited 14,698 new cases in Indonesia, though experts estimate true prevalence around 37,000, indicating likely underreporting. This year aims to identify 20,000 new cases to accelerate treatment and interrupt transmission. The government emphasizes community collaboration to report suspected cases to health facilities to achieve WHO-elimination guidelines.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、2026年半ばまでに小児ハンセン病452例を記録
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病は既知の風土病であり、慢性疾患として継続的に管理されている。急性の公衆衛生上の脅威や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: ハンセン病は長期の潜伏期間を持つ慢性感染症であり、報告数の増加は主に検出強化・報告体制改善による可能性が高い。WHO排除目標に向けた通常の保健行政活動の一環と見られる。

article.articleHeadline: Gia Lai ghi nhận ca tử vong đầu tiên do sốt xuất huyết trong năm 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gia Lai records the first dengue fever death in 2026.
article.articleSummary: As of July 9, 2026, Gia Lai Province, Vietnam, reported its first dengue fever death of 2026. The patient, L.V.P., a 27-year-old man from Tiên Sơn 2 hamlet, Biển Hồ Commune, Gia Lai, developed dengue symptoms on June 26 and, after self-medicating, sought care on June 30 at Military Hospital 15 and was transferred to Gia Lai General Hospital. He bore multiple comorbidities, including insulin-dependent diabetes with acidosis, electrolyte disturbances, coagulopathy, acute pancreatitis, and hyperglycemia. Dengue NS1 antigen test was positive, and clinicians diagnosed dengue fever on a background of type 2 diabetes. Despite aggressive treatment in the Intensive Care Unit, his condition deteriorated and he died en route to a higher-level facility. This marks the first dengue-related death in Gia Lai in 2026. Nationwide, dengue cases have risen about 1.7-fold, while hand-foot-mouth disease has doubled; Covid-19, rabies, and several other infections are declining.

triage.headline_ja: ザーライ省、2026年初のデング熱死亡例を記録
triage.triage_reason: デング熱による死亡例は既知の風土病の範囲内だが、基礎疾患を持つ患者の重症化・死亡と全国的な症例増加(1.7倍)がみられるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムの風土病で毎年発生。基礎疾患合併による重症化例だが、個別症例としての位置づけであり国際的懸念には至らない。全国的な症例1.7倍増加・手足口病2倍増加という情報は続報で注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : au moins 600 morts depuis le début de la nouvelle épidémie, selon l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: at least 600 dead since the start of the new outbreak, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has caused at least 600 deaths, according to the World Health Organization. Ebola is transmitted by contact with infected bodily fluids and causes a hemorrhagic fever. Across Africa, Ebola has killed more than 15,000 people over the past five decades, underscoring the ongoing risk. The current DR Congo outbreak is described as a new event, with WHO reporting 600 fatalities as the situation evolves. The report highlights the importance of ongoing surveillance, infection prevention measures, and rapid case investigation to contain transmission. As of July 9, 2026, authorities continue to monitor the outbreak and coordinate response efforts in the affected region of the Democratic Republic of Congo, emphasizing readiness for containment and public health intervention.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：新たな流行開始以降、少なくとも600人が死亡とWHOが発表（コンゴ民主共和国）
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱による600人以上の死者が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: WHOが確認した600人以上の死者数を伴う進行中のエボラ流行。フルリスク評価に進むべき事案。

article.articleHeadline: Menjelang Hadapi Inggris, Skuad Norwegia Terserang Wabah Penyakit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ahead of facing England, the Norwegian squad hit by a disease outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Norway’s national football team is coping with an illness outbreak ahead of their World Cup 2026 quarterfinal against England at a stadium in Miami Gardens, Florida. Several players have fallen ill, including Crystal Palace striker Jorgen Strand Larsen, who was ruled out of the opening match due to illness, and Marcus Holmgren Pedersen, who also missed the Brazil 2-1 win because of illness. Head coach Ståle Solbakken was affected after a 4-1 group-stage loss to France. The coach said the illness appears to involve fever in one player, but others report cough and hoarseness spreading across the squad, potentially linked to air conditioning, travel, and locker rooms. With more than 50 team personnel, he noted it would be unusual for only one or two to be affected. Norway remains determined to perform against England for a semifinal spot.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : plus de 1 700 cas et 600 décès
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: more than 1,700 cases and 600 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) with 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths as of 9 July 2026. Declared 15 May, the Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or specific approved treatment. The epidemic primarily affects Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with concerns over population movement and access. In recent days, suspected cases appeared in Tshopo province, notably Kisangani, prompting investigations to determine links with known clusters. The response, led by Congolese authorities with support from the WHO and partners, includes detection, isolation, treatment, and contact tracing, but faces funding gaps, logistics, insecurity, and attacks on treatment centers. A clinical trial to evaluate new therapeutic options for Bundibugyo began in early July, marking progress in finding targeted solutions. This is one of the largest Ebola crises in the DRC in recent years, underscoring the need for strengthened surveillance and care.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:コンゴ民主共和国で1,700人以上の症例と600人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行が1,759症例・600死亡に達し、新たな州(ツォポ州)へ拡大の兆候があり、ワクチン・治療法未確立で資金・治安面の課題も深刻なため。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Death Toll In DR Congo Rises To 600
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-09, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths, with a case fatality rate of 34%. Recovery stands at 285, while 304 suspected cases remain under investigation. The outbreak, declared in mid‑May and centered in Ituri province, has spread across four provinces in northeastern DRC. In neighboring Uganda, two deaths have occurred, and 17 of 20 confirmed cases have recovered. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, for which there are no approved vaccines or treatments. A trial of two potential treatments for Bundibugyo began in the DRC on July 2. The WHO notes the true scale is not yet fully established, according to WHO representative Anne Ancia.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国での死者数が600人に増加
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で致死率34%のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが4州に拡大し、隣国ウガンダにも越境感染が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Lekarz ostrzega przed tą bakterią. Do zakażenia dochodzi rzadko, ale zaleca ostrożność
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A doctor warns about this bacterium. Infections occur rarely, but he advises caution.
article.articleSummary: Vibrio cholerae, the cholera bacterium, has been found in the Baltic Sea via ballast-water discharge from ships originating in warmer regions. Although rare, cholera infection can occur after exposure to contaminated seawater or seafood; untreated illness can be fatal within 12–24 hours. Globally, WHO estimates 1.3–4 million cases and 21,000–143,000 deaths annually, with reporting gaps. Most infections occur in Afghanistan, the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Dominican Republic, Yemen, Haiti, Kenya, and Tanzania. In Poland, a case was reported in a West Pomeranian Voivodeship resident last year linked to Baltic waters. Preventive advice includes treating water, cooking food, peeling or avoiding raw foods, and protecting wounds; wash and disinfect skin; change dressings regularly. Vaccination is recommended at least one week before travel to at-risk areas, delivered in two doses with a booster after two years.

triage.headline_ja: 医師がこの細菌に警告。感染はまれだが注意を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: バルト海(ポーランド)でのコレラ菌検出に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、対象国での発生事例や新規アウトブレイクの情報は含まれない。
triage.notes: 記事はポーランドのバルト海における稀なコレラ菌検出と一般的な予防啓発が主題。DRCなど流行地域は世界的な発生状況の一例として言及されているのみで、記事の主題ではないため実質的な発生情報は乏しい。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: deux cas détectés à Kisangani, un deuxième test de vérification en cours
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Two Cases Detected in Kisangani, a Second Confirmatory Test Underway
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). As of July 9, 2026, the 17th outbreak has 1,759 laboratory-confirmed cases and 600 deaths in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Two cases were detected in Kisangani, Tshopo province, more than 500 km from known foci. The first patient links to Nia-Nia in Ituri (35 cases, 13 deaths) with a mining corridor to Kisangani; the second case has no clear geographic link yet. PCR-Radione positives on-site; RT-PCR confirmatory testing is underway and not yet in official counts. Response teams fear an undetected transmission chain. The outbreak centers in Ituri and is caused by Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no vaccine or treatment; the virus is also present in Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu. Declared May 15; transmission via contact with bodily fluids; WHO reports 600 deaths as of July 9, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国：キサンガニで2症例検出、2回目の確認検査進行中

article.articleHeadline: Ciclosporíase: o que é o parasita por trás dos casos de diarreia 'explosiva' pelos EUA e que já causou surto no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cyclosporiasis: what the parasite behind the explosive diarrhea cases in the United States is, and which has already caused an outbreak in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Cyclosporiasis is fueling explosive diarrhea outbreaks in the United States, led by Michigan with 992 confirmed cases—the state’s largest outbreak to date, far exceeding its typical ~50 annual cases. Ohio reports 177 infections, of which 171 occurred in June (primarily after June 20), and 28 hospitalizations. CDC data indicate at least 17 states had cyclosporiasis cases by mid-June. The illness is caused by the parasite Cyclospora cayetanensis; symptoms include sudden, persistent diarrhea. Michigan health officials advise residents with abrupt, persistent diarrhea to seek medical care and to contact local health departments if others in the household have similar symptoms. The article’s title notes a Brazil outbreak, but the body focuses on U.S. figures; no further Brazilian details are provided in the text.

triage.headline_ja: サイクロスポーラ症とは何か:米国で「爆発的下痢」を引き起こしている寄生虫、ブラジルでもすでに発生
triage.triage_reason: 主たる発生地は米国(ミシガン州・オハイオ州)であり対象国リストに含まれない。ブラジルは見出しのみで本文に詳細情報がなく、実質的な発生確認ができない。
triage.notes: 記事は米国(ミシガン、オハイオ等)での大規模なサイクロスポーラ症流行を報じているが、見出しに言及されたブラジルの発生については本文中に具体的情報が一切なく、対象国としての検証ができない。

article.articleHeadline: US announces Sh1.9bn to boost Kenya's Ebola preparedness
article.articleSummary: On 9 July 2026, the United States announced Sh1.9 billion to bolster Kenya’s Ebola preparedness, focusing on surveillance, laboratory testing, and emergency response after a Nanyuki quarantine facility at Laikipia Air Base was halted by a High Court amid protests. The funding aims to prevent, detect and respond to Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) outbreaks by strengthening disease surveillance, lab capacity (two US-supported KEMRI labs and the National Virology Reference Laboratory) and border screening, training healthcare workers, and coordinating rapid response. It includes two mobile laboratories, training for more than 800 biosafety professionals and over 1,700 Field Epidemiology and Laboratory Training Programme disease detectives, plus 120 national rapid response trainers and 160 county responders. Twenty-two high‑risk counties are targeted; 27 Emergency Operations Centres are activated with plans for 12 more. The program underlines regional surveillance across East and Central Africa amid the DRC outbreak (1,759 cases, 600 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: 米国、ケニアのエボラ対応能力強化のため19億シリング(約1900万ドル)の支援を発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラアウトブレイク(1,759例・600死亡)を背景に、隣国ケニアへの大規模な国際支援(サーベイランス・検査・緊急対応強化)が発表されており、地域拡大リスクと国際的関心の高さからフルRRAでの評価が望ましい。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は米国によるケニアへの資金支援だが、背景にあるのはDRCで継続中のエボラアウトブレイク(1,759例・600死亡)。ケニア自体での感染確認は記載されておらず、地域的な予防強化措置として報じられている。対象国リストにケニアは含まれないためverified_locationsから除外し、実際の発生国であるDRCのみを記載した。

article.articleHeadline: Mondial 2026 : Une mystérieuse maladie décime la Norvège
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Cup 2026: A mysterious disease decimates Norway.
article.articleSummary: On the eve of the World Cup 2026 quarterfinal against England, Norway faces a mysterious virus outbreak as several players were affected, disrupting team preparations after a 2-1 win over Brazil in the round of 16. Goalkeeper Ørjan Nyland confirmed the situation, saying the medical staff are stretched, and the team doctor is very busy. The origin of the illness is unclear; Nyland suggested it could have occurred during the rest period, given there was downtime in which someone might have contracted something. Despite uncertainty, Nyland remained optimistic, hoping Norway can face England on Saturday with a fully rested squad. The outbreak adds suspense to a tournament where Norway had been a surprising revelation.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップ2026:謎の病気がノルウェー代表を襲う
triage.triage_reason: サッカー選手間の原因不明の体調不良に関する話題性記事であり、対象国での公衆衛生上の重大イベントとは認められない。
triage.notes: 発生地域はNorway/England/Brazilが含まれるが、対象国リストにはBrazilのみ含まれる。しかし記事の主題はノルウェー代表チーム内の体調不良であり、ブラジルは対戦相手として言及されるのみで疾病発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll in DR Congo reaches 600
article.articleSummary: As of July 9, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 600 laboratory-confirmed deaths, according to a daily bulletin from the country's ministry of communication and media. In the past 24 hours, 20 people died, and confirmed cases total 1,759, up 51 from the previous day. The average case fatality rate is about 34.1%. About 750 patients are currently hospitalized or in medical isolation units. The outbreak began in eastern DR Congo and neighboring Uganda on May 15, with the epicenter in Ituri Province, DR Congo. The data reflect an ongoing outbreak centered in Ituri Province.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死者数、600人に到達
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクで死者600人・症例1,759人に達し、致死率も高く、国際的拡大リスクを伴う深刻な公衆衛生事案であるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として記載されているが対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsから除外。DRC・イトゥリ州が主要発生地。

article.articleHeadline: Jakarta Utara gencarkan edukasi pencegahan TBC hingga ke kelurahan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Jakarta ramps up TB prevention education to the kelurahan level.
article.articleSummary: North Jakarta intensifies tuberculosis (TB) prevention education to the kelurahan level, focusing on Rawa Badak Selatan. The effort involves community cadres and local leaders to raise awareness, reduce stigma, and promote early detection and treatment. Puskesmas data show 29 residents of Rawa Badak Selatan are undergoing TB treatment. The kelurahan population is about 37,000, spanning 11 RW and 119 RT, highlighting the need for wide information dissemination. Officials stress TB is not hereditary or a curse and is curable, urging residents with symptoms to report and seek optimal care. Success hinges on broad community involvement rather than isolated actions, aiming to eliminate TB and prevent deaths. This initiative reflects Jakarta North’s ongoing TB prevention drive and stigma reduction efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 北ジャカルタ、結核予防教育を村レベルまで強化

triage.notes: 結核は既知の地方病であり、本記事は予防啓発活動の内容であるため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。ポーランド（Łódzkie）は記事の主題ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 41-year-old man hospitalised with Mpox after Taiwan trip
article.articleSummary: Mpox confirmed case in Hong Kong: A 41-year-old man developed fever and a genital rash on July 2, with groin lymphadenopathy five days later, and was admitted to Princess Margaret Hospital for isolation; he is in stable condition. He had not been vaccinated before symptom onset; during incubation he travelled alone to Taiwan and engaged in high‑risk activities. Officials say overseas infection is possible, with no identified epidemiological links to local cases. Since 2022, Hong Kong has 93 mpox cases (74 locally acquired, 19 imported), all male, with most linked to high‑risk sexual behaviour. Vaccination remains effective and is available on a voluntary basis for designated high‑risk groups, via walk‑in appointments at Social Hygiene Service Clinics, Integrated Treatment Centres, and Hospital Authority clinics. Mpox is not typically spread through casual contact or respiratory routes; high‑risk individuals should seek medical advice if symptoms appear. CHP will notify WHO and Taiwan authorities.

triage.headline_ja: 41歳男性、台湾旅行後にMpoxで入院
triage.triage_reason: 香港における既知のMpox流行状況の一部としての輸入例1件であり、症状は安定、重症度・異常性・国際的拡大リスクとも低いため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 香港では2022年以降93例のMpox症例が報告されており、本件はその延長線上の輸入例。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため、香港部分のみChinaとして計上。

article.articleHeadline: US backs Kenya's Ebola fight with Sh1.9 billion, targets 22 counties
article.articleSummary: US backs Kenya’s Ebola preparedness with Sh1.9 billion ($14.5 million) to target 22 high-risk counties, funding new laboratories, trained personnel and emergency response centres. The package supports surveillance, laboratory systems, healthcare worker training, emergency coordination, risk communication and screening at points of entry, with over 800 laboratory professionals to be trained in biosafety and testing for viral hemorrhagic fevers. Two US-supported KEMRI laboratories will join the National Virology Reference Laboratory; two mobile laboratories will be deployed to cut turnaround times. It also funds 1,700+ Field Epidemiology and Laboratory Training Programme disease detectives, 120 national responders via a Training of Trainers programme, and 160 county-level responders in border counties. Twenty-seven Emergency Operating Centres are active, with 12 more counties identified for new centres, under three pillars: detect, prepare, respond. Kenya has not recorded a confirmed Ebola case; the DRC Bundibugyo outbreak exceeds 1,500 cases and 500 deaths, with Uganda reporting about 20 cases.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、ケニアのエボラ対策に19億シリング支援、22郡を対象に

triage.notes: 記事の主眼はケニアの備え強化（米国資金支援）だが、実際の感染事例が発生しているのはDRC（ブンディブギョ株、1500例超・死亡500例超）とウガンダ（約20例）。ケニア・ウガンダ・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: 600 dead in DR Congo Ebola outbreak - Africa - World
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths, with 285 recoveries and 304 suspected cases under investigation since mid-May. Two deaths reported in neighbouring Uganda, which has 20 confirmed cases and 17 recoveries, marking cross-border spread. The outbreak, centered in Ituri province (Bunia), spans four provinces and remains in expansion phase with no stabilization yet. Bundibugyo offers no approved vaccines or treatments; two trial candidates, MBP134 and remdesivir, began in Kinshasa on July 2. Transmission is via close contact with infected bodily fluids. Response challenges include population movements, insecurity, and weak health systems. Healthcare capacity covers ~700 beds across 22 treatment centers (with 300 more planned); labs can run >2,000 tests daily. WHO seeks $115 million (32% received). South Kivu has seen clashes with the M23 group, raising displacement risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行で600人死亡 - アフリカ - 世界
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大＝ウガンダへの越境伝播確認）に加え、WPRO基準も全て該当する重大なエボラ流行であり、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境感染が確認されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCのイツリ州（ブニア）を中心に4州に拡大中で、承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しないBundibugyo株による流行であり、資金不足（要請額の32%のみ確保）と武装勢力衝突による治安悪化が対応の障害となっている。

article.articleHeadline: התפרצות האבולה מסלימה: 600 מתים וחשש להתפשטות
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak intensifies: 600 dead and fear of its spread.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has reached about 1,759–1,800 cases with roughly 600 deaths as of 9 July 2026. Declared May 15, the outbreak spreads across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with Kisangani in Tshopo reporting two suspected cases: one linked to Ni-Nia in Ituri, the other with no clear geographic link yet, awaiting final confirmation. Kisangani’s location on the Congo River and heavy cross-border movement complicate contact tracing. No approved vaccine targets Bundibugyo; ring vaccination is not currently feasible. Experimental vaccines and therapies are under evaluation but not widely available. Transmission requires direct contact with blood or bodily fluids; healthcare worker shortages, PPE gaps, and trust issues hinder response. Border screening has intensified with Uganda and neighbors; two Israelis hospitalized in Israel were later found not to have Ebola; no confirmed cases in Israel.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が悪化：600人死亡、拡大への懸念
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる大規模流行（約1800症例、600人死亡）が継続中で、承認ワクチンがなく国境をまたぐ拡大リスクや医療体制の脆弱性が確認されるため。
triage.notes: イスラエルでの疑い例は否定的（エボラではないと確認）。ウガンダでは国境スクリーニング強化のみで感染確認はなし。両国はverified_locationsに含めない。

article.articleHeadline: La RDC eleva a 600 el número de muertos por el brote de ébola y detecta casos en una cuarta provincia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The DRC raises the death toll to 600 from the Ebola outbreak and detects cases in a fourth province.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 600 confirmed deaths and 1,759 confirmed cases as of July 7, 2026, with the epicenter in Ituri and spread to North Kivu and South Kivu. Two cases were detected in Kisangani, Tshopo; one is linked to the Nia-Nia health zone in Ituri, the other’s origin is undetermined. The case fatality rate stands at 34.1%; 285 people are in isolation or hospitalized, and 750 have recovered. Contact tracing is 80%. Declared May 15 in Ituri, the outbreak expanded regionally; Uganda reports 20 confirmed cases (15 imported from the DRC) and two deaths. France confirms a first imported case in a doctor returning from a mission in the DRC. WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 17. The Bundibugyo strain has a 30–50% fatality and no licensed vaccine or specific treatment, making this the third-worst Ebola outbreak on record.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ流行による死者数が600人に増加、第4の州でも症例を確認
