triage.notes: ウガンダとフランスへの症例輸出が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOはすでにPHEICを宣言済みであり、既存の進行中危機として継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: deux cas détectés à Kisangani, un deuxième test de vérification en cours
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: two cases detected in Kisangani, a second confirmatory test underway.
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola virus disease cases were detected in Kisangani, in Tshopo Province, DRC, over 500 km from outbreak foci. Ebola is a hemorrhagic fever transmitted via contact with bodily fluids. Both patients tested positive by field PCR-Radione; a laboratory-confirmatory RT-PCR test is underway and not yet included in the official tally for the 17th outbreak. The first patient is linked to the Nia-Nia health zone in Ituri, which has recorded 35 confirmed cases and 13 deaths to date; a mining corridor connects Ituri to Kisangani, raising concerns about cross-regional transmission. No geographic link has yet been established for the second patient outside Kisangani. WHO data indicate the outbreak has caused 600 deaths as of July 9. The epicenter remains Ituri, with the virus present in Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu provinces. The 17th Ebola outbreak, declared May 15, is caused by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no vaccine or treatment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国、キサンガニで2例検出、2回目の確認検査進行中
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株、ワクチン・治療法なし）が発生地から500km離れたキサンガニに拡大した可能性があり、致死率の高い出血熱でヒト-ヒト感染リスクもあることからIHR基準・WPRO基準双方で複数該当。
triage.notes: 第17次エボラ流行（2026年5月15日宣言）はイツリ州を震源とし、既に600人の死者を出している。今回キサンガニで検出された2症例のうち1例はイツリ州ニアニア保健区との関連が疑われ、鉱山回廊を通じた地域間伝播の可能性が懸念される。確認検査（RT-PCR）の結果待ちであり、公式集計にはまだ反映されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Ituri - L'UNICEF appelle à préserver les services de santé de base malgré l'épidémie d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Ituri - UNICEF urges the preservation of basic health services despite the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ituri, DR Congo: As Ebola outbreak persists in Ituri province, UNICEF urges maintaining essential health services, including child vaccination, antenatal care, and routine health visits, to avoid sacrificing other health gains. Government and UNICEF discussions in Bunia between the military provincial governor and UNICEF Africa West and Central regional director Gilles Fagninou stressed integrated response, with emphasis on protecting basic health services while containing Ebola. Education remains a priority: thousands of children lack schooling due to conflict; the partners commit to strengthen collaboration to resume schooling, with August follow-up to discuss child protection, child labor, and children's participation. The regional UNICEF mission also met health, education, child protection and humanitarian partners to assess on-the-ground needs and improve coordination of interventions for populations affected by insecurity and health crises in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:イトゥリ州 - ユニセフ、エボラ流行下でも基礎的保健サービスの維持を訴える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は本質的に重篤かつ国際的懸念の高い疾患であり、イトゥリ州での流行が継続している状況はIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ流行下での基礎保健サービス維持を巡るUNICEFの活動報告であり、新規発生や症例数の詳細は記載がないが、既知の継続流行であるため重症度・国際的懸念は高いと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : les parents appelés à surveiller leurs enfants pendant les vacances - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: Parents urged to monitor their children during the holidays - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is circulating in Ituri, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with Bunia cited in reporting. On July 9, 2026, ANAPECO president David Mputu urged parents to tighten monitoring of children during school holidays to curb transmission. He noted rising deaths across several health zones in Ituri and condemned celebratory gatherings after exam results that risk spreading the virus. Parents are urged to reinforce prevention: limit nonessential travel, avoid funerals and other crowded events, and refrain from activities with close physical contact. Regular handwashing with soap or chlorinated solution should be established at home. During holidays, children should be steered away from communal sports or religious activities and away from games involving hugs or direct contact. Adherence to barrier measures and vigilant child supervision are presented as essential to protecting families and supporting the Ebola response in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州のエボラ出血熱：休暇中の子供の監視を親に呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州でエボラ出血熱の死亡者数が複数の保健地域で増加しており、地域社会への感染拡大リスクが高いため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: エボラは高致死率かつヒト-ヒト感染のリスクが高い疾患であり、DRCイツリ州で複数の保健地域にわたり死亡者が増加している継続的アウトブレイクであるため、フルリスク評価（RRA）へ進めるべき。

article.articleHeadline: Julho Amarelo Alerta Para Hepatites Virais; Veja Cuidados E Quando Procurar Atendimento - Rnews
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yellow July Alert for Viral Hepatitis; See Care Tips and When to Seek Medical Attention - Rnews.
article.articleSummary: As of July 9, 2026, the July Yellow campaign promotes awareness of viral hepatitis in Caieiras, Franco da Rocha, Francisco Morato, Cajamar, and Mairiporã, highlighting vaccination, testing, and timely care. Hepatitis A–E can be linked to contaminated water or food, while others spread through blood, unprotected sex, or sharing sharp instruments. Prevention emphasizes handwashing, treated water, proper food hygiene, not sharing razors, blades, or needles, condom use, and ensuring hepatitis B vaccination—available in the public health network. Seek care at a basic health unit for persistent symptoms or after exposure; warning signs include extreme fatigue, nausea, fever, abdominal pain, dark urine, jaundice, loss of appetite, and pale stools. Testing enables early diagnosis and appropriate referral, reducing complications. The campaign reinforces routine vaccination, testing, and health guidance rather than substituting medical evaluation.

triage.headline_ja: 黄色い7月キャンペーン、ウイルス性肝炎への注意喚起；ケアのポイントと受診タイミングについて - Rnews
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクではなく、ウイルス性肝炎に関する定例の啓発キャンペーン記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル・サンパウロ州の地方自治体による毎年恒例の啓発キャンペーン（Julho Amarelo）に関する内容であり、具体的な感染急増やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'évolution de l'épidémie impose une redynamisation de la riposte(ministre de la Santé) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the evolution of the epidemic demands a reinvigoration of the response (Health Minister) - ACP
article.articleSummary: With Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo, the response enters a 54-day active phase, led by Health Minister Roger Kamba Mulumba who stresses ongoing adaptation and national responsibility, aided by partners. In Ituri and Nord-Kivu, the epidemic remains in an acute, rising phase, with other provinces—Tshopo, Sud-Kivu, Haut-Uele—now affected as population movement spreads transmission. Expanded community-based case finding by relays increases reported cases, intended to reveal all infectious individuals and stabilise the outbreak. Authorities constrain cross-border movement at entry and control points to limit spread. On vaccines, experts note there is no approved vaccine for the Bundibugyo strain yet; research is evaluating existing candidates, potentially 4–6 months to a year before mass use. Separately, payroll issues hamper response staff payments, with plans for a digital health card that doubles as a bank card to streamline disbursements, ensuring payments reach workers directly.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：流行の進展により対応の再活性化が必要（保健大臣）- ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC複数州（イトゥリ、北キブ等）で急性期にあり、人口移動により新規州へ拡大、承認ワクチンも未確立でIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株に対する承認ワクチンが未整備であり、ワクチン大量使用まで4~6ヶ月～1年を要する見込み。人口移動による複数州（Tshopo, Sud-Kivu, Haut-Uele）への拡大が進行中で、国境管理の強化が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Mais de 1,7 mil pessoas convivem com hepatites virais em Feira de Santana - Folha do Estado da Bahia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 1,700 people live with viral hepatitis in Feira de Santana - Folha do Estado da Bahia.
article.articleSummary: Feira de Santana, Bahia, Brazil — More than 1,700 residents are followed at the Municipal Reference Center for STIs/HIV and Viral Hepatitis for hepatitis B and C. The facility currently cares for 1,708 patients: 836 with hepatitis B and 872 with hepatitis C, with 56 new patients added in 2026. Viral hepatitis can inflame the liver with few early symptoms and may progress to cirrhosis or liver cancer. Transmission occurs mainly through unprotected sex and the sharing of sharp objects such as razors, nail clippers, and syringes; excessive alcohol use and indiscriminate medication can also contribute to liver damage. Care is provided free of charge by a multidisciplinary team (hepatologist, infectious disease specialist, nurses, nutritionist, psychologist, social worker, nursing technicians), including consultations, laboratory testing, and medications. Access is via healthcare referrals or spontaneous demand.

triage.headline_ja: フェイラ・デ・サンタナで1,700人以上がウイルス性肝炎とともに生活
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・バイーア州の慢性ウイルス性肝炎(B型・C型)の既存患者に関する日常的な保健医療報告であり、突発的な公衆衛生上の脅威や異常な流行を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 慢性感染症（B型・C型肝炎）の地域医療センターにおける通常診療実績の報告であり、急性アウトブレイクや新規発生事象ではない。対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるが、記事内容が定型的統計報告のため、地域として記録する意義は低いと判断しverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak death toll climbs to 600
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths, a case fatality rate of 34%. Declared in mid-May in Ituri and now affecting four provinces, the northeastern outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo Ebola, for which there are no approved vaccines or treatments. A trial of MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir began July 2. There have been 285 recoveries and 304 suspected cases under investigation. Two new suspected cases in Kisangani; one linked to Nia-Nia in Ituri, the other with no clear outbreak connection. Uganda reports two deaths among 20 confirmed cases, with 17 recoveries. The response faces population movement, insecurity, and fragile health systems; about 700 beds across 22 treatment centres are in use (90% capacity), with plans for 300 more. Lab capacity has risen to over 2,000 tests daily; more than 10,000 contacts are monitored (82% follow-up; target 95%). WHO seeks $115 million; 32% received.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、死者数600人に達する
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認症例1,759件・死者600人（致死率34%）、承認薬なしのブンディブギョ株が4州に拡大し、ウガンダへの越境感染も発生しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの感染拡大が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。WHOは1億1500万ドルの資金要請中で、現在32%のみ充足という国際支援の必要性が高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: Hepatites virais exigem atenção e prevenção para evitar danos graves ao fígado, alerta médico - ACidade ON Ribeirão Preto
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Viral Hepatitis Requires Attention and Prevention to Avoid Serious Liver Damage, Doctor Warns - ACidade ON Ribeirão Preto.
article.articleSummary: Viral hepatitis risks progression to chronic liver disease and cirrhosis, says infectious-disease specialist Luis Felipe Visconde of Hospital Ribeirânia in Ribeirão Preto, during the July Yellow Hepatitis campaign. While hepatitis can arise from noninfectious factors such as medications, excessive alcohol, anabolic steroids, and obesity, the viral forms require special attention due to chronicity. Hepatitis C is curable; hepatitis A often resolves spontaneously. Other viral hepatitis types currently lack definitive cures, underscoring prevention. Vaccination is crucial for hepatitis A and B; hepatitis B transmission is tied to exposure to blood and contaminated bodily fluids, with vaccination included in Brazil’s SUS schedule. Beyond vaccination, prevention includes condom use, avoiding sharing sharp instruments, and seeking medical care for suspicious symptoms. The focus is on awareness in Ribeirão Preto and hospital-safety measures regarding procedures and tattooing.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス性肝炎には注意と予防が必要、重篤な肝障害を避けるため医師が警告 - ACidade ON リベイランプレト
triage.triage_reason: 特定の集団発生報告ではなく、7月の啓発キャンペーンに合わせた一般的な予防啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定のアウトブレイクではなく、ブラジルの啓発キャンペーンに関連した一般的な医療情報提供記事であるため、地域特定の緊急イベントとしては扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : campagne de sensibilisation contre Ebola dans une zone de santé - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: Ebola awareness campaign in a health zone - ACP
article.articleSummary: On July 9, 2026, in Bunia, Ituri, northeastern DR Congo, the Mambisa community began an Ebola awareness campaign at the Nizi shopping center to bolster prevention and counter misinformation. The twofold objective is to inform residents about Ebola’s existence and protective measures, and to collect local grievances to relay to health authorities. Sensitization teams outlined Ebola transmission routes, key warning signs, and recommended prevention practices, urging adherence to hygiene measures and rapid health facility consultation at first symptoms. Campaigners also sought to debunk rumors fueling distrust of the response teams. 'The disease exists. If someone seeks care early, they recover,' the organizers stressed. The outreach will proceed to Likida, Mabanga, Lalu, Dala, and other Mambisa localities to strengthen community vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ：保健地域におけるエボラ啓発キャンペーン - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はDRC・イトゥリでのエボラに関する住民啓発活動の報告であり、新規症例や感染拡大の情報は含まれていないが、エボラという重大疾患に関する継続的な状況のため経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: UFMG identifica antígenos contra a malária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UFMG Identifies Antigens Against Malaria.
article.articleSummary: Researchers at the Federal University of Minas Gerais (UFMG) identified a set of antigens with potential to underpin a universal malaria vaccine, published in Nature. Using immunopeptidomics, they mapped 453 peptides derived from 166 Plasmodium vivax proteins, many never previously explored for vaccines. These antigens are linked to essential parasite functions, less prone to mutations, increasing prospects for lasting, cross-species protection. The antigens are highly conserved: 71% are found across different Plasmodium species and 75% appear in multiple life-cycle stages. Functional validation showed strong CD8+ T cell responses in samples from Brazil, Mali and the United States, with two antigens conferring protection in experimental models. The HLA-E molecule, which presents these epitopes, shows little genetic variation across populations, suggesting broad applicability. The study, led by UFMG's CTVaccines researchers, marks a milestone as the first Nature paper published entirely by Brazilian scientists and advances strategies toward a universal malaria vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: UFMGがマラリアに対する抗原を同定
triage.triage_reason: マラリアワクチン開発に関する研究成果報告であり、感染症の発生・流行事象ではないため公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事はマラリアワクチン開発の研究成果に関する科学ニュースであり、疾病の発生・流行報告ではない。ブラジル・マリ・米国は研究サンプル提供国として言及されているのみで、実際の感染症発生地域ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: A Djugu, des communautés alertent sur les retards d'enterrements sécurisés des victimes d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo-Kinshasa: In Djugu, communities warn about delays in safe burials of Ebola victims.
article.articleSummary: As of July 9, 2026, in Djugu, Ituri province, Congo-Kinshasa, Ebola fatalities are rising as communities report delays in safe, dignified burials. In Lopa, leaders say over 180 people died in the past month in the city and environs, though the figure awaits official confirmation. Corpses are reportedly held in homes for three to four days awaiting response teams, due to shortages of vehicles, fuel, and operational support. Community actors warn that delays heighten transmission risk and demand immediate government provisioning of vehicles and fuel to enable burial teams to intervene within 24 hours of death, protecting the living and preserving dignity for hundreds of bereaved families, including many orphans and widows. Health authorities emphasize the contagion risk from handling Ebola corpses and urge rapid reporting of suspected deaths and avoidance of handling until specialists arrive, underscoring persistent response gaps in Djugu.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:ジュグにおいて、コミュニティがエボラ出血熱犠牲者の安全な埋葬の遅延を警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱による死者数が急増し(1ヶ月で180人超)、安全な埋葬の遅延が感染拡大リスクを高めている。公衆衛生上深刻な影響があり、対応能力不足で国際支援が必要な状況。
triage.notes: 死者数180人超は非公式情報であり、公式確認待ち。遺体の取り扱い遅延による二次感染リスクが強調されている。車両・燃料不足という対応能力の不足が明記されており、外部支援の必要性が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Naegleria fowleri : Une " amibe mangeuse de cerveau " qui a tué des enfants pourrait se propager dans le monde entier, avertissent des scientifiques
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Naegleria fowleri: a 'brain-eating amoeba' that has killed children could spread worldwide, scientists warn.
article.articleSummary: Naegleria fowleri, the brain-eating amoeba, caused a fatal primary amoebic meningoencephalitis (MEAP) in 11-year-old Jordan after a Costa Rica trip, with death occurring seven and a half days after swimming in a natural hot spring. The amoeba thrives in hot lakes, thermal springs, and abandoned pools and invades the brain when water enters the nose during recreational water activities. Globally, 488 cases were reported from 1962–2023, mainly in the U.S. South, Pakistan and Australia, with ~97% mortality. India logged over 200 cases last year—the largest outbreak on record—and cases have increasingly appeared in the north, including Italy, Belgium, and Minnesota; Slovakia recorded its first confirmed infection; Taiwan reported an indoor-surfing center exposure, and a U.S. playground water incident occurred in 2023. Warming climates raise lake temperatures, potentially expanding risk, while improved detection may inflate reported numbers.

triage.headline_ja: ナエグレリア・フォーレリ:子どもを死に至らしめた「脳を食べるアメーバ」が世界的に広がる可能性があると科学者が警告
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約97%と極めて重篤で、気候変動により従来報告のなかった地域（イタリア、ベルギー、スロバキア、米国北部等）へ拡大している点が異常・予想外であり、インドでは過去最大規模の集団発生が報告されている。
triage.notes: 本疾患はヒト-ヒト感染せず環境曝露（淡水でのレクリエーション活動）による散発例であるため、疫学的拡大というよりは気候変動による地理的分布拡大が主眼の科学的警告記事。インドでは昨年200例超と過去最大の集団発生が報告されている点が特筆される。パキスタン・米国・オーストラリア等は対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : Roger Kamba annonce officiellement la Tshopo et le Haut-Uele parmi les provinces affectées
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Roger Kamba officially announces Tshopo and Haut-Uele among the affected provinces.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) in the Democratic Republic of Congo expands to Tshopo and Haut-Uele, announced July 9, 2026 by Health Minister Roger Kamba in Bunia, Ituri. Patients moved from Nia-Nia to Tshopo and Haut-Uele, with two positive cases reported in Wamba and two positive cases in Tshopo on the 54th day of the response. Ituri and Nord-Kivu remain in an active, expanding phase; mobility is driving spread to new zones. The outbreak totals stand at 1,759 cases, 600 deaths, and 750 recoveries. In Nord-Kivu, there have been 42 consecutive days without a new case. The minister indicated that Sud-Kivu may soon be withdrawn from the response. The geographic expansion underscores ongoing transmission dynamics across eastern DRC and the need for continued surveillance and containment measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ロジェ・カンバ氏、ツォポ州とオート・ウエレ州を被害州として正式発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ流行が新たな州（ツォポ、オート・ウエレ）へ拡大しており、累計1,759症例・600死亡と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 北キブ州では42日間新規症例なし、南キブ州は対応終了検討中とされ、地域ごとの状況に差がある。継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll in Congo reaches 600, as new cases suspected in previously unaffected provinces
article.articleSummary: Ebola death toll in Congo reaches 600 as new suspected cases appear in previously unaffected provinces. As of 9 July 2026, suspected cases have been reported in Kisangani, Tshopo, and in Haut-Uele, signaling continued spread beyond the Ituri epicenter. Nationwide confirmed cases total 1,759 with 600 deaths. In Tshopo, one suspected case is linked to the Nia-Nia health zone in Ituri; the other case has no apparent geographical connection and is under investigation. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus — for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment — was declared on 15 May after transmission persisted without official detection. Clinical treatment trials began last week. Containment is hampered by funding gaps, attacks on health centers, and ongoing conflict in eastern Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者数600人に達し、これまで感染がなかった州でも新たな症例が疑われる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴで拡大し、死者600人・確認症例1,759人に達し、これまで未感染だった州にも拡大している。ワクチン・治療法未承認の株であり、国際的拡大・公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められるためPICKUPと判断。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoウイルスによるエボラ流行で、ワクチン・治療法が未承認。資金不足・医療施設への攻撃・東部コンゴでの紛争により封じ込めが困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: কঙ্গোতে ইবোলার ভয়াবহ প্রাদুর্ভাব, মৃত্যু বেড়ে ৬০০
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deadly Ebola outbreak in Congo; death toll rises to 600.
article.articleSummary: DRC’s deadly Ebola outbreak has reached 600 deaths from about 1,759 cases, as of 9 July 2026. The Bundibugyo strain has spread across 37 health zones in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with two additional cases in Kisangani linked to Ituri’s Nia-Nia zone. About 750 patients have recovered; 285 remain in treatment. Since the outbreak was declared on 15 May, Ituri accounts for over 90% of cases and more than 84% of deaths, making this the largest flare-up to date. The WHO Africa region notes a high mortality rate before hospital admission and expanding transmission into new areas, highlighting surveillance and referral gaps. As of 5 July, investigation of 430 deaths found nearly 400 occurred before patients reached a health facility, underscoring delays in identification, isolation, and care."}{

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラの深刻な流行、死者数600人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC複数州37保健地域に拡大し、死者600人・症例1759件と大規模化しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: WHOアフリカ地域が病院到着前の高致死率とサーベイランス・搬送体制の不備を指摘。過去最大規模の流行とされ、国際的な支援ニーズが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Muertes por ébola en Congo llegan a 600 entre sospechas de casos en otra provincia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deaths from Ebola in Congo reach 600 amid suspected cases in another province.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused 600 deaths, with 1,759 confirmed cases nationwide, as new suspected infections surface in Kisangani, Tshopo province (previously unaffected). One of the two suspected cases ties to the Nia-Nia health zone in Ituri province where the outbreak began; the other case has no apparent link to known outbreaks, under investigation. The government declared a new Ebola outbreak on May 15, now attributed to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a strain with no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. Clinical trials of therapies began last week. Containment efforts are hampered by funding shortfalls, attacks on health facilities, and ongoing armed conflict in eastern Congo, the outbreak’s epicenter.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ死者数600人に到達、別州でも感染疑い例
triage.triage_reason: 死者600人・確定症例1759人に達する大規模アウトブレイクで、新たな州（チョポ州）への拡大疑い、ワクチン未承認株（ブンディブギョ型）、武力紛争による対応の困難さがあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 新たな州（チョポ州）への拡大疑いと、武力紛争・資金不足による対応困難、ワクチン未承認株（ブンディブギョ型）である点が特に懸念される。続報でチョポ州の症例が確定した場合、地理的拡大が確認され重大性が増す可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai Monsoon: Hospitals Report 30 Per Cent Surge In Viral Illness Cases After Heavy Rainfall
article.articleSummary: Heavy monsoon rainfall in Mumbai and the Mumbai Metropolitan Region triggers rising viral, gastrointestinal, and mosquito-borne illnesses. As of July 9, 2026, private hospitals report a 20–30% rise in daily OPD visits, driven by seasonal viral infections, influenza-like illness, gastroenteritis, and early dengue, malaria, and typhoid cases. Paediatric emergency departments see a 30–40% uptick in children. Adults 22–65 show about a 20% increase in viral infections over three–four days. Common symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, body aches, fatigue. Mosquito-borne diseases have begun to surface; doctors note high-grade fever in dengue and malaria, with some admissions for viral respiratory infections and severe cough. Precautions include hand hygiene, boiled water, freshly cooked food, avoiding crowded places, and seeking medical care if symptoms persist beyond two days.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイのモンスーン:大雨後、病院でウイルス性疾患の症例が30%急増と報告
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の雨季に伴う一般的なウイルス性・媒介動物性疾患の増加であり、IHR基準への該当は乏しいが、デング・マラリア等の増加傾向は今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: モンスーン季節性の疾患増加であり、毎年恒例の現象。国際的な健康危機というよりは地域の医療需要増加の報告。

article.articleHeadline: 瑞普生物：禽流感疫苗创制项目获国家科学技术进步奖二等奖
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ruipu Biotech: Avian Influenza Vaccine Development Project Wins the National Science and Technology Progress Award (Second Prize).
article.articleSummary: On July 9, 2026, Ruipu Biotech and its subsidiary Guangzhou South China Agricultural University Biopharmaceuticals were recognized for participation in the project ‘Avian Influenza Vaccine Creation and Source Control Key Technologies and Applications,’ which won China’s National Science and Technology Progress Award (Second Prize). Led by South China Agricultural University with Yangzhou University and the Ministry of Agriculture’s Veterinary Drug Evaluation Center, the project addresses three core bottlenecks in avian influenza source control and reveals new mechanisms of viral spread and mutation. It delivers China’s first fully avian-origin recombinant avian influenza inactivated vaccine and the world’s first waterfowl-specific H5-subtype inactivated vaccine, plus a reverse-genetics platform for fully avian-source vaccines. The collaboration produced multiple vaccines—four-valent poultry vaccine (H5+H7), two-valent H5 vaccine, and a bivalent Newcastle disease/H9 vaccine—with new veterinary drug approvals and some exports, underscoring national-level innovation in animal disease control and industrialization.

triage.headline_ja: 瑞普生物:鳥インフルエンザワクチン創製プロジェクトが国家科学技術進歩賞二等賞を受賞
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は鳥インフルエンザワクチン開発の受賞に関する企業広報であり、実際の感染症発生や公衆衛生上の懸念を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン開発の科学技術賞受賞に関する企業ニュースであり、実際の疫病発生事例ではないため、対象国発生としての検証対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 香港男子赴台旅遊高風險接觸後確診猴痘 | 電訊
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong man diagnosed with monkeypox after high-risk exposure during a Taiwan trip | Telecom
article.articleSummary: A 41-year-old man in Hong Kong has been diagnosed with monkeypox after high-risk exposure during a trip to Taiwan. He developed fever and genital-area rash starting July 2, and by July 7 presented with lymphadenopathy. He is unvaccinated against monkeypox. During the incubation period he traveled alone to Taiwan and had high-risk contact there; the infection source is under investigation. The Hong Kong Department of Health’s Centre for Health Protection is conducting an epidemiological investigation and has not found evidence of a link to previously reported Hong Kong monkeypox cases. The case will be reported to the World Health Organization and Taiwan health authorities. Since 2022, Hong Kong has recorded 93 monkeypox cases, including 74 locally acquired and 19 imported, all male.

triage.headline_ja: 香港の男性、台湾旅行中の高リスク接触後に猿痘（Mpox）と診断
triage.triage_reason: 香港では2022年以降93例のMpox症例が既に報告されており、本件は台湾渡航に関連した輸入症例1件に過ぎず、異常性や重篤性、国際的拡大の兆候は認められない。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。香港特別行政区は中国(1814991)として計上。既存の風土病的発生の一環であり、通常のサーベイランス報告に該当。

article.articleHeadline: 600 de.ad in DR Congo Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: 600 Ebola-related deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) as of 2026-07-09, with 1,759 confirmed cases since the outbreak began in mid-May. The outbreak's case fatality rate stands at 34%, with 285 patients recovered and 304 suspected cases still under investigation. In neighboring Uganda, two additional deaths have been reported, and the 20 confirmed cases there include 17 recoveries. The figures come from the World Health Organization and reflect laboratory-confirmed cases and deaths reported by national authorities. The update highlights ongoing transmission in the DRC, despite recoveries, amid the broader regional spread across nearby Uganda. No infection source or vaccination details are provided in the article. All data are WHO-reported as of July 9, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行で600人死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（致死率34%、1759症例）で国境を越えた地域拡大（ウガンダ）が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダも影響を受けているが対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。感染源・ワクチン情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola/RDC : deux nouvelles provinces à leur tour touchées (ministre)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola/DRC: Two new provinces affected in turn (minister).
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo expands to Tshopo and Haut-Uele provinces, with patient movements observed toward Kisangani (capital of Tshopo) and Wamba (Haut-Uele). Ituri remains the epicenter, Bunia the provincial capital, while North Kivu also shows acute growth; the response now covers these northern provinces. The outbreak is in a “very active” phase, and the timing of the peak cannot be determined due to high population density, mobility, and community engagement challenges. Daily increases in reported cases accompany expanded resource mobilization, which helps define transmission on the ground. Surveillance is being extended to additional zones, with calls to strengthen entry-point controls and limit high-risk movements. South-Kivu could be removed from the response after more than 42 days without a new case, none having been reported since May 26.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ／コンゴ民主共和国：新たに2州で感染拡大（大臣発表）
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行が新たな州（Tshopo、Haut-Uele）に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 南キブ州は42日以上新規症例なしのため対応解除の可能性があるが、イトゥリ州が依然震源地であり、北キブ州でも急増、人口密度・移動性・地域協力の課題によりピーク時期は不明。国境管理強化と高リスク移動制限が呼びかけられている。

article.articleHeadline: झारखंड में ब्रेन मलेरिया का कहर, 5 लोगों की हुई मौत, स्वास्थ्य विभाग ने जारी की चेतावनी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cerebral malaria ravages Jharkhand, five people dead, health department has issued a warning.
article.articleSummary: Cerebral malaria (Plasmodium falciparum) outbreak in Jharkhand's East Singhbhum district, centered in Potka block near Jamshedpur. Five deaths reported; 70 new infections in Potka, with 1,250 tested there. Over 70 patients admitted to MGM Medical College and Hospital and Sadar Hospital. Districtwide, 12,518 tested on a single day, yielding 128 malaria cases: 98 Plasmodium falciparum cerebral malaria and 28 other malaria cases. Across 11 days, 52,480 people tested. Health teams conduct screening, drug distribution, and fogging; special fogging planned in 11 Potka villages until 13 July. Symptoms include high fever, severe headache, vomiting, weakness, seizures; care needed for children, elderly, and those with diabetes, kidney, or liver disease. Monsoon conditions boost mosquito proliferation, underscoring need for timely testing, treatment, and vector control amid ongoing government response.

triage.headline_ja: ジャールカンド州で脳性マラリアが猛威、5人死亡、保健当局が警告発令
triage.triage_reason: 脳性マラリア（熱帯熱マラリア原虫）による死亡5例と多数の入院例が報告され、感染拡大が継続中でWPRO基準の複数項目に該当し、当局・地域社会の関心も高い。
triage.notes: マラリアはインドで地域流行性疾患だが、短期間で死亡例・重症例が急増しており、モンスーン期の媒介蚊対策の状況を注視する必要がある。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حصيلة وفيات (الإيبولا) في الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 600 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to 600.
article.articleSummary: As of 9 July 2026, Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo total 600, with two new suspected cases in areas previously free of transmission. In Kisangani, Tshopo Province, authorities reported the two suspected cases, lifting total confirmed cases to 1,795 nationwide. One case is linked to the Nyanya health zone in Ituri Province, where first infections were recorded; the second has no known link to known outbreak zones. The outbreak, first announced in May, involves the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, a rare lineage with no licensed vaccine or treatment. Containment challenges include funding shortfalls, attacks on health facilities, and ongoing violence in eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の死者数が600人に上昇
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱（希少なブンディブギョ株、ワクチン・治療法なし）の症例が既知の感染ゾーン外にも拡大しており、IHR基準を複数満たす重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 2026年5月に発表されたエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続中。累計死者600人、確定症例1,795人。既知の感染ゾーン（イトゥリ州ニャニャ保健区）と関連のない新規疑い症例がキサンガニ（チョポ州）で報告され、地理的拡大の懸念がある。資金不足、医療施設への攻撃、東部コンゴの紛争が対応を困難にしている。南スーダンは発生地域として記載されているが、記事本文では言及がないため対象国リストに含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le bilan grimpe à 600 morts, l'épidémie poursuit sa progression - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the death toll rises to 600, the outbreak continues to spread
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo continues; as of July 9, 2026, 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths. The response reports 750 patients under care and 285 recoveries, with 80% of identified contacts being followed. The outbreak is expanding geographically: Ituri now has 25 affected health zones, totaling 37 of 104 zones nationwide. Two additional confirmed cases were reported in Kisangani (Tshopo Province), one linked to the Nia-Nia health zone in Ituri; investigations are ongoing to determine transmission. The three affected provinces remain Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Strengthened epidemiological surveillance and diagnostics enable faster detection, including outside usual transmission foci. Authorities urge rapid reporting of suspected symptoms and remind the free helpline 151 for alerts and information.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：DRCでの死者数が600人に増加、流行は拡大を続ける
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC東部で拡大を続け、死者600人・確定症例1,759人に達し、感染地域も37/104ゾーンに拡大しており、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラはIHR Annex2の即時通知対象疾患であり、感染地域の拡大（キサンガニへの新規症例など）から国際的拡大リスクも懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Moradora de São Miguel dos Campos morreu vítima de chikungunya, aponta Sesau
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A resident of São Miguel dos Campos died from chikungunya, according to Sesau.
article.articleSummary: Alagoas, Brazil, reports a chikungunya death and two suspected dengue deaths in São Miguel dos Campos. Rubenita Lins dos Santos, 60, died May 30 after condition worsened. Her daughter Crisleine Lins dos Santos, 34, and a child, also from São Miguel dos Campos, are suspected chikungunya deaths; laboratory confirmation is pending. From Jan 1 to July 8, 2026, Sesau records 910 probable chikungunya cases and one chikungunya death; 3,042 probable dengue cases and two confirmed dengue deaths; 38 probable Zika cases with no deaths. Dengue victims include a 59-year-old man who died in March in a private hospital in Maceió, and a 17-year-old girl who died in April after hospital admission in Arapiraca, in the Agreste region. Chikungunya is transmitted by Aedes aegypti, and authorities urge year-round mosquito control to eliminate standing water in tires, bottles, boxes, and other containers.

triage.headline_ja: サン・ミゲル・ドス・カンポスの住民がチクングニア熱で死亡、州保健局(Sesau)が発表
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・アラゴアス州でのチクングニア・デング熱による死亡例が報告されているが、地域限定の風土病的流行であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。ただし死亡者数の推移は継続注視が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とする。地域の風土病的なアルボウイルス流行であり、既存の対策枠組み内で対応可能と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en República Democrática del Congo alcanza 600 fallecidos: el virus llega a una nueva provincia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches 600 deaths: the virus has reached a new province.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 600 deaths and 1,759 confirmed cases as of July 7, with 750 recoveries and 285 in isolation or hospitalisation (case fatality 34.1%). Two new infections detected in Kisangani, the capital of Tshopo province, the fourth affected province; one linked to Nia-Nia in Ituri, the other under investigation. Previously in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu; now a fourth province affected. Last 24 hours: 51 new cases and 20 deaths; 80% contact tracing. Measures include July 3 ban on corpse handling from affected provinces and enhanced screening toward Kisangani at Avakubi, Bafwasende, PK23, PK13. Bundibugyo Ebola virus has no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Outside DRC, Uganda reports 20 cases (15 imported, 2 deaths); France reports its first imported case in a returning medical worker.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、死者600人に到達：ウイルスが新たな州に到達
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（死者600人、CFR34.1%、国境を越えたウガンダ・フランスへの拡大、遺体取扱い禁止等の措置）し、フルリスク評価が必要な重大シグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（20例、輸入例15、死亡2）およびフランス（帰国医療従事者の輸入例1）での確認例が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。承認されたワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しない点も重大な懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Recém-nascida com 18 dias de vida morre com suspeita de chikungunya no interior de AL
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An 18-day-old newborn dies with suspected chikungunya in the interior of Alagoas.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya-related deaths in Alagoas, Brazil, highlighted. An 18-day-old newborn died July 8, 2026, in São Miguel dos Campos after multiple organ failure; authorities suspect congenital chikungunya since the mother was infected during pregnancy, though no test confirmation was reported. The baby was buried July 9. In the same municipality, a mother (Rubenita Lins dos Santos, 60) died May 30, and her daughter Crisleine Lins dos Santos died July 4 after hospital admission on June 23, both linked to chikungunya with severe complications, including shock and multiorgan failure. The municipal health department continues vector-control measures such as house visits, larvicides, and removing water-collection items. For 2026 (Jan 1–Jul 8), Alagoas records 910 probable chikungunya cases and one death; dengue totals 3,042 probable cases with two deaths, Zika 38 probable cases with no deaths, and Oropouche fever is also tracked.

triage.headline_ja: アラゴアス州内陸部で生後18日の新生児がチクングニア熱疑いで死亡
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア熱による死亡例（新生児を含む複数例）が報告されており、地域での感染拡大・重症化が確認されているため、詳細なリスク評価が必要と判断する。
triage.notes: 先天性チクングニア熱による新生児死亡例は特異的であり、家族内で複数の死亡例（母・祖母）も報告されている。2026年のアラゴアス州における確定的チクングニア症例は910件、死亡1例と公式統計あり。デング熱・ジカ熱・オロプーシュ熱も同時に監視対象。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候は現時点で確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: These Factors During Monsoon Could Raise Your Risk Of Food Poisoning
article.articleSummary: Monsoon in India heightens food-poisoning risk as heavy rainfall intensifies exposure to contaminated water and open-food handling. The IMD monsoon alert signals widespread rain, humidity, and storage challenges that accelerate microbial growth and food spoilage. Common foodborne pathogens—Salmonella, Escherichia coli, Campylobacter, and Staphylococcus aureus—can multiply in prepared foods, especially when kept at room temperature or exposed to rainwater and dust. Contaminated water, unfiltered ice, street drinks, and raw produce during the monsoon pose major hazards; poor storage at home and at room temperature further raise risk. Street food, often prepared in open areas, faces contamination from rain and dust. Symptoms include diarrhoea, indigestion, and stomach infections. To reduce risk, avoid street foods during monsoon, wash raw produce, and ensure proper refrigeration and timely consumption of cooked foods. Some parts of India have reported spikes in waterborne diseases during rain.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン期のこれらの要因が食中毒リスクを高める可能性
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン時期における一般的な食中毒リスクに関する啓発記事であり、特定のアウトブレイクや異常事態の報告はない。
triage.notes: 特定の集団感染や具体的な症例数の報告はなく、一般的な健康啓発記事。一部地域で水系感染症の増加報告があるとの記述はあるが具体性に欠ける。

article.articleHeadline: Serum Institute of India ties up with DNDi for Phase III trial of dengue therapy
article.articleSummary: Serum Institute of India (SII) has signed licensing with DNDi to run Phase III trials of an SII-developed monoclonal antibody therapy for dengue, formerly VIS513. The international Phase III trial led by DNDi will start in Q1 2027 in Malaysia, Thailand and Brazil, enrolling about 1,000 participants; in India, the therapy is already in Phase III at more than 25 centers. SII will supply the study drug for overseas sites and manage refrigerated transport. The trial is funded by DG HERA and the French Development Agency (AFD). Dr Rajeev Dhere of SII emphasized efforts to develop affordable vaccines and antibodies with ICMR and DNDi. Dengue remains lacking specific treatment; current management is supportive, with heavy health-system burden during outbreaks. DNDi advocates therapeutics to prevent progression, especially for vulnerable groups. Monoclonal antibodies are laboratory-engineered proteins designed to neutralise viruses.

triage.headline_ja: インド血清研究所（SII）、デング熱治療薬の第III相試験でDNDiと提携
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング熱治療薬（モノクローナル抗体）の臨床試験に関する研究開発・提携のニュースであり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の実際の発生・流行を報じるものではなく、モノクローナル抗体治療薬（旧VIS513）の国際共同第III相試験（2027年Q1開始予定、マレーシア・タイ・ブラジル、インドは既に実施中）に関する製薬企業間の提携発表。疾病サーベイランス上のシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: L'épidémie d'Ebola en RDC se propage plus vite que toutes les précédentes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in the DRC is spreading faster than all previous epidemics.
article.articleSummary: As of 9 July 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is spreading faster than any previous Ebola outbreak, according to Dr. Wessam Mankoula, head of emergency operations at Africa CDC, the health arm of the African Union. The outbreak was officially declared on May 15 in the DRC. During an online press briefing, Mankoula warned that the virus continues to outpace the response and that transmission is expanding more quickly than the deployment of resources to control the situation. The briefing provides no additional details on case counts, laboratory confirmation, or infection sources at present.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、過去最速のペースで拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ流行が過去最速のペースで拡大しているとAfrica CDCが警告しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAに進めるべき。
triage.notes: 症例数、検査確認、感染源についての詳細は記事内に記載なし。続報での具体的な数値確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ¿Qué es la viruela del mono? Así se transmite, cuáles son los síntomas y cómo prevenirla
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is monkeypox? How it is transmitted, what the symptoms are, and how to prevent it.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox, a zoonotic Orthopoxvirus infection, was first detected in humans in 1970 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Transmission occurs mainly through close contact with an infected person—direct skin-lesion contact, body fluids, respiratory secretions, or recently contaminated objects (bedding, clothing, towels, utensils, electronics). Prolonged face-to-face and intimate or sexual contact also pose risks. Incubation is typically 6–13 days, with a range of 5–21 days. The hallmark is skin lesions resembling pimples or blisters, appearing anywhere but often in the genital, perianal, oral, facial regions, as well as hands and feet. Lesions evolve from macules to papules, vesicles, pustules, and crusts, and may be accompanied by fever, headache, lymphadenopathy, myalgias, fatigue. Prevention emphasizes avoiding close contact with affected individuals, not sharing personal items, hand hygiene, isolating cases, and delaying sexual activity until skin is completely healed. Suspected cases with rash and fever should seek medical care and be reported to health authorities.

triage.headline_ja: サル痘とは何か？感染経路、症状、予防法について
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はMpoxに関する一般的な啓発・解説記事であり、特定の国での新規発生や流行拡大を報じるものではないため、シグナルとして扱う必要はない。
triage.notes: 記事はMpoxの一般解説であり、DRCは1970年の初発見地として言及されているのみで、現在進行中の発生を報じていないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola Death Toll Rises To 600 As Virus Spreads To New Areas - The News Chronicle
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-09, DR Congo reports 600 Ebola deaths and 1,759 confirmed infections in the current outbreak, with two new suspected cases identified in Kisangani, the capital of Tshopo Province; one case traced to the Nia-Nia health zone in Ituri Province (where the outbreak was first detected) and the second with no clear transmission link, under investigation. The government declared the outbreak on May 15 after undetected spread for weeks, according to the WHO. The outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Clinical trials for therapies have begun. Response is complicated by funding shortages, attacks on health facilities, and ongoing conflict in eastern DR Congo. Authorities continue surveillance and contact tracing to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ死者数600人に増加 ウイルスは新たな地域へ拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱による死者600人・感染者1,759人という重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、新地域への拡大や不明感染経路の症例も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 希少なブンディブギョ株による流行で承認されたワクチン・治療法がなく、資金不足・医療施設への攻撃・紛争により対応が困難な状況。新規感染経路不明症例の発生は地域拡大リスクを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Toll Reaches 600 in Congo Amid Fears of Spread to New Territory
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo reaches 600 deaths with 1,759 confirmed cases nationwide. The latest toll comes as two new suspected Ebola cases emerge in Kisangani, in Tshopo province, marking spread to areas previously untouched. The Nia-Nia health zone in Ituri province remains linked to one probable case, while the second case has no clear connection to known outbreaks; authorities are investigating. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus, an uncommon strain with no approved vaccine or treatment. May 15 marked the official declaration of this outbreak, which had been spreading for weeks undetected before confirmation. Efforts to contain the virus face obstacles including insufficient funding, attacks on health facilities, and ongoing fighting in eastern Congo. Clinical trials for treatment began recently as researchers pursue potential therapeutics.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ死者600人に、新たな地域への拡大が懸念される
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で600人の死者を出すエボラ流行が、ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス（承認されたワクチン・治療法なし）により新たな地域（キサンガニ）へ拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 感染力の強いブンディブギョ株による流行で、数週間検知されずに拡大していた点、資金不足・医療施設への攻撃・東部紛争が対応を妨げている点が重大なリスク要因。渡航・貿易制限の有無は記事内で言及されていないため不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: Neštovice do Austrálie dovezli Britové. Bleskově zdecimovaly místní
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The British brought smallpox to Australia. Smallpox quickly decimated the locals.
article.articleSummary: Smallpox was introduced to Australia with the British First Fleet and caused rapid depopulation of Indigenous Australians. In January 1788, Sydney became the anchor of a new British colony as Captain Arthur Phillip raised the Union Jack. The epidemic, spread by variola virus carried on board, devastated Aboriginal populations with mortality estimates up to 80 percent over a few years; pre-contact population about 2.3 million. Historical records lacked evidence of infected crew in ship logs, fueling debates about a northern route via Indonesia; modern models, however, show the northern path could not account for the Sydney-wide outbreak. The authors propose vaccination practices aboard ships—crusts from smallpox were carried to inoculate seamen—and that exposure likely occurred among Indigenous people lacking immunity. No solid evidence supports deliberate release, though it remains a remote possibility.

triage.headline_ja: イギリス人が天然痘をオーストラリアに持ち込んだ。天然痘は瞬く間に現地住民を激減させた
triage.triage_reason: 1788年の歴史的出来事に関する記事であり、現在進行中の公衆衛生イベントではないため、トリアージ対象外。
triage.notes: 本記事は1788年のイギリス艦隊によるオーストラリアへの天然痘持ち込みという歴史的事象を扱った歴史・科学ニュースであり、現代の感染症危機とは無関係。インドネシアやオーストラリアが発生地域として付与されているが、いずれも対象国リストの現代的な感染症イベントには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: जमशेदपुर: ब्रेन मलेरिया से 5 बच्चों की मौत पर स्वास्थ्य विभाग की कार्रवाई, पोटका CHC प्रभारी सस्पेंड - potka chc in charge suspended after brain malaria deaths
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jamshedpur: Health department action after five children die of cerebral malaria, Potka CHC in-charge suspended.
article.articleSummary: Five children in Jamshedpur’s Potka block died from cerebral malaria, prompting action by the Jharkhand health department. Potka Community Health Centre (CHC) in-charge Dr. Rajni Mahakud has been suspended with immediate effect and replaced by Dr. Sukant Seat as the new officer in charge. A departmental review found serious lapses in malaria control and prevention, including ineffective timeliness of campaigns, weak surveillance, and administrative negligence. The investigation notes that the deaths are being treated seriously and those responsible will face action. The department ordered immediate reallocation and directed district officials to intensify malaria-affected area campaigns, speed up investigations, ensure drug distribution, conduct fogging and insecticide spraying, and run community awareness campaigns to rapidly control cerebral malaria and prevent recurrence.

triage.headline_ja: ジャムシェドプル：脳マラリアで子供5人死亡、ポトカCHC責任者を停職処分に

article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola outbreak is the fastest-growing on record, according to Africa CDC. WHO reported earlier that at least 600 people have died and 1,759 have been infected, with the true toll potentially higher. The deadly hemorrhagic-fever virus has in recent days been detected in eastern DR Congo areas that had not previously been affected by the outbreak. This is described as the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak ever, not only among Bundibugyo-variant outbreaks but across all Ebola virus species. Wessam Mankoula, who leads Africa CDC’s outbreak preparedness, notes the rapid expansion and highlights the seriousness of the situation. The report underscores the dramatic pace of spread.

article.articleHeadline: Rising paediatric dengue cases in Kerala a cause for concern
article.articleSummary: As of 9 July 2026, Kerala reports rising paediatric dengue, with about 100+ cases daily over the past week, though the current load is lower than last year at the same time. A dengue death of a 14-year-old was reported from the state capital last week. No current severe dengue or child fatalities are reported, but rising pediatric cases indicate active Aedes transmission in homes and schools and increased household mosquito breeding. Dr. R. Aravind notes this reflects the force of infection (FOI). A Government of Kerala–WHO Lancet 2023 study of 5,200+ schoolchildren found seroprevalence of 30.9% among 9–12-year-olds and 24.6% among 5–8-year-olds; Thiruvananthapuram seroprevalence was 46.9%. FOI was 3.3/100 persons per year; about 90% of dengue antibodies are subclinical, and 40% show exposure to multiple serotypes. Preventive measures for children include mosquito repellent and fully covered clothing during evening hours.

article.articleHeadline: Épidémie d'Ebola en RDC: le bilan atteint 600 morts, selon l'OMS

article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has caused 600 deaths and 1,759 confirmed cases, as of July 7, with Uganda reporting 2 deaths and 20 confirmed cases. The outbreak, the DRC’s 17th, was declared May 15 and centers in Ituri province near the northeast border with South Sudan and Uganda; the virus is also present in Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu. It is caused by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no vaccine or approved treatment. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids and causes fever and hemorrhagic symptoms. Treatment centers are operating at about 90% capacity, complicating response amid insecurity and population displacement. A July 2 clinical trial tests two treatments for this strain, and emergency use authorization was granted for the first molecular diagnostic test. Background: Ebola has killed more than 15,000 people in Africa over 50 years; the 2018–2020 DRC outbreak caused around 2,300 deaths.

article.articleHeadline: Dengue: what nurses need to know
article.articleSummary: Dengue, a Flavivirus transmitted mainly by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes, is spreading worldwide, including Europe, as climate change and travel increase transmission. There is no sustained human-to-human respiratory spread; rare vertical transmission and bloodborne routes via transfusion or organ/bone marrow donation exist. Burden is under-reported, rising from 505,430 cases in 2000 to 14.6 million in 2024; the Americas account for about 90% of cases, with Brazil recording over 10 million infections and 6,321 deaths. Modelling suggests up to 390 million infections annually, with 96 million clinically evident. 308 cases were reported to WHO from France, Italy and Spain; Africa faces a looming threat, though true burden is underestimated. The UK is not endemic, but records travel-associated cases; 2025 dengue cases were 344, down from 904 in 2024. Symptoms include fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgia; dengue hemorrhagic fever or dengue shock syndrome raise mortality. Fatality <1%, higher if untreated.

article.articleHeadline: City reports 19 jaundice cases; water sample tests positive | Bengaluru News

article.articleHeadline: Death toll in DR Congo reaches 600 as Ebola spreads
article.articleSummary: Death toll in DR Congo’s latest Ebola outbreak reaches 600 with 1,759 confirmed cases nationally as of 2026-07-09. The government declared the outbreak on May 15, caused by Bundibugyo virus, a rare strain with no approved vaccine or treatment. Protests by Ebola response workers outside three treatment centers—Centre Medical Evangelique (CME), Elikya, and Salama—in Bunia, Ituri, were dispersed; HR/payroll issues were cited by Health Minister Samuel Kamba. Clinical treatment trials began last week. Containment is hindered by funding gaps, attacks on health centres, and ongoing conflict in eastern DR Congo.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak is 'fastest growing ever' as 600 die
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is the fastest-growing ever, centered in Ituri Province with four provinces affected. article.articleHeadline: Ameba comedora de cérebros: não é filme B, é real. Veja sintomas e prevenção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brain-eating amoeba: it's not a B-movie, it's real. See symptoms and prevention.
article.articleSummary: Naegleria fowleri infection, though extremely rare, causes primary amebic meningoencephalitis and is often fatal. Transmission occurs when warm freshwater enters the nose during diving or play in lakes, rivers, hot springs, or inadequately treated pools; drinking water is not the route. Globally, 488 cases were reported 1962–2023, historically centered in the United States, Pakistan, and Australia; recently Italy, Belgium, Slovakia, and cooler US regions have seen cases. In Brazil, a child died in Rondônia in April this year. Symptoms typically appear 1–12 days after exposure and mimic meningitis: severe headache, fever, nausea/vomiting, neck stiffness, photophobia, confusion, hallucinations, seizures, and drowsiness. Mortality has been around 97%, though a Kerala, India outbreak saw more than half survive with rapid diagnosis and early treatment. Prevention: avoid nasal water entry, avoid warm stagnant waters, use distilled/boiled nasal irrigation, and keep pools treated; seek urgent care for severe symptoms after freshwater exposure.

article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) mobilizes Libya’s veterinary services as suspected cases emerge in Qandula and Marawa in Al Bayda, prompting expanded containment actions and market closures in Qasr Ben Ghashir, Ajilat, Al Khums, and Qasr Al-Akhiyar. Animal-health teams collected samples for laboratory testing at the National Center for Animal Health to identify the viral strain and guide vaccine selection and control measures. FMD is highly contagious, spreading via direct contact, contaminated gear, and airborne routes under suitable conditions; rapid action is essential to limit spread. Authorities urge strict biosecurity, vaccination with approved vaccines, and a minimum 21-day quarantine for new arrivals, plus safe disposal of carcasses. The disease threatens livestock productivity, milk and meat production, and food security; human risk is very low, and epidemiological surveillance relies on farmer cooperation and coordinated enforcement.
