article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Ebola outbreak spreads to new provinces, more than 600 deaths.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Ebola outbreak linked to Bundibugyo virus spreads beyond Ituri to new provinces, with Kisangani in Tshopo reporting two suspected cases and Haut-Uele also reporting suspected cases, while investigations continue. One Kisangani case is linked to the Nia-Nia health zone in Ituri; the other has no apparent geographic link to known foci. The national tally now stands at 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths. Declared on May 15, the outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, a rare strain with no approved vaccine or treatment. Clinical trials for potential therapies were launched recently. Response is hampered by funding shortages, attacks on health facilities, and ongoing insecurity in the east, where the outbreak remains concentrated.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ流行が新たな州に拡大、死者600人超
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ型）がイトゥリ州から他州へ拡大し、確定症例1,759例・死者600人と重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、ワクチン・治療法未承認で国際的拡大リスクも高いためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス株は稀少で承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、資金不足・治安悪化・医療施設への攻撃が対応を妨げている。新たにキサンガニ（ツォポ州）、オートウエレ州で疑い例が報告され地理的拡大が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Actuala epidemie de Ebola se răspândește mai repede decât cele anterioare. "Virusul depășește reacția noastră sanitară" - HotNews.ro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The current Ebola outbreak is spreading faster than the previous ones. "The virus outpaces our public health response" - HotNews.ro.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo spreads faster than any prior outbreak, declared May 15 in DRC. As of a WHO report dated 7 July, there are 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths in DRC; neighboring Uganda has 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. The circulating virus is the Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no vaccines or approved specific treatments. WHO issued an alert on 19 May detailing the scale and rapid spread in eastern DRC. Africa CDC’s Wessam Mankoula warned the outbreak continues to outpace public health responses, and MSF has highlighted dangerous gaps in the response mid-June. Context: the 2013–2016 West Africa Ebola epidemic was the deadliest, with about 11,300 deaths from ~29,000 cases, predominantly in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone.

triage.headline_ja: 現在のエボラ出血熱流行は過去最速で拡大している。「ウイルスが我々の公衆衛生対応を上回っている」―HotNews.ro
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最速の拡大を見せるエボラ流行があり、確定症例1,759人・死亡600人、既にウガンダへも越境しており、ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないBundibugyo株であるためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ギニア・リベリア・シエラレオネは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ギニア・リベリア・シエラレオネは2013-2016年の過去流行の文脈であり現行流行地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 19 jaundice cases reported in Dongarakery since June 23
article.articleSummary: 19 jaundice cases of Hepatitis A and E have been detected in Dongarakery, Mangaluru, within a 1.5-km radius since June 23, 2026, according to Dakshina Kannada DHO H.R. Thimmaiah. Health workers surveyed 832 houses and collected 40 drinking-water samples; one tested positive, 26 normal, and results for 13 awaited. Surveillance will continue for 45 days after the last jaundice case. For January–June 2026, Mangaluru taluk reported 24 Hepatitis A/E cases (versus 12 in the same period in 2025), with the district total at 35 (versus 23 in 2025). Hepatitis A and E are typically food- and waterborne and usually not severe; precautions include boiled water, clean food, and thorough handwashing. Symptomatic individuals should avoid self-medication.

triage.headline_ja: ドンガラケリーで6月23日以降、黄疸(肝炎)19例が報告
triage.triage_reason: 局地的なA型・E型肝炎の集団発生で水質汚染が疑われ前年より増加傾向にあるが、重症度は低く地元保健当局が調査・対応中であり国際的拡大等の懸念は乏しい。
triage.notes: 水系感染の可能性があり保健当局が水質検査・45日間のサーベイランスを実施中。前年同期比で症例数増加が見られるが、地元での対応が継続されており外部支援の必要性は現時点で不明。

article.articleHeadline: ആഫ്രിക്കയിൽ ഭീതി വിതച്ച് എബോള വ്യാപനം; മരണസംഖ്യ 600 കടന്നു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreading fear across Africa; death toll has crossed 600.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed more than 600 people, with confirmed cases rising as transmission spills into Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. As of May 15, 1,759 cases have been laboratory-confirmed. In Kisangani, in Tshopo Province, authorities have escalated surveillance, contact tracing, and other response measures as new districts report Ebola-like symptoms. Health officials say people who have had contact with Ebola patients in Tshopo and Uele remain under monitoring. Over the last 24 hours, 51 new cases and 20 deaths were recorded. The World Health Organization warned that rapid spread could worsen across Africa if containment is not strengthened. The article highlights ongoing outbreak dynamics and the critical need for expanded public health interventions.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラ流行が拡大、死者数600人超え
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行が拡大しており、死者600人超、症例1,759例確認、直近24時間で51新規症例・20死亡と重大な公衆衛生上の影響とヒト-ヒト感染拡大のリスクがあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOも封じ込め強化がなければアフリカ全域で拡大悪化の恐れを警告しており、既存の対応体制の強化・国際支援が必要とされる状況。

article.articleHeadline: Incontenible brote de ébola en República del Congo: 20 muertos en un...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uncontainable Ebola outbreak in the Republic of the Congo: 20 dead in a....
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) Ebola outbreak persists, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with 1,759 cases and 600 deaths to date. The latest daily tally records 51 new cases and 20 deaths; 750 patients have recovered, 285 are hospitalized, and contact tracing stands at 80%. The outbreak began in mid-May in eastern DRC and has drawn international concern as two deaths occur in Uganda. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. WHO has declared the event a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). The DRC has a history of Ebola response, having declared Kasai’s outbreak ended in December 2025. In Tshopo province, authorities on July 3 banned entry of corpses from affected areas after three Ebola deaths, including one in a morgue.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ共和国で制御不能なエボラ流行:1日で20人死亡
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言済みで、多数の症例・死亡者、国境を越えたウガンダへの拡大が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC東部（Tshopo州等）でのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行を主題としており、ウガンダでの死亡も言及されるが対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため除外。WHOがPHEICを宣言済みの重大事案。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : 3 malades guéris d'Ebola à Komanda en 24h
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: 3 Ebola patients cured in Komanda in 24 hours.
article.articleSummary: Three Ebola virus disease (EVD) patients—two women and a young man—were declared cured within 24 hours at the Ebola Treatment Center in Komanda, about 75 km southwest of Bunia in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo. MSF communications officer Franck Yemba said the first recovery occurred July 6, with two more officially cured 24 hours later. The patients had been medically managed for two to four weeks before leaving the epidemiological surveillance facility. The rapid cures have drawn local attention, though some residents doubt the disease’s presence; community radio, churches and other groups are boosting prevention messaging. As of July 7, 2026, the World Health Organization reports 1,561 confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC, with 506 deaths and 254 recoveries, and more than 10,000 contacts currently being followed.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ:コマンダで24時間以内にエボラ患者3人が治癒
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（累計1,561症例、506死亡）に関する続報であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: WHOによると2026年7月7日時点でDRC全体で1,561症例確認、506死亡、254回復、接触者追跡は10,000人超。MSFが治療センターを運営し、地域住民の疾病への懐疑心も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Hà Tĩnh tìm cách kiểm soát, ngăn chặn dịch tả lợn châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ha Tinh seeks ways to control and prevent African swine fever.
article.articleSummary: Ha Tinh Province, Vietnam, is intensifying African swine fever (ASF) surveillance in three centralized slaughterhouses—Cam Trung Commune, Thach Tan Center Slaughterhouse, and Thach Huong Center Slaughterhouse in Ha Huy Tap Ward. In the current monitoring wave, 90 ASF samples were collected, with a second round planned for August 10–13, 2026. The province’s pig herd exceeds 351,700 head. In the first six months of 2026, ASF outbreaks occurred in 31 of 69 administrative units, infecting 1,591 pigs and resulting in deaths and culling totaling 133.6 metric tons of pork. ASF virus is highly contagious, affects all pig ages, and mortality approaches 100%; it persists in the environment and has no specific treatment. Therefore, proactive surveillance and biosecurity are critical to early detection, defining virus circulation, and safeguarding slaughter and trade.

triage.headline_ja: ハティン省、アフリカ豚熱（ASF）の制御・阻止に向けた対策を模索
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱は家畜（豚）のみに感染する動物疾病であり、ヒトの公衆衛生への直接的影響はない。ベトナムでは既知の風土病的状況であり、異常性・国際的拡大リスクも低い。
triage.notes: ASFはヒトに感染しないため公衆衛生上のリスクは限定的。畜産・貿易への影響として地方当局が監視強化を行っている定期的報告。

article.articleHeadline: FG flags off surveillance measures on tsetse fly in Akwa Ibom
article.articleSummary: Nigeria's Federal Ministry of Livestock Development flagged off tsetse fly surveillance, community sensitization and vector control across Akwa Ibom's livestock settlements and markets, as part of a nationwide effort to curb African trypanosomiasis. About 12 Glossina species are identified in Nigeria; these flies transmit African trypanosomiasis (sleeping sickness) in humans and African Animal Trypanosomiasis (Nagana) in cattle, sheep and goats, causing weight loss, anemia and reduced milk or meat production. Glossina palpalis is endemic to the South South region; Akwa Ibom's humid tropical climate supports riverine populations. Surveillance will cover Itu, Mbo and Oron LGAs and the cattle domain in Itam, with traps set and flies harvested. State Coordinator Ikankeabasi Ukpong, State Director of Veterinary Services Dr. Teddy Essien, and Team Leader Gilbert Okoro lead a nationwide transboundary disease effort, with six collaborations already undertaken this year to boost animal health and farmers' livelihoods.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア連邦政府、アクワイボム州でツェツェバエのサーベイランス対策を開始
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアにおけるツェツェバエ媒介性アフリカトリパノソーマ症の予防的サーベイランス開始の報道であり、実際の感染急増や異常事態は報告されていない。また対象国リストにナイジェリアは含まれない。
triage.notes: 発生地域にインド（Jharkhand州のItamという地名）が含まれているが、これはナイジェリア国内の地名Itamとの混同または誤タグ付けであり、実際のイベントはナイジェリア国内での予防的サーベイランス活動。ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حصيلة وفيات "الإيبولا" في الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 600 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to 600.
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, July 9, 2026 – The Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ebola outbreak has reached 600 deaths and 1,795 confirmed cases nationwide. Government reports record two new suspected cases in Kisangani, in Tshopo Province; one case is linked to the Nyania health zone in Ituri Province where the outbreak began, while the second case has no known geographic link to existing foci and remains under investigation. The World Health Organization notes the outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine or treatment. Since its May declaration, response efforts have been hampered by funding shortfalls, attacks on health facilities, and ongoing violence in eastern DR Congo, hindering containment and contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱による死者数が600人に上昇
triage.triage_reason: 死者600人・確認症例1,795件に達し、稀少なブンディブギョ株（ワクチン・治療法なし）による大規模流行が継続、資金不足と治安悪化で封じ込めが困難な状況であり、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 新規疑い症例のうち1例は既知の発生地との地理的関連が不明であり、未検出の感染連鎖の可能性が懸念される。ワクチン・治療法が存在しないブンディブギョ株であることも重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola se v Kongu šíří nejrychleji v historii. Zabila už 600 lidí
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo at the fastest rate in history. It has already killed 600 people.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Bundibugyo variant) is spreading at the fastest rate in history. Since mid-May, 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths have been reported; 285 recovered and 304 are under investigation. Four eastern provinces are affected, with Ituri the hardest hit. Case fatality is about 34%. Health infrastructure includes roughly 700 beds across 22 treatment centers, about 90% full, with plans to add 300 more beds; over 10,000 contacts are under monitoring. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo; early July trials are assessing MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir, alone and in combination. WHO seeks $115 million for outbreak response, with only about a third secured. The situation is worsened by ongoing conflict in South Kivu between the army and M23, hampering response efforts and humanitarian access.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で史上最速のスピードで拡大。すでに600人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が史上最速で拡大し、致死率約34%、死者600人に達しており、武力紛争により対応が阻害され国際支援も不足しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 南キブ州における武装勢力（M23）と政府軍の紛争が対応・人道アクセスを妨げており、資金調達も目標115百万ドルの約3分の1にとどまっている点がリスクを増大させている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases in Congo rise 25% within one week
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) up 25% in a week. As of 2026-07-09, DRC reports 1,759 laboratory-confirmed cases and 600 deaths. Health system strain: 95% bed occupancy; authorities say beds must be increased by about 50% urgently. Time to act remains critical; Africa CDC notes over half of cases have information delayed by 72 hours from onset, with specimen collection and transport delays. Testing capacity has reached 2,000 Ebola tests per day in Congo, though regional disparities persist. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo variant, challenging containment due to the lack of a vaccine or specific treatment. Two antiviral therapies have entered clinical testing since last week. Transmission is via direct contact with infected bodily fluids. Cross-border context: Uganda reports 20 cases, 2 deaths, with 1 patient still being treated.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ症例、1週間で25%増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の症例が1週間で25%増加し、600人死亡、医療体制逼迫、ウガンダへの越境伝播も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境伝播（20症例、2死亡）が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。ワクチン・特効薬が存在せず、抗ウイルス薬2剤が臨床試験段階にあることから今後の動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Crescimento do surto de ebola na África preocupa OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Growth of the Ebola outbreak in Africa concerns WHO
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo escalates. As of July 9, 2026, the World Health Organization reports 1,759 confirmed Ebola cases and 600 deaths since the outbreak began in May in the northeast, with rapid growth challenging response capacity. The epicenter started in Mongbwalu and spread toward Bunia, with suspected cases emerging in Kisangani and other provinces, raising regional transmission risk. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved specific treatment. Responders face armed conflict in eastern DRC, population displacement, attacks on health facilities, and resource shortages. The WHO calls this the fastest-growing outbreak in DRC; regional risk is high, but global risk remains low as transmission requires direct contact with bodily fluids. The current situation contrasts with the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone), which totaled about 28,616 cases and 11,310 deaths across ten countries.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでのエボラ出血熱の流行拡大、WHOが懸念表明
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱の症例・死亡者数が急増し、WHOが「最速拡大の流行」と表明。武力紛争や医療施設への攻撃により対応が困難で、地域的拡大リスクも高いためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: リベリア・ギニア・シエラレオネは2014-2016年の過去流行との比較として言及されているのみで、現行アウトブレイクの発生地域ではないため除外。ワクチン・治療薬未承認、武力紛争下での対応困難という点で管理可能性（外部支援必要性）が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de ebola se propaga mais rápido do que os anteriores, diz agência africana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreads faster than previous outbreaks, says an African agency.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak spreads faster than prior waves, Africa CDC reports July 9, 2026. The current flare-up, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has reached 1,759 confirmed cases in the DRC with 600 deaths, while neighboring Uganda reports 20 cases and 2 deaths. WHO situation report dated July 7 notes the virus is outpacing response resources. The DRC has endured 17 Ebola epidemics, and there is no vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo. The most deadly Ebola outbreak on record occurred in West Africa between late 2013 and 2016, with about 11,300 deaths among roughly 29,000 cases, concentrated in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. The current transmission in eastern DRC continues to challenge containment efforts, underscoring gaps in prevention and rapid response capacity.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ疾病対策センターによると、エボラ出血熱の流行は過去の流行より速く拡大している
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブジョ株）流行が過去のどの波よりも急速に拡大し、1,759例・600人死亡、既にウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されており、ワクチン・特異的治療法がない点からもIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: シエラレオネ・リベリア・ギニア・アンゴラ・ウガンダは記事内で言及されているが、現行流行の主体はDRCであり、シエラレオネ・リベリア・ギニアは2013-2016年の過去最大流行の歴史的言及に過ぎない。ウガンダは越境症例が報告されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola se širi u nove delove zemlje, broj mrtvih porastao na 600: Crni bilans raste iz dana u dan, potvrđeno 1.759 zaraženih -
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreading to new parts of the country; death toll has risen to 600: The grim toll grows day by day, 1,759 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo has spread to new areas, with 1,759 laboratory-confirmed cases and 600 deaths reported as of 2026-07-09. Suspected cases have emerged in Chopo (Tshopo) and Ot-Uele (Haut-Uele) provinces, indicating further spread beyond the Ituri epicenter. Two new suspected cases were reported in Kisangani; one linked to the Nia-Nia health zone in Ituri, the other with no clear geographical link and under investigation. The government declared the outbreak on May 15, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or registered therapy. Experimental treatments are entering clinical trials. Response efforts are hampered by funding shortages, attacks on health facilities, and ongoing armed conflict in the eastern region where the outbreak remains concentrated.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが新たな地域に拡大、死者数600人に増加：黒い犠牲者数は日々増加、確定感染者1,759人
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC国内で新たな州(Tshopo、Haut-Uele)に拡大しており、致死率の高い深刻な公衆衛生事象で、承認されたワクチン・治療法がなく、武力紛争下で対応が阻害されているため国際的拡大リスクと支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるアウトブレイクで、致死率約34%（600/1759）。ワクチン・登録済み治療法なし。武力紛争地帯での対応困難、医療施設への攻撃、資金不足が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Após mortes por chikungunya, prefeitura de São Miguel dos Campos intensifica ações de prevenção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After chikungunya-related deaths, the São Miguel dos Campos City Hall steps up prevention measures.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya mortality rises in São Miguel dos Campos, Alagoas, Brazil, with two confirmed deaths in the past month and a suspected perinatal case. An 18-day-old newborn, Clarisse, died on July 8; authorities suspect in-utero transmission since the mother contracted chikungunya during pregnancy. The two confirmed deaths are Rubenita Lins dos Santos, 60 (May 30), and Crisleine Lins dos Santos (died July 4 after June 23 hospital admission with chikungunya, hypotension, bacterial infection, and multi-organ failure at Hospital Helvio Auto). Perinatal transmission can occur, with newborn infection risk up to about 50% and around 90% of infected neonates progressing to severe disease. In response, Health Secretary Ademir Vieira intensified preventive actions: larviciding visits and removal of standing water through urban waste collection, plus urging residents to seek care at Basic Health Units if symptoms arise. Regional data (2026): 910 probable chikungunya cases and one death; dengue 3,042 cases and two deaths; Zika 38 cases, no deaths.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア熱による死亡後、サンミゲル・ドス・カンポス市が予防対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア熱による複数の死亡例（新生児の周産期感染疑いを含む）が確認され、重症化・死亡リスクが高く、WPRO基準を複数満たし地元自治体が対応強化するなど社会的関心も高いため。
triage.notes: アラゴアス州サンミゲル・ドス・カンポス市におけるローカルなチクングニア熱アウトブレイク。周産期感染による新生児死亡例は特筆すべき重症化事例。地域レベルの流行だが、蚊媒介感染症の継続的リスクと重症例増加を踏まえフルRRAでの精査が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Secretário projeta semestre de desafios na saúde e alerta para dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Secretary Foresees Six Months of Health Challenges and Issues a Dengue Alert.
article.articleSummary: As of July 9, 2026, in Piauí, Brazil, the State Health Secretariat (Sesapi) plans major deployment of high-complexity services in the interior to decentralize care and reduce patient transfers to Teresina. Installations include hemodynamics equipment in Floriano and Picos, magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) facilities in Floriano and Parnaíba, and oncology services in Picos, Parnaíba, and Floriano, aligned with Sesapi investments for the year. Concurrently, Health Secretary Dirceu Campêlo warns that the upcoming rainy season may elevate dengue transmission, urging municipalities to prepare through training, guidance, and knowledge diffusion to prevent increased cases. The article focuses on capacity expansion and dengue preparedness; it does not provide dengue case counts, deaths, or laboratory-confirmed diagnoses.

triage.headline_ja: 保健長官、今後半年間の医療課題を予測し、デング熱への警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 実際の症例数や死亡者数の報告はなく、雨季を前にした季節性デング熱への予防的注意喚起と医療体制整備に関する記事であり、異常性や深刻な公衆衛生上の影響は確認されない。
triage.notes: ブラジル・ピアウイ州における雨季前のデング熱予防体制強化に関する記事で、具体的な症例数・死亡者数の記載はない。デング熱は同地域で毎年発生する風土病であり、今回の記事は例年の季節性警戒に該当する内容と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Vírus da hepatite B humana é identificado pela 1ª vez em macacos silvestres da Amazônia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The human hepatitis B virus is identified for the first time in wild Amazonian monkeys.
article.articleSummary: Human hepatitis B virus detected in wild Amazonian monkeys for the first time. A study analyzed blood and liver tissue from 88 primates across 28 species in two Amazon regions: a degraded area with intense human influence (between Rondônia, Mato Grosso and Amazonas) and a preserved area along the upper Rio Japurá in Amazonas. HBV was found in 17 of 49 primates in the degraded region (34.7%), while none of the 39 animals in the preserved region tested positive. Samples were collected from July 2009 to November 2013. Infection correlated with human population density; proximity to people was a key determinant. Findings imply that deforestation and forest fragmentation increase contact between humans and wildlife, elevating the risk that primates become HBV reservoirs and enabling spillback to humans. Authors call for strengthened wildlife health surveillance in high-interaction regions and further studies on HBV effects in primates and transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: アマゾンの野生ザルからヒトB型肝炎ウイルスが初めて確認される
triage.triage_reason: 野生霊長類でのHBV検出は新知見だが、2009〜2013年の研究データに基づくものでヒトへの新規感染事例ではなく、現時点で公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。今後の研究や監視強化の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 研究は2009-2013年に収集されたサンプルに基づく学術報告であり、直近のアウトブレイクではない。人獣共通感染のスピルバックリスクについての注意喚起が主旨。

article.articleHeadline: Rajesh Sharma Is Not Yet Out Of Danger, His Team Responds To Blood Clot And Lung Infection Reports
article.articleSummary: On July 9, 2026, veteran actor Rajesh Sharma remains in critical care in Kolkata after a suspected poisonous insect bite during filming for Prabhas's Fauzi at Hyderabad's Ramoji Film City. Initial reports linked the bite to a spreading infection and possible blood clots with lung involvement, but his team says the infection is confined to the leg and has not reached the lungs. Tests are ongoing to identify the cause; his condition has shown improvement over the past two days, though he remains medically monitored. The leg infection has advanced from the toes to the knee, with large blisters and persistent fever and breathing difficulties; Sharma is diabetic, with reported blood sugar spikes over 400. He was admitted to Manipal Hospital, Dhakuria, Kolkata, and remains in critical care. AICWA has urged a safety probe into on-set conditions and medical coverage for Sharma.

triage.headline_ja: ラジェシュ・シャルマ氏、依然として危険な状態脱せず——所属チームが血栓・肺感染報道に反応
triage.triage_reason: 個人の芸能人に関する単一症例（虫刺されによる感染疑い）であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生・伝播性・国際的拡大の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 有名俳優個人の健康状態に関する芸能ニュースであり、感染症の公衆衛生イベントとしての性質はない。虫刺されによる局所感染で、原因病原体も特定されていない単発症例。

article.articleHeadline: Le gouvernement officialise l'extension de l'épidémie d'Ebola à la Tshopo et au Haut-Uélé - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The government formalizes the extension of the Ebola epidemic to Tshopo and Haut-Uele - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is formally extended from the Nia-Nia health zone in Ituri to the provinces of Tshopo and Haut-Uele due to population movement from Nia-Nia. As of 9 July 2026, four confirmed cases are reported: two in Haut-Uele (Wamba Territory) and two in Kisangani, capital of Tshopo. The implicated strain is Bundibugyo Ebola virus. Authorities describe ongoing active-to-very active transmission, with rising case counts attributed to strengthened community surveillance and identification of hidden patients. The outbreak’s focal center remains Nia-Nia in Ituri, while surveillance, contact tracing, and patient care continue to contain spread. The geographic extension underscores continued transmission linked to mobility, with no clear peak identified at present.

triage.headline_ja: 政府、エボラ出血熱の流行がツォポ州とオートウエレ州に拡大したことを正式発表 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の流行がイトゥリ州から新たにツォポ州・オートウエレ州へ拡大し、活発な人-人感染が継続しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 感染源はイトゥリ州ニア・ニアで、住民の移動により新たな州（ツォポ、オートウエレ）に拡大。確認症例4例（ワンバ2例、キサンガニ2例）。活発な監視強化により隠れ患者の発見が進み症例数増加中で、ピークは未確認。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: मांस चबाने वाला बैक्टीरिया, दुनियाभर के टूरिस्ट के लिए खतरा, अलर्ट पर कई देशों
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flesh-eating bacteria pose a threat to tourists worldwide; several countries on alert.
article.articleSummary: Vibrio bacteria, known for causing flesh-eating infections, are prompting beach closures and tourist alerts in Europe. Warm, moderately salty coastal waters enable Vibrio growth as temperatures rise. The bacteria can enter through small wounds, causing swelling, pain, and redness; untreated, it can spread to the bloodstream causing sepsis and death. Ingesting seawater may trigger abdominal cramps, diarrhea, vomiting, and fever, while water in the ear can cause infections. The most feared form destroys skin and underlying tissue, sometimes requiring amputation to stop spread. Bloodstream infections have about a 1-in-5 fatality within 24–48 hours. Vibrio is also present on India’s coasts (Goa, Maharashtra, Odisha, West Bengal) but there is no alert there yet. The European CDC has a satellite map to track risk; high-alert zones include the Netherlands, France, and the UK, with Bulgaria, Estonia, France, Germany, Lithuania, Poland, Romania, and Sweden flagged in early July. Spain closed beaches last month.

triage.headline_ja: 人食いバクテリア、世界中の観光客に脅威、複数国が警戒
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はヨーロッパ（オランダ・フランス・英国等）でのVibrio感染症拡大警戒であり、対象国リストに含まれるインドについては『沿岸に存在するが警戒はまだ出ていない』と明記されているのみで、実際の発生事例ではない。
triage.notes: IHR/WPRO基準はヨーロッパでの事象に基づき該当するが、対象国リスト（India等）では実際の発生・警戒は報告されていないため、対象国に関するシグナルとしてはDISMISSと判定。ヨーロッパの動向として別途モニタリング対象とすべき可能性はある。

article.articleHeadline: Επιδημία Έμπολα: Εξάπλωση με τους ταχύτερους ρυθμούς που έχουν καταγραφεί ποτέ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Epidemic: Spreading at the Fastest Rates Ever Recorded.
article.articleSummary: Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading at the fastest rate on record. Since the outbreak began, 1,759 cases and 600 deaths have been confirmed by the World Health Organization. The outbreak was officially declared on May 15 in the DRC. Africa CDC official Dr. Wessam Mankula says the virus is advancing faster than the response can contain. In neighboring Uganda, 20 confirmed cases and two deaths have been reported. The DRC has experienced 17 Ebola outbreaks in the last 50 years. There is neither a vaccine nor any specific treatment for the Bundibugyo strain. The West Africa outbreak of 2013-16 remains the deadliest, with over 11,300 deaths among about 29,000 cases, primarily in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行:過去最速のペースで拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が過去最速のペースで拡大しており、死亡者数も多く、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行拡大を主題としており、ウガンダへの越境例も言及されているが対象国リストに含まれない。シエラレオネ・リベリア・ギニアは2013-16年の過去流行への言及であり、現在の発生地域ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 游港澳染病毒 瞒病情登机 上吐下泻 | 中國報 China Press
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Contracted a virus while touring Hong Kong and Macau; hid his illness to board a plane, vomiting and diarrhea
article.articleSummary: On 2026-07-09, reports describe an aviation-linked incident involving a family of four who contracted a virus during a Macau trip, presenting high fever and severe diarrhea and vomiting. They boarded a plane after only giving fever reducers to two children, concealing illness. During the flight, the younger child’s diarrhea worsened, with stool seeping onto seats, blankets, and cushions. The family later apologized to the cabin crew but did not arrange cleaning or compensation. A separate post claimed the family sought emergency care at Beijing’s Peking Union Medical College Hospital; doctors initially suspected food poisoning. Two children received intravenous saline and cefalosporin antibiotics, with treatment continuing until 2:30 a.m. Netizens criticized the act as “deliberate spreading” of illness. This case highlights concerns over in-flight transmission and infection control during travel.

triage.headline_ja: 香港・マカオ旅行で感染、病状を隠して搭乗―機内で嘔吐下痢
triage.triage_reason: 単一家族(4名)の嘔吐下痢事例で、医師は当初食中毒を疑っており感染症としての病原体・伝播性は未確定。SNSでのマナー違反批判が中心で、公衆衛生上の重大性は現時点で不明のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: マカオ旅行中に発症し北京の病院で治療。医師は当初食中毒を疑っており、病原体・伝染性の情報がないため感染症イベントとしての重大性は不明。SNS上での搭乗マナー違反への批判が主論点。

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Ebola patient placed in Equatorial Guinea hotel with...
article.articleSummary: Malabo, Equatorial Guinea—A Bioko island hotel on a tropical coast, owned by President Teodoro Obiang Nguema Mbasogo, is housing 17 migrants (4 women, 13 men) deported from the U.S. under a third-country removal deal, including individuals from Angola, Mauritania, and Ethiopia. Reports say a man suspected of Ebola was brought to the hotel last week by medical personnel in hazmat suits and placed on a floor below detainees; a woman was reportedly moved to the quarantine floor on Sunday. No laboratory confirmation of Ebola is reported, and detainees say they received little information or protective supplies. The facility previously served as a Covid-19 isolation center and operates under a $7.5 million deal. Congo is in the midst of a rare Ebola outbreak with over 600 deaths since May; Uganda has reported cases, but Equatorial Guinea has no border with Congo and is about 1,425 km (1,885 miles) away. Rights lawyers have filed a case with Africa’s top human rights body."

triage.headline_ja: 赤道ギニアのホテルにエボラ疑い患者が移送、米国からの被送還者らと同居—弁護士らが指摘
triage.triage_reason: エボラ疑い患者（未確認）が移民収容施設に置かれ、防護具不足など管理体制の不備が指摘され人権問題化・社会的関心が高まっているため、フルRRAでの確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は赤道ギニア（対象国リスト外）での疑いエボラ患者事案。DRCのエボラアウトブレイク（600人以上死亡、5月以降継続中）は背景情報として言及されているが、実際に進行中の流行であるため参考として記載。赤道ギニア自体は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。ラボ確認なしの疑い症例であり、続報での確定情報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Recife terá ações voltadas aos idosos no mês de combate às Hepatites Virais; saiba mais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Recife to Implement Actions Aimed at the Elderly During Viral Hepatitis Awareness Month; Learn More.
article.articleSummary: Recife launches a July campaign for viral hepatitis awareness and prevention, targeting people aged 60 and over, with the theme “Don’t let time hide the care.” The program includes health education, rapid testing for hepatitis B and C focused on the elderly, special editions of the PrEPara a Prevenção strategy, the opening of a Viral Hepatitis Care Service, and the release of Recife’s Epidemiological Bulletin on Viral Hepatitis. Officials stress aging-related STI vulnerability and the need to expand prevention and diagnosis access for seniors. From 2015–2025, Recife recorded 2,647 viral hepatitis cases: 97 (3.7%) hepatitis A; 1,208 (45.6%) hepatitis B; and 1,342 (50.7%) hepatitis C. Of hepatitis B, 438 occurred in older adults (36.7%); for hepatitis C, about 60.2% were 50+. Activities span multiple venues with Days D of Addressing Viral Hepatitis on July 10, 15, 20, 22, 24, and 29, plus Saturday PrEPara events, vaccinations for HepA/HepB and HPV, PrEP, and prevention supplies. A new reference service opens July 23 at SAE Josefa Severina Conceição/Policlínica Albert Sabin.

triage.headline_ja: レシフェ、ウイルス性肝炎対策月間に高齢者向け施策を実施へ；詳細
triage.triage_reason: これは公衆衛生キャンペーン・啓発活動に関する広報記事であり、アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではないため。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・レシフェ市の高齢者を対象としたウイルス性肝炎予防啓発キャンペーン（検査・ワクチン接種等）の告知であり、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。過去10年間の統計データが含まれるのみで、急性の公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: ارقام غير مسبوقة.. الإيبولا تفتك بالكونغو والوفيات تقفز إلى 600 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unprecedented figures... Ebola is ravaging the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and the death toll has jumped to 600.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is sweeping the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths as of July 9, 2026, three days after the death toll passed 500. The outbreak—driven by a rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain with no licensed vaccines or approved treatments—spreads across four northeastern provinces and is centered in Ituri. The World Health Organization cites a case fatality rate of about 34% in DRC. Neighboring Uganda has recorded two deaths and 17 recoveries among 20 confirmed cases, suggesting cross-border transmission. The UN agency notes the outbreak is the fastest-spreading Ebola event on record across all strains, and authorities have not yet fully defined its true scale.

triage.headline_ja: 前例のない数字…エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国を席巻し、死者数が600人に急増
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確定症例1,759例・死者600例、致死率約34%、まれなブンディブギョ株でワクチン・治療薬未承認、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認され、史上最速拡大のエボラ流行とWHOが指摘しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境伝播が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・治療薬未承認のまれなブンディブギョ株による流行で、史上最速拡大とWHOが指摘しており、規模がまだ完全に把握されていない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: ΛΔ Κονγκό: Η επιδημία του Έμπολα εξαπλώνεται γρηγορότερα από όλες τις προηγούμενες σύμφωνα με τα Africa CDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The Ebola epidemic is spreading faster than all previous outbreaks, according to Africa CDC.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak declared May 15 is spreading faster than all previous outbreaks, according to Africa CDC. As of 2026-07-09, WHO-confirmed figures show 1,759 cases and 600 deaths. In neighboring Uganda, 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths are recorded. The Democratic Republic of Congo has endured 17 Ebola outbreaks in the past five decades. There is no vaccine or specific treatment for the Bundibugyo strain. The West Africa 2013-2016 outbreak remains the deadliest on record, with over 11,300 fatalities among about 29,000 cases, centered in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. The statement underscores the epidemic outpacing response efforts, highlighting a critical need for enhanced public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:アフリカCDCによると、エボラ出血熱の流行は過去のどの流行よりも速いペースで拡大している
triage.triage_reason: DRCで1,759症例・600死亡、隣国ウガンダにも拡大しており、Africa CDCが過去最速の拡大速度と指摘する等、深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大の複数のIHR基準に該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダも感染確認されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。シエラレオネ・リベリア・ギニアは2013-2016年の過去の流行事例として言及されているのみで今回の主題ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 洪水淹死数千头猪！会引发传染病吗？居民居家出行最全防护指南_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Floods Drown Thousands of Pigs! Will It Trigger an Infectious Disease? The Most Comprehensive Protection Guide for Residents at Home and When Going Out
article.articleSummary: Guangxi’s Binyang region faced heavy rains and floods that drowned thousands of pigs, with carcasses floating. Post‑flood risks include pig diseases and zoonoses. For pig farms, contaminated water can spread swine fever (Classical swine fever), African swine fever, and foot‑and‑mouth disease to other herds. For residents, human infections may arise from Streptococcus suis (through wounds in contaminated water), Leptospirosis from pig/rodent urine, and gastrointestinal infections from polluted water or produce; standing water can boost dengue and Japanese encephalitis transmission. Practical guidance: boil all drinking water from flood areas; avoid flood‑damaged foods (rice, vegetables, fruits, seafood); cook foods thoroughly and keep utensils separate; avoid wading in floodwater; wear rain boots and long pants; wash exposed skin and disinfect wounds; do not touch floating dead pigs—report them to authorities. Farmers should report carcasses, disinfect premises, vaccinate survivors, and quarantine. With proper sanitation and reporting, risk is controllable.

triage.headline_ja: 洪水で数千頭の豚が水死！感染症を引き起こす可能性は？住民向け完全防護ガイド
triage.triage_reason: 洪水による豚の大量死後の感染症リスクに関する予防啓発記事であり、実際の人・動物における感染症発症事例の報告はない。潜在的リスク（ASF/CSF/レプトスピラ症等）はあるため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事は実際の感染症発生報告ではなく、洪水後の予防的健康ガイダンス。豚コレラ・アフリカ豚熱・レプトスピラ症・連鎖球菌症・デング熱・日本脳炎の複数病原体リスクが列挙されているが、いずれも実際の症例確認情報はなし。当局への死骸報告や消毒・ワクチン接種などの対応策が記載されており、地域レベルで管理可能とされている。

article.articleHeadline: ΛΔ Κονγκό: Ραγδαία αύξηση κρουσμάτων Έμπολα, λέει το Africa CDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: People's Democratic Republic of the Congo: Rapid increase in Ebola cases, Africa CDC says.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading at record speed, per Dr. Wesam Mankula (Africa CDC emergencies). Declared May 15 in the DRC, the outbreak is advancing faster than authorities’ response for the Bundibugyo strain and for all Ebola strains. Since onset, 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths (WHO). In neighboring Uganda, 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. The DRC has experienced 17 Ebola outbreaks in 50 years. There is currently no vaccine or targeted therapy for the Bundibugyo strain. The West Africa outbreak of 2013–2016 remains the deadliest, with over 11,300 deaths among about 29,000 cases, mainly in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラ感染者が急増、アフリカCDCが発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)の症例が記録的速度で拡大し、死者600人・確認症例1759人、隣国ウガンダにも拡大しており、ワクチン・治療薬もないためIHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当する。
triage.notes: シエラレオネ・リベリア・ギニアは2013-2016年の過去の流行に関する言及であり、現行イベントの発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。ウガンダも症例報告があるが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Possible new Ebola cases reported in previously unaffected areas of DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Two new suspected Ebola cases have been reported in Kisangani, Tshopo province, DR Congo, taking the country's latest outbreak to 1,759 confirmed cases and a death toll of 600. One suspected case is linked to the Nia-Nia health zone in Ituri province, where the first cases were reported; the other case has no apparent geographical connection to known outbreaks. The government's latest report, published July 9, notes that Kisangani had not previously recorded Ebola cases. A fresh outbreak was declared on May 15 after transmission occurred for weeks without detection, and the current outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, which has no approved vaccine or treatment. Last week, treatment clinical trials began, but containment efforts are hampered by a funding gap, attacks on health centres, and ongoing eastern Congo conflict.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、これまで感染が確認されていなかった地域で新たなエボラ感染疑い例が報告される
triage.triage_reason: 既存の流行地域から離れた新規地域（キサンガニ）への拡大疑いがあり、致死率の高いブンディブギョ株（ワクチン・治療法未承認）による大規模流行（確定1,759例、死亡600例）が継続中で、資金不足と紛争により対応が困難なため。
triage.notes: 新規疑い例のうち1例は既知の流行地域（イトゥリ州ニアニア）との関連が確認されているが、もう1例は地理的関連が不明であり、未検出のヒト-ヒト感染連鎖の存在を示唆する。ワクチン・治療薬未承認のブンディブギョ株であること、資金不足・医療施設への攻撃・紛争により封じ込めが困難な点は重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: ಕಾಂಗೋದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಬೋಲಾ ಅಟ್ಟಹಾಸ : ಸೋಂಕಿಗೆ ಬಲಿಯಾದವರ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ 600ಕ್ಕೆ ಏರಿಕೆ | Ebola ravages Congo; death toll rises to 600.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola ravages Congo; death toll rises to 600.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have killed at least 600 people, with 1,759 infections reported since mid-May. The World Health Organization said the toll rose to 600, three days after deaths had reached 500. In neighboring Uganda, 20 confirmed Ebola cases have been reported, including 2 deaths and 17 recoveries. The outbreak is driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus, and no vaccine or treatment has been approved yet. Official caution that the full scale of transmission is not yet clear continues as authorities strengthen surveillance and response. The figures reflect ongoing, cross-border concerns between the DRC and Uganda as health teams monitor spread and mobilize resources.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ猛威：感染死者数600人に増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCで600人の死者を出すエボラ流行が継続し、ウガンダへの越境感染も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも20例（死亡2、回復17）確認され越境拡大が示唆されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。稀なブンディブギョ株によるもので、ワクチン・治療法未承認の点が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Ebola patient placed in Equatorial Guinea hotel with deportees from the US, lawyers say
article.articleSummary: Equatorial Guinea’s Bioko island hotel detention center, owned by President Teodoro Obiang Nguema Mbasogo, houses 17 migrants (from Angola, Mauritania, and Ethiopia) under a U.S.-linked third-country deportation deal. Following a $7.5 million deal, the hotel was turned into a detention/isolation site. Lawyers and detainees say a man suspected of having Ebola was brought there last week by medical personnel in hazmat suits and placed on a floor below detainees; a woman suspected of Ebola was reportedly brought on Sunday. Detainees report no masks, disinfectants, or adequate protective measures, with limited medical information or care. The case unfolds amid Congo’s May-announced Ebola outbreak, with over 600 deaths, and neighboring Uganda reporting cases; Equatorial Guinea has not reported any Ebola cases. Four women and 13 men are detained, all with U.S. court orders, and rights groups have filed a case with Africa’s top human rights body seeking protections for deportees.

triage.headline_ja: 赤道ギニアのホテルに、米国からの被送還者とともにエボラ出血熱の疑いのある患者が収容されたと弁護士らが証言
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の疑い症例が非流行国である赤道ギニアの拘束施設で確認され、防護対策不備の中で被拘束者と接触した可能性があり、コンゴ民主共和国では600人以上が死亡する実際の流行が進行中であるため、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は赤道ギニアの被送還者拘束施設における疑い症例の扱いだが、赤道ギニア・ウガンダ・米国・アンゴラ・モーリタニア・エチオピアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。背景として言及されているコンゴ民主共和国の実際の流行（600人超死亡）は対象国であり、記事内で実質的に言及されているためverified_locationsに含めた。赤道ギニア自体は公式にエボラ症例を報告していない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Número de mortos sobe para 600 e epidemia alastra
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Death toll rises to 600 as the epidemic spreads.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths since the outbreak began May 15 in Ituri. Two deaths are reported in Uganda among 20 confirmed cases, signaling cross-border spread. Africa CDC notes this is the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record, outpacing all previous strains, including Bundibugyo virus. Suspected cases have appeared outside the epicenter, with reports in Tshopo and Haut-Uele; in Kisangani, two suspected cases—one linked to Nia-Nia in Ituri, the other with no clear link. There is no vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo virus. WHO warned on May 19 about the scale and speed; MSF cautioned in mid-June about gaps in the response. This is the third-worst Ebola epidemic, behind 2014-2016 West Africa and 2018-2020 eastern DRC outbreaks. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids, causing fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:死者数600人に増加、流行が拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認症例1,759人・死亡600人に達し、ウガンダへの越境拡大も報告されており、Africa CDCが史上最速の拡大速度と指摘するなど、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境感染が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。WHO及びMSFも懸念を表明しており、ワクチン・特異的治療法がないBundibugyoウイルスによる流行で、史上3番目に深刻なエボラ流行とされる。

article.articleHeadline: Baguio courts revive face mask advisory amid COVID-19 threat
article.articleSummary: Baguio City, Philippines – A court employee tested positive for COVID-19, prompting the Regional Trial Court (RTC) and Municipal Trial Court in Cities (MTCC) to revive a voluntary mask advisory for everyone entering the Hall of Justice. The joint memorandum covers the main and annex areas and urges judges, litigants, court personnel and visitors to wear masks to reduce transmission. The move follows the confirmed Baguio case and a rise in COVID-19 activity in Metro Manila, where Quezon City epidemiology reports 84 cases from June 11 to July 1, up from 23 between May 21 and June 10. Most patients (86%) experience mild symptoms and are treated as outpatients; 14% require hospitalization. Advisory copies were distributed to all RTC/MTCC offices and the regional court manager.

triage.headline_ja: バギオ市の裁判所、COVID-19の脅威を受けマスク着用勧告を復活
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の局所的な症例増加に対する予防的なマスク勧告に過ぎず、重症度・異常性・国際的拡大のいずれも認められない通常の公衆衛生対応である。
triage.notes: 既知の疾患（COVID-19）の季節的な増加に対するローカルな予防措置であり、86%は軽症で外来対応。特段の異常性や重大な公衆衛生リスクは確認されない。

article.articleHeadline: Жертв спалаху Еболи в ДР Конго вже 600 -- France 24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 600 deaths from the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo accelerates with 1,759 laboratory-confirmed cases since mid-May and 600 deaths (case-fatality rate 34%), while 285 patients have recovered and 304 suspected cases remain under investigation. The four-province spread is led by Ituri, where the outbreak was declared May 15; two probable cases were reported in Chopo Province. Transmission is hampered by population displacement, armed-group activity, and a weak health system. About 22 treatment centers provide ~700 beds, with 300 more planned. Over 10,000 contacts are under medical surveillance, but contact tracing is 82% versus a 95% target. The crisis risks humanitarian and economic impacts, with UNDP estimating up to $3.6 billion in African losses; nevertheless, the first global clinical trials for Bundibugyo-strain therapies have begun in DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、死者600人に -- France 24
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行(1,759症例確定、致死率34%)が4州に拡大し、武装勢力活動や人口移動で対応が困難となっており、国際的拡大リスクと人道・経済的影響が深刻であるため。
triage.notes: 接触者追跡が目標95%に対し82%に留まり、武装勢力活動や人口移動により対応が困難。国際的な臨床試験も開始されており、WHO等の関与が既にある可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak is 'fastest growing ever' as 600 die
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak is the fastest growing in history, with 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths reported by the WHO. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo (no approved vaccine or treatment), is centered in Ituri province in northeastern DR Congo and has affected four provinces. Case fatality rate is 34%, with 285 recoveries and 304 suspected cases under investigation. Trials of MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir began July 2, evaluating solo and combination therapies. Transmission occurs via close contact and infected bodily fluids. Health facilities face strain: about 700 beds across 22 treatment centres at ~90% capacity; plans to add 300 beds. Lab capacity has expanded from 30 tests/day in Kinshasa to over 2,000 daily in decentralised labs. More than 10,000 contacts are monitored (82% follow-up; target 95%). WHO seeks $115 million; 32% received. Security disruptions in South Kivu, including clashes with the M23 group, raise displacement fears.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱流行、史上最速のペースで拡大し600人死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最速拡大とされるエボラ流行が複数州に拡大し、致死率34%・600人死亡と深刻。IHR基準複数該当かつ国際支援要請もあり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 承認されたワクチン・治療法がないBundibugyo株による流行で、南キブ州ではM23との衝突による治安悪化・避難民増加も懸念材料。WHOは1億1500万ドルの資金を要請しているが32%しか確保できていない。

article.articleHeadline: Число жертв вспышки лихорадки Эбола в ДР Конго уже достигло 600 -- France 24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has already reached 600 — France 24.
article.articleSummary: As of 9 July 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths, a 34% case fatality rate per WHO; 285 recoveries and 304 suspected cases under investigation; two probable cases reported in Chopo. Four provinces are affected, with Ituri the hardest hit since May 15. Response includes 22 treatment centers with about 700 beds, with 300 more planned; more than 10,000 contacts are under medical surveillance, but tracing is only 82% complete vs the 95% target. Factors fueling spread are population movement, armed groups, and weak health systems; humanitarian crisis and hunger prompt patients to leave centers, raising transmission risk. Economic losses may reach $3.6 billion, threatening up to ~1 million people with poverty. Encouragingly, first world clinical trials for Bundibugyo-strain therapies have begun in DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、死者数が600人に到達 — France 24
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱が複数州に拡大し致死率34%、死者600人・確定例1,759件と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、武装勢力や人口移動によるヒト-ヒト感染拡大リスクが高いためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 接触者追跡が目標の95%に対し82%にとどまり、武装勢力・人口移動・貧困が感染拡大を助長。経済損失は36億ドルと推定され、約100万人が貧困リスクに直面。臨床試験開始は前向きな進展。

article.articleHeadline: Нынешняя эпидемия Эболы распространяется быстрее, чем любая предыдущая -- санитарное агентство Африканского союза
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The current Ebola epidemic is spreading faster than any previous one — the African Union's health agency.
article.articleSummary: Rapidly spreading Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) since May 15, 2026, driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a strain with no approved vaccines or treatments. Africa CDC notes the outbreak is the fastest in history, with 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths in the DRC, and 20 confirmed infections and 2 deaths in neighboring Uganda. The six-week period produced about 1.5 times more cases than the 2013–2016 West Africa outbreak, historically the deadliest with over 11,300 deaths. The World Health Organization cautions that true scale is unclear amid mass population movements, ongoing conflict, and health-system fragility. The epicenter is Ituri Province in the northeast, bordering South Sudan and Uganda, with spread to North and South Kivu, where territory is controlled by the M23 armed group. No licensed vaccines or therapies exist for Bundibugyo ebolavirus.

triage.headline_ja: 現在のエボラ流行は過去のどの流行よりも速く拡大している——アフリカ連合保健機関
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が史上最速のペースで拡大し、ワクチン・治療薬もなくウガンダへも越境拡大しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（226074）へも感染が拡大しているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。北・南キブ州はDRC国内のため個別記載せず。M23武装勢力の支配地域への拡大や紛争、住民移動による把握困難さがWHOにより指摘されており、状況は流動的で悪化の可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: आंध्रप्रदेश में कोरोना से 46 साल के मरीज की मौ''त, 4 दिन इलाज के बाद दम तोड़ा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Andhra Pradesh, a 46-year-old patient died of COVID-19 after four days of treatment.
article.articleSummary: In Kadappa district, Andhra Pradesh, a 46-year-old man died of COVID-19 after four days of high-dose antibiotic treatment. The alcohol-dependent patient was admitted to a local hospital with severe shortness of breath and a cough. Chest X-ray showed both lungs severely damaged, a finding consistent with pneumonia. Despite four days of intensive antibiotics, his condition did not improve, prompting clinicians to suspect a coronavirus infection. A chest CT scan subsequently confirmed COVID-19. Once infection was confirmed, sanitization was carried out and efforts were made to identify and trace those who had come into contact with him.

triage.notes: 既知の風土病的疾患であるCOVID-19の個別死亡例報告であり、クラスターやアウトブレイクの兆候は記載なし。接触者追跡が行われた旨の記載はあるが、地域的拡大の証拠はない。

article.articleHeadline: आंध्रप्रदेश में कोरोना से 46 साल के मरीज की मौत, 4 दिन इलाज के बाद दम तोड़ा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 46-year-old patient died of COVID-19 in Andhra Pradesh after four days of treatment.
article.articleSummary: As of 9 July 2026, Kadapa district, Andhra Pradesh, a 46-year-old man, a chronic alcohol user, died of COVID-19 after four days of high-dose antibiotics failed to improve his condition. He was admitted with severe dyspnea and cough; chest X-ray showed bilateral pneumonia with lungs severely damaged. Despite four days of antibiotic therapy, clinicians suspected SARS-CoV-2 infection, and chest CT confirmed COVID-19 infection. Sanitization and contact tracing were undertaken. The report provides no details on vaccination status, other comorbidities beyond alcohol use, infection source, or whether any cases were imported or exported.

triage.notes: COVID-19は既知の疾患であり、本事例は基礎疾患（慢性飲酒）を有する個人の単発死亡例。接触者調査と消毒は実施されたが、地域的なアウトブレイクや異常な拡大の兆候は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: UA alerta que 35 sanitarios han muerto y 112 están infectados por ébola en la RD del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UA alerts that 35 health workers have died and 112 are infected with Ebola in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: As of July 9, 2026, Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) reports 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths (case fatality 34%), with an estimated R0 of 1.4. Health workers: 112 infected, 35 dead. Hospitals are strained: bed occupancy 95% overall, 113% in North Kivu; officials seek >50% more beds. Delays hinder response: 55% of patients seek care after >72 hours; 24% of suspected cases are isolated after three days. Only 32% of cases come from contact lists (goal >90%). The outbreak began May 15 in Ituri and spread to North and South Kivu. Uganda reports 20 cases, mostly imported; 17 recovered, 1 hospitalized, 2 deaths. Uganda will deploy about 4,000 health workers to eastern DRC; Bundibugyo strain, 30–50% fatality, no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Third-worst Ebola epidemic to date, behind 2014–2016 West Africa and 2018–2020 eastern DRC outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: UAが警告：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱により医療従事者35人死亡、112人感染

triage.notes: ウガンダへの感染拡大（輸入例20件、うち死亡2件）が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。第三次エボラ流行として過去最大級の規模であり、ワクチン・特異的治療法がないBundibugyo株が原因。

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Ebola Patient Placed in Equatorial Guinea Hotel With Deportees From the US, Lawyers Say
article.articleSummary: Equatorial Guinea detains 17 migrants deported from the U.S. in a Malabo hotel under a third-country deal. Lawyers say four women and 13 men from Angola, Mauritania and Ethiopia are held there after U.S. judges ordered removals. Detainees report a man suspected of Ebola was brought to the hotel last week in hazmat gear and placed on a floor below them; a doctor reportedly warned others to be careful, and a woman suspected of Ebola was described. Medical staff in full protective gear moved patients, while detainees say they received no masks or disinfectants. The facility, previously a Covid-19 isolation site, is linked to a $7.5 million deal backing Obiang’s hotel. Congo’s Ebola outbreak has killed more than 600 since May; Uganda has confirmed cases, but Equatorial Guinea has had no confirmed or suspected cases. Rights lawyers filed a case with Africa’s top human rights body.

article.articleHeadline: Odisha to intensify TB screening in 13,271 high-risk villages
article.articleSummary: On 2026-07-09, Odisha will launch an intensive TB screening drive in 13,271 high‑risk villages and urban wards under the TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan‑100 Day Campaign 2.0, focusing on X‑ray‑based screening, preventive treatment, and regular follow‑up of vulnerable populations. District administrations will appoint a senior nodal officer for every block to oversee implementation. The decision was taken at a PRAYAS platform meeting chaired by Chief Secretary Anu Garg at Lok Seva Bhawan, aligning with broader health, education, women and child development, and social welfare reviews under PRAYAS. Officials noted declines in maternal and institutional newborn deaths January–June, attributed to field monitoring and corrective action. Garg urged strict referral protocols, adequate doctor and paramedical staffing, uninterrupted medicines, and reinforced infection control in labour rooms, operating theatres and neonatal units. District Collectors will hold monthly meetings with CDM&PHOs to address gaps; district‑wide convergence for health outcomes was emphasized.

triage.triage_reason: 既存の結核対策プログラムの一環としてのルーチン活動報告であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 国家的な結核撲滅キャンペーン（TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan）の一環としての行政的取り組みであり、突発的な感染症イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: Raj reissues infection-control SOPs for maternity units | Jaipur News
article.articleSummary: Jaipur, Rajasthan's health department reissued infection-prevention SOPs for maternity units to strengthen hygiene and monitoring after maternal deaths earlier this year in Kota, Bikaner and Jodhpur. The measures aim to reduce maternal and neonatal sepsis and curb HAIs. Hospitals must conduct air sampling in labour rooms and operating theatres using settle plate or validated tests, plus monthly surface swabs from disinfected areas. Water testing is required every three months, monitoring E. coli, Legionella and Pseudomonas. Weekly fogging and air-sampling records must be kept; if growth is detected, areas must be disinfected and fogged again, with follow-up testing and escalation to an infection-control specialist if needed. Labour rooms are spot-cleaned after each delivery; surfaces disinfected with Baccishield (silver nitrate and hydrogen peroxide) and floors and sinks with detergent. OT zones comprise four infection-control areas: protective, clean, sterile, and disposal; spills use sodium hypochlorite 1% or 10% for large spills.

triage.headline_ja: ラジャスタン州、産科ユニット向け感染管理SOPを再発行 | ジャイプルニュース
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は今年初めに発生した妊産婦死亡を受けた行政の感染管理SOP再発行を報じるものであり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクや新規症例の報告ではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Η επιδημία του Έμπολα στο Κονγκό εξαπλώνεται γρηγορότερα από όλες τις προηγούμενες, λένε οι ειδικοί
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in the Congo is spreading faster than all previous epidemics, experts say.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading faster than any previous Ebola epidemic. Officially declared on May 15 in the DR Congo, the outbreak is described as accelerating more rapidly than prior ones by Dr. Wesam Makula, the Africa CDC official responsible for emergency responses. Africa CDC operates under the African Union. The article provides no figures on cases or deaths, geographic scope, laboratory confirmation, transmission sources, or details on imported or exported cases. As of 2026-07-09, experts emphasize the unprecedented speed of spread cited by the Africa CDC, signaling a heightened public health challenge for the DR Congo and surrounding regions. The piece concentrates on transmission rate, without additional operational details or outbreak metrics.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、過去のどの流行よりも急速に拡大していると専門家が指摘
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で過去最速のペースで拡大していると専門家（Africa CDC）が指摘しており、公衆衛生上の深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスクの観点からフルリスク評価に進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 症例数・死亡者数・地理的範囲・検査確認状況など具体的なデータが記事中に示されておらず、続報での詳細確認が必要。Africa CDC高官が過去最速の拡大速度と発言している点が主要な懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Purnia News: बरसात में बढ़ा संक्रामक बीमारियों का खतरा, स्वास्थ्य विभाग ने किया सतर्क
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Purnia News: Increased risk of infectious diseases in the rainy season; health department on alert.
article.articleSummary: As of July 9, 2026, in Meerganj, Purnia district, post-monsoon rains and high humidity have heightened the risk of waterborne and infectious diseases. Diarrhea, malaria, dengue, typhoid, and viral fever are of concern. The health department has urged heightened vigilance. Primary Health Center Chickni is conducting village-level awareness campaigns on prevention. Dr. S. P. Singh of APHC Chickni notes that changing weather patterns raise transmission potential. Preventive guidance includes drinking only clean, boiled water; eating fresh, properly cooked food; keeping food and drinks covered; and maintaining cleanliness at home and surroundings to limit spread. Public health messaging emphasizes water safety, sanitation, mosquito control, and prompt medical consultation for fever.

triage.headline_ja: プールニヤーニュース:雨季に感染症のリスク増大、保健当局が警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の感染症リスクに関する一般的な注意喚起であり、具体的な症例数や異常な流行の報告がなく、通常の予防的公衆衛生メッセージに留まる。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性の感染症リスクに対する予防的な注意喚起であり、具体的な症例数、死亡者数、アウトブレイクの発生は報告されていない。地方の保健センターによる通常の啓発活動の一環。

article.articleHeadline: Centrafrique: Des équipes déployées à la frontière avec le pays pour prévenir une potentielle propagation d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Central African Republic: Teams deployed at the border with the country to prevent a potential spread of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Central African Republic strengthens vigilance against Ebola as the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak advances. In Obo, Haut-Mbomou, southeast CAR, health authorities and humanitarian actors are on alert due to Ebola progression in the DRC’s Ituri region and other eastern provinces. No Ebola case has been confirmed in CAR, but border screening and surveillance are intensified: epidemiological surveillance teams deployed; health workers stationed at major border crossings; emergency care centers established at the border and at the city health center. The Ministry of Health urges rapid reporting of suspected cases and reiterates prevention measures: regular handwashing, avoiding contact with sick persons, and seeking prompt medical attention for symptoms. With WHO support, authorities stress vigilance without panic. Border communities fear trade disruption with the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカ共和国：エボラ出血熱の潜在的拡大を防ぐため、コンゴとの国境にチームを配備
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部（イトゥリ州）でのエボラ出血熱の進行に伴い、中央アフリカ共和国が国境警戒を強化しており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められるためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国では確定症例は未報告だが、DRC（イトゥリ州）での実際の流行拡大が主題であるため、対象国としてはDRCのみを検証済み地域とした。CARは対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Afrikan unioni: Ebola leviää Kongossa nyt nopeammin kuin aiemmat ebolaepidemiat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African Union: Ebola is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo now faster than previous Ebola epidemics.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak expanding faster than any prior epidemic, Africa CDC reports. Since the outbreak began in mid-May, WHO records over 1,750 infections and about 600 confirmed deaths. The 2013–2016 epidemic saw nearly 1,000 cases in the first six weeks. Africa CDC spokesperson Wessam Mankoula warns the virus is advancing faster than our countermeasures, with infections doubling roughly every month. Transmission occurs via bodily fluids and direct contact. WHO estimates a case fatality rate of about 34%. The report notes there is no vaccine or preventive treatment available at the moment. The information underscores an ongoing, rapidly evolving outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of July 9, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ連合：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が過去の流行より速く拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、過去の流行より異常な速さでの拡大）に該当し、WPRO基準も複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率約34%、ワクチン・予防治療が現時点でないと報告されており、感染拡大速度が過去のエボラ流行を上回っている点が特筆される。国際的拡大の有無や渡航制限については記事内に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Nord-Kivu : 2 168 contacts actifs répertoriés à la date du 8 juillet (Officiel) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in North Kivu: 2,168 active contacts registered as of July 8 (Official) - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, with data as of July 8, 2026. A total of 2,168 active contacts are being followed; provincial coordination reports 1,942 contacts followed to date, under overall supervision led by General-major Evariste Somo Kakule, Governor of North Kivu. Cumulative confirmed cases reach 158, with 90 deaths among confirmed cases (case fatality 57%). Recovered: 24 across 11 of the province’s 34 health zones. Suspected cases under observation: 70, with 28 deaths among suspected cases. Two cases relocated; no new zones affected. 54 health areas are affected, with case-follow-up rate estimated at 90%. Eleven health zones affected so far: Katwa, Butembo, Beni, Oicha, Kyondo, Kalunguta, Goma, Masereka, Vuhovi, Mabalako, and Musienene. Ongoing Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ノースキブでのエボラ出血熱:7月8日時点でアクティブな接触者2,168人を確認(公式)-ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州でエボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクが継続中で、確定症例158例・死亡90例(致死率57%)と重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、複数の保健地域に拡大しているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の既知アウトブレイクの継続報告。致死率57%と高く、11の保健地域に及ぶ拡大が確認されている。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: Diarrhea-causing parasite infecting more than 1,200 in Michigan has not spread to Canada: PHAC
article.articleSummary: Cyclospora outbreak in Michigan has infected 1,251 people as of Thursday, with more than 1,200 cases reported and a surge of nearly 260 in the past day; the source remains unknown. The Public Health Agency of Canada says the outbreak has not spread to Canada and no cyclospora outbreaks are being investigated there; the parasite is not present in Canada's drinking water. Cyclospora, or cyclosporiasis, can be imported via contaminated fresh produce from abroad: basil, cilantro, raspberries, blackberries, mesclun lettuce, snow and snap peas, and pre-packaged salad mix—from Peru, Cuba, India, Nepal, Mexico, Guatemala, Southeast Asia and the Dominican Republic. Infection typically causes watery diarrhea for six to seven weeks, plus bloating, nausea, cramps, loss of appetite, weight loss, and mild fever. Diagnosis by stool sample; treatment is prescription medication with symptoms improving in 2–3 days, though intestinal problems may persist weeks. Summer and spring see cases due to imported produce.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll in DRC hits 600, WHO reports
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 confirmed deaths, with a case fatality rate around 34%. The epicenter remains Ituri Province, and four provinces are affected. Since mid-May, 285 patients have recovered and 304 suspected cases remain under investigation. The Bundibugyo strain is implicated, for which there are no approved vaccines or licensed treatments. Uganda has reported spillover with two Ebola deaths and 20 cases, of which 17 have recovered. In response, a clinical trial began on July 2 to test MBP134, a monoclonal antibody, and the antiviral remdesivir, both alone and in combination. Ebola spreads through direct contact with bodily fluids or contaminated materials. The DRC declared its 17th Ebola outbreak on May 15 in Ituri, a region long affected by conflict.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死者数、600人に到達 - WHO報告

article.articleHeadline: Why Outbreak Response Is the Biggest Infection Prevention Story Right Now: Lessons From Cyclospora, Ebola, Legionnaires', VRE, and Product Recalls | Infection Control Today
article.articleSummary: Cyclospora cayetanensis has triggered a 2026 cyclosporiasis outbreak across 17 states, with >1,000 confirmed cases and Michigan most affected. The waterborne parasite causes watery diarrhea, fatigue, nausea, and cramping; detection often requires specific testing, making awareness and prompt reporting essential for vulnerable patients, including the immunocompromised and hospitalized. A new lawsuit links a contaminated Olympus duodenoscope to vancomycin‑resistant Enterococcus (VRE) infection during ERCP, renewing concerns about reprocessing complex reusable devices, biofilm formation, drying gaps, and the need for ongoing audits and clear use instructions. In the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the DRC and Uganda, >100 health‑care workers have been infected, underscoring PPE shortages, training gaps, and surveillance fragility. The article frames outbreak response as the central IPC challenge, requiring robust surveillance, environmental safety, HCW protection, and communication.

article.articleHeadline: République démocratique du Congo | L'épidémie d'Ebola se propage plus rapidement que toutes les précédentes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo | The Ebola outbreak is spreading faster than any previous outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri, North-East, bordering South Sudan and Uganda) is advancing faster than any prior outbreak. As of July 7, 2026, the DRC reports 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths since the May 15 declaration; neighboring Uganda reports 20 confirmed cases with 2 deaths. The Bundibugyo variant has no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. A clinical trial of two therapies began July 2, and the WHO has granted emergency use authorization for the first molecular diagnostic test. In six weeks, 1,596 cases have been counted, compared with 994 in the six weeks of West Africa’s 2013–2016 outbreak, which killed over 11,300. The epicenter has expanded to Nord and Sud-Kivu; cases in Haut-Uélé (one death) and Kisangani (two cases, Tshopo). Treatment centers operate at ~90% capacity; responders seek about $1.4 billion in funding to accelerate control.

Confirmed cases exceed 1,400 with several hundred deaths, and the outbreak is expanding across eastern DRC and beyond its borders. The incidence is described as the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 1976, and Nigeria is monitoring as part of a regional emergency with international implications. The death toll in the article title is about 600. The piece notes rapid spread and cross-border concerns, but does not provide infection sources or symptomatic details.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa CDC: The current Ebola epidemic is spreading faster than all previous ones.
article.articleSummary: Current Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading faster than any previous outbreak, Africa CDC says. In DR Congo, 600 deaths and 1,759 confirmed cases have been reported. The surge is driven by the rare Bundibugyo variant; there is no approved vaccine or treatment yet, though clinical trials of a promising therapy began last week (AP). Control efforts are hampered by resource shortages, attacks on medical facilities, and ongoing fighting in eastern DR Congo. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DR Congo since 1976, declared May 15, about six months after the previous outbreak ended in 2025. The strain has reached Uganda, near the Ituri and North Kivu border. Ebola spreads via direct contact with blood, secretions, or excreta of infected persons, often causing death.

article.articleHeadline: فيروس نادر بلا علاج يُقلق العالم - Lebanese Forces Official Website
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A rare untreatable virus worries the world.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus, a rare untreatable filovirus related to Ebola, is driving an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Previous outbreaks occurred in Uganda (2007) and DRC (2012), but the current events have reached hundreds of infections and deaths as of 2026-07-09. The virus causes an acute febrile illness with features of viral hemorrhagic fever, potentially triggering systemic inflammation, vascular damage, bleeding, and multi-organ failure. Transmission occurs by direct contact with infected body fluids, elevating risk among household contacts and healthcare workers. The piece is an opinion by Professor Nancy Sullivan of Boston University published in the New England Journal of Medicine, emphasizing global concern about preparedness for emerging, potentially deadly pathogens.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll in Congo reaches 600, as new cases suspected in previously unaffected provinces
article.articleSummary: On July 9, 2026, Congo's Ebola outbreak death toll reached 600, with 1,759 confirmed cases nationwide. article.articleHeadline: СЗО: Епидемията от ебола се разраства
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola epidemic is spreading.
article.articleSummary: WHO reports the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 1,759 laboratory-confirmed cases and over 600 deaths as of July 2026. This is the 17th DRC Ebola outbreak, officially declared on May 15, caused by the Bundibugyo variant, for which no approved vaccine or specific treatment exists. The epicenter is Ituri province in the northeast, near Uganda and South Sudan, with cases also in North Kivu and South Kivu, where areas are under the control of the armed group M23. Ongoing insecurity, population movement, and weak health infrastructure hinder containment, heightening humanitarian needs for civilians, food access, and essential health services. In early July, two experimental therapies entered clinical trials, and the WHO granted emergency use authorization for the first molecular diagnostic test for this variant. Ebola transmits through contact with bodily fluids and causes hemorrhagic fever; past DRC outbreaks (2018–2020) caused about 2,300 deaths from ~3,500 cases.

article.articleHeadline: UA alerta que 35 sanitarios han muerto y 112 están infectados por ébola en la RD del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UA warns that 35 healthcare workers have died and 112 are infected with Ebola in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: 112 health workers in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo are infected with Ebola, with 35 deaths, according to Africa CDC. Hospital beds are 95% full nationwide and 113% in North Kivu, prompting an urgent call to add more than 50% capacity. About 55% of patients take over 72 hours to seek care; 24% of suspected cases are not isolated within three days of alert. Confirmed cases reach 1,759 with 600 deaths (case fatality ~34%), and the reproduction rate is 1.4. Declared May 15 in Ituri, near Uganda and South Sudan, the outbreak has spread to North and South Kivu. Uganda reports 20 confirmed cases, mostly imported; 17 recovered, 1 hospitalized, 2 deaths. The Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. This is the third-worst Ebola epidemic to date. Four thousand Ugandan health workers will be deployed to eastern DRC, joining 50 already deployed.

article.articleHeadline: Rabies concern prompts Lake George water advisory
article.articleSummary: As of July 9, 2026, the New York State Department of Environmental Conservation issued a water safety advisory for Turtle Island, Lake George Wild Forest, Warren County, NY. The advisory follows a July 4 incident in which two visitors reported being bitten by a beaver. Rabies has not been confirmed; the beaver has not been captured, but officials say it is likely the animal carried rabies, prompting precautionary measures for the area. No other cases or fatalities are reported, and the article notes only the ongoing investigation. The advisory highlights wildlife bite risk in Lake George recreation sites and directs caution for water-related activities around Turtle Island.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病の懸念でレイクジョージに水域注意勧告
triage.triage_reason: 米国ニューヨーク州レイクジョージでのビーバー咬傷事例に関する予防的注意勧告であり、狂犬病は未確認、対象国リストにも該当しないため見送り。
triage.notes: 発生地域にPhilippines(Turtle Islands, ARMM)が含まれるが、記事本文はニューヨーク州レイクジョージの事案であり、フィリピンとは無関係のため対象国に該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: Continúa la alerta internacional a causa del ébola | MÁSNOTICIAS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The international alert continues due to Ebola | MÁSNOTICIAS
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has claimed more than 600 lives so far this year, keeping the international health alert active, according to the World Health Organization. The Ebola virus is highly lethal, transmitted by direct contact with bodily fluids, with case fatality rates exceeding 50% in vulnerable communities. WHO and humanitarian organizations are implementing vaccination campaigns, isolation of cases, and support to local hospitals, but the situation remains critical due to resource shortages and political instability in the region. Neighboring countries have strengthened border controls and airport screening to prevent cross-border spread. The outbreak underscores the importance of strengthening health systems and international cooperation against emerging diseases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱による国際的な警戒が継続中
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で年間600人以上の死者を出すエボラ出血熱の流行が継続しており、WHOが国際的な健康警戒を維持、近隣国が国境管理を強化するなど国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 致死率50%超、資源不足と政治的不安定さが状況を悪化させている。ワクチン接種キャンペーンと隔離措置が実施中だが、状況は依然として深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak is 'fastest growing ever' as 600 die
article.articleSummary: As of 10 July 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is the fastest-growing on record, with 1,759 confirmed cases since mid-May and 600 deaths, per WHO updates. Africa CDC notes cases doubling roughly every 28 days. In the first six weeks, 1,596 cases were reported—exceeding the 994 cases seen in the 2013-16 West Africa outbreak’s first six weeks. The response requires about US$1.4 billion for the outbreak and humanitarian needs; authorities urge a rapid surge of resources, calling on partners and donors to fast-track disbursement to accelerate containment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、600人死亡で「史上最速の拡大」に
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが史上最速の拡大速度を示し、致死率も高く、国際的な資金支援を要請していることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaも含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCのみが主題として言及されているためAngolaは除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de síndrome respiratória grave no Espírito Santo continuam altos, diz Fiocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases of severe acute respiratory syndrome in Espírito Santo remain high, says Fiocruz.
article.articleSummary: Espírito Santo, Brazil, continues to report high hospitalizations for Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) in epidemiological week 26 (June 28–July 4), with the state in the alert-to-high-risk range for SRAG and signaling ongoing circulation of respiratory viruses in Greater Vitória and the interior. Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) sustains a large burden of severe cases, especially among children up to 4 years old, even as national indicators hint at stabilization or decline. Across Brazil, laboratory data show influenza A and B as leading causes of hospitalization for severe respiratory illness; RSV accounted for 55.9% of positive viral tests in the last four weeks, followed by rhinovirus (23.3%), influenza A (12.7%), influenza B (8.4%), and COVID-19 (2.2%). Reinforced preventive measures include hand hygiene, masking when needed, cough etiquette, and isolation with symptoms. Vaccination remains essential for risk groups. Brazil has reported 109,347 SRAG cases in 2026 to date.

triage.headline_ja: エスピリトサント州の重症急性呼吸器症候群、依然高水準—フィオクルス発表
triage.triage_reason: 季節性呼吸器ウイルス（RSV・インフルエンザ）による重症例増加は例年見られる現象であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、症例数の高止まりが続いているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性の呼吸器感染症（RSV、インフルエンザA/B、COVID-19）による国内サーベイランス報告であり、新規病原体や異常な流行パターンは示されていない。ブラジル国内の公衆衛生対応の範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Fumacê reforça combate ao mosquito da dengue em cinco bairros de Campo Grande
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fogging strengthens the fight against the dengue mosquito in five neighborhoods of Campo Grande.
