article.articleSummary: On 9 July 2026, five Campo Grande neighborhoods—Cabreúva, Coronel Antonino, José Abrão, Nasser, and Nova Lima—will receive intensified Aedes aegypti control via ultra-low-volume fumigation (fumacê) by the CCEV of the Municipal Health Secretariat (Sesau) from 16:00 to 22:00. The fumigation targets adult mosquitoes, especially females, vectors of Dengue, Zika, and Chikungunya. Residents are advised to open doors and windows to maximize reach. Operations may be delayed or canceled in case of rain, wind, or fog, which can reduce effectiveness. This initiative is part of ongoing vector control efforts in Campo Grande, Mato Grosso do Sul. No case counts or laboratory confirmations are reported.

triage.headline_ja: 煙霧処理でカンポ・グランデの5地区でデング熱蚊対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 定例的な蚊媒介対策の実施報告であり、症例数や異常な流行状況の記載がなく、通常の公衆衛生活動の範囲内である。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・カンポグランデにおける通常の蚊対策活動（燻蒸）に関する内容で、症例数や検査確認情報は含まれていない。対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるが、通常業務の報告でありシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : les motocyclistes appelés à la vigilance pour prévenir la propagation d'Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: motorcycle taxi riders urged to be vigilant to prevent the spread of Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease prevention urged among motorcycle taxi riders in Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo. In the northeast, riders serving the Mongbwalu mining zone and other routes in Ituri were asked by ACP, via the provincial ATAMOV association, to heighten vigilance to limit spread. Michael Tibasima, president of ATAMOV, said riders transport many people daily and could transmit Ebola between individuals or communities without precautions. Drivers are encouraged not to board people displaying Ebola symptoms—fever, headaches, or weakness—while reinforcing hygiene practices: handwashing, motorcycle disinfection, and providing clients with a disinfectant solution. The appeal underscores strict adherence to preventive measures to support the Ebola response in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州:エボラ拡大防止のためバイクタクシー運転手に警戒呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州でエボラウイルス病の感染拡大防止のための注意喚起が行われており、致死率の高いエボラの継続的な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す内容であるため、フルリスク評価に進むべきと判断した。
triage.notes: 記事はイツリ州でのエボラ対応活動（バイクタクシー運転手への予防啓発）を報じており、既存のエボラ流行に対する地域社会レベルの対策強化を示唆する。具体的な感染者数・死亡者数・渡航制限の有無は本文に記載がなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: 一家四口明知染病仍登机，一路疯狂"喷粪"，飞机里到处都是....._手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A family of four knowingly infected still boarded the plane, and throughout the flight they carried out a wild 'feces-spraying' spree, leaving the aircraft covered in it.
article.articleSummary: Family of four returning from Macau on a flight to Shanghai allegedly developed infection symptoms; despite illness, they took antipyretics and boarded. On board, their condition worsened with vomiting and diarrhea, leading to the cabin being contaminated by spraying feces and exposing fellow passengers to health risks. The incident sparked online debate over public safety versus personal convenience, with netizens criticizing that illness should not be traveled with, especially in a closed cabin. No laboratory confirmation or official outbreak details are provided in the report. The article highlights the ethical and public health implications of flying when symptomatic, emphasizing that public transportation is not private, and that such actions seek to avoid costs at the expense of others’ safety. Location mentions: Macau, Shanghai; date published: 2026-07-09.

triage.headline_ja: 感染を承知で搭乗した4人家族が機内で嘔吐・下痢を繰り返し、機内を汚染させた
triage.triage_reason: 単一家族の嘔吐下痢事例であり、病原体や検査確認情報がなく、公衆衛生上の異常性や国際的拡大リスクを示す根拠に乏しい。ネット上の話題性はあるが公式な発生報告ではない。
triage.notes: 検査確認や公式発表がなく、個人の行動に関するSNS的な話題記事。感染症名も『Unknown Illness』であり具体的病原体不明。続報があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: يشبه إيبولا...فيروس جديد يثير القلق وتحذير من العلماء | مصراوي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Resembles Ebola... A new virus raises concerns and scientists warn.
article.articleSummary: As of 9 July 2026, Bundibugyo virus (BDBV), a filovirus related to Ebola, has sparked a major outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with 695 confirmed cases and 138 deaths reported by WHO. This is the largest BDBV outbreak to date, after two earlier events in 2007 and 2012. The virus causes severe hemorrhagic fever with high fever, widespread inflammation, vascular damage, uncontrolled bleeding, and possible multi-organ failure. Transmission is via direct contact with the body fluids of infected individuals, heightening risks in healthcare settings. Diagnosis is difficult because symptoms overlap with malaria and typhoid, and limited laboratories delay confirmation, isolation, and contact tracing. Early laboratory confirmation, rapid patient isolation, and supportive care are crucial to improve survival and curb spread, mirroring Ebola control measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラに似た新型ウイルスが懸念を呼ぶ…科学者らが警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでブンディブギョウイルス（エボラ関連フィロウイルス）による過去最大規模の出血熱アウトブレイクが発生し、695症例・138死亡と重大な公衆衛生上の影響があるため。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として挙げられているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOにより過去最大規模のBDBVアウトブレイクと報告されており、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: East Singhbhum reports 101 fresh malaria cases, Death toll rises to 6
article.articleSummary: East Singhbhum, Jamshedpur, 9 July 2026 – Malaria outbreaks persist with 101 new infections reported on Thursday, raising the district’s death toll to six. Health authorities screened 11,096 people across nine blocks, plus Mango and Birsanagar urban areas and Sadar Hospital; 101 tested positive: 67 Plasmodium falciparum (PF), 31 Plasmodium vivax (PV), and 3 mixed infections. PF, the more severe form, is associated with cerebral malaria. Five-year-old Rakhi Sardar of Potka died Wednesday evening after PF infection; she had been admitted on July 5 with high fever at MGM Medical College and Hospital. Between June 29 and July 9, 63,570 tests yielded 1,603 positives (1,268 PF, 295 PV, 40 mixed). Deputy Commissioner Rajiv Ranjan has directed officials to complete 100,000 malaria screenings by July 12 to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 東シングブーム地区でマラリア新規101例、死者数6人に増加
triage.triage_reason: インド・ジャールカンド州の一地区における既知の風土病（マラリア）のアウトブレイクで、死者数が増加しているが国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低く、地域内対応が継続中である。
triage.notes: マラリアはインド東部の風土病であり、地区レベルでの症例急増と死亡例増加が報告されているが、地元当局によるスクリーニング強化など既存の対応枠組み内での管理が行われている。国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威としての性質は低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Sospechoso de ébola en hotel de Guinea Ecuatorial con deportados de EEUU
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola case at a hotel in Equatorial Guinea with deportees from the U.S.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case reported at a hotel in Malabo, Equatorial Guinea, housing 17 deported migrants from Angola, Mauritania, and Ethiopia under a U.S. deportation agreement. A man suspected of Ebola was moved to the hotel last week by medical staff in protective gear and placed on a lower floor; a woman was reportedly quarantined on a separate floor. A coalition of international lawyers and two deported detainees say doctors spoke in English and urged precaution, but offered few details. The hotel, previously used as a COVID-19 isolation center, has faced criticism for hygiene and limited protective supplies beyond masks. Guinea Ecuatorial reports no confirmed or suspected Ebola cases; the Democratic Republic of the Congo is experiencing an outbreak with over 600 deaths since May, and Uganda has confirmed cases. Four women and 13 men are under judicial orders not to be repatriated.

triage.headline_ja: 米国からの被強制送還者が滞在する赤道ギニアのホテルでエボラ疑い例
triage.triage_reason: 米国からの被強制送還者を巡るエボラ疑い例であり、DRC・ウガンダでの実際のエボラ流行を背景に国際的な関心と越境移動リスクが認められるため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 本イベントの主体は赤道ギニア（対象国リスト外）での疑い例であり確定例ではない。DRCでの流行（600名超死亡）やウガンダの確定例は背景情報として言及されているのみで、記事の主題ではないため verified_locations には含めていない。続報でエボラ確定診断の有無、及び対象国（DRC等）への波及有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola se acelera en República Democrática del Congo: se registran más de 500 muertes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is accelerating: more than 500 deaths have been recorded.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is accelerating, with more than 500 deaths. The African CDC reports a 25% weekly increase in confirmed cases, and the WHO says treatment centers are near capacity. By July 7, the DRC had 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths; Uganda had 20 cases and 2 deaths. As of July 4, Congo recorded 1,561 infections, 506 deaths, and 254 recoveries, with over 10,000 contacts under surveillance. Response challenges include logistical limits and ambulance shortages in Ituri’s Bunia, where most cases cluster. Diagnostic capacity has expanded to more than 2,000 daily tests across ten decentralized labs, including Bunia. A clinical trial started July 2 to assess MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir, with over 1,200 treatment doses available. North Kivu remains under surveillance with no confirmed cases; Congo has faced 17 outbreaks, the deadliest in 2013–2016 West Africa.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行が加速：死者500人超を記録
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行が加速し死者数が急増、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されておりIHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例が報告されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。臨床試験（MBP134、レムデシビル）が開始され、WHO・Africa CDCも関与する国際的関心の高い事案。

article.articleHeadline: What parents should know about RSV
article.articleSummary: RSV (Respiratory Syncytial Virus) is a leading cause of infant hospitalization for chest infections. In India, babies, often under one, present in monsoon-to-winter seasons with bronchiolitis after initial cold symptoms; some develop rapid breathing, chest retractions, wheeze, hypoxia, needing hospital care, though most recover at home. Globally, RSV causes about 33 million lower respiratory infections and 3.6 million hospital admissions in children under five each year, and around 100,000 deaths; in the first year of life it accounts for more hospitalizations than flu. Warning signs include fast breathing and chest distress warranting urgent medical evaluation. For high-risk babies, discuss nirsevimab use with a pediatrician; routine administration is not yet standard in India. Most RSV infections are mild, and parents should monitor the chest, not just nasal symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: RSVについて親が知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: 季節性RSVに関する一般的な啓発記事であり、異常な増加や特定のアウトブレイクを報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はRSVの一般的な医学解説記事であり、特定の流行状況やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Учени алармират: Епидемията от ебола се разпространява по-бързо от всяка предишна
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists warn: The Ebola outbreak is spreading faster than any previous outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of July 9, 2026, the Ebola outbreak declared in the Democratic Republic of Congo on May 15 is spreading faster than any previous outbreak. Dr. Wesam Mankula of the African Union's health agency warned that the virus is outrunning response measures. In DRC, there have been 1,759 laboratory-confirmed cases and 600 deaths since the outbreak began. Neighboring Uganda reports 20 new infections and two deaths, with the situation described as stable there. The Bundibugyo strain, the outbreak's culprit, currently has no vaccine or specific treatment. The World Health Organization had warned on May 19 about the scale and rapid spread in eastern DRC. Officially, DRC has experienced 17 Ebola outbreaks historically, but this event is notable for its accelerated transmission and the ongoing cross-border risk.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者が警告：エボラ流行は過去のどの流行よりも速く拡大している
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで急速拡大し1,759症例・600死亡、ワクチン・特効薬なし、ウガンダへの越境も確認されておりIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ワクチン・治療法が存在しないBundibugyo株による流行で、致死率・拡大速度ともに高く、国際的懸念が大きい。

article.articleHeadline: "إيبولا" يحصد 600 وفاة في الكونغو.. وتحذير إفريقي من أسرع تفشٍ على الإطلاق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola kills 600 in the Congo, African warning of the fastest outbreak ever.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 600 deaths from 1,759 confirmed cases, 34% CFR. The outbreak centers in Ituri Province, with spread to four provinces in northeast DRC. Two new suspected cases were reported in Kisangani, in Tshopo Province near Ituri; one case links to Nyanya health zone in Ituri, the other has no known hotspot link. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with no licensed vaccine or approved therapy. The virus has crossed into Uganda, where 20 confirmed cases include two deaths and 17 recoveries. The African CDC says this is the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record, aided by movement and insecurity; some treatment centers are near capacity. The outbreak was declared on May 15; a clinical trial for a therapy began recently. Health workers in Ituri protested salary delays and funding disruptions; Bunia airport closures hinder response.

triage.headline_ja: 「エボラ」がコンゴで600人の死者を出す…アフリカが史上最速の流行拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大）に該当し、WPRO基準も全5項目該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境感染が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。空港閉鎖は対応上の障害として言及されているが、正式な渡航・貿易制限措置かは記事から不明。34%という高いCFRと史上最速拡大という警告から緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: RDC eleva a 600 el número de fallecidos por ébola y detecta casos en una cuarta provincia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC raises Ebola death toll to 600 and detects cases in a fourth province.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: as of July 7, 2026, 600 deaths confirmed; 1,759 confirmed cases in the eastern provinces of North Kivu, South Kivu, and Ituri. These figures exclude two cases detected in Kisangani, Tshopo province, where investigations are ongoing. One Kisangani case is linked to the Nia-Nia health zone in Ituri; the other case details have not been provided. Case-fatality ratio stands at 34.1%. 285 patients are in isolation/hospitalization; 750 have recovered. Contact tracing is at 80%. The outbreak was declared May 15 in Ituri, a border province with Uganda and South Sudan, and has since spread to North and South Kivu. Response teams are reinforcing surveillance and rapid detection nationwide.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ死者数600人に到達、第4の州で新規症例を検出
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクが4州に拡大し、死者600人・致死率34.1%と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、国際的拡大リスクも懸念されるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンは国境隣接国として言及されているが、実際の症例発生はDRC国内（北キブ、南キブ、イトゥリ、チョポ州）に限定されている。国境地域であるため越境拡大のリスクは高い。

article.articleHeadline: Divinópolis passa de 2 mil casos confirmados de dengue em 2026 - Portal MPA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Divinópolis exceeds 2,000 confirmed dengue cases in 2026 - Portal MPA.
article.articleSummary: Divinópolis, Brazil reports 2,023 confirmed dengue cases in 2026 from 4,252 notifications, with 264 hospitalizations and four confirmed deaths (one under investigation) as of July 9, 2026. The outbreak shows sustained growth: 55 confirmed in February, 142 in March, 1,144 in May, reaching 2,023 by July. The Centro neighborhood leads with 287 cases, followed by São José (190), Catalão (148), Planalto (145) and Belvedere (124). Age groups most affected are 20–29 (815), 30–39 (750), 40–49 (666), and 60+ (592). Of 4,252 notifications, 1,983 are dengue classic, 37 with alarm signs, 3 severe; 2,057 discarded and 164 under analysis. Laboratory results show 30.27% serology positive and 44.13% NS1 antigen positive; 55.69% of cases are female. Chikungunya has 7 confirmed cases (5 hospitalizations), Zika has none in 2026. Emphasis on eliminating standing water to curb Aedes aegypti; seek care for high fever, body pains, retro-orbital pain, or rash.

triage.headline_ja: ジヴィノーポリス、2026年のデング確定症例が2,000件を超える - Portal MPA
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル南東部の一都市における季節性デング流行の報告で、死亡例・重症例はあるものの地域限定かつ既知の疾患パターンであり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いと考えられるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: ブラジルの一地方都市（ジヴィノーポリス、ミナスジェライス州）における季節性デング熱の定期的な流行報告。チクングニア熱も少数確認されているが、ジカ熱は0例。地方紙の報道であり国際的な社会的関心は不明。

article.articleHeadline: डेंगू-मलेरिया रोकने के लिए 58 फॉगिंग मशीनों के साथ 2 शिफ्ट में होगा छिड़काव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spraying will be carried out in two shifts using 58 fogging machines to prevent dengue and malaria.
article.articleSummary: Patna, India, as of 2026-07-09 on monsoon onset, launches two-shift fogging with 58 vehicle-mounted and ward-level hand-held machines to curb dengue, malaria and chikungunya. Targeting mosquito breeding, Patna Municipal Corporation uses 375 anti-larvae kits with temephos to destroy larvae and disrupt transmission. The operation covers residential areas plus malls, markets, government/private offices, construction sites, open spaces, and waterlogged zones; garbage points are treated with lime and bleaching powder to deter breeding. Public involvement encouraged: call toll-free 155304 or use WhatsApp bot 9264447449 for fogging requests. The plan emphasizes larval control and outbreak prevention; no current case counts are stated as part of ongoing prevention efforts.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱・マラリア予防のため58台の消毒機で2交代制の散布を実施
triage.triage_reason: 現時点で症例数の報告はなく、季節性の予防的防除活動（フォギング・幼虫駆除）に関する内容であり、異常性や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は確認されない。
triage.notes: 季節性のデング・マラリア・チクングニア予防活動の記事であり、実際の症例報告や異常事態を示す情報は含まれていない。モンスーン前の恒例的な公衆衛生対策と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Diarrhea-Causing Parasite Infecting More Than 1,200 in Michigan Has Not Spread to Canada: PHAC
article.articleSummary: Michigan reports 1,251 Cyclospora cases as of Thursday; outbreak source remains unknown and counts exceed the typical 50/year. The Public Health Agency of Canada says there is no spread to Canada and no current cyclospora investigations there. Cyclosporiasis causes watery diarrhea for six to seven weeks, with bloating, nausea, cramps, fatigue, loss of appetite, weight loss and mild fever. It can contaminate foods via water or processing contamination. Imported produce from Peru, Cuba, India, Nepal, Mexico, Guatemala, Southeast Asia and the Dominican Republic can carry cyclospora; linked foods include basil, cilantro, raspberries, blackberries, mesclun lettuce, snow peas, snap peas and pre-packaged salad. Diagnosis is by stool sample and treatment with prescription meds often improves symptoms within 2–3 days, though some intestinal issues may take weeks.

triage.headline_ja: 下痢を引き起こす寄生虫、ミシガン州で1,200人超に感染 ― カナダ公衆衛生庁「カナダへの拡大なし」
triage.triage_reason: 発生は米国ミシガン州に限定され、カナダへの拡大も否定されている。対象国（インド・ネパール等）は輸入農産物の潜在的汚染源として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではないため対象外。
triage.notes: インド・ネパール・ペルー等は輸入農産物によるサイクロスポーラ汚染源の例として挙げられているのみで、実際の発生国はアメリカ（ミシガン州）。対象国リストに該当する発生国はないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Bilanțul epidemiei de Ebola din RD Congo ajunge la 600 de morți. Cadrele medicale amenință cu greva
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from the Ebola epidemic in DR Congo reaches 600. Healthcare workers threaten to strike.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 600 confirmed deaths and 1,759 confirmed cases, government data valid through Tuesday. In the last 24 hours, 51 new cases and 20 deaths were reported. Two suspected cases in Kisangani (Tshopo) await laboratory confirmation; one case is linked to Nia-Nia village in Ituri, while the other has no clear geographic link beyond Kisangani. Healthcare workers in Ituri, the hardest-hit province, threaten a strike over delayed salaries and bonuses, warning of a 24-hour payment deadline; some have already ceased work amid PPE shortages and concern over management. The outbreak centers on the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, with no approved vaccine; clinical trials for treatment have begun. WHO notes the virus circulated for weeks undetected in Mongbwalu, Rwampara, and Bunia before spreading, and, in May, WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、死者600人に達する。医療従事者はストライキを警告
triage.triage_reason: PHEIC宣言済みのエボラ流行が死者600人・症例1,759件に拡大し、医療従事者のストライキ懸念や新規疑い症例も報告されており、深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクともに高い。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州・チョポ州）でのエボラ流行が主題。ルワンダは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文で言及がなく、除外。既にWHOによりPHEIC宣言済みの継続事案。

article.articleHeadline: El número de muertos por ébola en el Congo asciende a 600
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola death toll in the Congo rises to 600.
article.articleSummary: On May 15, Congolese authorities declared a new Ebola outbreak after weeks of undetected transmission, per the WHO. New suspected cases have been reported in Tshopo and Haut‑Uele provinces, indicating spread beyond the Ituri epicenter. A government report notes two suspected Kisangani cases in Tshopo: one linked to the Nia‑Nia health zone in Ituri and the other with no apparent epidemiological link; investigations are ongoing. Total confirmed cases in the country have reached 1,759. The current outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. As of 9 July 2026, the death toll stands at 600. Last week, clinical trials for a treatment began, amid funding shortfalls, attacks on health centers, and ongoing conflict in eastern Congo, which hinder containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱による死者数が600人に増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認症例1,759人・死者600人に達するエボラアウトブレイクが複数州に拡大しており、ワクチン・治療薬未承認の希少株かつ紛争により対応が困難なため、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当する。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルス株による稀な流行で、ワクチン・承認治療薬が存在しない点、資金不足・医療施設への攻撃・東部コンゴの紛争が封じ込めを阻害している点が特に懸念される。Ituri震源地からTshopo・Haut-Uele州への拡大が確認されており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 一家4口搭乘東航從澳門入境上海 檢疫異常
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Quarantine Abnormalities Detected for a Family of Four Arriving in Shanghai from Macau on China Eastern Airlines.
article.articleSummary: On July 3, 2026, a family of four returning from Macau to Shanghai on a China Eastern Airlines flight triggered a quarantine abnormality confirmed by Shanghai Customs. All four developed fever during their Macau trip; on the flight back, the son had persistent diarrhea causing soiling of seats, and after landing in Shanghai they were hospitalized where multiple infections were diagnosed. Subsequent tests identified Coxsackie virus, Salmonella, and COVID-19. Macau hospital staff had initially suspected food poisoning, but customs confirmed the quarantine irregularity and instructed the airline to enforce sanitation measures. The airline stated it followed national entry-exit health quarantine standards and reported no further impact on subsequent flights. The incident sparked online concern about public health and traveler responsibility, with legal commentary noting potential fines (up to 50,000 yuan) under border health quarantine law for failing to declare health status or evading quarantine.

triage.headline_ja: 澳門から東方航空便で上海入境の家族4人、検疫異常を検出
triage.triage_reason: 単一家族内での複数病原体（コクサッキーウイルス、サルモネラ、COVID-19）同時検出という異常な検疫事例だが、その後の便への影響なしと報告されており、ヒト-ヒト感染拡大の証拠は乏しい。続報の有無を注視する。
triage.notes: 家族内クラスター事例であり、検疫当局が既に対応・是正措置済み。以降の便への影響なしと明記されているため、公衆衛生上の広範なリスクは限定的と判断。ただし複数病原体同時検出という異常性とオンラインでの社会的関心の高まりがあるため、続報を注視する必要がある。マカオ発の事例だがマカオは対象国リストに含まれず、記事の主題は上海（中国）での検疫対応であるためChinaのみを計上。

article.articleHeadline: 一家4口搭乘东航从澳门入境上海 检疫异常
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A family of four on China Eastern Airlines arrives in Shanghai from Macau; quarantine screening shows abnormal results.
article.articleSummary: Four-member Macau family traveling to Shanghai on a China Eastern Airlines flight fell ill during a seven-day trip; on July 3 they returned to Shanghai where all four tested positive for multiple infections after arrival, with the child diarrhea on the flight and seats reportedly soiled. Customs confirmed abnormal quarantine results on that flight, prompting disinfection and notification to the airline; no wider outbreak reported, and authorities say normal sanitization of the aircraft was conducted and no impact on subsequent flights. Laboratory findings identified Coxsackievirus, Salmonella, and SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19). Public online discussion followed about violating entry health declarations and boarding while sick. The case illustrates potential importation risk; legal consequences per Frontier Health Quarantine Law Article 44 include warnings or fines up to 10,000 yuan for failing to declare health status or comply with quarantine, with 10,000–50,000 yuan penalties for serious cases.

triage.headline_ja: 中国東方航空機でマカオから上海に入国した4人家族、検疫で異常反応
triage.triage_reason: 単一家族4名の事例で、検疫により検出・消毒対応済み、当局は他便への影響なしと発表しており、広範な流行の兆候は報告されていない。
triage.notes: オンラインでの議論（検疫申告違反）はあるが、公衆衛生上の脅威としては単発の家族内感染で終息しており、フルリスク評価の必要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حصيلة فيات الإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 600 حالة - بوابة الشروق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to 600.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 600 deaths with 1,795 confirmed cases as of 2026-07-09. The government reported two new suspected cases in Kisangani, Tshopo Province; one case is linked to the Nyanya Health Zone in Ituri Province (where initial cases were recorded), while the other has no clear geographic link and is under investigation. The outbreak, declared on May 15, is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a strain with no licensed vaccine or treatment. Containment is hindered by funding gaps, attacks on health centers, and ongoing conflict in eastern DRC. Uganda reports 20 cases, with one patient still under treatment. Africa CDC notes health authorities often receive information more than 72 hours after symptom onset in over half of cases, and hospital bed capacity is about 95% occupied, prompting a call to increase beds by roughly 50% immediately.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱による死者数が600人に上昇
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ流行が600人の死者・1795症例に達し、ワクチン・治療薬のないBundibugyo株による国際的拡大（ウガンダへの波及）も確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも20症例が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。ワクチン・治療法のないBundibugyoエボラウイルス株であること、資金不足・医療施設への攻撃・紛争により対応が困難な状況であることが重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Após mortes em São Miguel dos Campos, Sesau diz que AL registrou 910 casos de Chikungunya no ano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After deaths in São Miguel dos Campos, Sesau says AL registered 910 cases of Chikungunya this year.
article.articleSummary: Alagoas, Brazil registered 910 probable chikungunya cases from Jan 1 to Jul 8, 2026, with three deaths in São Miguel dos Campos. Rubenita Lins dos Santos, 60, died May 30; her daughter Crisleine Lins dos Santos died July 4 after hospital admission on June 23; a newborn girl died July 8, possibly perinatal transmission. Sesau notes Rubenita’s death is officially confirmed as chikungunya; Crisleine and the newborn, though reported by the municipality, are not yet in Sesau records and are considered suspected until the next biweekly bulletin. Municipal actions include larvicides and removing water-collecting objects, plus awareness campaigns and intensified vector control. By July 8, dengue had 3,042 probable cases (2 deaths) and Zika 38 (no deaths). CHIKV is transmitted by Aedes aegypti in urban areas and Aedes albopictus in rural settings; Oswaldo Cruz Institute notes 70–80% of breeding sites are indoors, urging residents to clean homes, use repellents, and install screens.

triage.headline_ja: サンミゲル・ドス・カンポスでの死亡後、セサウ（アラゴアス州保健局）は州内で年間910件のチクングニア熱症例を記録したと発表
triage.triage_reason: アラゴアス州でチクングニア熱による死亡例（新生児含む3例）が発生し、致死性・重症度の面で懸念があり、地域保健当局が対応中であることから社会的関心も認められるため。
triage.notes: チクングニア熱による死亡例のうち1例（Rubenita氏）は公式確認済みだが、他2例（娘・新生児）は次回の隔週報告書待ちの疑い例。デング熱・ジカ熱も同時流行中で、地域全体でのAedes媒介感染症対策が課題。

article.articleHeadline: Kampf gegen Ebola-Virus: "Eindämmung ist nicht in Sicht"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fight against the Ebola virus: "Containment is not in sight."
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Beni, faces a major Ebola outbreak with 1,561 confirmed cases and 506 deaths (WHO). MSF is establishing treatment facilities; two local centers in Beni with 12 beds each opened full, and a third site is underway as demand remains high. The first Bundibugyo ebolavirus survivor in Beni has been discharged. Insecurity persists, with armed-group attacks in peripheral areas hindering outreach. Beni has a single Ministry of Health lab capable of Bundibugyo virus testing, though it lacks diesel for the generator; MSF has secured diesel. Many patients present late to centers, reducing survival chances. There is no licensed vaccine or specific antiviral for Bundibugyo virus; care is supportive, including treatment for diarrhea and vomiting to conserve energy for the immune response. The interview highlights ongoing humanitarian emergencies and daily logistical challenges in the region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスとの闘い：「封じ込めの見通しは立っていない」
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部（ベニ中心）で確認症例1,561件・死亡506件に達する大規模エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が継続しており、ワクチン・特効薬もなく、治安悪化が対応を阻害しているため、複数のIHR基準に該当する重大シグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスには承認済みワクチン・特効薬が存在せず、支持療法のみ。治安悪化による周辺地域へのアウトリーチ困難と、患者の受診遅延が致死率上昇の要因となっている。MSFが治療施設運営を継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Η ταχύτερα καταγεγραμμένη εξαπλούμενη επιδημία στο Κονγκό - Πάνω από 600 νεκροί
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The fastest-documented spreading outbreak in the Congo — More than 600 dead.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo is unfolding at unprecedented speed, officially declared on May 15. As of the latest WHO figures, 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths have been reported in DRC; neighboring Uganda reports 20 cases and 2 deaths. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved specific treatment. The DRC has experienced 17 Ebola outbreaks in five decades, reflecting substantial experience but presenting new challenges given transmission velocity. Authorities are intensifying surveillance, isolating cases, and reinforcing rapid-response mechanisms to curb spread. 2013-2016 West Africa Ebola epidemic remains the deadliest on record, with more than 11,300 deaths and about 29,000 cases, primarily in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. International health bodies are monitoring evolution closely due to rapid transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴで史上最速の感染拡大 — 死者600人超
triage.triage_reason: DRCで前例のない速度でエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)が拡大し、1,759症例・600人死亡、ウガンダにも越境しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのアウトブレイクが主題。ウガンダへの拡大が言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。シエラレオネ・アンゴラ・リベリア・ギニアは2013-2016年の過去の流行への言及であり現行イベントの発生地域ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Bebê de 18 dias morre de chikungunya em São Miguel dos Campos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An 18-day-old baby dies from chikungunya in São Miguel dos Campos.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya deaths in São Miguel dos Campos, Alagoas, Brazil include an 18-day-old infant who died on July 9, 2026, after contracting chikungunya at birth. The mother was diagnosed during pregnancy and still showed symptoms at delivery; the newborn died after 18 days due to low immunity. In less than two months, the city has recorded three chikungunya fatalities: the infant and two women (mother and daughter) Rubenita Lins dos Santos, who died May 30, and Crisleine Lins dos Santos, who died July 4. Chikungunya is transmitted by Aedes aegypti, the same mosquito that spreads Zika and dengue. The report underscores the ongoing local burden of chikungunya in São Miguel dos Campos, with multiple fatalities within a short timeframe, highlighting the need for vector control and public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: 生後18日の乳児がサンミゲル・ドス・カンポスでチクングニア熱により死亡
triage.triage_reason: 特定地域での短期間に複数のチクングニア熱死亡例が報告されているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の兆候はなく、地域の局所的アウトブレイクとして経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 同一地域（Alagoas州São Miguel dos Campos）で2ヶ月足らずのうちに3名のチクングニア熱死亡例（新生児含む）が報告されており、ベクター対策の必要性が示唆される。ただし記事は地方紙のローカル報道であり、全国的な流行状況や政府対応についての情報はない。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Brits' Plan to Stop Smallpox May Have Spread It in Australia
article.articleSummary: Smallpox (variola) likely arrived in Australia with Britain's First Fleet in 1788, not via sick sailors but through jars of variola matter—powdered material from survivors used for inoculations—two new studies now accepted by peer-reviewed journals argue. The analyses suggest the virus was carried to the penal colony with the fleet of 11 ships, via inoculation material rather than living cases. Researchers note variola matter was not routinely carried, but at least one surgeon could have brought it aboard or acquired it en route in Rio de Janeiro or Cape Town. Smithsonian Magazine reports the findings. The implication is that smallpox spread to Aboriginal peoples in Australia, though the article does not provide specific case counts or laboratory confirmation details.

triage.headline_ja: 英国の天然痘対策計画がオーストラリアで感染を広げた可能性
triage.triage_reason: 1788年の歴史的出来事に関する研究報告であり、現在進行中の公衆衛生上の脅威ではないため、シグナルとして扱う必要はない。
triage.notes: 1788年の英国第一船団によるオーストラリア入植時の天然痘伝播に関する歴史研究であり、現代の感染症危機管理とは無関係。ブラジル・南アフリカは当時の寄港地として言及されているのみで、現在の発生国ではない。対象国リストに該当する現行の感染症事例はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ketika Rasa Malu Menghalangi Perempuan Mencari Pertolongan atas Infeksi Menular Seksual
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: When Shame Prevents Women from Seeking Help for Sexually Transmitted Infections
article.articleSummary: Stigma and fear of judgment drive women to delay seeking care for sexually transmitted infections (STIs; IMS in Indonesian). Globally, the WHO reports more than one million curable STIs daily among ages 15–49; 2020 saw about 374 million new infections (trichomoniasis 156M, chlamydia 129M, gonorrhea 82M, syphilis 7.1M); genital herpes affected 846 million; 2022 HIV new cases ~1.3 million. In Indonesia, 2023 had 61,065 STI-positive cases and 2024 had 52,830, with many undetected due to asymptomatic presentation or testing gaps; gonorrhea and syphilis have been found in under-15s. In Semarang, HIV cases declined from 719 in 2023 to 680 in 2024 and 620 in 2025; by May 2026, 240 new HIV cases were reported. The largest HIV share is among MSM (~44%). Women remain at risk due to late diagnosis and limited reproductive-health access, illustrating how stigma fuels health deterioration.

triage.headline_ja: 恥じらいが女性の性感染症治療への支援要請を妨げるとき
triage.triage_reason: STIに関する啓発・社会問題を扱う一般的な意識喚起記事であり、急性の公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 既知のSTI/HIV流行に関する統計・社会的スティグマの議論であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de Ebola avança na RD Congo e deixa 600 mortos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak advances in the DRC and leaves 600 dead.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola cases are under investigation in Kisangani’s Quissangane, the capital of Tshopo Province, as of July 8, 2026, with confirmatory tests pending before updating the official tally. The Democratic Republic of the Congo’s outbreak, declared May 15, has reached 1,759 cases and 600 deaths across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. One Quissangane case is linked to the Niania health zone in Ituri; the second patient has no confirmed geographic link beyond being in Kisangani. Response teams have intensified surveillance and contact tracing in Kisangani, and authorities report possible exposures in Tshopo and Haut-Uele. The latest government report noted 51 new cases and 20 deaths in 24 hours. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus; there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for this species.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行が拡大、死者600人に
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ流行は1,759症例・600死亡に達し、新規地域（キサンガニ）への拡大や治療薬・ワクチン未承認のブンディブギョ株であることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 発生地域にMali（Koulikoro Region含む）が含まれているが、記事サマリーはDRCの流行のみを扱っており、Maliへの言及はないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak is 'fastest growing ever' as 600 die in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 10 July 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is the fastest growing on record, with 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 confirmed deaths since it was declared in mid‑May. Health authorities say the virus is moving faster than the response, with cases doubling about every 28 days. By comparison, the West Africa 2013–16 Ebola outbreak had 994 cases in the first six weeks, while this outbreak reached 1,596 cases in that period. The U.N. and World Health Organization estimate a total funding need of about US$1.4 billion for outbreak control and humanitarian operations. The brief notes ongoing transmission; no infection source or symptom details are provided.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、DRコンゴで史上最速のペースで拡大、600人死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴでのエボラ出血熱流行が過去最速のペースで拡大し、確定症例1,759例・死亡600例に達しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域として記載されているが、記事サマリーではDRコンゴでの流行のみが主題であり、アンゴラでの発生については言及がないため verified_locations から除外した。WHO・国連は約14億ドルの資金需要を推定しており、国際支援の必要性が明確。

article.articleHeadline: Pune Microchips 1,500 Stray Dogs, Aims to Eliminate Rabies by 2030
article.articleSummary: Rabies in Pune, India: Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC) aims to make the city rabies-free by 2030. As of 9 July 2026, nearly 50% of Pune's stray dogs have been anti-rabies vaccinated; remaining animals to be covered over the next two years. The expansion to 34 newly merged villages pushes the stray dog population in PMC limits above 2.5 lakh. Microchips have been implanted in about 1,500 dogs to improve identification, vaccination tracking, sterilisation records, and medical history; ear clipping is being phased out. A handheld scanner can read chips from 15–20 cm. 19 veterinary doctors are involved; the goal is 80,000–100,000 microchips in one year. Vaccination data: 65,537 vaccinated (2024-25); 61,454 (2025-26); 12,290 (Jan-Jun 2026); total 139,281 vaccines. 25 stray dogs were temporarily relocated along the Ashadhi Wari route to ensure pilgrims' movement.

triage.headline_ja: プネー市、野良犬1,500匹にマイクロチップ装着、2030年までに狂犬病撲滅を目指す
triage.triage_reason: 野良犬の予防接種・マイクロチップ管理という予防的公衆衛生プログラムの報道であり、異常な発生や急性の公衆衛生リスクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病の発生事例ではなく、行政による予防的な野良犬管理・ワクチン接種プログラムの進捗報告。

article.articleHeadline: Santana de Cataguases intensifica ações de combate à Dengue com mutirão de limpeza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santana de Cataguases Steps Up Dengue-Fighting Efforts With a Community Cleanup Drive
article.articleSummary: On July 4, 2026, Santana de Cataguases held its third 2026 community cleanup to combat Aedes aegypti, the vector for Dengue, Chikungunya, Zika, and Yellow Fever. The Epidemiology team canvassed the municipality, removing materials that could become mosquito breeding sites and identifying as well as eliminating infestation hotspots, including hard-to-reach areas. While these control efforts are vital to reduce health risks, resident participation remains essential: avoid keeping water-collecting containers inside homes or in yards. The campaign also hinges on collaboration with community health and endemias agents, enabling visits and guidance. Santana de Cataguases stays mobilized against Aedes aegypti, merging municipal actions with community awareness to keep the city protected.

triage.headline_ja: サンタナ・デ・カタグアゼス市、地域清掃活動でデング熱対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 通常の蚊媒介対策・地域清掃活動の報道であり、異常な流行や重症例の情報はなく、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルの一自治体における通常のデング熱予防・清掃キャンペーンの活動報告であり、具体的な症例数や流行状況の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Грипп и ковид: какие вирусы "гуляют" сейчас заграницей
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flu and COVID-19: which viruses are circulating abroad right now.
article.articleSummary: As of 9 July 2026, Russians planning trips abroad are warned that influenza and SARS-CoV-2 are circulating in tropical regions. Academician Gennady Onishchenko told the International Multimedia Press Center that southern-hemisphere countries, currently in winter, pose the greatest travel risk. In Indonesia and Bali, circulating influenza strains exist and vaccination against those strains will begin only in late August; COVID-19 can also be acquired there. The warning underscores precautions for summer trips in these regions. Separately, reports indicate the first Ebola case in France, in a humanitarian worker who had returned from Congo, representing an imported Ebola event. Overall, the piece highlights ongoing international circulation of flu and COVID-19, and the potential for Ebola importation linked to travel.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザとコロナ:海外で今流行しているウイルスとは
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・バリにおける季節性インフルエンザとCOVID-19の通常流行に関する渡航者向け一般注意喚起であり、異常性や深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。エボラの輸入例はフランスでの発生であり対象国外、DRCでの新規発生報告でもない。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア人向けの季節性インフルエンザ・COVID-19に関する渡航注意喚起が主題。エボラのフランス輸入例（コンゴ帰りの人道支援者）は言及されているが、DRC自体での新規発生を報じるものではなく、フランスは対象国リスト外のため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Delayed monsoon keeps monkey fever season alive; Karnataka records 214 cases
article.articleSummary: Karnataka reports 214 Kyasanur Forest disease (KFD, monkey fever) cases since January 2026, well above the 188 cases recorded in all of 2025, with six deaths (five in Shivamogga, one in Uttara Kannada). A fresh positive case appeared in Shivamogga in the last week of June, signaling ongoing transmission. The tick-borne disease, caused by Kyasanur Forest disease virus, can cause high fever, headache, muscle pain, bleeding, and neurologic complications; most cases have been concentrated in Shivamogga and Chikkamagaluru, with Uttara Kannada also affected. Four positives were reported in June. Officials cite delayed monsoon, accumulation of dry leaves harboring infected ticks, and increased forest exposure as factors. Decline is expected with sustained rainfall; DEPA oil tick repellent was distributed. ICMR is conducting vaccine trials; Health Minister UT Khader pressed for expedited development, hoping for a vaccine by next year and appointing a deputy director to follow up.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーンの遅れでサル熱シーズンが継続；カルナタカ州で214件の症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: カルナタカ州で毎年発生する既知の風土病（キャサヌール森林病）の季節性増加であり、国際的拡大リスクは低いが、死亡例増加と継続的な曝露があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: キャサヌール森林病はインド・カルナタカ州の風土病で毎年季節的に発生。今回は2025年通年(188件)を上回る214件・死亡6件が報告されているが、ワクチン開発やダニ忌避剤配布など既存の対応枠組み内で管理されている。ヒト-ヒト感染はなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola Outbreak: 600 Dead, Spreads to New Provinces
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak: as of 2026-07-09, 1,759 laboratory-confirmed cases and 600 deaths. The outbreak remains in a very active phase, with Ituri (epicenter, Bunia) still in acute growth and North Kivu continuing to see rising cases. It has spread to two additional provinces, Tshopo (Kisangani) and Haut-Uele (Wamba), as patients move toward Kisangani and the Wamba area, expanding the response. South Kivu has reported no new cases since May 26 and may soon be declared outbreak-free. Hospitalizations total 750, with a 94% bed occupancy rate. Health Minister Roger Kamba highlighted high population density, mobility, and community-engagement challenges as factors complicating control and noted peak timing remains unpredictable. Authorities call for strengthened surveillance at entry points and restrictions on high-risk movements to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: DRCエボラ流行:死者600人、新たな州へ拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで大規模流行(1,759症例、600死亡)し、新たに2州へ拡大するなど国際的拡大リスクと重大な公衆衛生影響が認められるため。
triage.notes: 南キブ州は5月26日以降新規症例なく終息宣言の可能性があるが、イトゥリ州・北キブ州は増加傾向、さらにチョポ州・オートウエレ州への拡大を確認。病床占有率94%と医療体制逼迫が顕著。

article.articleHeadline: Aumentan a 600 las muertes por brote de ébola en Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death toll from an Ebola outbreak in Congo rises to 600.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 1,759 laboratory-confirmed cases and 600 deaths. Declared in May, the outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no vaccine and no approved treatment. Two new suspected cases were detected in Tshopo province, a region with no prior transmission; one case is linked to the original Ituri focus, while the other has no geographic link and remains under investigation. Containment is hampered by limited resources, attacks on health facilities, and ongoing armed conflict in the region. The situation underscores ongoing challenges for surveillance and outbreak response in eastern Congo, with confirmation of additional cases expected as investigations continue.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱流行による死者数が600人に増加
triage.triage_reason: 1,759例確認・600人死亡という大規模流行で、ワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョ株が原因であり、新規州(Tshopo)への拡大や武力紛争下での対応困難が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョ変異株による流行で、Tshopo州への地理的関連性不明の症例拡大が確認されており、封じ込めが武力紛争と資源不足により阻害されている点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak is 'fastest growing ever' as 600 die
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, centered in Ituri with four provinces affected; South Kivu clashes complicate response. Declared May 15 as the DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak, the situation worsens as cases are estimated to double roughly every 28 days. The disease spreads via close contact and infected bodily fluids; there is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo. The WHO reports a 34% case fatality rate in the DRC; 285 patients have recovered and 304 suspected cases remain under investigation. About 700 beds are in 22 treatment centres, with 300 more beds in the pipeline; centres operate at ~90% capacity. Over 10,000 contacts are monitored (82% follow-up; 95% needed). Lab capacity rose from 30 tests/day in Kinshasa to >2,000 in decentralised labs. Trials began July 2 for MBP134 and remdesivir, alone and in combination. A US$1.4 billion funding need is urged.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行は「史上最速の拡大」、死者600人に到達
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最速拡大とされるエボラ(Bundibugyoエボラウイルス)流行が継続、死者600人・致死率34%、複数州に拡大し国際的支援(14億ドル)も要請されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 承認されたワクチン・治療薬がないBundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる流行で、症例が約28日ごとに倍増と報告されており、拡大速度・重症度ともに高い。武力衝突が対応を複雑化させている点も注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le VPM de l'Intérieur ordonne à Kinshasa, à la Tshopo et aux Uele de verrouiller la surveillance
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the Deputy Prime Minister for the Interior orders Kinshasa, Tshopo and Uele to tighten surveillance.
article.articleSummary: DRC declares its 17th Ebola outbreak; as of July 7, 2026, 1,759 laboratory-confirmed cases and 600 deaths (case-fatality 34.1%) across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, detected May 15, is driving spread from Ituri into new provinces. In response, Deputy Prime Minister for the Interior Jacquemain Shabani Lukoo Bihango on July 4 ordered governors of Kinshasa, Tshopo, Haut-Uele and Bas-Uele to tighten surveillance. Five measures: map risk zones and population movement; strengthen surveillance at ports, airports, bus stations, markets, places of worship and border posts; limit mass gatherings; establish a provincial Ebola surveillance cell; and produce a daily standardized report on suspected cases, actions, monitored zones, challenges and urgent needs. The plan targets Kinshasa and gateways via Kisangani; no deadline for lifting is set; daily accountability is required. Kisangani has two confirmed cases, one linked to Nia-Nia in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱:内務担当副首相がキンシャサ、チョポ州、ウエレ州にサーベイランス強化を命令
triage.triage_reason: DRCで第17次エボラ流行が発生し、1,759例確定・600死亡（致死率34.1%）と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、首都キンシャサを含む複数州への拡大リスクが高いため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 17次目のエボラ流行で、Bundibugyo株がイトゥリ州から北キブ・南キブ州、さらに首都キンシャサへの玄関口となるキサンガニにも拡大。政府が主要交通拠点でのサーベイランス強化を命令しており、国際的拡大・渡航制限のリスクが今後高まる可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Source.ba:Raste broj zaraženih ebolom: U Kongu epidemija van kontrole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Source.ba: The number of people infected with Ebola is rising: In the Congo, the epidemic is out of control.
article.articleSummary: As of 9 July 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to expand in eastern regions, with 1,759 confirmed cases reported by the government since the May 15 declaration, across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Two new Kisangani cases (capital of Tshopo Province) are awaiting confirmation; one linked to the Njani health zone in Ituri where the outbreak began, the other with no clear geographic connection to known clusters. If confirmed, Kisangani cases will be added to official tallies. In the last 24 hours, authorities recorded 51 new Ebola cases and 20 deaths. Health teams have intensified surveillance, contact tracing, and control measures in Kisangani. The WHO warns the outbreak remains uncontrolled, with population movement contributing to ongoing transmission.

triage.headline_ja: Source.ba：エボラ感染者数が増加中—コンゴでは流行が制御不能に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の症例が1,759例に達し、直近24時間で51例・20死亡を記録するなど拡大が続き、WHOも制御不能と警告しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: キサンガニ（Tshopo州）で感染経路不明の新規症例が確認されており、地理的拡大と人口移動によるさらなる感染拡大リスクが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Varanasi division tops UP in TB elimination drive | Varanasi News
article.articleSummary: TB elimination drive in Uttar Pradesh: Varanasi division topped the state in the 100-day TB Mukt Bharat campaign (Mar 24–Jul 5), with comprehensive coverage of high-risk villages and service delivery across rural and urban areas. Special camps at Ayushman Arogya Mandirs identified suspected tuberculosis patients who received timely treatment. Key districts: Varanasi, Chandauli, Jaunpur, Ghazipur; activities included chest X-rays, NAAT-based microbiological testing, differentiated TB care, and contact screening of family members, plus distribution of poshan potlis. The effort was driven by coordinated work of medical officers, National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme teams, health workers, and partner institutions, enabling timely patient assistance and monitoring. Agra and Saharanpur divisions also shared top state honours for the TB elimination drive. This highlights UP's multi-district progress towards TB elimination.

triage.headline_ja: バラナシ管区がTB撲滅運動でウッタル・プラデーシュ州トップに | バラナシニュース
triage.triage_reason: 結核撲滅キャンペーンの進捗を伝える行政広報的な記事であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 既存の結核対策プログラムの成果報告であり、新規発生や異常事態を示すものではないため対象国リストへの計上は不要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго число жертв Эболы достигло 600 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, the Ebola death toll reached 600.
article.articleSummary: Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches 600, with 1,759 confirmed cases nationwide. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, began in Ituri Province. Two new suspected cases were detected in Kisangani, Tshopo Province, in the northern-central region bordering Ituri. One case is linked to the Ni-Nia health zone in Ituri; the other has no obvious link to known hotspots. The virus continues spreading amid population movement and security instability, with several treatment centers nearing capacity. Healthcare workers report nonpayment since the outbreak was declared, complicating response amid equipment shortages and tensions. Bunia airport closure hampers response by hindering financial flows. WHO notes the Bundibugyo virus drives the outbreak, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment; researchers began a long-awaited clinical trial last week to seek a therapeutic option.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ死者数600人に到達
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる大規模アウトブレイクで死者600人・確定症例1,759例に達し、複数州への拡大、治療体制の逼迫、承認済みワクチン・治療薬の不在等、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するため。
triage.notes: Ituri州で始まったアウトブレイクがTshopo州Kisanganiに拡大し疑い例2件検出。ワクチン・治療薬未承認、医療従事者未払い、Bunia空港閉鎖による資金流入阻害など、対応能力に深刻な課題あり。承認治療薬を求める臨床試験が先週開始された。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع عدد الوفيات بسبب الإيبولا في الكونغو إلى 600
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola in Congo rises to 600.
article.articleSummary: As of July 9, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports two new suspected Ebola cases in Kisangani, Tshopo province, where no prior cases had been recorded. The nationwide confirmed case count rises to 1,795, with deaths at 600 in the current outbreak. One suspected case is linked to the Nyanya Health Zone in Ituri province, where the outbreak's first cases were recorded; the other has no clear geographic link to known outbreaks and is under investigation. The outbreak, declared May 15 after transmission continued for weeks without detection, is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. Containment has been hampered by funding gaps, attacks on health centers, and ongoing conflict in eastern DR Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱による死者数が600人に増加
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確定症例1,795件・死者600人に達する進行中のエボラ流行であり、新規地域（キサンガニ）への拡大やワクチン・治療法未承認の希少株（ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス）である点から、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 南スーダンやイトゥリ州はBluedotの発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC国内（トショパ州キサンガニ、イトゥリ州ニャニャ保健区）での症例拡大であり、南スーダンでの発生は言及されていないため除外。資金不足・医療施設への攻撃・紛争により封じ込めが困難な状況が続いている。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC reports progress, warns Ebola outbreak outpacing response in DRC
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to expand, with 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths reported as of July 7, 2026, a case fatality rate of ~34%. Uganda reports 20 cases (mostly imported), two deaths, 17 recoveries, and one current patient; Uganda achieved complete contact tracing and rapid containment. In DRC, Ituri Province accounts for 94% of cases across 37 health zones; six zones have had no new cases in 21 days. Bed capacity is severely strained, with 95% occupancy in affected treatment units. Laboratory capacity has improved to 2,000+ tests daily; therapeutic clinical trials have begun. The outbreak is described as the fastest-growing Ebola epidemic on record in its early weeks, with an effective reproductive number around 1.4. Cross-border surveillance, MoU with Uganda, deployment of 4,000 community health workers, and calls for a 50% bed-capacity increase and sustained funding are underway, amid security challenges in North Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、DRCにおけるエボラ流行対応の進展を報告するも、対応能力を上回る流行拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで1,759症例・600死亡と拡大が続く大規模エボラ流行であり、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Uganda, GeoNames ID 226074）は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。記事は史上最速拡大のエボラ流行と評価し、病床逼迫・北キブでの治安問題など対応能力への懸念が強い。

article.articleHeadline: حصيلة ضحايا تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية ترتفع إلى 600 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death toll from Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to 600.
article.articleSummary: 600 deaths among more than 1,700 confirmed Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo strain) cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, as of July 9, 2026. The outbreak is described by Africa CDC as the fastest-spreading on record, with rapid local transmission and spread beyond the initial epicenters. The virus is active in 37 areas across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with suspected cases in Kisangani (Tshopo) and Haut-Uele, indicating wider geographic reach. WHO reports a case fatality rate around 34%. There is currently no vaccine or approved treatment for Bundibugjo Ebola virus disease; two experimental therapies have been in trials since July 2 in the DRC. Contributing challenges include funding shortfalls, attacks on health facilities and staff, and ongoing conflict in eastern DR Congo, hindering containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行による死者数が600人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（1700症例超、致死率34%）で、Africa CDCが「史上最速の拡大」と表現し地理的拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 紛争地域における医療施設への攻撃やワクチン・治療薬の未承認状態が封じ込めを困難にしており、既にフルRRA相当の重大イベントである。

article.articleHeadline: Расте бројот на жртвите од ебола во ДР Конго- епидемијата е вон контрола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola in DR Congo is rising - the epidemic is out of control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is escalating. As of July 9, 2026, the government reports 1,759 Ebola infections across the eastern Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces. Two new Kisangani cases (Kisangani is the capital of Tshopo Province) are not yet included in the official tally: one case is linked to the Nyani health zone in Ituri, where the outbreak began, while the second has no clear geographic link to previously affected areas. Kisangani test results are still undergoing confirmatory analysis before official inclusion. Health teams have intensified surveillance, contact tracing, and other containment measures in Kisangani. In the last 24 hours, 51 new cases and 20 deaths were reported. The WHO warns the epidemic remains out of control, partly due to population movements that increase transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴでエボラ出血熱による死者数が増加 - 流行は制御不能に
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴでエボラ出血熱の症例・死者数が急増し、新たな都市（キサンガニ）への拡大が確認されており、WHOも流行の制御不能を警告しているため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域にGhana(Upper West Region等)が含まれているが、記事サマリーはDRコンゴ国内（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu、Tshopo/Kisangani）の状況のみを述べており、ガーナでの発生は言及されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Andhra man dies of Covid after four days of failed antibiotic treatment
article.articleSummary: An Andhra Pradesh man, 46, from Masapeta in Kadapa district, died of Covid-19 four days after high-dose antibiotics failed to control his severe breathlessness and cough. Admitted to a local hospital, his X-ray showed bilateral lung damage consistent with pneumonia; a CT chest scan later confirmed Covid-19 infection. Officials noted the patient was alcoholic. The death prompted containment measures, including sanitisation and tracing of primary and secondary contacts of the deceased, as authorities moved to curb potential spread. The case highlights the rapid progression of Covid-19 despite antibiotic therapy and the role of imaging in establishing a diagnosis. This case underscores ongoing public health vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州の男性、抗生物質治療失敗から4日後に新型コロナウイルス感染症で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 単一の個別死亡例であり、COVID-19は既に流行病として管理されている疾患であるため、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地元当局により接触者追跡・消毒等の封じ込め対応が行われているが、単発の死亡例でありCOVID-19自体は既知の疾患であるため、シグナルとしての重要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: A huelga, trabajadores que combaten el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: On strike, workers who are fighting Ebola
article.articleSummary: Health workers in Bunia, Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, are on strike over delayed pay and allowances since the outbreak declaration on May 15, threatening Ebola response efforts. Ituri is the hardest-hit province among three eastern regions affected. Government data report 1,708 Ebola cases and 580 deaths; the outbreak’s first month was the worst on record. Workers report operating with limited equipment and accuse authorities and response teams of unfair treatment. WHO representative Anne Ancia says the virus continues to spread, driven by population movements and insecurity, with several treatment centers near full capacity. The strike coincides with the start of clinical-trial enrollments for a Bundibugyo virus treatment. Ongoing transmission and workforce disruptions risk undermining containment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラと闘う医療従事者らがストライキ
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州で1,708症例・580死亡という大規模なエボラ流行が進行中であり、医療従事者のストライキが対応を脅かしているため、IHR基準の複数該当が認められる。
triage.notes: 医療従事者の給与未払いによるストライキが対応能力を低下させ、感染拡大リスクを高めている。WHOも人口移動・治安悪化による感染継続を指摘。

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Ebola patient placed in Equatorial Guinea hotel with deportees from the US, lawyers say
article.articleSummary: As of July 9, 2026, Equatorial Guinea is housing 17 migrants (4 women, 13 men) deported under a third-country deal with the United States in a Malabo hotel owned by President Obiang Nguema Mbasogo’s family. Deportees report a man suspected of having Ebola was brought to the hotel last week by medical personnel in hazmat suits and placed on a floor below detainees; a woman was reportedly identified as a suspected Ebola patient on Sunday. Detainees say they received no masks, disinfectants, or information, and that medical care for those with serious conditions is being denied. The hotel previously served as a COVID isolation center. Ebola context: Congo is grappling with an outbreak that has killed over 600; Uganda has confirmed cases but Equatorial Guinea has not. Rights lawyers have filed a case with Africa’s rights body alleging deportees are being forced back to home countries in violation of rights.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疑い患者が赤道ギニアのホテルに、米国からの被送還者らと共に収容されたと弁護士が証言
triage.triage_reason: 主題は赤道ギニア（対象国外）での移民収容施設内エボラ疑い患者に関する報道であり、DRCのアウトブレイクは既知の背景情報として言及されているのみで新規性がないため、フルRRAに直結する新情報は乏しい。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は赤道ギニアの移民収容施設におけるエボラ疑い患者と人権問題であり、対象国リストに赤道ギニアは含まれない。DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）のエボラ流行（600人以上死亡）は文脈説明として言及されているのみで、本記事の主題ではないため verified_locations には含めなかった。疑い患者の確定診断情報がなく、続報を要する。

article.articleHeadline: 600 dead in DRC Ebola outbreak - WHO
article.articleSummary: 600 Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) with 1,759 confirmed cases since the outbreak was declared in mid-May, per WHO figures on 2026-07-10. In the DRC, 285 recoveries and 304 suspected cases under investigation; the outbreak spans four provinces but is focused in Ituri. The virus is Bundibugyo Ebola, for which there are no approved vaccines or treatments. The outbreak’s case fatality rate in the DRC is 34%. Two deaths have occurred in neighboring Uganda, where 20 confirmed cases have been reported and 17 have recovered. Transmission occurs via close contact and infected bodily fluids. On 2026-07-02, trials began in the DRC evaluating MBP134 (monoclonal antibody) and remdesivir, alone and in combination, as potential treatments for Bundibugyo Ebola. The DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak was declared on May 15 in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行で600人死亡－WHO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大）に該当し、WPRO基準も複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境感染（2名死亡、20例確認）も報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。Bundibugyoエボラ株には承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、致死率34%と高い。DRCで17回目の流行、4州に拡大中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak is 'fastest growing ever' as 600 die
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak ever, with 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo since mid-May. Case fatality is 34%, with 285 recovered and 304 suspected under investigation. The northeastern outbreak spans four provinces, centered in Ituri, and includes South Kivu amid armed clashes with the Rwanda-backed M23 group. Health systems are stretched, with population movement hindering control. About 700 beds across 22 treatment centers exist, with 300 more beds in the pipeline; over 10,000 contacts are being followed (82% follow-up; 95% needed). Laboratory capacity rose from 30 tests/day in Kinshasa to over 2,000 in decentralized labs. Trials began July 2 in DRC for Bundibugyo, evaluating MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir, alone and in combination. No approved vaccine or treatment exists for Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行は「史上最速の拡大」、死者600人
triage.triage_reason: 史上最速の拡大とされる大規模エボラ流行（死亡600人、致死率34%）で、武力紛争地域における人口移動が制御を妨げており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoウイルスによるエボラ流行で承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在せず、M23武装勢力との衝突により対応が困難な地域（イトゥリ州、南キブ州）で拡大中。ルワンダは発生地域として記載されているが、記事本文では言及がないため対象外とした。

article.articleHeadline: Епидемията от ебола се разпространява по-бързо от която и да било предишна - Фактор
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic is spreading faster than any previous one — Factor.
article.articleSummary: As of July 9, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading faster than any previous outbreak, with 600 deaths among 1,759 confirmed cases since the epidemic began. Officially declared on May 15 in the DRC, the Bundibugyo strain is driving transmission, and there is no vaccine or specific treatment for this strain. Dr. Wesam Mankula, head of emergency at the African Union’s health agency, warned that the virus is outpacing control measures. In neighboring Uganda, 20 new infections were confirmed and two people died, indicating cross-border spillover but a comparatively stable situation. The World Health Organization cautioned on May 19 about the scale and rapid spread in eastern Congo. Congo has recorded 17 Ebola epidemics to date.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行、過去最速のスピードで拡大 — Factor紙
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の流行が過去最速で拡大し、致死率が高く、ウガンダへの越境伝播も確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境感染が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・特異的治療法がないブンディブギョ株が流行しており、WHOも規模と拡大速度について警告済み。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola deja 600 muertos; OMS alerta que el brote sigue fuera de control
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola leaves 600 dead; WHO warns that the outbreak remains out of control.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo variant, has 600 deaths and 1,759 confirmed cases as of the latest figures, with the outbreak officially declared on May 15. There is no vaccine or specific treatment for this variant. The principal transmission focus is Ituri province in northeastern DRC, with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu, in areas affected by conflict that hinder response and surveillance. Health facilities are operating at about 90% capacity, intensifying health-system strain amid insecurity and population displacement. Experimental therapies began a clinical trial on July 2, and the WHO authorized emergency use of the first diagnostic test for this variant to accelerate case identification. Uganda reports two deaths and 20 confirmed cases. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids; background notes highlight the 2018–2020 outbreak in DRC as a prior high-severity event, with ~2,300 deaths from ~3,500 cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱で600人死亡、WHOはアウトブレイクが制御不能な状態が続いていると警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱(ブンディブギョ株)によるDRCでの大規模流行で600人死亡・1,759症例確認、ワクチン・治療法未確立かつ紛争地域での対応困難、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ(Republic of Uganda)への感染拡大が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCのイトゥリ州・北キブ州・南キブ州が主要感染地域。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 에볼라 사망자 600명..."역대 가장 빠른 확산"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 600 Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo... the fastest spread in history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda have reached 1,759 cumulative cases and 600 deaths as of July 7, with 285 recoveries and a 34.1% case‑fatality rate. Africa CDC warns that the initial six weeks show the fastest spread in the outbreak’s history. Infections have moved beyond Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu to neighboring Tshopo and Haut-Uele provinces. Health workers account for 112 infections, including 35 deaths, while diagnostic capacity has expanded to about 2,000 tests per day. Uganda reports 20 total cases, 2 deaths, 17 recoveries, and 1 patient still in treatment. The outbreak began in May, with Congo and Uganda declaring cases on May 15, and the World Health Organization declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. Ongoing response efforts include case tracking and containment across cross-border regions.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴでエボラ死者600人…「史上最速の拡散」
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した大規模エボラ流行で、致死率34.1%、コンゴからウガンダへ越境拡大し、史上最速の感染拡大とされるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外した。WHOは既にPHEICを宣言済みであり、既にRRA相当の対応が進行中と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Kwango: Yaushe za a rabu da annobar Ebola?
article.articleSummary: Ebola re-emerges in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kwango), with authorities confirming renewed transmission in areas previously affected. The death toll from the latest Ebola activity reached 600, while total reported cases in the country stand at 1,759. Reports of Ebola-like symptoms have been observed in two provinces beyond Ituri, which remains the main hotspot. The Ministry of Health did not release the number of suspected cases in those two provinces. No details on laboratory confirmation or infection source are provided in the report, and no mention of imported/exported cases. The situation as of 9 July 2026 underscores ongoing transmission risk and the need for continued surveillance and public health response across multiple provinces.

triage.headline_ja: クワンゴ:エボラの流行はいつ終わるのか?
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラの再燃が確認され、死者600人・症例1,759人と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、複数州への拡大も疑われるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: Ituri以外の2州での疑い症例数や検査確定の詳細が不明であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: إغلاق جميع أسواق المواشي في بني وليد بسبب انتشار الحمى القلاعية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Closure of all livestock markets in Bani Walid due to the spread of foot-and-mouth disease.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) outbreaks in Libya trigger sweeping measures. The Central Committee for Combating FMD in Bani Walid orders the immediate closure of all livestock markets in Bani Walid until further notice, and restricts entry of livestock from districts with infections, along with banning meat from slaughtered animals to curb transmission and protect livestock resources. Violators face legal action, and authorities urge farmers and the public to report suspicious signs promptly. The response follows reports of suspected FMD among sheep in Kandoula and Marawa, Al-Bayda, with test results pending. Earlier, on July 1, 2026, livestock markets were closed in Khums and Qasr al-Akhiyar as precaution. No laboratory-confirmed case counts are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: 口蹄疫の拡大によりバニ・ワリドの全ての家畜市場を閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: リビアにおける家畜(羊)の口蹄疫（動物疾患）に関する記事であり、対象国（Philippines等）は発生地域リストに含まれるが記事の主題ではない。ヒトへの公衆衛生上の影響は報告されておらず、対象国での実際の発生も確認できない。
triage.notes: 口蹄疫は動物疾病であり、ヒトへの感染症としての公衆衛生上の影響は通常想定されない。発生地域にPhilippinesが含まれているが、記事本文はリビア国内（バニ・ワリド、カンドゥーラ、マラワ、アル・バイダ、フムス等）での発生に限定されており、対象国リストにおける実際の発生は確認できないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : le premier cas français déclaré guéri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: France's First Case Declared Cured.
article.articleSummary: France’s first Ebola case, a humanitarian doctor returning from eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, has been declared cured after two negative PCR tests; discharged July 4 in Paris with no deaths in France. The infection originated in the Bundibugyo variant circulating in northeastern DRC, in Ituri’s Bunia area, and is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the country; as of July 7 the WHO, cited by the UN, reports 1,561 confirmed cases, 506 deaths and 254 recoveries, with over 10,000 contacts being followed. Five close passengers from the same flight were isolated for the 21‑day incubation period, and Paris considers importation risk very low; Mayotte remains under enhanced surveillance due to geography. In Bunia, treatment centers are saturated; ambulances are scarce. A clinical trial began July 2 to test MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir, with more than 1,200 doses available.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：フランス初の症例が治癒と発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の第17次エボラ流行（1,561症例、506死亡）に加え、フランスへの輸入症例が発生し国際的拡大が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。輸入症例は治癒済みで国内二次感染なしとされるが、DRCでの流行拡大（治療センター飽和、救急車不足）が継続しておりモニタリング継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en Congo sigue "muy activo"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains 'very active'.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains very active as of July 9, 2026, and it is too early to determine when infections will peak, Health Minister Roger Kamba said during a visit to Bunia, the capital of Ituri province and the outbreak’s epicenter. After nearly two months of response operations, officials warn that transmission remains in an active phase. High population density, frequent movement of people, and local factors that hamper community engagement are cited as key challenges for containment. The remarks were delivered from Kinshasa as the government and health agencies continue surveillance, case management, and field operations in Ituri to curb spread and identify new cases and exposures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の流行は依然として『非常に活発』
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で継続中であり、保健相が『非常に活発』と表明、感染拡大のリスクと封じ込めの困難が指摘されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事は保健相の発言に基づくもので、感染ピークの予測時期は不明。人口密度の高さや人の移動、地域社会の協力困難が封じ込めの課題として挙げられている。国際的な支援要請の有無は記事に明記されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 600 dead in DR Congo Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths, according to World Health Organization figures published July 9, 2026. The outbreak was declared in mid-May. The death toll rose to 600 within three days after surpassing 500. The report emphasizes that these are confirmed cases and deaths reported by WHO; no details on transmission routes, symptoms, or laboratory confirmation are provided in the article. The figures reflect ongoing outbreak activity in DRC, with the update released by the UN health agency through WHO. No mention of imported or exported cases appears in the summary, highlighting the domestic scale of the current surge as of the publication date.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行で死者600人
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で死者600人・確定症例1,759人に達しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 致死率が高く（600/1759 ≈ 34%）、感染経路や検査確認の詳細は不明。WHOによる継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Aos 77, atriz de Senhora do Destino morreu durante gravações por infecção rara
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: At 77, the Senhora do Destino actress died during filming due to a rare infection.
article.articleSummary: Miriam Pires, a veteran Brazilian actress known for Senhora do Destino, died on July 7, 2004, at age 77 from cerebral toxoplasmosis during filming in Brazil. The rare, severe brain infection forced the production to rewrite the storyline to explain the character Clementina’s absence; she remained in memory, while her on-screen daughter Aurélia, played by Cristina Müllins, pursued her mother’s cookbook dream. Director Aguinaldo Silva paid homage at the book launch with a career montage. The article notes other Brazilian TV losses that prompted plot revisions, such as Domingos Montagner and Daniella Perez. Cerebral toxoplasmosis is described as a rare, grave form of infection.

triage.headline_ja: 77歳、『運命の女』出演女優が撮影中に稀な感染症で死去
triage.triage_reason: 2004年に発生した個人の稀な脳トキソプラズマ症による死亡を報じる過去の芸能ニュースであり、公衆衛生上の異常事象やアウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 2004年の個別死亡事例に関する芸能・追悼記事であり、公衆衛生上の新規イベントではないため対象国リストへの計上も行わない。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola Outbreak Becomes Fastest-Growing Ever
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, declared mid-May, is the fastest-growing on record, with the World Health Organization confirming 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths. The Bundibugyo strain, for which there is currently no approved vaccine or treatment, is driving transmission across Ituri Province and into four provinces. The fatality rate is about 34%, with 285 recoveries and more than 300 suspected cases under investigation. Cases are doubling roughly every 28 days. Health authorities seek $1.4 billion to bolster disease control and humanitarian operations amid insecurity, displacement and a weak health system. More than 10,000 contacts are being monitored; trials for two potential treatments are underway to curb further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、史上最速の拡大に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱(ブンディブギョ株)が複数州に拡大し致死率約34%、承認されたワクチン・治療法がなく、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチン・治療薬がないブンディブギョ株による流行で、致死率・拡大速度ともに高く、国際支援要請（14億ドル）が明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: ES investiga seis mortes por suspeita de dengue hemorrágica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Espírito Santo investigates six deaths on suspicion of dengue hemorrhagic fever.
article.articleSummary: Espírito Santo, Brazil, is investigating six deaths with suspected dengue hemorrhagic fever, the severe form of dengue spread by Aedes aegypti. The State Health Secretariat (Sesa) says confirmation may take 60–90 days, relying on laboratory tests, medical-record reviews, family interviews, and clinical-history assessments. One case under investigation is dentist Lorena Nascimento Cardoso, 29, of Jacaraípe, Serra, who died on June 30 from complications of severe dengue. Four dengue-related deaths have been confirmed in 2026—Vitória, Baixo Guandu, Jerônimo Monteiro, and Nova Venécia—with other cases still under investigation. The state has recorded over 12,000 probable dengue cases since the start of 2026. Prevention emphasizes eliminating standing water where Aedes aegypti breeds, keeping water tanks closed, cleaning gutters, storing bottles upside down, and using repellent, especially during the day. Seek care for high fever, body pains, eye pain, rash, or severe abdominal pain/bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: エスピリトサント州、デング出血熱疑いの死亡6件を調査
triage.triage_reason: デング出血熱による死亡例が複数発生し、州内で12,000件超の疑い例が報告されており、重症度・持続的曝露・流行しやすさの観点でWPRO基準に複数該当し社会的関心も高いため。
triage.notes: デングはブラジルで季節的に流行する疾患であり、今回のケースは重症型（出血熱）による死亡例の集積が注目点。確定診断には60〜90日を要するため、続報での確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola RDC : le scénario catastrophe des 10 000 cas et 2 000 décès
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the catastrophic scenario of 10,000 cases and 2,000 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) faces a high-end scenario of over 10,000 cumulative cases and 2,000 deaths by Q4 2026 if isolation and treatment fail to reach 50%. This scenario derives from a CDC MMWR transmission model (June 5) cited by the UNDP, which shows isolation rate as the key determinant. As of July 7, 2026, the World Health Organization reports 1,561 confirmed cases and 506 deaths, 254 recoveries, with more than 10,000 contacts under follow-up. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or therapy; containment relies on contact tracing and isolating patients. The epicenter is Ituri, accounting for over 90% of confirmed cases, in a region with more than 260 armed groups and 5.8 million internally displaced people; transmission has crossed into Uganda, reaching Kampala. The high-end scenario reflects late detection and saturated treatment centers, while a 70% isolation scenario yields 94% of simulations under 10,000 cases and 90% under 2,000 deaths, though uncertainty remains.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ・DRC：1万症例・2000人死亡という最悪シナリオ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認症例1,561人・死亡506人と深刻な流行が継続し、ウガンダ（カンパラ）への越境拡大も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（カンパラ）への感染拡大が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。ワクチン・治療法未承認のBundibugyo株であり、武装勢力活動地域・国内避難民多数のIturiが震源地であることから管理困難性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Two die of Covid-19, four test positive for virus in Andhra Pradesh's Kadapa district
article.articleSummary: Kadapa district, Andhra Pradesh reports four Covid-19 positives and two deaths as of July 9, 2026. Four individuals tested positive via RT-PCR at the Kadapa virology laboratory; three are in home isolation, while one with mild symptoms is admitted to a Covid-19 ward in Kadapa. All four had two vaccine doses, with one having a booster. The two fatalities occurred earlier: a 60-year-old with diabetes and kidney disease died after transfer from SVIMS Tirupati to CMC Vellore and subsequently tested positive; a 43-year-old patient undergoing treatment also died after testing positive. Viral samples from the deceased have been sent to NIV Pune for genome sequencing to identify the variant, with Omicron suspected. The Andhra Pradesh health department has stepped up surveillance in Kadapa; AP last reported a Covid-19 death in 2022.

triage.headline_ja: アンドラプラデーシュ州カダパ県でCOVID-19により2名死亡、4名陽性
triage.triage_reason: 小規模なCOVID-19クラスター（陽性4例、死亡2例、いずれも基礎疾患あり）で、2022年以来の死亡例という点でやや異常だが、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の兆候はなく、社会的関心の高まりも記事からは確認できないため、続報を注視する。
