triage.notes: 疾患タグにNipahが含まれるが、記事本文・サマリーはCOVID-19の内容のみで、Nipahに関する記述は確認できない。死者は糖尿病・腎疾患などの基礎疾患を有しており、変異株（オミクロン疑い）の遺伝子解析が進行中。地域は限定的（カダパ県）で、州として2022年以来初の死亡例という点が注目点。

article.articleHeadline: World must move faster on Ebola response for DR Congo: UN relief chief
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri province, caused by Bundibugyo, with 1,700 cases and 600 deaths; Uganda reports 20 cases. Since declaring on 15 May, the outbreak has spread beyond Ituri to other provinces due to conflict and displacement. The crisis is intensified by war, hunger, displacement, weak services, and limited healthcare, making it one of the most complex humanitarian crises. The UN released up to $60 million in May to accelerate response and support neighboring countries. WHO, with MONUSCO, has supplied medical equipment and built isolation and treatment units. The Inter-Agency Standing Committee activated a System-Wide Scale-Up; Senior Ebola Coordinator Julien Harneis is deployed. Travel restrictions hamper operations; all parties must ensure safe access for responders. Defense relies on surveillance, testing, referral systems, infection prevention and control, and community engagement, with locally led approaches addressing both men and women. Delays cost lives.

triage.headline_ja: 世界はコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対応をより迅速に進めるべき：国連人道問題担当上級代表
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事態、国際的拡大、渡航制限）し、コンゴ民主共和国での大規模エボラアウトブレイク（1700症例・600死亡）がウガンダにも拡大、国連が大規模支援を展開している重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも20症例確認との記載があるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。紛争・避難民により感染がイトゥリ州から他州へ拡大しており、国連が6000万ドルの緊急支援を実施、System-Wide Scale-Upが発動されるなど極めて深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: UN Urges Swifter Ebola Response in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) centers in Ituri province, declared 15 May, with Bundibugyo strain causing more than 1,700 infections and 600 deaths in the DRC; neighboring Uganda has confirmed 20 cases. Conflict and displacement hinder response, amid hunger and weak health services, making this one of the most complex humanitarian crises. The UN released up to $60 million in May to accelerate response, support neighboring countries and build community trust; WHO, with MONUSCO, supplied medical equipment and built isolation/treatment units. The UN Inter-Agency Standing Committee activated a System-Wide Scale-Up, and Senior Ebola Coordinator Julien Harneis is deployed to aid containment. Travel closures disrupt operations; access for humanitarian workers and supplies must be ensured. The best defenses remain surveillance, laboratory testing, referral, infection prevention, and community engagement, with locally led, gender-inclusive approaches.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ対応の迅速化を要請
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でのエボラ流行（1,700人以上感染、600人以上死亡）がウガンダにも越境拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高いため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも20例確認され越境拡大しているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。紛争・人口移動・脆弱な保健システムが対応を妨げており、国連は6000万ドルの資金拠出とSystem-Wide Scale-Upを実施済み。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de ebola na República Democrática do Congo se propaga em velocidade inédita, diz agência de saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading at an unprecedented speed, says health agency.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading at unprecedented speed. As of July 7, 2026, there have been 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths in the DRC since the current outbreak began. Uganda remains threatened but currently stable. The eastern DRC epicenter continues to see case numbers rise, with authorities estimating transmission could double roughly every 28 days. Wessam Mankoula, Africa CDC emergency operations chief, warned the outbreak is advancing faster than the response can mobilize, marking the fastest spread observed across Ebola virus species, not just Bundibugyo. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids of living or deceased individuals, and Ebola causes hemorrhagic fever. There is no vaccine or specific treatment for the Bundibugyo variant. A two-treatment clinical trial began on July 2, 2026, according to the WHO. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の流行、前例のない速さで拡大―保健当局が警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が急速拡大しており（1,759症例、600死亡）、有効なワクチン・治療法がなく国際的拡大リスクも高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは「脅威にさらされているが安定」との記載のみで、実際の症例発生は確認されていないため verified_locations には含めない。ワクチン・治療法未確立のBundibugyo型で、17回目のDRCでの流行という点も重大。

article.articleHeadline: Breaking News Live, July 10: Congo's Ebola outbreak kills 600 as total cases reach 1,759
article.articleSummary: On July 9, 2026, Congo's Ebola outbreak has reached 1,759 total confirmed cases and 600 deaths. New suspected cases have been reported in Tshopo and Haut-Uele provinces, signaling spread beyond Ituri’s epicenter. In Kisangani (Tshopo), two new suspected cases were recorded; one is linked to the Nia-Nia health zone in Ituri, where the outbreak began, while the other case has no apparent geographical connection to known outbreaks. Authorities are investigating both cases. The Congolese health ministry notes the outbreak was officially declared on May 15 after transmission continued for weeks without detection, according to the World Health Organization, with ongoing transmission across multiple provinces.

triage.headline_ja: 速報:7月10日、コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで死者600人、総感染者数1,759人に達する
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の感染者1,759人・死者600人に達し、震源地イトゥリ州を超えてツショポ州・オートウエレ州に拡大している。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、深刻度と国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 5月15日に公式にアウトブレイク宣言後、震源地イトゥリ州から複数州へ拡大中。致死率約34%と高く、WHOも関与。続報でさらなる拡大状況・国際対応の詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak is 'fastest-growing ever' as 600 die
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is the fastest-growing on record, with 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths since mid-May. Case fatality is 34%; 285 recovered and 304 suspected cases under investigation. Declared May 15 in Ituri province, the outbreak spans four provinces but concentrates in Ituri, believed to have been spreading for some time before detection. Bundibugyo, a rare Ebola species with no approved vaccine or treatment, spreads through close contact and infected bodily fluids. Health resources are strained: about 700 beds across 22 treatment centres, with 300 more in the pipeline, operating at ~90% capacity. More than 10,000 contacts are being monitored; follow-up is 82% versus the 95% target. Laboratory capacity has expanded from 30 tests per day in Kinshasa to over 2,000 in decentralised labs. Trials begun July 2 evaluate MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir, alone and in combination. Conflicts in South Kivu raise displacement fears.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行は『史上最速の拡大』、600人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のブンディブギョ種エボラ出血熱が史上最速のペースで拡大し、致死率34%・600人死亡・複数州に拡大しており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチン・治療薬のないブンディブギョ種エボラの流行で、南キブ州の紛争による住民移動が更なる拡大リスクを高めている。接触者追跡は目標(95%)に対し82%と未達成であり、医療体制も約90%稼働率と逼迫している。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا: التفشي في الكونغو الديمقراطية هو "الأسرع على الإطلاق"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the fastest ever.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the fastest on record, with 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths since it began on May 15, yielding about a 34% case-fatality rate per WHO. The epicenter remains Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu in the northeast, with two new suspected cases in Kisangani: one linked to Nyanya health zone and one with no clear geographic link. Recently 20 cases were reported, 1 patient still under treatment. Health facilities are near capacity (roughly 95% occupancy); authorities urge a ~50% increase in beds. Uganda reports cross-border transmission and two deaths, with stricter border controls. The outbreak is the 17th in DRC in half a century and is hampered by funding gaps, attacks on health centers, and ongoing eastern conflict. Separately, migrants detained in Equatorial Guinea report a suspected Ebola case at a Bioko Island hotel; no confirmed cases there yet.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国での流行は「史上最速」
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最速とされるエボラ流行が拡大中（1,759症例、致死率34%）、既にウガンダへの越境感染も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境感染や赤道ギニアでの疑い症例も報告されているが、両国とも対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。医療体制の逼迫（病床稼働率95%）や資金不足、紛争による医療施設への攻撃など、対応の困難さが顕著。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : 2 nouvelles provinces touchées
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Two more provinces affected.
article.articleSummary: Two more provinces in the Democratic Republic of Congo are now considered affected by Ebola virus disease: Tshopo and Haut-Uele, with South Kivu slated to exit the affected list after a prolonged period with no confirmed cases. The announcement, on July 9, 2026, by Public Health Minister Dr. Roger Kamba in Bunia, Ituri province, followed an evaluation meeting with response partners at the provincial governorate. The outbreak remains active 54 days after its official declaration, underscoring the need to strengthen surveillance in the newly affected areas. Authorities also announced measures to improve human-resource management in the response, including a digital card for health workers to enable direct payment of bonuses and reduce intermediaries’ frustrations. Scientists continue vaccine development for the Bundibugyo strain; INRB’s Prof. Dr. Ahuka said progress is being made toward an appropriate vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：新たに2州が感染確認
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが新たに2州（チョポ州、オートウエレ州）に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数項目に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生から54日が経過し、南キブ州は終息傾向にある一方、チョポ州・オートウエレ州が新たに感染確認地域として追加された。ワクチン開発（Bundibugyo株対応）が進行中であり、国際的な技術支援が継続的に必要とされている。

article.articleHeadline: L'épidémie d'Ebola en RDC se propage plus rapidement que toutes les précédentes, selon l'agence de santé de l'UA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC is spreading faster than all previous outbreaks, according to the AU's health agency.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is spreading faster than all prior outbreaks, according to Africa CDC. The current event is the 17th Ebola epidemic in the DRC and involves the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is neither a vaccine nor a specific treatment. Treatment centers are operating at about 90% capacity, increasing strain on response efforts. The epicenter is Ituri province in the North-East near borders with South Sudan and Uganda; the virus has spread to North and South Kivu provinces, with large areas controlled by the M23 armed group. Responders warn that conflicts, hunger, displacement, and weak health services hinder control. Donors are urged to provide funding, with needs estimated at about $1.4 billion. A clinical trial of two treatments began on July 2, and the WHO granted emergency use authorization for the outbreak's first molecular diagnostic test.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCによれば、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は過去のどの流行よりも速く拡大している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、ワクチンのないBundibugyo株が紛争地域で急速に拡大、資金・支援ニーズも高いためフルRRAへ進めるべき事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダン国境付近への拡大懸念が言及されているが、実際の感染確認は記事内でDRC国内（Ituri、北・南キブ州）に限定されている。ウガンダ・スーダンは対象国リスト外または国境地域の言及のみのためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemija ebole v DR Kongo najhitreje rastoča doslej
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Epidemic in DR Congo Fastest-Growing to Date
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak is the fastest-growing to date. The World Health Organization reports 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths since the outbreak began in mid-May. Africa CDC official Wessam Mankoula says this is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak ever across all Ebola virus species, with cases doubling roughly every 28 days, outpacing the 2013–2016 West Africa outbreak (994 cases in the first six weeks). Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with no licensed vaccine or treatment, is driving the current spread, believed to have circulated long before detection. The 17th outbreak in DR Congo was declared May 15 after multiple deaths in Ituri province, a mineral-rich area controlled by armed groups. WHO's Anne Ancia notes ongoing security risks, population movement, and a fragile health system hindering response. A $1.4 billion funding requirement is cited for the health and humanitarian effort.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、過去最速の拡大ペース
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常な拡大速度、国際的拡大リスク）が確認され、ワクチン・治療法のない稀な株による過去最速の流行拡大という重大シグナル。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルス株はワクチン・治療法未承認で、致死率・拡大速度が高い。武装勢力が支配する鉱物資源地帯（イツリ州）での発生であり、治安リスクと人口移動が対応を困難にしている。1,759症例・600死亡、$14億の資金需要が報告されている。Angolaは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文中に言及がないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de ebola na República Democrática do Congo se propaga em velocidade inédita, diz agência de saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading at an unprecedented speed, says the health agency.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak declared in the Democratic Republic of the Congo on May 15 is spreading at an unprecedented speed, according to Africa CDC on July 9, 2026. By July 7, the World Health Organization reported 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths across the DRC. The virus is advancing faster than the response and resources mobilized to control it. Uganda, a neighboring country, remains at risk but is reported as stable. The remarks underscore the ongoing domestic transmission in the DRC and the challenges faced by public health authorities in scaling up interventions to curb the outbreak. The report provides no further details on imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、前例のない速さで拡大と保健機関が発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱が多数の死者を伴い前例のない速度で拡大しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダは近隣国としてリスクありと言及されているが、現時点で感染発生は報告されていないため verified_locations には含めていない。ウガンダは対象国リストにも含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : plus 180 décès suspects d'Ebola signalés à Lopa en un mois, les communautés en alerte se mobilisent
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: More than 180 suspected Ebola deaths reported in Lopa in one month, as alert communities mobilize.
article.articleSummary: Over June–July 2026, civil society in Lopa, Djugu territory, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, reports more than 180 deaths from an Ebola-like illness in Lopa and surrounding areas, indicating a worsening outbreak. Response efforts are hampered by unpaid response-team stipends, insufficient logistics, and delays in organizing dignified, safe burials. No reaction from the Ituri provincial health division or INSP was available at publication. In response, the LORI cultural association—representing the Lendu people—launched a sensitization campaign in Bakombe to educate residents on transmission, promote infection prevention, and strengthen collaboration with health teams. The latest official figures for the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC show 1,561 confirmed cases, 506 deaths, and 253 recoveries, with Ituri remaining the epicenter as of July 9, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州:ロパで1か月に180人超のエボラ疑い死亡、地域社会が警戒態勢を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRC第17次エボラ流行の継続悪化を示す情報で、地域での死者急増・対応リソース不足が確認され、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 既知の第17次DRCエボラ流行の悪化事例。地元当局(州保健局・INSP)からの公式反応なし、対応資金・物流不足が報告されており、既存アウトブレイクの深刻化として要フォロー。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak Spreads to New Areas as Deaths Soar Past 600
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Congo expands as of 9 July 2026: total confirmed cases reach 1,759 with 600 deaths (up about 100 in three days). Most cases are in eastern Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu; two confirmed cases in Tshopo—one linked to Nia-Nia in Ituri, the other with no apparent geographic connection. Suspected cases under investigation in Haut-Uele; confirmed vs suspected depend on lab testing, negatives removed from counts. Uganda reports 20 cases and 2 deaths. Detected mid-May, the outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus (orthoebolavirus). About 750 patients are in care, 250 recovered. International and national groups have surged to contain spread. WHO Africa rep Anne Ancia says the outbreak continues to expand; Africa CDC epidemiologist Wessam Mankoula calls it the fastest growing Ebola outbreak on the continent, with cases expected to double in 28 days.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の発生、死者600人を超え新たな地域に拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認症例1,759人・死者600人に達し、ウガンダにも拡大するなど国際的拡大リスクが高く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAに進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダも症例報告があるが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHO・Africa CDCが急速な拡大を指摘しており、症例は28日で倍増する見込みとされる。

article.articleHeadline: São Bernardo tem dois casos de suspeita de sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Bernardo has two suspected cases of measles.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected measles cases in São Bernardo trigger immediate containment measures. On 9 July 2026, epidemiological teams will visit residences near the patients to assess vaccination status and vaccinate if needed, aiming to block virus transmission. Measles vaccination is available at the city’s 35 Basic Health Units (UBS) from Monday to Friday, excluding holidays. For 1–29-year-olds, two doses are required; those 30 and older need at least one dose. The suspected cases are thought to have contracted the disease in another municipality. Authorities say relatives and contacts have already been immunized. Health Secretary Jean Gorinchteyn calls this a preventive, time-sensitive action to curb spread. Residents are urged to show vaccination cards, receive vaccines if indicated, and, on Monday, visit their UBS to confirm vaccination status.

triage.headline_ja: サンベルナルドで麻疹疑い2例が発生
triage.triage_reason: 疑い例2件で確定診断はまだなく、当局が封じ込め措置を開始した段階のため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 疑い例段階であり確定患者数・感染経路の詳細は不明。地元自治体単独で対応可能な規模と見られる。

article.articleHeadline: Campo Grande segue em alerta para SRAG - Ponta Porã Informa - Notícias de Ponta Porã - MS e Pedro Juan Caballero - PY
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campo Grande remains on alert for SARS - Ponta Porã Informs - News from Ponta Porã - MS and Pedro Juan Caballero - PY.
article.articleSummary: As of July 9, 2026, Campo Grande, the capital of Mato Grosso do Sul, remains on alert for Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) despite a deceleration after about five months of rising cases. Fiocruz’s InfoGripe bulletin notes that Mato Grosso do Sul shows signs of stabilization or decline, yet circulation of respiratory viruses keeps the epidemiological situation at attention, especially in Campo Grande, where SRAG risk remains elevated with no recent growth trend. Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) continues to be the main driver of hospitalizations, particularly among young children; nationally it accounts for more than half of SRAG positives in the last four epidemiological weeks. Influenza A remains the leading cause of deaths. Tatiana Portella from InfoGripe emphasizes that incidence remains high despite slowing and urges flu vaccination for seniors, children, and at-risk groups, plus prompt care for persistent respiratory symptoms. Campo Grande stays under Fiocruz monitoring during peak virus circulation.

triage.headline_ja: カンポ・グランデ、SRAG（重症急性呼吸器症候群）について引き続き警戒
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのカンポ・グランデにおける季節性のRSV・インフルエンザAによるSRAG（重症急性呼吸器症候群）の通常のサーベイランス報告であり、既に減速傾向にある既知の季節性流行パターンであるため、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性呼吸器感染症（RSV・インフルエンザA）による地域レベルのサーベイランス情報。5か月間の増加後に減速傾向にあり、Fiocruzによる通常のモニタリング対象。国際的な懸念や渡航制限等には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果埃博拉疫情已酿600死 有史以来扩散最快
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo Ebola outbreak has killed 600 people, the fastest-spreading outbreak in history.
article.articleSummary: 600 Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) amid the fastest-spreading outbreak on record. Since mid-May, the DRC has confirmed 1,759 cases and 285 recoveries, with a case fatality rate of 34% and 304 suspected cases under investigation. The Bundibugyo strain is responsible, differing from the historical Zaire lineage, raising concerns that existing vaccines and therapeutics may be ineffective. The outbreak has spread to neighboring Uganda, which has 20 confirmed cases, 17 recoveries, and 2 deaths. Transmission occurs primarily through contact with infected body fluids; the virus is not typically airborne. The WHO and Africa CDC state the outbreak remains in expansion, with stabilization not yet in sight. Incubation is 2–21 days; historical fatality averages around 50%, though rates vary by strain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、死者600人に達し史上最速の拡大ペースに
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数(深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大)に該当し、DRCからウガンダへの越境拡大とワクチン無効化の懸念があるため、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ(Uganda, GeoNames ID 226074)は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。Bundibugyo株による既存ワクチン・治療薬への有効性懸念は重要な注視点。

article.articleHeadline: Συναγερμός για τον Έμπολα στη Λαϊκή Δημοκρατία του Κονγκό - Πάνω από 1.700 κρούσματα και 600 νεκροί
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - More than 1,700 cases and 600 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of 9 July 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths, driven by the Bundibugyo strain. The outbreak, officially declared on 15 May, is spreading faster than containment efforts can keep pace, according to Africa CDC emergency head Dr. Wesam Mankula. Cross-border concerns are growing: Uganda reports 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths, though the situation remains comparatively more stable there. There is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo. The DRC has endured 17 Ebola outbreaks over five decades. The deadliest episode occurred in West Africa (2013–2016), with over 29,000 cases and more than 11,300 deaths in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. Authorities stress coordinated response, rapid frontline funding, and health-system strengthening to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ警報 - 症例1,700件以上、死者600人超
triage.triage_reason: DRCでBundibugyo株によるエボラ流行が拡大中で、死者600人・症例1,759件、ワクチン・治療法なく、国境を越えてウガンダにも拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境拡大が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めない。シエラレオネ・アンゴラ・リベリア・ギニアは過去の流行の歴史的言及であり、現行の発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : la guerre s'étend de nouveau dans le Sud-Kivu, sur fond de flambée d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: War spreads again in South Kivu, amid an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Fighting intensifies in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo as South Kivu confronts renewed violence amid an Ebola outbreak. Clashes in Fizi and Mwenga peaked July 4–5 around Mulima, with drones, heavy artillery and other explosives in populated areas, resulting in civilian casualties and destruction of homes and cattle. UN Human Rights Chief Volker Türk condemns the escalation and urges the Congolese army and the M23 to halt hostilities, with Rwanda urged to end its support for the rebels and for disarmament of the FDLR; all parties must ensure safe humanitarian access. The conflict threatens to derail Ebola response, already spreading in North Kivu and Ituri, prompting a 60 million USD UN relief mobilization to accelerate the response and prep neighbors (Uganda, Burundi, South Sudan). MONUSCO notes ongoing fighting with M23, backed by Rwanda, and allied forces including Wazalendo and FDLR. Ensure open aid corridors and logistics.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラ流行の最中、南キブ州で再び戦争が拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ流行に加え、南キブ州での武力衝突がアウトブレイク対応を阻害しており、国際的拡大リスクと外部支援の必要性が高いため。
triage.notes: 記事は主にDRC（南キブ、北キブ、イトゥリ）でのエボラ流行と武力紛争の同時進行を扱っており、ウガンダ・ブルンジ・ルワンダ・南スーダンは近隣国としての備え文脈で言及されているのみで、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Neurocisticercosis: El impactante caso de la mujer con 38 parásitos en el cerebro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Neurocysticercosis: The shocking case of the woman with 38 parasites in her brain.
article.articleSummary: From Wales, 42-year-old Lowri Denman developed neurocysticercosis, a central nervous system infection caused by Taenia solium larvae, after a 2007 trip to India. In 2010 she expelled a transparent, approximately one-meter tapeworm from her bathroom, prompting medical tests. MRI confirmed cysticercosis with 38 tapeworm larvae embedded in brain tissue, producing severe headaches, seizures, and psychotic episodes. Infectious diseases consultant Dr. Brendan Healy believes she ingested pork containing tapeworm eggs during the India visit, allowing silent spread for years. The case highlights the neurological risks of neurocysticercosis when not diagnosed early and underscores the role of imaging and travel history in identifying travel-associated parasitic infections.

triage.headline_ja: 神経嚢虫症:脳内に38個の寄生虫を持つ女性の衝撃的な症例
triage.triage_reason: 2007年のインド渡航歴に関連する単一の過去症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 英国ウェールズ在住の女性が2007年のインド渡航後に発症した個別の過去症例（2010年診断）に関する医学的興味記事であり、現在進行中の公衆衛生イベントではない。インドは渡航歴として言及されているのみで、現地での発生・流行を示すものではないためverified_locationsからも除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果埃博拉疫情已釀600死 有史以來擴散最快
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Congo has killed 600 people, the fastest spread in history.
article.articleSummary: As of July 9, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths, with 285 recoveries and 304 suspected cases under investigation; the case fatality rate is 34%. The Africa CDC calls this outbreak the fastest-spreading on record, with mid-May declared as the start and deaths surpassing 500 within three days. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, unlike the Zaire strain, suggesting vaccines and antivirals developed for Zaire may be ineffective. It has reached neighboring Uganda, with 20 confirmed cases, 17 recoveries, and 2 deaths. Transmission occurs mainly through contact with infected bodily fluids, contaminated materials, or during funeral rites; incubation is 2–21 days, and Ebola’s fatality rate has historically ranged 25%–90%.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、死者600人に到達。史上最速の感染拡大
triage.triage_reason: 致死率34%・死者600人規模のエボラ流行が史上最速で拡大し、隣国ウガンダへも越境しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。ブンディブギョ株であり既存のザイール株用ワクチン・治療薬が効果不十分の可能性がある点は重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Over 1,700 cases and 600 deaths reported in DRC
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) reports 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths as of July 9, 2026. Declared May 15, the outbreak is centered in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with new suspected cases emerging in Tshopo province (Kisangani) raising concerns about cross-province spread. No specific approved vaccine or treatment exists for Bundibugyo. Health authorities, with WHO and international partners, continue surveillance, isolation, care, and contact tracing, but face funding shortages, logistical challenges, insecurity, and attacks on treatment centers. A clinical trial for new therapeutics against Bundibugyo began in early July. With over 1,700 cases and 600 deaths, this outbreak ranks among the most significant Ebola crises in the DRC, underscoring the need to strengthen surveillance and treatment resources.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:DRCで1,700人以上の症例と600人の死亡が報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱(ブンディブギョ株)がDRCで大規模流行し、致死率が高く複数州へ拡大、承認済み治療薬・ワクチンがなく国際的懸念が高いためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株には承認されたワクチン・治療薬が存在せず、資金不足・治安悪化・治療センターへの攻撃など対応困難な要因が多い。Tshopo州(キサンガニ)への拡大が新たな懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Bebê de 18 dias morre por chikungunya em São Miguel dos Campos; cidade registra terceira morte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An 18-day-old baby dies of chikungunya in São Miguel dos Campos; the city records its third death.
article.articleSummary: An 18-day-old infant died from chikungunya in São Miguel dos Campos, a municipality in the interior of Alagoas, Brazil. The death, recorded on July 8, marks the third chikungunya fatality in the city in under two months. The mother contracted chikungunya during pregnancy and had symptoms on the day of delivery; the newborn was infected at birth but showed no immediate clinical signs. Days later the infant developed illness, was hospitalized, but succumbed after 18 days of life. With this case, São Miguel dos Campos has three chikungunya deaths since late May; the other two were mother and daughter: Rubenita Lins dos Santos (May 30) and Crisleine Lins dos Santos (July 4). Municipal Health Secretary Ademir Vieira said the city has intensified Aedes aegypti control via endemic agents visits, larviciding, and removal of water-collecting objects, but urged community participation to eliminate breeding sites.

triage.headline_ja: 生後18日の赤ちゃんがチクングニア熱で死亡、サンミゲル・ドス・カンポス市で3人目の死者
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の一自治体における周産期チクングニア熱死亡例の集積であり重症度は懸念されるが、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の要素は認められず、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 同一市内で短期間に3例（うち1例は新生児垂直感染疑い）の死亡が報告されており、母子感染事例として臨床的に注目される。ただし国レベルでの流行状況や他地域への拡大に関する情報はなく、フルRRAに進む前に続報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Health Official Warns Ebola Outbreak Is 'Fastest Growing Ever' As DR Congo Death Toll Hits 600
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak is the fastest growing ever, with 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths reported by the World Health Organization as of July 9, 2026. The case fatality rate stands at 34%, meaning about one in three patients has died. Declared in mid-May, the outbreak has rapidly expanded, according to Africa CDC head of emergency preparedness and response Wessam Mankoula, who called it the fastest growing Ebola outbreak to date among all Ebola viruses, not just Bundibugyo events. The figures underscore ongoing transmission and the high mortality burden, highlighting the urgent need for intensified public health response in DR Congo.

triage.headline_ja: 保健当局者、DRコンゴのエボラ流行が『史上最速の拡大』と警告、死者数600人に達する
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の急速な拡大と高い致死率（34%）が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: WHOおよびAfrica CDCが史上最速の拡大と警告しており、症例数1,759件・死亡600人・致死率34%と深刻な状況。継続的な監視とフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Preocupación mundial por brote de ébola en el Congo: se propagaría más rápido que los anteriores
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global concern over Ebola outbreak in the Congo: it would spread faster than previous outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: Across the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola outbreaks persist with 1,759 laboratory-confirmed infections and 600 deaths, up 25% in a week per the Africa CDC. The current outbreak is linked to Bundibugyo Ebola virus, a strain for which there is no vaccine or approved specific treatment; WHO indicates ongoing trials and candidate therapies. The DRC has faced 17 Ebola outbreaks since 1976; WHO notes this surge is fueled by humanitarian crises, remote regions, high population mobility, and insecurity. Across the border in Uganda, 20 cases and 2 deaths are reported as authorities monitor potential cross-border chains of transmission. The article recalls the 2013-2016 West Africa epidemic (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) with over 11,300 deaths and about 29,000 cases. The key concern is preventing the outbreak from outpacing the response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱流行に世界的懸念:これまでより速いスピードで拡大する可能性
triage.triage_reason: DRCで1,759例・600人死亡、1週間で25%増加という急速な拡大が確認され、ワクチンのないブンディブギョ株によるもので、既にウガンダへの越境伝播も報告されているため。
triage.notes: 記事にはシエラレオネ・リベリア・ギニア・ウガンダも言及されているが、これらは過去の流行（2013-2016年西アフリカ）や越境事例の言及であり、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダでの20例・2死亡は越境伝播として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Επιδεινώνεται η κατάσταση στο Κονγκό - Τουλάχιστον 600 οι θάνατοι
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The situation in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is deteriorating — at least 600 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo worsens, with at least 600 deaths and 1,759 confirmed cases reported as of Tuesday; the previous 24 hours recorded 51 new cases and 20 deaths. Two uncounted cases in Kisangani, capital of the Tshopo Province, await lab confirmation; one linked to the village Nia-Nia in Ituri Province, the other with no geographic link beyond Kisangani. As the situation deteriorates, health workers in Ituri, the hardest-hit of three eastern regions, have withdrawn from duties over unpaid wages since the outbreak was declared on May 15. Separately, clinical trials for a Bundibugyo-strain therapy are beginning; there is no approved vaccine for Bundibugyo. The WHO declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern in May, noting spread from mining towns to Bunia in Ituri before widening to surrounding areas.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国で状況悪化、死者少なくとも600人
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言済みのエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクで死者600人・症例1,759件、複数州へ拡大し医療従事者の離脱も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株には承認済みワクチンがなく、治療薬の臨床試験が開始されたばかり。医療従事者の賃金未払いによる離脱が対応能力の低下を示唆。既にWHOがPHEIC宣言済みでフルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: New Congo province has suspected Ebola case as deaths hit 600, report says
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to expand. A new Congo province has a suspected Ebola case as overall deaths reach 600. Kisangani reports two cases; one linked to Niania in Ituri province where the first cases emerged, the second case with no clear geographic link beyond Kisangani. Positive tests are awaiting confirmatory validation before being added to the official tally. Response teams are strengthening surveillance, contact tracing, and containment in Kisangani. Health authorities are tracing potential exposures in Tshopo and Haut-Uele, provinces not previously affected. In the past 24 hours, the situation report recorded 51 new cases and 20 new deaths. The World Health Organization says the outbreak has not stabilised and is still expanding due to population movement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の新州でエボラ疑い症例、死者600人に達したと報道
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の死者が600人に達し、新たな州（ツショピ、オートウエレ）へ拡大中で、WHOも「未収束・拡大継続」と評価しており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事にはマリ（Koulikoro Region等）が発生地域として付与されているが、記事本文はDRCの状況のみを主題としており、マリは対象国リストにも含まれないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: "Arrisquem la vida i no ens volen pagar": la vaga dels sanitaris amenaça la resposta a l'Ebola al Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "We risk our lives and they won't pay us": the health workers' strike threatens the Ebola response in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Health workers in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province have gone on strike amid two months of nonpayment, jeopardizing the Ebola response at the outbreak’s epicenter. In public facilities, doctors and nurses, including at Rwampara Hospital, have not been paid, despite high risks and severe conditions. The strike comes as the outbreak — caused by the Bundibugyo strain with no vaccine or authorized treatment — has killed over 580 and infected more than 1,700. Five doctors and seventeen nurses at Rwampara have died since the outbreak began. Workers demand more resources and higher salaries; a promised risk allowance of $76 per day and a general salary boost have not been delivered. The disruption compounds global concerns that this could become the deadliest Ebola outbreak yet, with containment already strained by aid cuts and misinformation.

triage.headline_ja: 「命がけで働いているのに給料が払われない」：医療従事者のストライキがコンゴのエボラ対応を脅かす
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が拡大中（死者580人超・感染1700人超）であり、ワクチン・治療薬もない中で医療従事者のストライキが対応をさらに悪化させている。深刻な公衆衛生影響と管理体制の脆弱性からPICKUP相当。
triage.notes: 発生地域にRwandaが含まれているが、記事本文ではDRC（イツリ州）のみが主題であり、ルワンダへの拡大は言及されていないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないブンディブギョ株であること、医療従事者の未払い賃金によるストライキが対応能力を著しく低下させている点は特に注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: turi : la sensibilisation intensifiée à Bambu face à la hausse de cas d'Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Turi: Intensified awareness in Bambu in response to rising Ebola cases - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Bambu Health Zone in Djugu, Ituri Province, North-East Democratic Republic of Congo reports a rising daily number of suspected and confirmed Ebola cases, driven by community infodemics and rumor-driven hesitancy to seek care. Dr. Christophe Lobo, the health zone chief physician, says emphasis on early identification and care aims to reduce transmission, though response is impeded by infrastructure gaps and insufficient resources. Government provisions include medical supplies, but inadequate facilities and a lack of adequate personal protective equipment across several health facilities hinder safe management of patients and protection for frontline staff. The situation highlights ongoing Ebola transmission risk in Bambu amid misinformation, with authorities seeking to improve case detection, timely isolation, and safe care-seeking behavior to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ：エボラ症例増加を受けバンブでの啓発活動を強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州バンブ保健地区でエボラ疑い・確定症例が増加しており、対応体制の不備（PPE不足、施設不十分）と誤情報による受診遅延が拡大リスクを高めているため、IHR基準複数該当と判断。
triage.notes: イタリア（Veneto/Bambù）は同名地名の誤マッピングと考えられ、記事はDRCのバンブ保健地区の話に限定されるため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : vers un retrait "imminent" du Sud-Kivu du dispositif de riposte - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: toward an 'imminent' withdrawal of South Kivu from the outbreak response apparatus
article.articleSummary: As of July 9, 2026, the Ebola outbreak response in the Democratic Republic of Congo may withdraw South Kivu from the outbreak response apparatus after 42 days with no new cases, Health Minister Dr. Roger Kamba said during an evaluation mission in Bunia, Ituri, in the northeast. He indicated a forthcoming announcement, attributing it to a favorable epidemiological trend in Sud-Kivu. The move would reflect progress in South Kivu, while the rest of the outbreak remains active in Ituri, North Kivu, Tshopo, and Haut-Uélé (Upper Uele), which continue to be covered by the response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：南キブ州の対応体制からの「差し迫った」撤退へ
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する続報であり、南キブ州は改善傾向だが、イトゥリ州・北キブ州・チョポ州・オートウエレ州では対応が継続中であるため、フルリスク評価の対象として注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は南キブ州の対応撤退（改善傾向）を報じているが、他の複数州（イトゥリ、北キブ、チョポ、オートウエレ）でアウトブレイクが継続中であり、DRC全体としてはエボラ危機が継続している状況。既存の進行中アウトブレイクのため、継続的なモニタリング対象としてPICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: Instead of settling in to her position as Canada's top doc, Dr. Joss Reimer immediately had to confront two deadly global outbreaks, underscoring the unpredictability of the job
article.articleSummary: Dr. Joss Reimer arrived as Canada's chief public health officer at the Public Health Agency of Canada headquarters in Building 62, Ottawa, on April 1 amid two concurrent global health crises. On the same day, passengers boarded the ocean liner MV Hondius for an Antarctic cruise; by April 11 a Dutch man aboard died from a mysterious illness later identified as hantavirus. By early May, the WHO confirmed a hantavirus outbreak linked to the event, triggering rapid contact-tracing and international coordination. On May 14, the WHO confirmed a major Ebola outbreak in the Democratic of Congo, thrusting Reimer into central pandemic response. She attended the World Health Assembly on May 18. Reimer notes the abrupt shift from a planned orientation to leading Canada’s response to two high-consequence pathogens, working seven days a week to protect Canadians.

triage.headline_ja: カナダの新首席公衆衛生官ジョス・ライマー博士、就任早々に2つの致死的なグローバルアウトブレイクへの対応を迫られる——この仕事の予測不可能性を浮き彫りに

triage.notes: 記事はカナダ首席公衆衛生官の就任エピソードが主軸だが、WHOが確認したDRCでのエボラアウトブレイクという実際の公衆衛生上重大な事象を含むため、DRCのエボラ流行についてシグナルとして扱う。南極クルーズ船（MV Hondius）でのハンタウイルス感染事例は対象国リスト外（カナダ・南極）のためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Alarma por el avance del ébola en Congo: los casos crecieron 25% en una semana - Sin Mordaza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarm over the spread of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: cases rose by 25% in one week.
article.articleSummary: Cases of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rose 25% in a week, according to Africa CDC. As of July 7, 2026, the World Health Organization reports 1,759 confirmed Ebola cases and 600 deaths in the DRC. The current outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is currently no vaccine or specific treatment. Wessam Mankoula, head of emergency preparedness and response at Africa CDC, warned that the virus is advancing faster than the response resources. The surge adds pressure on the national health system and international partners, with the DRC having endured 17 previous Ebola outbreaks. The absence of a licensed vaccine or targeted therapy for this variant heightens containment challenges.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ拡大に警鐘：1週間で症例数が25%増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の確認症例1,759例・死者600例と大規模な流行が進行中で、ワクチン・特異的治療法が存在せずヒト-ヒト感染拡大のリスクが高いため。
triage.notes: 致死率約34%（600/1759）と高く、ワクチン未承認のBundibugyo株であることから封じ込めが困難。Africa CDCおよびWHOが対応にあたっており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC reports progress, warns Ebola outbreak outpacing response in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Africa CDC reports progress in containing the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) but warns transmission is outpacing response. The continental Incident Management Support Team is now operational in Uganda to coordinate cross-border efforts, with a DRC–Uganda MoU on surveillance being implemented. Laboratory capacity has improved to over 2,000 Ebola tests daily, and therapeutic trials have begun. Despite gains, confirmed cases rose 25% in the past week; Ebola treatment centers are at 95% bed occupancy and contact tracing averages seven contacts per case (below target), with frontline health workers still at high risk. Uganda has recorded 20 cases (mostly imported), with two deaths and 17 recoveries; one patient remains in treatment and complete contact tracing has been achieved. In the DRC, 1,759 confirmed cases as of 7 July and about 600 deaths (CFR ~34%), across 37 health zones, with 94% of cases in Ituri. Insecurity in North Kivu hampers response. Calls for a 50% bed-capacity increase, faster case detection, stronger community engagement, sustained funding, and deployment of 4,000 community health workers and additional experts.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行で進展を報告するも、対応が追いついていないと警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱流行は致死率約34%、症例数増加傾向にあり、ウガンダへの越境伝播も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境伝播が確認されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。DRCでは1,759例confirmed、約600死亡、CFR約34%、94%がIturi州に集中。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola se propaga "más rápido" que los anteriores, según
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreads "faster" than previous ones, according to.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Ebola outbreak is spreading faster than previous waves, according to Africa CDC. Wessam Mankoula warned the virus is outrunning response resources. As of a World Health Organization situation report dated July 7, 2026, there are 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths in the DRC. Uganda reports 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. The current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo virus, with no vaccine or specific treatment available. The DRC has experienced 17 Ebola epidemics. WHO warned on May 19 about the magnitude and speed of spread in eastern DRC. For context, the 2013–2016 West Africa outbreak was the deadliest, with over 11,300 deaths among ~29,000 cases, primarily in Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、アフリカCDCによれば過去の流行より「速く」拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が過去の流行より速いペースで拡大しており、多数の死者とウガンダへの拡大が確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: シエラレオネ、リベリア、ギニアは2013-2016年の過去の流行の文脈として言及されているのみで、現在の発生国ではない。ウガンダでも症例が報告されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しないブンディブギョ株による流行であり、WHOも拡大速度と規模について警告している点は重大。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라 사망자 600명 돌파...콩고서 확산 가속, 대도시 전파 우려
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll surpasses 600... Spread accelerates in Congo, concerns about transmission to major cities
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has surpassed 600 deaths, with 1,759 confirmed cases reported as of July 9, 2026. In the last 24 hours, 51 new cases and 20 deaths were recorded. Suspected cases have appeared outside previously affected areas, including two in Kisangani—the capital of Tshopo Province and one of the DRC’s five largest cities. One Kisangani case has an epidemiological link to the Ituri Province Niania Health Zone outbreak; the other has no known link, raising concerns about potential community transmission. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola; no approved vaccines or therapies exist, leaving infection control, patient isolation, and contact tracing as primary containment tools. WHO says the outbreak remains expanding; Africa CDC reports rapid spread and is scaling up funding and staff; health workers protest wage delays, and treatment centers face disruptions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ死者600人突破…コンゴで感染拡大加速、大都市への伝播懸念

article.articleHeadline: चूहा छछूंदर से संचारी रोग की आशंका, बचाव को दिए टिप्स
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Risk of communicable diseases from rats and mongooses; protection tips.
article.articleSummary: In Lakhimpur, a special communicable disease control campaign targets diseases spread by rats and mongooses, including leptospirosis and plague. The district Agricultural Defense Officer, Suryapratap Singh, said that control is essential to limit transmission by these carriers. Measures urged include storing grain, animal feed, and other foods in sealed containers; maintaining cleanliness around homes, warehouses, and fields; identifying rat burrows for control. Rodent control may involve traps as needed. During control activities, extra attention should be given to protecting children and pets. Dead rats should be disposed of by burying them in a pit while wearing gloves. The article emphasizes preventive sanitation and safe handling, with no outbreak or case counts reported, focusing on reducing exposure risk in the district.

triage.headline_ja: ネズミやジャコウネズミによる感染症のリスク、予防のためのアドバイス

Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba said cases have moved from Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu to neighboring Tshopo and Haut-Uele. article.articleHeadline: La RDC eleva a 600 el número de muertos por el brote de ébola y detecta casos en una cuarta provincia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC raises the death toll from the Ebola outbreak to 600 and detects cases in a fourth province.
article.articleSummary: 600 Ebola deaths confirmed in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 1,759 laboratory-confirmed cases reported in North Kivu, South Kivu and Ituri as of July 7. Two additional cases were detected in Kisangani (Tshopo), not included in the three-province total; one case is linked to Nia-Nia health zone in Ituri, other details not disclosed. Case fatality rate 34.1%; 285 patients in isolation/hospitalization; 750 recovered; contact tracing about 80%. The outbreak began May 15 in Ituri near Uganda and South Sudan, then spread to North and South Kivu. Uganda has 20 cases (15 imported from DRC) with two deaths; France reports its first Ebola case in a returning doctor. The Bundibugyo strain has 30–50% fatality; no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids.

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de Ébola está a propagar-se mais rapidamente do que qualquer outro surto anterior

The epicenter remains Ituri, but suspected new cases have appeared in Kisangani (Tshopo) and Haut-Uele, indicating spread beyond the initial region. In Kisangani, two suspected cases are reported: one linked to Nia-Nia in Ituri, and another with no clear link to known clusters. The World Health Organization reports, as of July 7, 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths in the DRC since the outbreak began on May 15; Uganda has 20 cases, including two deaths, with 15 imported from DRC. Africa CDC has provided about $2,000,000 to support the response, including potential use for back payments to health workers; there is no vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo ebolavirus.

article.articleHeadline: Malaria had nearly been eliminated around a giant dam in the Amazon -- but then it came roaring back. Experts just discovered why.
article.articleSummary: Malaria in Altamira, Pará, Brazil, near the Belo Monte Dam on the Xingu River, nearly vanished during 2013–2017 after a targeted control program (indoor spraying, nets, rapid testing) but rebounded after funding ended. A 15-year analysis of malaria data from 150 health centers shows cases rising from >1,200/year pre-construction to <60 during the campaign, then to >700/year by 2020, concentrated in rural areas at the forest edge. Malaria is transmitted by Nyssorhynchus darlingi mosquitoes. The rebound tracked most closely with the forest-edge boundary: each 1% increase in forest edge perimeter yielded ~0.7% more cases; each 1% rise in people living near the edge yielded ~1.4% more cases. The findings stress continuous environmental surveillance and targeted public health in high-risk forest-edge landscapes for elimination efforts.

triage.headline_ja: アマゾンの巨大ダム周辺でほぼ根絶されていたマラリアが、再び猛威を振るう――専門家がその理由を解明
