article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll's grim milestone as deadly outbreak spreads
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo driven by Bundibugyo virus; as of 2026-07-09, deaths reach 600 and confirmed cases total 1,759 across the country, with the epicentre in Ituri. New suspected cases have been reported in Tshopo and Haut-Uele provinces, including two suspected in Kisangani; one linked to Nia-Nia health zone in Ituri and the other with no apparent connection to known outbreaks, prompting investigations. The government declared the outbreak on May 15 after weeks of undetected transmission; Bundibugyo is a rare strain with no approved vaccine or treatment. Ebola response workers protested in Bunia over pay, while the health minister cited human resources payment issues. Clinical treatment trials began last week. Containment is hindered by funding gaps, attacks on health centres, and ongoing eastern DR Congo conflict, which continue to challenge the outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ死者数が悲惨な節目に達し、致死性の流行が拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクが死者600人・確定例1,759人に拡大し、新規州への拡大や紛争・資金不足による対応困難があり、IHR基準複数該当のため。
triage.notes: 承認されたワクチン・治療法がない稀な株(Bundibugyo)であり、紛争地域での対応困難、資金不足、医療従事者の抗議活動など管理能力に深刻な課題がある。新規州(Tshopo, Haut-Uele)への拡大も確認されており、さらなる注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Acre tem quase mil casos de dengue confirmados em 2026, diz Sesacre | ContilNet Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Acre has nearly a thousand confirmed dengue cases in 2026, says Sesacre | ContilNet News
article.articleSummary: Dengue remains ongoing in Acre, Brazil, despite an 84.5% drop in confirmed cases in 2026 compared with the same period in 2025. Data from the Sesacre Epidemiological Bulletin (weeks 1–20, Jan 4–May 23) show 1,455 probable dengue cases in 2026, of which 993 were laboratory-confirmed, down from 6,407 confirmations among 7,063 probable cases in the same period last year. The incidence stands at 165.2 cases per 100,000 inhabitants (medium level), underscoring continued Aedes aegypti transmission and the need for vigilance and mosquito-control actions. Among municipalities, Xapuri records the highest incidence (670.5/100k), followed by Mâncio Lima (408.3) and Porto Walter (408.2) — high incidence; Rio Branco is 159.3/100k (medium). By week 20, 15 dengue cases showed warning signs; two deaths are suspected in Rio Branco and Sena Madureira and are under investigation. Vaccination coverage remains low: 31.03% have first dose and 13.43% have completed the second dose across Acre.

triage.headline_ja: アクレ州、2026年のデング熱確定例が2000例近くに―セサクレ州保健局
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は前年比84.5%減少しており流行は既知の風土病的状況だが、一部自治体で高い罹患率と死亡疑い例があり経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱は例年発生する風土病的疾患であり、今回は前年より大幅減少しているため異常性は低いが、一部地域（Xapuri等）で高罹患率、死亡疑い例、ワクチン接種率低下が見られるため継続的なモニタリングが望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de ébola se extiende a dos nuevas provincias en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreads to two new provinces in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: As of July 9, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports Ebola expanding to two new provinces, Tshopo and Haut-Uele, after confirmed patients traveled from Nia-Nia in Ituri. Two cases were diagnosed in Tshopo and two in Haut-Uele (Wamba). Ituri and North Kivu remain in the acute phase with rising infections, while South Kivu could be withdrawn from the response after 42 days without new cases. Movement between affected areas and non-compliance with controls contributed to spread, despite measures banning corpse transport, mandatory traveler screening, quadrupled temperature checks, and hand disinfection. About 15 people remain in quarantine due to contact with intercepted corpses, underscoring weaknesses in corpse management. In Ituri, treatment centers faced incidents and unpaid safe-burial bonuses. Health Minister Roger Kamba’s Bunia visit aims to address working conditions and funding. From May 15 to June 8, 2026, Congo reported 600 Ebola deaths, 1,759 confirmed cases, and 285 recoveries.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行、コンゴ民主共和国の新たな2州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC国内で複数州（イトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ、チョポ、オートウエレ）に拡大しており、致死率の高い症例が多数（死亡600人、確定1,759例）報告されているため、深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威かつ国際的拡大リスクがある。
triage.notes: 感染は複数州（イトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ、チョポ、オートウエレ）に及び、遺体管理の不備や資金不足など対応上の課題が指摘されている。continuing spreadのため続報の監視とフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Случаите на ебола во Конго се зголемија за 25 отсто за една седмица
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in Congo rose by 25 percent in one week.
article.articleSummary: As of 9 July 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) rose 25% in one week, per Africa CDC. The DRC government reports 1,759 laboratory-confirmed cases and 600 deaths. Hospital bed capacity is strained, with about 95% of beds occupied; authorities say capacity must be increased by roughly 50% to meet demand. In neighboring Uganda, 20 Ebola cases have been recorded, with two deaths and one patient still under treatment. Transmission occurs through direct contact with infected bodily fluids. The current outbreak involves Bundibugyo ebolavirus, which has proven hard to control due to a lack of vaccine or specific treatment. Control remains possible, as Uganda’s experience suggests, but rapid scale-up of clinical capacity and infection-control measures are required.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ症例、1週間で25%増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで急拡大し（1週間で25%増）、隣国ウガンダにも拡大しており、病床逼迫やワクチン・治療薬不足など公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedotの発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストに無いため verified_locations には含めていない。Bundibugyoエボラウイルスによる流行で、ワクチン・特異的治療法がなく制御困難とされる点は重症度・流行拡大性の観点で重要。

article.articleHeadline: Cidade mineira investiga duas mortes por febre maculosa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minas Gerais city investigates two deaths from Brazilian spotted fever.
article.articleSummary: Two deaths in Manhuaçu, Minas Gerais, are being investigated for Brazilian spotted fever (febre maculosa) after two July fatalities. The first death occurred July 4 and the second on July 6; both men from Manhuaçu worked extracting sand along a riverbank in Santana do Manhuaçu. Fundação Ezequiel Dias (Funed) results are awaited to confirm the cases. The SES-MG reports 20 confirmed cases and four deaths from Brazilian spotted fever in Minas Gerais this year, with no cases in Belo Horizonte. The disease is transmitted by the star tick (carrapato-estrela) and can resemble leptospirosis, dengue, Zika, and meningitis, delaying diagnosis. The state’s average fatality is about 30%. Prevention emphasizes avoiding tick exposure, repellents (icaridina), light clothing, regular body checks, careful tick removal, and environmental cleanliness; veterinary acaricides may be used as advised.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州の都市、紅斑熱による2件の死亡例を調査
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ミナスジェライス州で紅斑熱（ロッキー山紅斑熱）による死亡例が発生し致死率も高いが、地域限定的で国際的拡大の可能性は低く、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 紅斑熱（febre maculosa）はダニ媒介性で人-人感染はなく、州内の地域的アウトブレイクに留まる。致死率約30%と高いが、既知の風土病であり異常性は低い。SES-MGが今年20例・4死亡を確認済みで当局が対応中。

article.articleHeadline: Xapuri tem a maior incidência de dengue do Acre, com mais de 670 casos por 100 mil habitantes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Xapuri has the highest dengue incidence in Acre, with more than 670 cases per 100,000 inhabitants.
article.articleSummary: Dengue incidence in Acre, Brazil, remains high, with Xapuri recording the highest rate at 670.5 probable cases per 100,000 inhabitants. Mâncio Lima (408.3) and Porto Walter (408.2) follow. Three municipalities are in the high-incidence category per Epidemiological Bulletin No. 5/2026 from Sesacre, covering January 4 to May 23, 2026. Regional rates: Alto Acre 285.7; Juruá 193.4; Baixo Acre 136.4; state average 165.2 (medium). Rio Branco, the state’s most populous city, shows 159.3 per 100,000. The lowest rates are Acrelândia 20.5, Feijó 21.3, and Manoel Urbano 23.5. In absolute confirmed cases, Baixo Acre regional accounted for 660 cases (over half of the state total), Rio Branco 607, Sena Madureira 19. Juruá regional had 266 (Cruzeiro do Sul 153; Mâncio Lima 66). Alto Acre reported 67 confirmed, with Brasiléia and Xapuri at 20 each.

triage.headline_ja: ザピウリ市はアクレ州で最も高いデング熱の発生率を記録、人口10万人当たり670件以上
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はブラジルで流行しており、本記事は州保健局の定例疫学速報に基づくルーチンなサーベイランスデータであり、突発的な異常事態や国際的拡大の兆候は確認できない。ただし媒介動物感染症で継続的曝露があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 州保健局（Sesacre）の疫学速報第5号（2026年1月4日〜5月23日）に基づく定例統計報告。デング熱はブラジルで地方病的に流行しており、死亡数や重症例の具体的言及はない。

article.articleHeadline: Жертвами лихорадки Эбола в ДР Конго стали уже 625 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola fever has claimed 625 lives in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola fever in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 1,792 laboratory-confirmed cases, with 625 deaths and 295 recoveries, according to a Ministry of Communications and Media report cited by RIA Novosti. The figures reflect the current outbreak dynamics in the DRC and come from an official document. On June 24, France’s Ministry of Health reported its first Ebola case. Russian infectious-disease specialist Darya Namazova said the risk of broader spread to Russia and other developed countries remains low. The article is dated 2026-07-10.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ熱による死者が625人に達した
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱の確定症例が1,792例、死者625人に達し、さらにフランスでも初症例が報告されたことから国際的拡大の懸念があり、IHR基準複数該当のためフルRRAへ進むべきである。
triage.notes: 記事中でフランスおよびロシアも言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外した。フランスでの初症例報告は国際的拡大の重要な指標として考慮した。

article.articleHeadline: Crescimento de casos de SRAG em nove capitais segundo boletim da Fiocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Increase in Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS) cases in nine capital cities according to Fiocruz bulletin.
article.articleSummary: Nine Brazilian capitals continue to report rising Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI) activity per Fiocruz InfoGripe bulletin dated 2026-07-09. While national SARI incidence trends downward, Belo Horizonte, Boa Vista, Curitiba, Florianópolis, Goiânia, Manaus, Palmas, Porto Alegre, and Rio Branco show increases, with Ceará, Maranhão, Mato Grosso do Sul, Paraná, and São Paulo showing signs of plateauing or decline. By Epidemiological Week 26, nine capitals are at alert/risk/high risk with a long-term growth signal; 11 additional capitals are at alert/risk/high risk but without sustained growth. Lab data from the recent weeks indicate RSV as the leading pathogen (55.9%), followed by rhinovirus (23.3%), Influenza A (12.7%), Influenza B (8.4%), and SARS-CoV-2 (2.2%). Mortality is highest with Influenza A (33.1%), rhinovirus (26.3%), RSV (21.7%), Influenza B (15.4%), and COVID-19 (6.9%). Since January, Brazil has 109,347 SARI cases, with 56,530 positive, 37,770 negative, and 8,195 pending. Children under age 2 and the elderly bear higher risks; vaccination is urged and infection control measures advised.

triage.headline_ja: フィオクルスの報告によると、9つの州都でSRAG(重症急性呼吸器症候群)症例が増加
triage.triage_reason: 季節性呼吸器感染症(RSV、インフルエンザ等)による通常のサーベイランス報告であり、全国的には減少傾向だが一部都市で増加が見られるため、経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 季節性呼吸器感染症サーベイランスの定期報告。RSV・インフルエンザ・COVID-19等の混合流行で、既知の病原体による予測可能な季節性増加。国内保健当局による通常の監視体制内での対応が可能とみられる。

article.articleHeadline: EPIDEMIE D'EBOLA - BILAN MEURTRIER, CRISE ALIMENTAIRE ET ISOLEMENT REGIONAL La RDC en apnée | EnQuete+
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: EBOLA EPIDEMIC - DEADLY TOLL, FOOD CRISIS AND REGIONAL ISOLATION: DRC HOLDS ITS BREATH | EnQuete+
article.articleSummary: Ebola epidemic in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 506 deaths from 1,561 cases, with 253 recoveries, per health authorities. Ituri province is the epicenter, with 24 of 36 health zones affected, including Nia-Nia, Lita, and Drodro; Nizi near Bunia hosts 34 displaced-site populations, raising transmission risk linked to artisanal mining and delayed medical deployment. In Nord-Kivu, 11 zones are affected, prompting a second treatment center in Beni; South Kivu remains less affected (Miti Murhesa: 3 cases, 1 death; no new cases since late May). An emergency request of $22 million seeks to fund the Ebola response; the wider plan for RDC totals $621 million and is ~84% funded. About 900 of 1,511 patients have received nutrition support. Key response elements include patient isolation, contact tracing, ring vaccination, and security corridors guarded by the army and MONUSCO, though militarization can impede community trust.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行 ― 死者数増大、食料危機、地域的孤立：コンゴ民主共和国、息を潜める
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で エボラ出血熱の大規模流行が継続しており、死者506名・症例1561件に達し、複数州に拡大、資金不足や地域的孤立も報告されているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにRomania（Cluj, Lita）が含まれるが、記事内容はDRCのエボラ流行に限定されており、地理情報の誤付与と判断し除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Больные Эболой выявлены ещё в двух провинциях Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola patients identified in two more provinces of Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola cases identified in two additional eastern provinces of the Democratic Republic of Congo: Chopo and Upper Uele, each with two laboratory-confirmed infections. The outbreak, extending through seven eastern jurisdictions, remains in the acute phase. The case fatality rate among confirmed cases is 26.6%. As of July 6, 2026, lab-confirmed Ebola deaths reached 506, up 14 in the last 24 hours. The UNDP warns the worst-case economic impact could reach $3.6 billion, affecting African economies and neighboring countries beyond Congo. The article emphasizes ongoing transmission and the continuing public health response; it does not provide further epidemiological details on transmission sources or case management.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ患者がさらに2州で確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC東部で7州に拡大し、致死率26.6%・死者506人と重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、経済的波及も懸念されるためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: UNDPによる経済損失予測(最大36億ドル)は近隣諸国への波及リスクを示唆しているが、具体的な国名は記載されていないため国際的拡大の詳細は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Apesar de queda, número de casos de SRAG seguem altos no país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Despite the decline, the number of Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS) cases remains high in the country.
article.articleSummary: As of 9 July 2026, Brazil continues to report high Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS) hospitalizations despite signs of a recent decline after almost five months of increases. The Fiocruz InfoGripe bulletin notes that overall severe respiratory admissions are no longer rising as quickly, driven mainly by fewer hospitalizations from respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) and a drop in influenza A and B. The pattern is uneven across states: Amazonas reports rising severe cases among older adults, possibly linked to ongoing COVID-19 hospitalizations; capitals Belo Horizonte, Curitiba, Florianópolis, and Porto Alegre show increased SARS in children under two. Health officials urge continued precautions: cover coughs and sneezes, wash hands regularly, and avoid contact when symptomatic; when staying home is not possible, masks help reduce transmission. Ongoing vigilance and public health measures remain essential.

triage.headline_ja: 減少傾向にもかかわらず、国内のSARS（重症急性呼吸器症候群）症例数は依然として高水準
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の呼吸器疾患（RSV、インフルエンザ、COVID-19）による重症入院がブラジル国内で高水準にあるが、既知の病原体による季節的変動であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは示唆されていない。
triage.notes: 既知の病原体（RSV、インフルエンザA/B、COVID-19）による季節性SARS/SRAG増加であり、新規病原体や異常な流行パターンの報告はない。国内公衆衛生当局による通常の注意喚起レベルの対応。

article.articleHeadline: Заболевшие Эболой выявлены еще в двух провинциях ДРК
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases identified in two more provinces of the DRC
article.articleSummary: Two more eastern provinces of the Democratic Republic of Congo report Ebola infections: Chopo and Haut-Uele, each with two cases, according to Health Minister Samuel Rège Kamba. The outbreak began on May 15 in eastern DRC and, in its first month, recorded a record number of confirmed cases, with more than 1,000 infections and 267 deaths. The World Health Organization confirms the infections involve the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain. Experts believe the virus was circulating for months before May 15, and transmission continues. The hardest-hit areas remain Ituri and North Kivu, where the epidemiological situation is most challenging as authorities bolster surveillance and response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、さらに2州でエボラ感染者を確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCの複数州に拡大しており、致死率が高く（267名死亡/1000名超感染）、稀なブンディブギョ株による感染で国際的拡大リスクもあるためIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: WHOが希少なブンディブギョ株の関与を確認。既存流行地のイトゥリ・北キブに加え、チョポ・オートウエレ州にも拡大しており、感染拡大が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak has killed 600 and is reaching new provinces
article.articleSummary: Congo's Ebola outbreak has killed 600 people and logged 1,759 confirmed cases since declaring the outbreak on May 15, 2026. As of July 9, 2026, new suspected cases have appeared in Kisangani, Tshopo province, extending beyond the epicenter in Ituri. The Africa CDC calls it the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak the continent has recorded. The outbreak is driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Containment is hampered by a funding gap, attacks on health centers, and the ongoing conflict in eastern Congo, enabling spread into previously untouched provinces. Authorities say the outbreak remains ongoing, with monitoring continuing as it spreads to new provinces.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行、死者600人に達し新たな州へ拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に加え、WPRO基準も全て該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 希少なブンディブギョ株による流行で承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在せず、資金不足・医療施設への攻撃・東部紛争により封じ込めが困難。Africa CDCはアフリカ大陸で最速の拡大速度と評価。イトゥリ州の震源地からチョポ州キサンガニへ拡大中で、さらなる拡散が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: 'Não pode pegar sozinha': Flávia Viana encontra morcego no closet e faz alerta sobre risco de doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't touch it on your own: Flávia Viana finds a bat in the closet and warns about disease risk.
article.articleSummary: Bat found inside a São Paulo apartment, raising rabies transmission concerns. Flávia Viana said the flying mammal had been hiding between her bedroom and closet for at least two months and was later seen nesting in a ceiling light. The couple attempted to contact the Centro de Controle de Zoonoses (CCZ) for capture, but responders did not attend; the Fire Department was not involved, and the 156 emergency line did not answer. Marcelo Zangrandi briefly wore a Minions costume as a makeshift protective measure, a playful yet cautionary detail underscoring the danger of handling bats. Health authorities warn that bats can carry rabies and emphasize professional removal and post-exposure steps if contact occurs. Location: São Paulo, Brazil. Publication date: 2026-07-09.

triage.headline_ja: 「一人で捕まえないで」フラヴィア・ヴィアナがクローゼットでコウモリを発見、病気のリスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: 個人宅での単発的なコウモリ発見に関する芸能ニュースであり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や集団感染の兆候はない。
triage.notes: 有名人の個人的なエピソードを扱った芸能記事であり、狂犬病の実際の感染例や集団発生を報告するものではない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、記事の主題は公衆衛生上の脅威というより個人的な体験談であるため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: World Must Move Faster On Ebola Response For DR Congo: UN Relief Chief
article.articleSummary: UN relief chief Tom Fletcher urged a faster Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where Ituri province remains the centre of the outbreak and conflict-driven displacement is driving spread to other provinces. Since the outbreak was declared on 15 May, the Bundibugyo species Ebola virus has infected more than 1,700 people in DRC and caused about 600 deaths; neighboring Uganda has confirmed 20 cases. In May, the UN released up to $60 million to accelerate response efforts. The WHO, with the UN peacekeeping mission, has supplied medical equipment and is building isolation and treatment units. Fletcher called for sustained humanitarian support and investment in preparedness. He stressed that the best defense is surveillance, laboratory testing, referral systems, infection prevention and control, and community engagement, with locally led, gender-sensitive approaches. Any delay would be measured in Ebola deaths and wider humanitarian costs.

triage.headline_ja: 国連救援責任者、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対応でより迅速な行動を訴える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで1,700人以上感染・約600人死亡し、ウガンダにも拡大しているため国際的拡大リスクが高く、IHR基準複数該当のシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例確認とあるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。紛争による人口移動が感染拡大の主要因とされている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع عدد ضحايا إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 625 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to 625.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 1,792 confirmed cases, 625 deaths, and 295 recoveries as of July 9, 2026. The outbreak began May 15 in eastern DRC, centered in Ituri Province, with infections and deaths also reported in neighboring Uganda. On May 17, the World Health Organization declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with regional risk assessed as high.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死者数が625人に増加
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した大規模エボラアウトブレイクで、死者625人・感染1792例に達しウガンダにも拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの感染拡大が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOにより2026年5月17日にPHEICが宣言され、地域リスクは高いと評価されている。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC: Dịch Ebola đang lan nhanh nhất từ trước đến nay
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa CDC: The Ebola outbreak is spreading faster than ever before.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading faster than ever, Africa CDC reported on July 9, 2026. Since mid-May, the outbreak has recorded 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths, per WHO data, yielding a case fatality rate of about 34%. The current flare-up is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, a rare Ebola lineage, for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. Africa CDC official Wessam Mankoula said the pace of transmission exceeds the capacity of response and the deployment of resources. The update underscores the volatility of a strain with high transmissibility and limited medical countermeasures. An earlier note cites over 500 deaths in the same outbreak with CFR up to 32%.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC:エボラ流行がこれまでで最も速いスピードで拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱(Bundibugyo株)が致死率34%で急速に拡大し、ワクチン・治療法未承認、対応能力を超える伝播速度とAfrica CDCが公式に警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: Africa CDC高官が対応能力を超える伝播速度と公式声明を出しており、ワクチン・治療薬未承認のBundibugyo株による致死率34%の大規模流行。国際的な支援要請が既に示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго за сутки от Эболы умерли 25 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 25 people died of Ebola in 24 hours.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) shows 1,792 cases and 625 laboratory-confirmed deaths as of 9 July 2026, up 33 cases and 25 deaths from the previous day. The case fatality rate is 34.9%. A total of 764 patients are under hospital or medical isolation observation. Contact tracing over the past three weeks stands at 78.6%. The current outbreak began on 15 May in eastern DRC and Uganda, with the epicenter in Ituri Province. These figures reflect ongoing transmission, with daily increases in both cases and deaths and a high fatality rate, underscoring the need for sustained surveillance, isolation, and public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラにより24時間で25人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大の恐れ）が該当し、致死率34.9%と高く、DRC・ウガンダにまたがる継続的な流行であるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として記載されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCのイトゥリ州が震源地とされ、感染者・死亡者数が日々増加している状況。

article.articleHeadline: За сутки в ДР Конго 25 человек умерли от Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In DR Congo, 25 people died of Ebola in 24 hours.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola outbreak persists with 25 deaths in 24 hours. Total cases reach 1,792, with 764 hospitalizations and 625 deaths, giving a case fatality rate of 34.9% per the ministry’s daily bulletin. The ongoing outbreak continues to drive transmission within the Democratic Republic of the Congo. In May, the World Health Organization declared the Ebola outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. The UNDP warns that, in a worst-case scenario, the epidemic could inflict up to $3.6 billion in economic losses across African economies, affecting the DRC and neighboring countries. The article provides no details on laboratory confirmation changes, infection sources, or imported/exported cases. Overall, figures indicate sustained high mortality and active transmission within the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で24時間に25人がエボラで死亡
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言済みのエボラ大規模流行が継続中で、致死率34.9%と高く、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威が明確なため。
triage.notes: WHOは2026年5月にPHEICを宣言済み。UNDPは周辺国への経済的波及（最大36億ドルの損失）を警告しており、地域的な影響拡大が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Στους 600 οι νεκροί από το σπάνιο στέλεχος του Έμπολα - Χωρίς εμβόλιο και υπό την απειλή του πολέμου η μάχη
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: 600 dead from the rare Ebola strain — without a vaccine and under the threat of war, the battle.
article.articleSummary: 600 deaths among 1,759 confirmed Ebola cases since mid-May in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the outbreak driven by the Bundibugyo strain has reached a critical phase. The hemorrhagic fever, transmitted via bodily fluids, marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the country. The epicenter is Ituri province in the northeast, with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu; areas under the control of the M23 armed group hinder response. Uganda reports 2 deaths and 20 cases. WHO notes the real scale may be higher as health centers operate near 90% capacity. In response, the WHO launched clinical trials for two new therapeutic approaches in early July and authorized emergency use of the first molecular diagnostic test to accelerate detection and isolation of cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：希少なエボラ株による死者が600人に達する ― ワクチンなし、戦争の脅威下での闘い
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認症例1,759例・死亡600例に達する大規模エボラ流行が進行中で、武装勢力の影響下で対応が困難な状況にあり、ウガンダへの越境拡大も報告されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例（2死亡・20症例）が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。武装勢力M23の影響下で対応が難航している点も高リスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Afrika'da Ebola kaynaklı ölüm sayısı 600'ü aştı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola-related deaths in Africa have surpassed 600.
article.articleSummary: As of 9 July 2026, the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda has surpassed 600 deaths, with 1,779 confirmed cases and 602 fatalities (case fatality ~34%), and 302 recoveries. DRC recorded about 353 new confirmed cases last week, a 25% rise. Africa CDC notes ongoing transmission, with laboratory capacity now over 2,000 tests per day. Health workers account for 112 infections and 35 deaths in the DRC. No licensed vaccines or targeted therapeutics exist for Bundibugyo Ebola; clinical trials for treatments are nearing start. Uganda reports containment, with only one active case and the most recent confirmed on 21 June. Africa CDC declared the outbreak a continental public health emergency after WHO declared a PHEIC on 17 May; 11 other high-risk countries include South Sudan, Rwanda, Kenya, Zambia, Central African Republic, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Angola, the Republic of the Congo, Burundi, and Somalia.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでのエボラ関連死者数が600人を超える
triage.triage_reason: WHO PHEIC宣言済み、致死率約34%、DRCで新規症例が25%増加するなど拡大傾向にあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストに多数の国が含まれるが、記事サマリーで実際の発生国として明記されているのはDRC（Bundibugyo株の発生源）とウガンダ（ただし対象国リスト外）。他の11か国は『高リスク国』として言及されているのみで、実際の症例発生は確認されていないため verified_locations には含めない。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Global Dengue Treatment Trial With Indian Therapy To Begin Next Year | Outlook India
article.articleSummary: Global dengue treatment trial using an Indian therapy is slated to begin next year, signaling a major step in international dengue management. European health authorities say dengue is no longer confined to tropical nations, with more than half of the world’s population living in areas at risk and Europe increasingly affected. Florika Fink-Hooijer, Director-General of DG HERA, described the study as an important milestone in strengthening global preparedness against vector-borne diseases. The report underscores a shifting epidemiology of dengue and the drive to broaden therapeutic options through international collaboration. The Outlook India piece positions the Indian therapy trial as part of a broader effort to bolster prevention and response capabilities across Europe, Asia, and other regions.

triage.headline_ja: インド発の治療薬によるデング熱の国際治験、来年開始へ | アウトルック・インディア
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング治療薬の国際治験開始に関する研究・政策的なニュースであり、特定地域での異常な感染拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はインドで開発された治療法の国際治験計画についての報道であり、インド国内での実際の感染拡大や症例急増を報じるものではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Ebola patient put in Equatorial Guinea hotel with deportees from U.S., lawyers say
article.articleSummary: 17 migrants deported from the United States and detained in a Malabo hotel on Bioko island, Equatorial Guinea, are reportedly being used as a quarantine site for suspected Ebola cases. The group—4 women and 13 men from Angola, Mauritania and Ethiopia—are held under a secret third-country deportation deal with U.S. authorities. A man suspected of Ebola was brought to the hotel last week by medical personnel in hazmat suits and placed on a floor below detainees; a woman was also described as a suspected Ebola patient. No laboratory confirmation is reported. Detainees say they lack masks, disinfectants, or information on risk reduction. The hotel, which previously served as a Covid isolation center, houses detainees amid concerns over medical care. Congo is battling a rare Ebola outbreak with over 600 deaths since May; Uganda has confirmed cases, while Equatorial Guinea reports none."

triage.headline_ja: 疑わしいエボラ患者が米国からの被送還者とともに赤道ギニアのホテルに収容されたと弁護士らが証言
triage.triage_reason: 疑わしいエボラ患者が確定検査なしに被送還者と同じホテルに収容されるという異常な状況であり、複数国からの被送還者が関与するため国際的拡大リスクも懸念される。IHR基準を2つ満たすためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は赤道ギニア（対象国リスト外）における被送還者とエボラ疑い患者の同居問題であり、対象国は主題として登場しない。DRCのエボラ流行（600人以上死亡）は背景情報として言及されているのみで、本記事のイベント主体ではないため verified_locations には含めなかった。ラボ確認がないため重症度・公衆衛生影響の判断は不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: República del Congo eleva a 600 los fallecidos por ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Republic of the Congo raises Ebola death toll to 600.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches 1,759 laboratory-confirmed cases and 600 deaths as of July 7, with a case fatality rate of 34.1%. The epicenter remains Ituri, a border province with Uganda and South Sudan, from where the outbreak, first declared May 15, has spread to North Kivu and South Kivu. An additional two cases have been detected in Kisangani, Tshopo Province; one case is linked to the Nia-Nia health zone in Ituri, while the origin of the second remains under investigation. About 285 patients are in isolation or hospital, and 750 have recovered. Contact tracing is at 80%. Laboratory confirmation continues, with no details of further imported/exported cases beyond the Kisangani detections.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ死者数600人に上昇
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で確認症例1,759例・死亡600例（致死率34.1%）に達し、新たにキサンガニ市へも拡大していることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州を震源地とし、北キブ・南キブ州、キサンガニ市に拡大）が主題。ウガンダ・南スーダンは国境地帯として言及されるのみで、実際の症例発生地とはされていないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Casos prováveis de dengue em Itajaí apresentam queda de 90%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Probable dengue cases in Itajaí drop by 90%
article.articleSummary: Probable dengue cases in Itajaí, Santa Catarina, Brazil, declined by more than 90% in the first half of 2026, according to the Epidemiological Surveillance Directorate. The municipality recorded 273 probable dengue cases in H1 2026, down from over 3,000 in the same period in 2025. Suspected cases fell 62.33% to 5,791 from over 15,000. Of 171 confirmed dengue cases in H1 2026, 166 were locally transmitted (autochthonous). The highest concentrations were in São Judas, Dom Bosco, and São Vicente. Circulation involves three serotypes (DENV-1, DENV-2, DENV-3), maintaining vigilance to prevent new outbreaks. Starting in July, Itajaí launches a community-engagement phase of the Wolbachia method to control Aedes aegypti, targeting São João, São Vicente, Cordeiros, and Cidade Nova; releases anticipated from late August to early September 2026. The strategy, WHO-endorsed, inhibits viral replication but does not replace elimination of standing water.

triage.headline_ja: イタジャイ市におけるデング熱の疑い症例、90%減少
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例数は前年から90%減少しており、地域の対策(ボルバキア法導入)も奏功している状況で、公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱は流行地の風土病であり、記事は症例減少と予防的なボルバキア法導入という好ましい内容を報じている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak is 'fastest-growing ever' as 600 die
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, is the fastest-growing on record, with 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths (case fatality rate 34%) as of 2026-07-09. Declared May 15 in Ituri, the northeastern outbreak spans four provinces, with Ituri as the epicenter; South Kivu has faced clashes with the M23 group, raising displacement concerns. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment. Recoveries total 285; 304 suspected cases remain under investigation. A July 2 trial in the DRC assesses MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir, alone and in combination. More than 10,000 contacts are monitored; follow-up is 82% (target 95%). Laboratory capacity rose from 30 tests/day in Kinshasa to over 2,000/day in decentralised labs. WHO seeks US$115 million for the response, with 32% funded.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行は「史上最速の拡大」、死者600人に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最速の拡大を見せるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が発生し、死者600人・致死率34%、承認されたワクチンや治療法もなく、武力衝突による避難民増加も懸念されるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: M23武装勢力との衝突による避難民の増加が感染拡大リスクを高めている。WHOは1億1500万米ドルの支援を求めており、現在32%しか資金調達できていない。ブンディブギョ株には承認されたワクチンや治療法がなく、MBP134モノクローナル抗体とレムデシビルの臨床試験が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in DRC: 750 recoveries compared with 600 deaths; recoveries outnumber deaths - ACP
article.articleSummary: On July 9, 2026, Ebola virus disease (EVD) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo shows 1,759 confirmed cases across Ituri, Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu with a 34.1% case fatality rate; 750 recoveries vs 600 deaths. Contact tracing rate 80%. Extension to Tshopo yields two Kisangani cases, one linked to Nia-Nia health zone. To Kisangani, operations have been launched to strengthen all pillars of the response. Officially affected provinces remain three. In Ituri, five patients (from CT Sota, CTE Rwampara, Mongbwalu, Nyakunde) recovered after negative follow-up tests. Decentralised diagnostics enable rapid detection outside usual transmission areas, illustrated by early Kisangani outbreak identification.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ出血熱：回復750例、死亡600例で回復が死亡を上回る - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認症例1,759例、致死率34.1%の継続中のエボラ流行が、新たな州（Tshopo/Kisangani）に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: Ituri、Nord-Kivu、Sud-Kivuの3州に加え、新たにTshopo州Kisanganiで症例確認。分散型診断により通常の伝播地域外での早期検出が可能となっている点が特徴的。致死率34.1%と高く、継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: UFMG avança em estudos de 'vacina universal' contra a malária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UFMG advances in studies of a 'universal vaccine' against malaria.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian researchers from CTVacinas, in collaboration with UFMG and Fiocruz Minas, report a potential path to a universal malaria vaccine. Led by Camila Barbosa, Luna de Lacerda, and Caroline Junqueira, the work, published July 8, 2026, builds on 15 years of basic research into Plasmodium vivax—the main malaria-causing parasite in Brazil, the Americas, and parts of Asia. Current globally approved vaccines target Plasmodium falciparum and show limited efficacy (about 30–50%), are administered mainly to children under five in Africa, require four doses, and do not cover parasite diversity. The Brazilian team uncovers a novel immune mechanism, distinct from the classic antibody-centric approach developed over five decades, offering potential broader, longer-lasting protection against malaria.

triage.headline_ja: UFMG、マラリアに対する『万能ワクチン』の研究を前進
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジルの研究機関によるマラリアワクチン研究の進展を報じる学術・研究ニュースであり、感染拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン研究の科学的進展に関する報道であり、実際の感染症発生・アウトブレイクの報告ではないため、対象国の発生地域としては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: A Beaver Near Campsites Two And Three On Turtle Island May Be Rabid, DEC Says
article.articleSummary: Rabies concern prompts a Lake George water-safety advisory after a beaver near Turtle Island campsites 2–3 may be rabid. On July 4, two people were bitten by a beaver, with a nearby den cited. By July 9, the DEC warned the beaver may be infected with rabies and issued a water safety advisory for Turtle Island, restricting access to the area around campsites 1–5 through at least July 14, 2026. Swimmers should avoid those areas; boaters and campers are urged to avoid contact with beavers and to exercise caution while recreating in Lake George Wild Forest. The DEC is monitoring the beaver colony and requests visitors report sightings of beavers displaying unusual behavior.

triage.headline_ja: ニューヨーク州レイクジョージのタートル島キャンプサイト2・3付近のビーバーが狂犬病の疑い、DECが発表
triage.triage_reason: 発生地は米国ニューヨーク州レイクジョージであり、対象国リストに該当しない。単一のビーバーによる狂犬病疑いの局所的な水域安全勧告であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストに含まれる『Turtle Islands』『Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao』『Republic of the Philippines』はBluedotの地名マッチングによる誤りで、記事本文は米国ニューヨーク州レイクジョージの『Turtle Island』（キャンプ場）に関するものであり、フィリピンとは無関係。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC reports progress, warns Ebola outbreak outpacing response in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak continues to outpace response, Africa CDC reports progress but warns infections rising. As of 7 July, the DRC has 1,759 confirmed Ebola cases and 600 deaths (case fatality ~34%), with 353 new infections in the past week across 37 health zones, 94% of them in Ituri Province. Health facilities are under pressure: bed occupancy at 95%, and contact tracing remains weak (about seven contacts per confirmed case). The outbreak’s estimated effective reproduction number is 1.4, signaling ongoing transmission. Uganda reports 20 cases, mostly imported; one patient in treatment, two deaths, and 17 recoveries, with complete contact tracing cited as crucial. Healthcare worker infections: 112 with 35 deaths. Advances include lab capacity >2,000 Ebola tests daily, a jointly deployed Incident Management Team in Uganda, border surveillance, and therapeutics trials. Calls for a 50% bed-capacity expansion and 4,000 additional community health workers.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、進展を報告するも、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱の流行が対応を上回っていると警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで1,759症例・600死亡、致死率約34%、実効再生産数1.4と持続的な人-人感染がみられ、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、越境拡大の重要な文脈として本文には含まれる。医療従事者感染112名・死亡35名など医療体制への深刻な負荷も確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Wabak Ebola di Congo 'paling pantas menular' dalam sejarah; ragut 600 nyawa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo, the fastest-spreading in history, claimed 600 lives.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is the fastest-spreading in history, with 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths (roughly 34% fatality) as of 9–10 July 2026. The four-province outbreak is centered in Ituri, with South Kivu also affected amid ongoing clashes with M23 rebels. The rare Bundibugyo strain is responsible and has no approved vaccine or treatment; transmission occurs via contact and bodily fluids and may have circulated before detection. WHO and Africa CDC warn cases could double about every 28 days. Health capacity has expanded to about 700 beds across 22 treatment centers, with 300 more beds in development, and lab testing capacity rising from 30 tests/day in Kinshasa to over 2,000 in affected areas. More than 10,000 contacts are monitored (82% follow-up; 95% needed). Two therapeutics, MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir, are in clinical trials since July 2, 2026. An estimated US$1.4 billion is required for response and humanitarian operations.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ流行、史上最速の感染拡大 600人死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最速拡大とされるエボラ（Bundibugyo株）流行、致死率約34%、ワクチン未承認、M23紛争地域での対応困難、WHO/Africa CDCが国際的懸念を表明しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 紛争地域（M23反政府勢力との衝突）が対応をさらに困難にしている点、ワクチン未承認の希少株（Bundibugyo）である点、約14億USDの国際支援要請がある点から、緊急のフルリスク評価が必要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak is 'fastest growing ever' as 600 die
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in DRC is the fastest growing Ebola outbreak ever, according to health authorities on July 9. WHO reports 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths (case fatality rate 34%), with 285 recovered and 304 suspected cases under investigation. The outbreak has hit four provinces, with Ituri as the focus, and is caused by Bundibugyo, a strain with no approved vaccine or treatment. Transmission occurs via close contact and infected bodily fluids. Trials for two treatments began July 2 in the DRC: MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir, tested alone and in combination. Response capacity includes about 700 beds across 22 treatment centres, with 300 more beds in the pipeline (operating at ~90%); over 10,000 contacts monitored (82% follow-up; WHO target 95%). Lab testing expanded from 30/day in Kinshasa to >2,000 in decentralised labs. US$1.4 billion in funding is needed amid security challenges in South Kivu with M23 clashes.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が「史上最速の拡大」、死者600人に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最速の拡大とされるエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)の流行が発生し、死者600人・致死率34%、承認されたワクチン/治療薬がなく、国際的資金支援が要請されているためフルRRAへ進めるべきシグナル。
triage.notes: 南キブ州ではM23武装勢力との衝突により対応が困難化している点、承認されたワクチン・治療薬が存在しない点（治験中）が特に懸念材料。1,759例確定・304例疑い例調査中で流行は継続拡大中。

article.articleHeadline: Over 56,000 in Karnataka unaware of HIV status; dating apps pose new challenge to tracing infections
article.articleSummary: HIV remains a major public health challenge in Karnataka, with 56,406 people living with HIV unaware of their status—the highest estimate among Indian states. KSAPS reports over two lakh people on antiretroviral therapy (ART) as of June 28, 2026, yet early diagnosis and linkage to care are priorities. Bengaluru’s mobile population and the use of dating apps hinder contact tracing, while stigma and reluctance to test slow voluntary testing. KSAPS launched the Mobilisation for AIDS Suraksha (MAS) campaign, featuring the BreakFree QR code linking users to confidential self-risk assessments and nearby testing centres under the HIV/AIDS (Prevention and Control) Act, 2017. Outreach extends beyond hospitals to colleges, workplaces, transport hubs, and online spaces via peer educators and Red Ribbon Clubs. In 2025–26, 37.57 lakh people were tested, yielding 11,322 new HIV-positive cases; in early 2026–27, 4.11 lakh tested with 2,057 positives.

triage.headline_ja: カルナタカ州で56,000人以上がHIV感染ステータスを未把握、出会い系アプリが感染追跡の新たな課題に
triage.triage_reason: 既知の慢性感染症であるHIVに関する公衆衛生プログラムの通常報告であり、突発的な公衆衛生上の異常事態には該当しない。
triage.notes: 既存の州保健プログラム(KSAPS)による定期的なHIV対策・啓発活動の報道であり、突発的な感染症危機ではない。継続的な曝露はあるが、EBSのシグナルトリアージ対象としては通常業務範疇。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: England hit by illness scare: Rice isolated from Three Lions stars
article.articleSummary: As of 10 July 2026, England's Declan Rice has been isolated after contracting a bug while already managing hamstring and lower-back issues, prompting FA officials to separate him from the main group ahead of England's World Cup quarter-final with Norway in Miami. Rice has missed two days of training as the illness is assessed as contained. Norway's camp is also affected: goalkeeper Orjan Nyland said the team doctor is very busy amid illness in the squad; two Norwegian players have missed matches, and manager Stale Solbakken has been coughing. Strand Larsen fever and Pedersen absent against Brazil illustrate travel- and facility-related transmission, with air conditioning, flights and changing rooms cited. England beat Mexico 3-2 at the Azteca; Jarell Quansah will miss the Norway game (red card) and Jordan Henderson is out with a wrist injury; Reece James remains doubtful.

triage.headline_ja: イングランド代表に体調不良の懸念:ライスがスリーライオンズの主力選手から隔離される
triage.triage_reason: サッカー選手個人の体調不良（風邪等の軽度感染症）に関する話題であり、公衆衛生上の重大性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。対象国における感染症アウトブレイクでもない。
triage.notes: スポーツ選手の軽度体調不良に関するスポーツ記事であり、公衆衛生上の感染症イベントではない。発生地域として挙げられた国（Brazil含む）はいずれも対象国の感染症アウトブレイクの主題ではなく、サッカーの試合結果や選手の体調に関する記述のみ。

article.articleHeadline: Jumlah Korban Tewas Akibat Ebola di Kongo Bertambah Menjadi 600 Jiwa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola death toll in Kongo has risen to 600.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak update: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola deaths have reached 600, with a total of 1,759 laboratory-confirmed cases nationwide as of July 10, 2026. New suspected infections have emerged in Kisangani, Tshopo Province, a district not previously affected. One of the two suspected cases is linked to the Nia-Nia health zone in Ituri Province, where the outbreak was first detected; the other case has no clear geographic link and is under investigation. The government confirmed the outbreak began on May 15 after weeks of undetected transmission. The current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain for which no vaccine or approved treatment exists. Last week, clinical trials for an Ebola treatment began amid funding shortages, attacks on health centers, and ongoing conflict in eastern DRC, hindering containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ（DRC）でのエボラ死者数、600人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目に該当し、稀な株（ブンディブギョ型）による死者600人・新規地域への拡大が確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 新規感染疑い例が未発生地域であったKisangani（Tshopo州）で報告されており、地理的拡大の兆候。ワクチン・承認された治療法が存在しない稀なブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスによる流行であり、資金不足・医療施設への攻撃・東部紛争が封じ込めを妨げている点にも注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola diễn tiến nhanh chưa từng có
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak progresses at unprecedented speed.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, has 1,759 laboratory-confirmed cases since mid-May, with 600 deaths (34% case-fatality), 285 recoveries, and 304 suspected cases under investigation, according to WHO. The northeastern four-province outbreak is concentrated in Ituri and marks the fastest-spreading Ebola event to date, exceeding early-stage figures from the 2013–2016 West Africa outbreak (1,596 vs 994). Authorities warn transmission is outpacing response, with cases doubling roughly every 28 days. A total of $1.4 billion is sought for outbreak response and humanitarian aid. There is no approved vaccine or therapy for Bundibugyo Ebola. Two potential treatments—MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir—began testing in DR Congo on July 2 to evaluate efficacy.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行、前例のない速さで進行
triage.triage_reason: DRCで1,759例・致死率34%のエボラ流行が過去最速のペースで拡大しており、国際的な対応資金1.4億ドルが要請されるなど深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域に含まれるが、記事本文では言及がなくDRC（イトゥリ州）が主題であるため除外した。承認されたワクチン・治療法が存在しないブンディブギョ株による流行であり、致死率34%と高い。

article.articleHeadline: बारिश के मौसम में बच्‍चों के लिए खतरनाक है ये बीमारियां, आप भी जान लें लक्षण व बचाव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: These diseases are dangerous for children during the monsoon season; learn their symptoms and how to prevent them.
article.articleSummary: Dengue, malaria, chikungunya and other feverish illnesses threaten children during the monsoon in New Delhi, driven by sudden temperature drops, high humidity, and pooled water after rain. Mosquito-borne infections cause rapid body aches, rashes, vomiting and abdominal pain; dengue can involve bleeding and requires urgent medical care. Food- and water-borne infections can also lead to dehydration in infants and children. Flu-like illness typically includes fatigue and fever lasting a week or less; management centers on rest and fluids, with oral rehydration solution (ORS) and, if needed, dal water or chaas. Prevention urged by experts from Motherhood Hospital, Kharghar and Walkhart Hospital’s lead pediatric critical care specialist includes good hygiene, boiled or filtered drinking water, avoiding street food, and keeping kids away from crowded places; use full-sleeve clothing, mosquito repellents, proper footwear, and wash after rain. Regular washing of bedding for allergy prevention.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季に子どもにとって危険な病気とその症状・予防法について
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の一般的な健康啓発記事であり、特定の異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 雨季における一般的な感染症（デング熱、マラリア、チクングニア熱など）の予防啓発記事であり、特定の流行状況やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള: മരണം 600 കടന്നു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Death toll crosses 600
article.articleSummary: More than 600 people have died and over 1,800 tested positive for Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of July 10, 2026. The outbreak began mid-April in the Ituri Province of eastern Congo and has since spread to North Kivu and South Kivu. Health officials face containment challenges as communities resist isolation measures and large gatherings persist. The circulating Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or specific treatment available. This ongoing transmission underscores the urgent need for strict adherence to public health measures, including isolation, contact tracing, and safe burial practices, to curb spread and prevent further escalation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:死者600人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)の大規模流行で死者600人超、感染1800人超、複数州に拡大し封じ込めが困難な状況であり、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しないブンディブギョ株による流行であり、封じ込め困難で複数州(イトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ)に拡大していることから重大な公衆衛生上の脅威と判断。

article.articleHeadline: मानसून में भूलकर भी न करें ये 5 गलतियां, वरना घर में घुस आएगा डेंगू का मच्छर
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: During the monsoon season, do not make these five mistakes, or the dengue-carrying mosquito will enter your home.
article.articleSummary: During India's monsoon season, dengue and chikungunya risk rises due to Aedes mosquitoes breeding in clean standing water around homes. To reduce transmission, the article highlights five common mistakes. First, letting water collect around the house in coolers, plant saucers, buckets, old tires, bottles, or broken items, with weekly cooler water changes and no standing water. Second, leaving water tanks or drums open; keep all containers tightly covered and clean regularly. Third, wearing partial sleeves; mosquitoes are most active in the morning and evening, so wear full-sleeved clothing outdoors and keep children covered. Fourth, neglecting protective measures: use mosquito nets, window screens, repellents, and liquid vaporizers; avoid unnecessary open doors/windows at dusk. Fifth, ignoring early symptoms: high fever, joint and head pain, fatigue, or red rashes require prompt medical evaluation to reduce complications.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン時期にやってはいけない5つの間違い、さもなければデング熱を媒介する蚊が家に侵入する
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱・チクングニア予防に関する一般的な啓発記事であり、具体的な発生状況や異常な増加を示すデータがないため。
triage.notes: インドにおける毎年恒例のモンスーン季節性デング熱・チクングニア予防啓発記事で、具体的な症例数や発生状況の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حصيلة ضحايا إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 625 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to 625 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of July 10, 2026, Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused 625 deaths among 1,792 confirmed infections, with 295 recoveries. The current outbreak began May 15 in eastern DR Congo, centered in Ituri Province, and linked cases and deaths have been reported in neighboring Uganda, signaling cross-border spread. On May 17, the World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for Congo and Uganda, with the regional risk assessed as high. Health authorities continue surveillance and response efforts in affected areas as they monitor the evolving situation across the border and within the implicated counties.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死者数、625人に増加
triage.triage_reason: PHEIC宣言済みのエボラ流行で高致死率、国境を越えたウガンダへの拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。致死率約35%と非常に高く、WHOによりPHEICが既に宣言されている重大事案。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll in Congo reaches 600, as new cases suspected in previously unaffected provinces
article.articleSummary: Two new suspected Ebola cases reported in Congo's Tshopo and Haut-Uele provinces indicate the disease is spreading beyond the Ituri epicenter. Kisangani in Tshopo records two suspected cases, with one linked to the Nia-Nia health zone in Ituri and the other with no apparent geographical connection. Across the country, confirmed Ebola cases total 1,759 and deaths reach 600 as of July 9, 2026. The outbreak, declared May 15, is caused by the Bundibugyo virus, which has no approved vaccine or treatment. The Africa Centre for Disease Control calls it the continent’s fastest-growing Ebola outbreak. Clinical treatment trials began recently amid efforts to contain transmission, while funding gaps, attacks on health centers, and ongoing eastern Congo conflict hamper containment. The epicenter remains Ituri, with spread now reported in Kisangani (Tshopo) and Haut-Uele.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者数が600人に達し、これまで影響を受けていなかった州で新たな症例が疑われる
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ大陸で最も急速に拡大しているエボラアウトブレイクとされ、震源地イトゥリ州を超えてチョポ州・ハウトウエレ州へ拡大が疑われており、ワクチン・治療薬未承認かつ紛争により対応が阻害されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによるアウトブレイクで承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、東部コンゴの武力紛争や資金不足、医療施設への攻撃が封じ込めを困難にしている。震源地イトゥリ州から新たにチョポ州（キサンガニ）およびハウトウエレ州へ拡大の疑いがある点が重大。

article.articleHeadline: Tư vấn sức khỏe: Sốt xuất huyết 'vào mùa', phòng ngừa thế nào?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Advice: Dengue fever is in season—how can it be prevented?
article.articleSummary: Vietnam faces dengue fever in peak season nationwide, with more than 50,000 dengue cases reported in the first six months and several fatalities. Dengue can cause hemorrhage, coagulopathy, and organ injury (including brain, liver, and kidneys) and death if not detected early. To enhance prevention awareness, the VNVC Vaccination System is hosting an online guidance program titled 'Proactive dengue prevention during the peak season' on Friday, July 10, 2026, at 20:00. The program features Dr. Truong Huu Khanh (Vice Chairman, Ho Chi Minh City Infectious Diseases Association), Dr. Bach Thi Chinh (Medical Director, VNVC), and Dr. Nguyen Hoang Anh (Internal Medicine, Tam Anh General Hospital, Ho Chi Minh City). It will be streamed on thanhnien.vn, vnvc.vn, tamanhhospital.vn and affiliated social channels. Readers can follow for guidance or call 028 7102 6595 or visit vnvc.vn to obtain vaccination services.

triage.headline_ja: 健康アドバイス：デング熱が「流行期」に入る―どう予防する？
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで季節性デング熱が流行中で症例数・死者数の報告があるが、本記事は主に予防啓発・オンライン講座の告知であり新規性・異常性は限定的。季節性流行として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は主にデング熱予防に関する啓発イベント告知であり、疫学的な新規情報（新規発生地域や異常な増加率など）は含まれていない。季節性流行の一環として引き続き動向を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: تصل وفيات إيبولا في الكونغو إلى 600؛ حالات جديدة مشتبه بها في منطقة لم تتأثر سابقًا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola deaths in Congo have reached 600; new suspected cases in an area not previously affected.
article.articleSummary: As of July 9, 2026, Congo's Ebola outbreak has reached 600 deaths, with two new suspected cases reported in Kisangani, in Tshopo Province, an area not previously affected. The total confirmed cases across the country now stand at 1,759. One suspected case is linked to the Nia-Nia health zone in Ituri Province, where the first cases were reported; the other case has no clear geographic link to the outbreak and is under investigation. The outbreak, announced on May 15, is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. Clinical trials for a treatment began last week. Containment has been hampered by funding gaps, attacks on health centers, and ongoing conflict in eastern Congo, the outbreak’s epicenter.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者数が600人に到達；これまで影響を受けていなかった地域で新たな疑い症例
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（死者600人、確定1,759例）が拡大し、これまで未発生だった地域（キサンガニ）にも疑い例が発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルス株による流行で、ワクチンや承認された治療法がなく、資金不足・医療施設への攻撃・紛争により封じ込めが困難な状況。新たな疑い症例の一つは既存の流行地域との明確な地理的関連が不明であり、感染拡大経路の解明が急務。

article.articleHeadline: 거창군, 에볼라바이러스병 예방수칙 준수 당부
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Geochang County urges adherence to Ebola virus disease prevention guidelines.
article.articleSummary: Geochang County, South Korea, urges strict adherence to Ebola virus disease prevention amid ongoing international activity. The WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 17 for Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda; France reported its first case on June 24. KDCA has raised the Ebola crisis alert to the 'Attention' level and maintains a dedicated response team. Five African countries—DRC, Uganda, South Sudan, Ethiopia, and Rwanda—are designated focus entry-screening zones with strengthened surveillance, diagnostics, and care readiness. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak worldwide is currently low risk, but travelers should remain cautious. Travelers visiting outbreak countries should avoid contact with wild animals (fruit bats and primates), refrain from attending funeral halls, and wear PPE in medical facilities. After returning, monitor for 21 days and report fever or abdominal pain to 1339 or a local health center before seeking care.

triage.headline_ja: 居昌郡、エボラウイルス病予防指針の遵守を要請
triage.triage_reason: WHOが5月17日にコンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダでのエボラ流行に対しPHEICを宣言し、フランスでも初症例が報告されるなど国際的拡大が確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダでのエボラ流行を発端としたWHO PHEIC宣言と、それに伴う韓国国内の渡航者向け予防対策を報じている。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ（ウガンダ、南スーダン、エチオピア、ルワンダ、フランス、韓国は対象外）。

article.articleHeadline: Rio Branco segue entre capitais com alta de casos de SRAG
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio Branco remains among the capitals with a surge in Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome cases.
article.articleSummary: Rio Branco, Acre, Brazil, shows a surge in Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI) cases, per Fiocruz InfoGripe bulletin issued July 9, 2026. The capital remains in an alert/at-risk/high-risk category with a long-term upward trend, ranking among nine Brazilian capitals alongside Belo Horizonte, Boa Vista, Curitiba, Florianópolis, Goiânia, Manaus, Palmas, and Porto Alegre. The increase is mainly among children and adolescents aged 2–14, with rising occurrences in the elderly. Despite a national reduction in hospitalizations, circulation of respiratory viruses remains elevated in several regions. Emphasis on influenza vaccination is advised for the elderly, young children, pregnant women, and those with comorbidities; masking for symptomatic individuals and limiting contact with vulnerable people are recommended. Over the four most recent epidemiological weeks, RSV accounted for the majority of positive SARI cases, followed by rhinovirus, Influenza A, Influenza B, and COVID-19; Influenza A remains the leading cause of deaths. Since January 2026, Brazil has logged over 109,000 SARI cases, with Rio Branco requiring continued attention.

triage.headline_ja: リオ・ブランコ、重症急性呼吸器症候群（SRAG）症例増加の州都に引き続き該当
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内で季節性の重症急性呼吸器感染症（SARI/SRAG）が複数州都で増加傾向にあるが、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなく、Fiocruzによる定例サーベイランス報告の域を出ないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: RSV、インフルエンザA/B、COVID-19など複数の呼吸器ウイルスが季節性に流行し、特に2〜14歳の小児・青少年で増加が見られる。全国的には入院数は減少傾向だが、複数地域でウイルス circulaiton は依然高水準。インフルエンザAが死亡の主要因とされるが、具体的な死亡者数や重症度データは記事中に明記されていない。

article.articleHeadline: L'épidémie d'Ebola en RDC reste "très active", avec 1.792 cas confirmés (PAPIER GENERAL)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC remains "very active", with 1,792 confirmed cases (GENERAL ARTICLE).
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains very active, with 1,792 confirmed cases, 625 deaths, and 295 recoveries as of 2026-07-10. About 764 patients are in isolation or hospitalised; the global case fatality rate stands at 34.1%. Ituri province, centered on Bunia, is the epicenter, with daily case increases as community-led surveillance detects more patients; a peak will only be identifiable once no undetected cases remain. The effective reproduction number is approximately 1.4, meaning roughly 14 secondary infections from every 10 cases. Only 32% of cases are detected via contact lists, well below the 90% target. Therapeutic progress includes a July 2 clinical trial in DRC of MBP134 and remdesivir, separately and in combination, with expansion planned; a prophylaxis trial with obeldesivir should start next week targeting about 800 high-risk contacts. Movement from Ituri has brought Kisangani (Tshopo) and Wamba (Haut-Uélé) into the response; investigations continue in Tshopo. CDC Africa calls this the fastest progression observed.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行は「非常に活発」なままで、確定症例1,792例
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で大規模に拡大しており（1,792例確定、625名死亡）、実効再生産数が1.4と高く複数州へ拡大、致死率34.1%と深刻でIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: CDC Africaが「最速の進行」と評価。イトゥリ州（ブニア中心）が震源地で、キサンガニ（チョポ州）やワンバ（オートウエレ州）へも拡大。接触者リストによる検出率は32%と目標90%を大きく下回り、封じ込めが困難な状況。MBP134・レムデシビル・オベルデシビルの臨床試験が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Ở chung cư vẫn có thể mắc sốt xuất huyết vì 7 điểm này
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever can still be contracted in apartment buildings because of these seven factors.
article.articleSummary: Seven hidden water sources in apartment buildings enable Aedes aegypti mosquitoes to breed and sustain dengue transmission: air-conditioner drip trays, flower vases, plant-water saucers, balconies, drainage trenches, mop buckets, and fridge condensation trays. After rain, tiny, seemingly clean water accumulations in these spots can harbor larvae, enabling local transmission, as Aedes aegypti bites primarily during the day and can bite multiple people in the same area. A high-rise setting requires awareness since mosquitoes can travel via hallways, elevators, or shared spaces. A simple, weekly 10-minute check can reduce risk: one-minute balcony cleanup; two minutes plant pot and vase cleaning; two minutes bathroom/kitchen; two minutes air-conditioner/fridge drainage; final minute ensure all containers are covered and trash removed. Spraying insecticides only kills adults; larvae remain if water is present, so community-wide larval control is essential. Not every fever is dengue, but vigilance is advised during the rainy season.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Know this danger before crossing water-filled roads in the rain; you could become a victim of leptospirosis.
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis risk rises in Mumbai during the monsoon floods. Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) warns that walking through accumulated rainwater or mud, especially with skin cuts, can lead to infection by Leptospira bacteria. The municipal health department urges residents who have traversed floodwater within 24 to 72 hours to seek medical advice and take prescribed preventive medicines. Free medical consultation, health checks, guidance, and preventive medicines are available at Hindu Hruday Samrat Balasaheb Thackeray Clinic, BMC dispensaries, health centers, and municipal hospitals. To reduce exposure, wear rubber or protective footwear and wash and dry feet promptly after contact with floodwater. Early symptoms may appear 2 days to 4 weeks after infection and include sudden high fever with chills, severe calf pain and headache, red eyes, vomiting, diarrhea, or jaundice. Fever in monsoon could also indicate dengue or malaria; seek doctor’s care rather than self-treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季の冠水した道路を渡る前に知っておくべき危険:レプトスピラ症の被害者になる可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン期にムンバイ市が例年実施しているレプトスピラ症の予防啓発・注意喚起記事であり、異常な集団発生や重症化の急増を示す情報はなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事はBMCによる毎年恒例のモンスーン期公衆衛生アドバイザリーであり、具体的な患者数や異常な増加は報告されていない。デング熱・マラリアにも言及があるが、いずれも季節性の一般的注意喚起に留まる。

article.articleHeadline: Campanha Julho Amarelo reforça o combate às hepatites virais em todo o país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yellow July Campaign Reinforces the Fight Against Viral Hepatitis Across the Country
article.articleSummary: Brazil launches the nationwide July Yellow Campaign (Julho Amarelo) to surveil, prevent, and control viral hepatitis across the country. It focuses on Hepatitis A (fecal-oral transmission through contaminated water/food), Hepatitis B (blood, unprotected sex, or mother-to-child transmission), and Hepatitis C (primarily bloodborne). Millions in Brazil are carriers of HBV or HCV, many asymptomatic until advanced liver disease. The campaign emphasizes early diagnosis with free SUS rapid tests yielding results in about 30 minutes from a finger-prick, and underscores treatment advances: Hepatitis C now cures in over 95% of cases with oral therapies (~12 weeks), while Hepatitis B can be effectively treated to halt progression. Vaccination against Hepatitis B is part of routine immunization; Hepatitis A vaccination targets children and high-risk groups. The WHO 2030 elimination target frames Brazil as a reference in hepatitis care, highlighting prevention, testing, and treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 「イエロー・ジュライ」キャンペーン、全国でウイルス性肝炎対策を強化

article.articleHeadline: Sewage pollution, disease caused Panzath spring fish deaths: SKUAST-K
article.articleSummary: As of 10 July 2026, severe sewage contamination degrades water quality at Panzath springs (Panzath Nag) in Qazigund, Anantnag, triggering ecological stress, oxygen depletion, and disease in the indigenous Schizothorax and mass fish mortality. SKUAST-K Rangil campus investigators collected water and fish samples, finding deteriorated physico-chemical conditions and stress making fish vulnerable to opportunistic bacterial and fungal infections; analyses confirmed water quality decline and ecological strain. The report attributes pollution to sewage discharge, siltation, and other effluents entering the spring, and urges stopping waste inflow, relocating exposed Public Health Engineering (PHE) pipelines, and improving spring management to curb algal blooms, weed growth, and stagnation. Treatments included potassium permanganate and benzalkonium chloride, plus de-weeding and cleaning, with the matter referred to the National Surveillance Programme for Aquatic Animal Diseases. This is Kashmir’s sixth mass fish mortality in six months, with prior events at Nagbal, Andernag (Anantnag), Chamgund (Kulgam), Zainapora (Shopian), Beehama (Ganderbal), and Martand (Mattan).

article.articleHeadline: Anh ghi nhận ca tử vong đầu tiên ở người lớn do mắc bệnh sởi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UK reports first adult death from measles.
article.articleSummary: England reports its first adult measles death. UKHSA says 883 measles cases in England as of 6 July, up 16% from a month earlier, with London 52%, West Midlands 17%, North West 10%; most patients are 10 or younger. The adult fatality occurred in an immunocompromised person; two child deaths occurred in June. The rise follows waning vaccination uptake; WHO in January 2026 said the UK had not sustained measles elimination due to stagnating vaccine coverage and rising cases. NHS launched a catch-up MMR campaign for 2–11-year-olds with incomplete doses, aiming to contact about one million families missing one or both doses. In Q1, 84.1% of five-year-olds had two MMR doses, though coverage varies by age and region. Separately, WHO on July 3 reported Ebola Bundibugyo virus circulating in the DRC, spreading to new health zones.

triage.triage_reason: 記事本文中でWHOがDRCにおけるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の新たな保健地域への拡大を報告しており、国際的拡大リスクや重症度の観点から見送れない内容を含む。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda ebola outbreak under control - Africa CDC
article.articleSummary: Uganda has declared the Ebola outbreak under control, with the last confirmed case reported on June 21, according to Africa CDC. Authorities credited a prompt, capable response, border screening for arrivals from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), and strong surveillance, testing, and case management. Across Uganda and the DRC, the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak has surpassed 600 deaths, with a cumulative 1,779 confirmed cases and 302 recoveries. DRC alone recorded 353 confirmed cases in the past week, a 25% increase, underscoring a rapidly evolving outbreak that health experts say remains ahead of response. Critical gaps include financing, limited safe burial capacity, and infections among healthcare workers (112 infected; 35 dead) in the DRC. Positive signs include lab testing capacity rising to more than 2,000 tests per day, reflecting improvements in diagnostics and surveillance.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confirmed Ebola cases in Congo rise to 1,792 - Urdu Point.
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa — Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have climbed to 1,792 laboratory-confirmed cases, with 625 deaths, according to government data released on Thursday. The figures, current as of July 10, 2026, underscore the continuation of a sustained Ebola outbreak in the country and a substantial fatality burden despite public health efforts. The brief provides no regional breakdown or methodological details beyond noting laboratory-confirmed cases. The update from the DRC's health authorities comes as officials continue surveillance and response activities across affected areas. These numbers reflect the current scale of the outbreak within the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll in Congo reaches 600
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo: As of July 9, 2026, the government reports a death toll of 600 and 1,759 confirmed Ebola cases nationwide. Two new suspected cases were reported in Kisangani, in the Tshopo province, where cases had not been recorded previously. Kinshasa's update, published late on July 9, notes no details on laboratory confirmation for the two suspected cases. The situation indicates continued transmission across multiple provinces with ongoing surveillance and contact exposure investigations. The report underscores the expanding geographic footprint of the outbreak, highlighting Kisangani as a newly affected area while the overall outbreak remains active in Congo.

article.articleHeadline: Rejection and fatigue: Healthcare workers report from the Ebola frontlines - CARE
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak persists in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with transmission across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces. CARE reports frontline fatigue among health workers and rising community resistance, mistrust, and misinformation hindering outreach. CARE has deployed more than 500 trained community health workers, reaching over 210,000 people in North Kivu and Ituri, but funding cuts weaken the health system and humanitarian response. In Sake, a key transit hub linking Goma, Bukavu, Walikale, Rutshuru, and Lubero, population movement raises the risk of spread. Frontline teams face skepticism that Ebola remains a threat, and some households deny entry or accuse workers of profiteering. Preventive measures—handwashing, reduced contact, and symptom reporting—remain central, while border controls along the DRC-Rwanda frontier add economic pressure. CARE calls for immediate financial and technical support to strengthen the response.

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC: dịch Ebola đang lan nhanh nhất từ trước đến nay
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa CDC: The Ebola outbreak is spreading faster than ever before.
article.articleSummary: Africa CDC reports that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading faster than ever before. WHO data show 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths since mid-May, yielding a case fatality rate of about 34%. The current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus, a rare strain for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. Wessam Mankoula, head of preparedness and emergency response at Africa CDC, described it as the fastest Ebola spread to date—surpassing prior Bundibugyo outbreaks and all other Ebola strains. Officials warn that the rapid transmission rate is outpacing response and resource deployment, underscoring a critical public health emergency.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC：エボラ流行、過去最速のスピードで拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCでBundibugyo型エボラが過去最速で拡大し、致死率約34%、ワクチン・治療薬未承認という深刻な公衆衛生上の緊急事態であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 希少株Bundibugyoによる流行で、ワクチン・治療薬が未承認である点が特に懸念される。致死率34%、症例数1,759、死者600人と規模も大きく、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Namakkal bird sanctuary faces opposition over biosecurity threat
article.articleSummary: Opposition to a proposed bird sanctuary at Idumbankulam in Mohanur taluk, Namakkal district, centers on a perceived biosecurity threat to the district’s Rs 10,000-crore poultry industry and the livelihoods of lakhs. A petition submitted on July 9 to the Namakkal district administration warns that turning the area into sanctuary habitats and plantings could attract migratory wild birds from across India and abroad, heightening disease transmission risks to nearby commercial poultry farms. The primary concern is avian influenza; even a single outbreak could trigger mass culling, large-scale losses for thousands of farmers, disruption of egg exports, and widespread job losses across the poultry value chain. PV Senthil, president of the Namakkal East District Congress Committee, highlighted these potential economic and public health impacts.
