article.articleHeadline: Лихорадка Эбола распространилась еще на две провинции ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola fever has spread to two more provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Two more provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo—Chopo and Upper Uele—have been added to the list of areas affected by the Ebola outbreak, with two confirmed cases in each province, according to Health Minister Roger Kamba. The newly affected territories join Ituri and North Kivu, where transmission is described as being in the acute phase. Since it began in early May in the DRC and Uganda, the outbreak has killed about 625 people and left roughly 1,800 affected. Officials attribute the spread to the Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no vaccines or treatments. The government continues surveillance and case confirmations as the epidemic expands geographically within the DRC, underscoring the ongoing public health challenge and the need for a robust response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国のさらに2州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC国内で新たに2州へ拡大し、死者約625人・感染者約1800人に達しており、ワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョ株による流行で公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として挙げられているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事では新たにChopo（Tshopo）とUpper Uele州が追加され、既存のIturi・North Kivuと合わせ拡大中。ワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョ株のため致死率・拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Nhiều trẻ vẫn mắc viêm não Nhật Bản vì bỏ quên mũi tiêm nhắc
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Many children still contract Japanese encephalitis because they forget their booster shot
article.articleSummary: Japanese encephalitis persists in Vietnam, where vaccination transformed the epidemiology: before immunization, 2,000–3,000 cases annually; 1985 nearly 5,000; 1995 JE accounted for about 61% of viral encephalitis. Cases have fallen to roughly 100–200 per year, but infections still occur in people who are unvaccinated, incompletely vaccinated, or who miss booster doses. Immunity can wane over time, so boosters are essential. Under the Expanded Immunization Program, children receive three basic doses: first at age one, second 1–2 weeks later, third one year after the second, with boosters every 3–5 years until age 15. The World Health Organization and Vietnamese preventive medicine groups now advocate boosters using the newer-generation JE vaccine, which is grown in Vero cells, pasteurized to remove mouse brain proteins, safer and more protective. For children, two basic doses may suffice with this vaccine, and protection is longer-lasting. Emphasize mosquito bite prevention, bed nets, sanitation, especially May–September.

triage.headline_ja: 多くの子どもが追加接種を忘れて日本脳炎に罹患し続けている
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで従来から知られている日本脳炎の流行状況とワクチン接種率の課題に関する定例的な公衆衛生報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 既知の風土病であり、ワクチン接種の重要性を啓発する内容の記事。年間100〜200例程度で推移しており、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威ではない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC: Nizi, une zone minée par l'insécurité où la progression d'Ebola est la plus rapide
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Nizi, a region plagued by insecurity where Ebola is spreading fastest.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province is spreading fastest in the Nizi health zone near Bunia. The latest toll stands at 1,792 confirmed cases and 625 deaths, with Africa CDC noting this outbreak as faster-growing than previous ones. Nizi is currently the fastest-progressing area within Ituri; nine Ebola-related deaths were recorded at Ituri treatment centers last Tuesday, four in Nizi—the highest for any single center in the province, ahead of Bunia with two. A late-June mission by the International Organization for Migration recommended strengthening community-based surveillance and expanding interventions across several sectors, including training of community health workers. Nizi is among Ituri’s five most affected health zones—Bunia, Rwampara, Mongbwalu, Nyankunde, and Nizi—together accounting for about 84% of province cases and over 76% of national cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：治安不安に苛まれるニジ地域、エボラ拡大が最速
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で1,792例・625人死亡という大規模エボラ流行が継続中で、過去の流行より拡大速度が速いと指摘されており、治安不安により対応が困難な状況にあるため。
triage.notes: Africa CDCが過去の流行より拡大速度が速いと指摘。治安不安（insécurité）が対応の障害となっており、国際移住機関（IOM）がコミュニティベースの監視強化を勧告している。ルワンダは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事本文では具体的な症例発生地としては言及されていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Roundup: DRC says Ebola outbreak yet to peak as virus spreads to new areas
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak remains in a 'very active' phase in Bunia, Ituri Province, with 1,792 confirmed cases, 625 deaths and 295 recoveries; 764 patients are in isolation or hospital care. Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba says the increase reflects expanded community surveillance and mobilized resources, not a sudden surge, while identifying undetected cases and engagement challenges hinder containment. Infections have been carried into Kisangani (Tshopo Province) and Wamba (Haut-Uele Province), with investigations in Tshopo ongoing as authorities widen the response perimeter and caution about broader geographic spread. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo Ebola virus. Africa CDC notes therapeutic research: MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir, tested alone and in combination, began July 2 at one center and will expand. A separate obeldesivir prophylaxis trial for about 800 high-risk contacts is set to start next week.

triage.headline_ja: まとめ:DRCがエボラ出血熱の流行はまだピークに達していないと発表、ウイルスは新たな地域へ拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱の大規模流行(確定1,792例、死亡625例)が継続し、複数州へ地理的拡大が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる流行。Ituri州Buniaを中心に、Tshopo州Kisangani、Haut-Uele州Wambaへ感染が拡大。Africa CDCによる治療薬・予防薬の臨床試験も進行中。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉疫情仍处于"非常活跃"阶段
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains in a very active phase.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains in a very active phase with no clear peak, per Health Minister Kamba. As of July 9, 2026, the cumulative totals are 1,792 confirmed cases, 625 deaths, and 295 recoveries. Expanded involvement of community health workers is increasing case detection in densely populated, highly mobile areas, complicating control efforts and hindering peak prediction. Africa CDC expert Mankula called this outbreak the fastest-spreading Ebola event on record, outpacing response capacity. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo ebolavirus currently. A clinical trial began July 2, 2026 in the DRC to evaluate potential therapies, including MBP134 monoclonal antibody and the antiviral remdesivir, used alone or in combination.

triage.headline_ja: 刚果（金）エボラ疫情、依然として「非常に活発な」段階にある
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス流行が急速拡大し、承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しないなど公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な状況であり、国際的拡大リスクも高いためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 史上最速の拡大と評されるエボラ流行で、承認ワクチン・治療薬なし。臨床試験が開始されたばかりであり、今後の推移を継続的に監視すべき重大事案。

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Covid death reported in AP's Kadapa district
article.articleSummary: Suspected Covid-19 death reported in Kadapa district, Andhra Pradesh. A 46-year-old man admitted to Government General Hospital–RIMS in Kadapa on July 4 with symptoms resembling Covid-19 and developed severe bilateral lung infections. Despite four days of intensive treatment, he died. He was a resident of Masapeta, Kadapa. Doctors suspect coronavirus infection given pulmonary severity. Biological samples have been sent to the National Institute of Virology (NIV), Pune, for definitive cause; authorities say a formal conclusion will follow the virology report. The patient had a history of heavy alcohol consumption, which may have worsened respiratory condition. The infection source and transmission details are not disclosed. No confirmation yet; awaiting NIV results as of 10 July 2026.

triage.headline_ja: アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州カダパ県でCOVID-19感染が疑われる死亡例を報告
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19感染が疑われる単発の死亡例であり、NIVによる確定診断待ちのため、現時点では感染拡大や異常性を示す情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 疾患タグにNipahが含まれているが、記事サマリー中にNipahに関する言及は一切なく、誤タグの可能性が高い。単一の疑い死亡例であり、感染源・伝播経路も不明。NIVの確定結果待ちのため続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Asian doctors seek wider, more proactive TB testing
article.articleSummary: Indonesia accounts for 10% of global TB cases, with 382.2 per 100,000 population in 2024 and 125,625 TB deaths that year (up from 115,204 in 2014). Pakistan accounts for 6.3% of global TB cases, with 266.1 per 100,000 in 2024 and 51,716 TB deaths in 2024 (down from 53,563 in 2014). At the APAC-IRIDS symposium in Bangkok, Universitas Indonesia professor Erlina Burhan urged expanding access to new TB diagnostics and treatments in low- and middle-income countries, noting technologies are concentrated in rich nations. Pakistani epidemiologist Razia Fatima called for shifting from reactive TB control to elimination, emphasizing prevention and equitable diagnostic access. The WHO End TB Strategy aims to cut TB incidence by 80% and TB deaths by 90%, highlighting at-risk groups such as household contacts of active cases, children under five, people with HIV, immunosuppressed individuals, those with diabetes or undernutrition, and tobacco exposure.

triage.headline_ja: アジアの医師ら、TB(結核)検査の拡充とより積極的な検査を求める
triage.triage_reason: 既知の流行性疾患（結核）に関する統計データと専門家による政策提言・アドボカシー記事であり、急性の異常発生や新規シグナルではないため。
triage.notes: 本記事はAPAC-IRIDSシンポジウム（バンコク開催）における結核対策・診断アクセス拡充を求める専門家提言であり、突発的な感染症アウトブレイクではない。インドネシアとパキスタンの既知の結核統計データが引用されているが、パキスタンは対象国リスト外。タイは開催地のみで発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de Ebola no Congo "tem propagação mais rápida já registrada"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo "has the fastest spread ever recorded"
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak spreading faster than any previously recorded, according to Africa CDC. Wessam Mankoula notes the virus is advancing more quickly than the response and resources can be mobilized. As of July 7, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reported 1,759 cases and 600 deaths (per WHO). The eastern epicenter continues to see rising new cases, with estimates that the caseload could double every 28 days. Uganda, a neighboring country, remains stable. The outbreak was declared on May 15 and is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC to date. Across Africa, Ebola has caused over 15,000 deaths in the last 50 years; the DRC’s 2018–2020 epidemic alone killed about 2,300. There is no approved treatment or vaccine for this variant; a two-treatment clinical trial began on July 2.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行「過去最速のスピードで拡大」
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRCで過去最速の速度で拡大しており、症例数・死亡者数ともに深刻で、国際的拡大リスクや対応資源不足が指摘されているため。
triage.notes: 承認された治療薬・ワクチンがない変異株であり、症例倍加が28日ごとと推定されるなど拡大速度が非常に速い。ウガンダは安定と記載されているため含めず。

article.articleHeadline: आंध्र प्रदेश में कोरोना से दो लोगों की मौत, 4 पाए गए पॉजिटिव; आखिरी बार कोविड ने कब ली थी जान?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two people died of coronavirus in Andhra Pradesh; four tested positive; when did COVID-19 last claim a life?
article.articleSummary: In Kadapa district, Andhra Pradesh, four new COVID-19 cases were confirmed via RT-PCR and two deaths were reported, the first fatalities in the state since 2022 (four years after the last Andhra Pradesh death). The four infections are from different areas; three are in home isolation and one with mild symptoms is hospitalized in Kadapa. All four had received two vaccine doses, with one patient having a booster. The two deceased include a 60-year-old man who died on 28 June after transfer from SVIMS Tirupati to CMC Vellore, with diabetes and kidney disease; RT-PCR was positive. The second death involves a 43-year-old man with infection confirmed by RT-PCR and CT scan; his prior health records were not available. Samples have been sent to NIV Pune for genome sequencing to identify the variant, with Omicron suspected. Health officials heightened surveillance in the district."

triage.headline_ja: アンドラ・プラデーシュ州でコロナウイルスにより2人死亡、4人が陽性反応；州内で最後にコロナが死者を出したのはいつか？
triage.triage_reason: 小規模なCOVID-19クラスター（4例・2死亡）で基礎疾患を有する患者の死亡例であり、現時点で異常な重症度や国際的拡大の兆候はないが、変異株同定のための遺伝子解析結果待ちのため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 死亡例2件はいずれも基礎疾患（糖尿病・腎疾患等）を有する患者であり、COVID-19自体の重症度上昇を示す明確な証拠はない。NIV Puneでのゲノム解析結果（Omicron疑い）待ちで続報を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: 清积水 灭蚊虫 织密登革热防控网_区县（市）_长沙站
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Clear standing water, eliminate mosquitoes and insects, tighten the dengue fever prevention and control network — Districts and Counties (Cities) — Changsha Station
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever prevention efforts are underway in Changsha, China (Furong District, MaPoLing Street, XiLong Village within XiLongyuan Community) as of July 2026. The campaign involves grid workers who conduct carpet-like inspections around buildings, green belts, and sanitation blind spots to remove mosquitoes breeding sites, including flowerpot trays, abandoned water barrels, and discarded tires. For persistent hidden water in drainage ditches and sewers, larvicides are applied according to guidelines, and public areas receive targeted mosquito control. In parallel, outreach staff distribute pamphlets, answer questions, and promote the slogan 'no standing water equals no mosquitoes, no dengue,' via home visits, online reminders, and nighttime public announcements to reach migrant workers. The initiative will continue with a multi-channel, day-night publicity matrix and regular vector control to strengthen the dengue prevention network and reduce transmission risk in the community.

triage.headline_ja: 清潔な水たまりの除去と蚊の駆除、デング熱予防管理網の強化 ― 区県（市）― 長沙駅
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は長沙市における日常的なデング熱予防活動（蚊の繁殖地除去、殺虫剤散布、住民啓発）を報じるものであり、実際の症例発生や異常な流行を示す情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性のデング熱予防・蚊対策キャンペーンについての行政広報であり、具体的な症例数や感染拡大の兆候は記載されていない。地方政府による通常の公衆衛生活動と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Bilaspur Swine Flu: बिलासपुर में स्वाइन फ्लू की दस्तक! संदिग्ध मरीज को एयर एंबुलेंस से भेजा गया हैदराबाद | Suspected Swine Flu Patient Found In Bilaspur
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bilaspur Swine Flu: Swine Flu Hits Bilaspur! A Suspected Patient Was Airlifted to Hyderabad | Suspected Swine Flu Patient Found in Bilaspur
article.articleSummary: On 10 July 2026, Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh reported a suspected H1N1 influenza case. A 54-year-old man, who had recently returned from Kolkata, was admitted to Apollo Hospital Bilaspur after sudden health deterioration. He presents with severe pneumonia in both lungs and suspected H1N1 infection. A sample has been sent to AIIMS for laboratory confirmation. The health department has been alerted and is on alert while awaiting definitive test results. The report identifies the situation as a suspected Swine Flu case detected in Bilaspur, with diagnosis pending.

triage.headline_ja: ビラースプルで豚インフルエンザ発生か！疑い患者はハイデラバードへ空輸
triage.triage_reason: 単一の疑い症例で検査結果待ちであり、季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の散発例の可能性が高いが、重症肺炎を呈しているため続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザの一種として既知の病原体であり、単発の疑い症例であるため現時点でPICKUPには該当しない。検査確定結果と関連症例の有無を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: مركز أفريقي: إيبولا في الكونغو الأسرع انتشارا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African Center: Ebola in Congo—the fastest-spreading
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is the fastest-spreading on record, with 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths reported by WHO updates, yielding a case-fatality rate around 34%. The four-province outbreak is centered in Ituri in the northeast, with spread across the region. It is caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there are no licensed vaccines or approved treatments. The African CDC regional director described it as the fastest Ebola outbreak ever among all strains. Neighboring Uganda has reported two deaths and 17 recoveries among 20 confirmed cases, suggesting cross-border transmission. WHO officials say the true size of the outbreak remains not fully determined, and the event began in mid-May. Continuous public health measures are needed to curb transmission across borders and affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC：コンゴのエボラは史上最速の拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最速とされるエボラ流行（1,759症例、600人死亡、CFR約34%）が発生し、ウガンダへの越境感染も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境感染（20症例、2死亡）が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。ワクチン・治療薬未承認のBundibugyoエボラウイルス株による流行で、WHOも真の規模を把握できていないと述べている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Multi-centric study to contain antimicrobial resistant neonatal sepsis begins in India
article.articleSummary: NeoSep1, a multi-centric trial tackling antimicrobial-resistant neonatal sepsis, has expanded to India (first enrolment at JIPMER, Puducherry; followed by Pt. B.D. Sharma PGIMS, Rohtak; Lokmanya Tilak Municipal Hospital, Mumbai planned). Globally, the study includes Vietnam and Pakistan with plans for Malaysia, Bangladesh, and Uganda; earlier sites were Ghana, Kenya, and South Africa. The goal is to enroll 3,000 newborns across Asia and Africa by end-2028. Neonatal sepsis is a life-threatening bloodstream infection in babies under 90 days, with early-onset within 72 hours and late-onset up to 28–90 days. In India, sepsis accounts for about 30–40% of neonatal deaths, estimated at 200,000–250,000 preventable deaths annually. Indian etiologies show Gram-negative predominance (Klebsiella pneumoniae, Escherichia coli, Acinetobacter, Pseudomonas), while Group B Streptococcus accounts for 2–5%. The PRACTical design ranks regimens; primary outcome is death within 28 days, with secondary outcomes including 90-day mortality, additional antibiotics, length of stay, and readmission; cultures guide organism ID and resistance.

triage.headline_ja: インドで薬剤耐性新生児敗血症対策のための多施設共同研究が開始
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は急性の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、薬剤耐性新生児敗血症に関する多施設共同臨床研究（NeoSep1）の開始を報じる内容であり、シグナルとして扱う根拠に乏しい。
triage.notes: 本記事は既存の新生児敗血症（薬剤耐性含む）の疫学的負担を背景とした研究プロジェクトの拡大報告であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: phơi nhiễm HIV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HIV exposure
article.articleSummary: Vietnam's National Assembly approved amendments to the HIV/AIDS Prevention and Control Law. The reform enables individuals aged 15 and older with civil capacity to request HIV testing on a voluntary basis. It also obligates those with a positive HIV test result to promptly inform their spouse, fiancé/fiancée, or cohabiting partner of the outcome. The provisions emphasize voluntary testing, partner notification, and transmission prevention, while the article notes no mention of compulsory testing or penalties. The changes focus on informed consent, responsibility, and communication within intimate relationships to bolster public health goals in Vietnam.

triage.headline_ja: HIV曝露
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はHIV/AIDS予防管理法の法改正に関する内容であり、急性の公衆衛生イベントや異常な発生を報告するものではないため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 法改正に関する報道であり、疾病アウトブレイクの探知シグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: बरसात में पशुपालक रहें अलर्ट, जानें खुरपका-मुंहपका के लक्षण और बचाव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: During the monsoon, livestock owners should stay alert; learn the symptoms and prevention of foot-and-mouth disease.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD), a highly contagious viral disease of cloven-hooved livestock (cattle, buffalo, goats and sheep), threatens farmers in Lakhimpur Kheri district, Uttar Pradesh, during the monsoon. Affected animals develop blisters in the mouth, tongue and hooves, along with high fever, excessive drooling, reduced appetite, and lameness, leading to lower milk production and diminished work capacity. Prevention hinges on timely vaccination, plus strict hygiene, dry shelters, avoidance of waterlogging, and isolation of infected animals. Ensure balanced nutrition and clean water. If symptoms appear, farmers should consult a veterinarian without delay to mitigate impact. The article emphasizes heightened vigilance in the rainy season to safeguard animal health and farm income in this region.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン期には家畜農家は警戒を、口蹄疫の症状と予防法を知ろう
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫は家畜のみに影響する動物疾患であり、本記事は特定の発生報告ではなく季節性の一般啓発・予防情報であるため、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定の発生事例の報告ではなく、家畜衛生に関する一般的な季節性注意喚起記事であり、人獣共通感染症としてのヒトへの影響についても言及がない。

article.articleHeadline: Ninth HIV-positive inmate detected at Jharpada special jail
article.articleSummary: As of 10 July 2026, nine HIV-positive prisoners are at Jharpada Special Jail in Bhubaneswar, Odisha. The ninth inmate—lodged by court from Khandagiri police in a theft case—tested HIV positive during routine intake medical examination. He was isolated and placed on treatment and under observation. Jail authorities are implementing measures to prevent disease spread, including mandatory medical examinations for new admissions and ongoing monitoring of HIV-infected inmates, who are reported to receive appropriate treatment. Routine checks aim to prevent communicable diseases among prisoners. The infection source remains unclarified, and no symptom details are provided beyond this surveillance. No further transmission details or outcomes are described.

triage.headline_ja: ジャルパダ特別刑務所で9人目のHIV陽性受刑者が確認される
triage.triage_reason: 既知の疾患であるHIVの個別症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められず、社会的関心も限定的である。
triage.notes: HIVは既知の慢性感染症で、刑務所内の日常的な健康診断による個別症例の発見報告。IHR/WPRO基準に該当せず、対象国リストの疾患監視シグナルとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго число жертв вспышки Эболы достигло 625 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the number of Ebola outbreak victims reached 625.
article.articleSummary: As of 10 July 2026, the Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 1,792 confirmed cases and 625 deaths. The situation remains under control in three provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, which together include 37 health zones (25 in Ituri, 11 in North Kivu, 1 in South Kivu). There are 764 patients in isolation or under treatment, and 295 have recovered. Contact tracing continues, with 78.6% of identified contacts under surveillance. In recent days, Ituri and North Kivu recorded 10 additional recoveries. Two suspected cases are under investigation in Kisangani, in Tshopo Province. Authorities emphasize ongoing outbreak monitoring and public health response across these regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の死者数が625人に達する
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認症例1,792件、死亡625人に達する大規模エボラ出血熱流行が複数州にわたり継続しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 接触者追跡は78.6%にとどまり完全な封じ込めには至っていない。キサンガニ（チョポ州）での疑い例2件は流行地域の拡大可能性を示唆しており、続報の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 赖斯确诊病毒感染被单独隔离，英格兰队多人伤、停，挪威队同样"队医很忙
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rice diagnosed with a viral infection and placed in isolation; England's squad plagued by injuries and suspensions; Norway's squad likewise "team doctors are very busy"
article.articleSummary: England’s World Cup squad faces a viral infection ahead of the July 12 quarterfinal against Norway in Miami, with Declan Rice diagnosed with a viral illness and isolated; Rice has missed two days of training and his participation is doubtful. England also grapples with suspensions and injuries: Aaron Wan-Bissaka is suspended after a red card against Mexico; Jordan Henderson fractured his wrist and remains in Mexico City; Reece James’s return is uncertain. Norway reports widespread coughs and fatigue; goalkeeper Ørjan Nyland confirms several players unwell, with team doctors extremely busy. Since arriving in North America, Norway has travelled Boston, New Jersey, Dallas, and played Brazil in New Jersey; travel-related fatigue is noted as a contributing factor.

triage.headline_ja: ライスがウイルス感染と診断され隔離、イングランド代表は負傷者・出場停止者続出、ノルウェー代表も『チームドクターは大忙し』
triage.triage_reason: サッカー選手個人の体調不良（ウイルス性感染症）に関する記事であり、公衆衛生上の脅威や国際的拡大の懸念を示す情報がなく、対象国（GeoNamesリスト）での発生でもない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola is 'fastest growing ever'
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is the fastest-growing on record, with the World Health Organization reporting 600 deaths. UN figures show 1,759 confirmed cases since mid-May, all within DR Congo, including 600 deaths. Wessam Mankoula of the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention called it the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak ever, surpassing Bundibugyo outbreaks and other Ebola virus variants. The update highlights rapid transmission and rising mortality as authorities intensify the response, with no other countries cited in this brief. Laboratory confirmation is referenced only by the term confirmed cases, and details on infection sources or imported/exported cases are not provided. Data are current as of 2026-07-10.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、「史上最速の拡大」
triage.triage_reason: WHO・アフリカCDCが史上最速拡大と表現するエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで、1,759例確診・600人死亡と重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 致死率は600/1759で約34%と高い。感染源や国境を越えた症例の詳細は不明であり、続報での確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 一家四口疑携带病毒乘机入境，涉事航司：已消杀；当地疾控回应
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A family of four suspected of carrying a virus on a flight into the country; the airline involved says disinfection has been carried out; local CDC responds.
article.articleSummary: A family of four returning from Macau is suspected of carrying a virus on a flight into Shanghai on July 3. The four reportedly had fever during their Macau medical visit; after landing, they were found to have multiple viral infections in hospital. On the flight, the younger brother had diarrhea, with excreta contaminating seat cushions, blankets, and pillows. Customs authorities intercepted the case, conducted on-site checks, and notified the airline to take sanitary action. The airline stated it disinfected the aircraft and that the flight complied with national entry-exit health quarantine standards, with no reported impact on subsequent flights. Shanghai Baoshan District Center for Disease Control and Prevention suggested symptoms could stem from foodborne illness and, without vomiting or exposure, would unlikely trigger large-scale transmission. Information sources include Elephant News, LiZhi News, Jinan Daily, and Dahe Daily.

triage.headline_ja: 一家四口が病原体を保有した疑いで航空機で入国、関係航空会社は「消毒済み」、地元疾病予防管理センターが回答
triage.triage_reason: 単一家族内での散発的な感染症状であり、現地CDCも大規模感染の可能性は低いとしている。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 家族4人の食中毒性疾患の疑いで、地元CDCは食品由来の可能性を示唆し大規模感染の懸念は低いと評価。中国国内メディアでの報道により一定の社会的関心はあるが、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: UN Relief Chief Urges Faster Global Action to Stop Ebola's Spread in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is no longer confined to Ituri; transmission spreads across provinces amid conflict and population movement. Since the May 15 declaration, infections exceed 1,700 with about 600 deaths. The DRC Ministry reports 1,792 cases and 625 deaths; 764 patients are in isolation or hospitalized, and 295 have recovered (case fatality rate 34.1%). Uganda reports 20 linked cases. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, for which no approved vaccine exists; trials of an antibody treatment and an antiviral began in early July. Nearly seven million people are internally displaced, hindering containment amid armed group activity and cross-border movement. UN actions include releasing up to $60 million from CERF and deploying a Senior Ebola Coordinator, seeking safe access and rapid funding. Imported/exported cases include a France-linked case and a US citizen treated in Germany; the US has entry screening for travelers from DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan. As of 10 July 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 国連人道問題担当事務次長、コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ拡大阻止に向けた迅速な国際対応を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）が複数州に拡大し、致死率34.1%、700万人の国内避難民、国際的な輸出症例・渡航制限も発生しておりIHR基準を複数満たす。

article.articleHeadline: 103 Kasus TBC di Boltara Sulut, Dinkes: Obat Gratis di Puskesmas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 103 TB Cases in Boltara, North Sulawesi; Health Office: Free Medications at Community Health Centers
article.articleSummary: As of June 2026, Bolaang Mongondow Utara (Boltara), North Sulawesi, Indonesia, reports 103 tuberculosis (TB) cases. TB is caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis and spreads via airborne droplets when patients cough, sneeze, speak, or spit. Predominant symptoms include a cough for about two weeks, prolonged fever, weight loss, night sweats, and coughing up blood. TB is curable with regular, complete treatment for at least six months; patients should not discontinue meds until a doctor declares recovery. Free TB medications are available at local health centers (Puskesmas). Case distribution by district within Boltara: Pinogaluman 13, Kaidipang 16, Bolangitang Barat 33, Bolangitang Timur 22, Bintauna 12, Sangkub 7. Health officials emphasize early testing to enable rapid treatment and reduce transmission. Key terms: TB, North Sulawesi, free medication, Puskesmas, airborne transmission, six-month therapy.

triage.headline_ja: 北スラウェシ・ボルタラでTB103例、保健局:保健所で無料投薬
triage.triage_reason: 結核はインドネシアで流行している既知の風土病であり、通常の症例報告であって異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の風土病であり、地域保健当局が通常業務として対応しているルーチン報告。

article.articleHeadline: आंध्र प्रदेश में कोविड-19 से एक व्यक्ति की मौत - dainiktribuneonline.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One person dies from COVID-19 in Andhra Pradesh - dainiktribuneonline.com
article.articleSummary: In Kadappa district, Andhra Pradesh, a 46-year-old man with a history of alcohol use disorder died of COVID-19 after four days of high-dose antibiotics failed to improve his condition. He was admitted with severe breathing difficulty and cough; chest X-ray showed extensive bilateral lung damage with pneumonia. Despite ongoing antibiotic therapy, clinicians suspected COVID-19, and a chest CT scan subsequently confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection. This case highlights the ongoing risk of severe COVID-19 in adults and potential rapid deterioration even with antibacterial treatment. No further details on exposure or travel are provided. The report records one COVID-19 death in Andhra Pradesh as of 2026-07-09.

article.articleHeadline: 一家四口疑携带病毒乘机入境 引发公共卫生担忧
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A family of four suspected of carrying a virus boarded a flight to enter the country, triggering public health concerns.
article.articleSummary: Four-member family suspected of carrying a virus boarded a flight into China, prompting public health concerns. The family reportedly developed fever during a Macau trip; local hospitals said the case required reporting, and they then flew to Shanghai the next day. On the flight, the younger brother had persistent diarrhea, with potential contamination of seat cushions, blankets and pillows. After arrival, Shanghai hospitals diagnosed infections with multiple viruses. A netizen said he and his father used Bai Jia Hei (a fever-reducing medicine) and norfloxacin. Customs confirmed that on July 3 the family’s flight showed quarantine irregularities; authorities intercepted, investigated, and ordered sanitation per national entry-exit health quarantine standards. The airline disinfected, with no reported impact on subsequent flights. A lawyer warned that taking fever reducers to evade temperature checks is a common quarantine evasion tactic; penalties include fines up to 50,000 yuan and possible criminal charges for serious cases.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス感染疑いの一家4人が入国、公衆衛生上の懸念を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: 検疫回避が疑われる個別家族例で「複数のウイルス」感染と診断されたが病原体・重症度・感染拡大の詳細が不明であり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 病原体の特定情報がなく、検疫逃れ目的での解熱剤使用という行動面の異常性のみが際立つ。診断された『複数のウイルス』の詳細（種類・重症度）が判明次第、再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Huge scare as England star isolated from teammates to prevent potential outbreak -- WC Daily
article.articleSummary: As of 10 July 2026, England's quarter-final with Norway in Miami is shadowed by an illness scare: Declan Rice fell ill and missed two training sessions, with FA officials isolating him from the squad to curb a potential outbreak ahead of the stay in South Florida. England rely on Kane and Bellingham to spearhead the attack as Haaland and Norway, fresh from beating Brazil to reach the last eight, pose a threat. The match sits within a high-stakes World Cup slate, including Belgium's quarter-final against Spain in Los Angeles after a 4-1 rout of the U.S. The article emphasizes the infection-control step within the England camp, noting no confirmed outbreak but a proactive precaution in the lead-up to the fixture.

triage.headline_ja: 深刻な懸念:感染拡大防止のためイングランド代表選手をチームメイトから隔離 -- ワールドカップ・デイリー

article.articleHeadline: Over 70 pigs in Itogon test positive for ASF
article.articleSummary: Over 70 pigs in Itogon, Benguet tested positive for African swine fever (ASF), with the outbreak confined to Barangay Tuding. The LGU said depopulation operations have begun, affecting livestock owned by seven swine raisers in the sitios of Baguio Gold, Yanggacan, and Cupao. Positive cases were confirmed through blood samples analyzed by the Regional Animal Disease Diagnostic Laboratory (RADDL). The confirmation by RADDL and the locality-bound nature of the outbreak were reported; details on symptoms or infection source were not provided. Ongoing surveillance and control measures are in place as authorities work to prevent spread within the municipality. Reported on 2026-07-10.

triage.headline_ja: イトゴンで70頭以上の豚がASF陽性
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（豚熱/ASF）であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生影響がなく、発生範囲も一地域に限定されているため見送りとする。

article.articleHeadline: Dokter Timnas Norwegia Buka Suara soal Kondisi Pemain yang Dikabarkan Terkena Wabah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Norway's national team doctor speaks out about the condition of players reportedly affected by an outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Norway’s national team faced reports of a mysterious flu-like illness spreading during World Cup 2026 training in the United States, ahead of their quarterfinal against England in Miami. Several players were affected: Jorgen Strand Larsen missed the group-stage opener due to high fever, and Marcus Holmgren Pedersen fell ill on the eve of the Brazil match. Coach Stale Solbakken cited fatigue and travel-related strain from long flights across various U.S. cities, but said the squad’s health was improving. Team doctor Ola Sand told Nettavisen that all players are fully fit and that the illness is under control, dismissing rumors. The squad reportedly comprises over 50 players, and concerns center on long travel, air conditioning, and climate effects as they prepare for the England game in Miami.

article.articleHeadline: Surto de Ebola no Congo "tem propagação mais rápida já registrada"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo "has the fastest spread ever recorded"
article.articleSummary: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading faster than any prior outbreak, according to Africa CDC. Wessam Mankoula said the virus advances quicker than the response, with resources being mobilized to contain it; this is described as the fastest propagation ever recorded. As of 7 July 2026, the DRC reported 1,759 cases and 600 deaths, per the WHO. In the eastern epicenter, new cases continue to rise, with estimates that the numbers could double every 28 days. Uganda, a neighboring country, remains stable. Declared on 15 May, this is the 17th Ebola outbreak to hit the DRC. The most lethal outbreak in the country (2018–2020) killed 2,300; across Africa, more than 15,000 deaths in 50 years. There is no treatment or vaccine for this Ebola variant; a two-treatment clinical trial began on 2 July.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、「過去最速の拡大」
triage.triage_reason: DRCで致死率の高いエボラ流行が過去最速のペースで拡大中であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: Ugandaは隣国として言及されているが、現時点で安定しており流行発生地ではないため対象国リストからは除外。Africa CDCおよびWHOのデータに基づき、症例数1,759件、死亡600件、28日ごとに倍増する可能性が指摘されている。有効な治療法・ワクチンがなく、臨床試験が開始されたばかりという点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में 1,700 लोग इबोला से संक्रमित, टॉम फ्लेचर ने की संक्रमण रोकने के लिए तत्काल कार्रवाई की अपील - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, 1,700 people infected with Ebola; Tom Fletcher urged immediate action to prevent transmission.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is at a highly active phase, centered in Ituri Province, with Bunia as the epicenter. Since the outbreak was declared on 15 May, more than 1,700 people have been infected in Congo and about 600 have died; Uganda has 20 confirmed cases. UN humanitarian affairs chief Tom Fletcher urged immediate action to curb transmission, stressing the need for rapid work to bend the outbreak. He called for safe, continuous access for aid workers, supplies and relief items; borders and supply routes must stay open; funding promised for relief workers should reach them quickly. The Congo's health ministry reports 1,792 confirmed cases and 625 deaths; 764 people are in isolation or hospital, 295 have recovered, for a case fatality rate of 34.1%. Bunia remains the center due to dense populations and ongoing movement.

The situation exacerbates preexisting challenges, including conflict, hunger, displacement, and limited health services in the region.

article.articleHeadline: 紧盯狂犬病风险监测 守护永州万家安宁_永州_湖南频道
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Closely monitor the risk of rabies to safeguard Yongzhou's tens of thousands of households — Yongzhou — Hunan Channel
article.articleSummary: Rabies surveillance and control in Yongzhou, Hunan Province, China, conducted July 7–9, 2026, led by the WOAH Rabies Reference Laboratory with Yongzhou’s Agriculture and Rural Affairs Bureau and City CDC. Three high-risk areas—Wenmingpu Town (Qiyang County), Duanqiao Pu Town (Dong’an County), and Longpo Town (Shuangpai County)—were surveyed. At each site, 15 dogs were sampled for blood and matched gastrointestinal and respiratory specimens, with one-to-one dog IDs to ensure traceability. Field procedures followed secondary biosafety, sterile technique, and single-use instruments, with on-site disinfection and cold-chain sample transport. Local authorities coordinated advance notifications, animal handling, vaccination efforts, and immunization records to support traceability and response. Simultaneously, outreach educated households on rabies prevention and management of exposures, and offered free canine rabies vaccination under the ongoing public-health drive, including the “Dog Bell” initiative. The WOAH lab will accelerate testing and report results to guide precise risk management and sustained surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病リスク監視を強化し、永州市数万世帯の安寧を守る — 永州 — 湖南チャンネル

article.articleHeadline: UN relief chief calls for efforts to contain Ebola in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains in a 'very active' phase as of July 10, 2026, centered in Ituri province (Bunia). Since the outbreak was declared May 15, the DRC has reported over 1,700 infections and about 600 deaths; Uganda has confirmed 20 cases. The latest DRC update lists 1,792 confirmed cases and 625 deaths, with 764 currently in isolation or hospitalization and 295 recovered, yielding a case fatality rate of 34.1%. UN humanitarian chief Tom Fletcher urged urgent action to break the outbreak’s trajectory, noting spread to other provinces due to conflict and high population movement. He called for safe, sustained access for health workers and supplies, open borders and supply routes, flexible donor funding, and parallel support for the broader humanitarian response alongside Ebola containment efforts.

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria steps up Ebola preparedness with new Presidential Task Force communication structure
article.articleSummary: On 10 July 2026, Nigeria activated the Presidential Task Force on Ebola Preparedness's communication structure to bolster public awareness, messaging coordination, and readiness for a possible outbreak. Nigeria has no confirmed Ebola case, but surveillance is intensified after Ebola developments in Central Africa, notably the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with importation risk deemed high due to movement and travel. The Communications Sub-Committee is chaired by Mohammed Idris; deputy chair is Ambassador Sola Enikanolaiye, with Dr Suleiman Haruna as secretary. Members include NCDC, NOA, the Ministry of Aviation and Aerospace Development, NIPR, NUJ, and NGE. Aims: develop a national risk communication strategy, harmonise messaging across agencies, counter misinformation, translate materials into major Nigerian languages, and coordinate outreach via schools, markets, religious/traditional institutions, and digital platforms. Surveillance at airports, seaports, and land borders remains strengthened.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、大統領直轄タスクフォースの新たな広報体制でエボラ対策準備を強化
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアでは確認例はなく、あくまで準備態勢の強化に関する記事。背景にあるDRCでのエボラ発生状況について具体的な症例数や規模の情報がなく、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリアにおけるエボラ準備態勢の強化が主題であり、ナイジェリア自体は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでのエボラ発生に言及されているが、詳細な症例数等の情報は本記事に含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: MG registra aumento de casos graves de gripe
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minas Gerais records an increase in severe influenza cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 10 July 2026, Minas Gerais is among states with rising severe influenza cases, with growth in nine capitals, including Belo Horizonte, Goiânia, Curitiba, Florianópolis, and Porto Alegre. Nationwide, more than 109,000 cases of severe acute respiratory syndrome (SRAG) have been notified since the start of the year. The burden now is greatest among young children, while deaths are concentrated in the elderly. In recent weeks, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) has been the main driver of positive SRAG cases, while influenza A is the leading cause of deaths associated with respiratory viruses. Fiocruz emphasizes influenza vaccination for priority groups and adherence to measures to reduce transmission of respiratory viruses.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州、重症インフルエンザ症例の増加を記録
triage.triage_reason: 季節性呼吸器ウイルス（RSV・インフルエンザA）による重症例増加は例年の季節的流行の範囲内と考えられ、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、全国的な症例増加の推移は注視が必要。
triage.notes: 季節性呼吸器感染症（RSV・インフルエンザA）による重症急性呼吸器症候群(SRAG)の増加で、ブラジル複数州（ミナスジェライス、サンタカタリーナ、ゴイアス、パラナ等）で報告。小児と高齢者にリスクが集中。国家的な季節流行として経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Megállíthatatlanul terjed az egyik leggyilkosabb járvány
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unstoppable spread of one of the deadliest epidemics
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-10, the Ebola Bundibugyo strain outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo spreads uncontrollably. The center is Bunia, with transmission linked to miners from Mongbwalu who seek care in other towns, enabling wider spread. This is described as the most severe outbreak of this strain, with no proven effective treatment. WHO's Anne Ancia warns the situation remains in the spread phase and not stabilized. Health facilities are stretched, with Ebola treatment centers near 90% occupancy amid ongoing conflict and disasters hindering response. No case counts are provided; infection sources appear linked to worker movement. Authorities fear the outbreak could escalate into a global threat if not contained.

triage.headline_ja: ある最も致死的な感染症の一つが、抑制不能なほど拡大

triage.notes: 症例数の具体的データは記事に記載されておらず不明。WHO関係者のコメントにより国際的懸念が示されている。最も致死性の高い株とされるブンディブギョ株の史上最悪の流行との表現あり。

article.articleHeadline: One More HIV Positive Case Detected In Jharpada Central Jail, Total Cases Rise To 9
article.articleSummary: One more prisoner at Jharpada Central Jail in Bhubaneswar tested HIV positive, raising the inmate tally to nine as of 10 July 2026. The latest case emerged during mandatory health screening conducted before entry; the accused, arrested by Khandagiri police and forwarded to court, was placed in judicial custody and then screened at the jail. Prior to this addition, eight inmates were HIV-positive. Jail authorities say the nine inmates will receive medical treatment, counselling, and regular health monitoring in line with guidance from the State Health Department, and will continue with routine health check-ups and awareness programs inside the facility. Authorities maintain ongoing adherence to health protocols within the jail.

triage.headline_ja: ジャルパダ中央刑務所でHIV陽性者がさらに1名確認、累計9名に

article.articleHeadline: 3天再添100人丧生 刚果伊波拉疫情急速恶化|光华网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another 100 deaths in three days as the Congo Ebola outbreak rapidly worsens | Guanghua Net
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is accelerating as of July 9, 2026, with 600 deaths and 1,759 laboratory-confirmed cases, plus 304 suspected infections. The northeast outbreak spans four provinces, centered in Ituri Province, and has crossed borders to Uganda, which reports 20 confirmed cases, 17 recoveries and 2 deaths. The case fatality rate is about 34%, and health authorities warn that infections may double roughly every 28 days. The World Health Organization published these figures; Africa CDC’s emergency operations chief described the situation as the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in history, noting that transmission is outrunning response efforts. Since the outbreak was declared in mid-May, transmission has intensified, underscoring the need for strengthened surveillance, cross-border coordination, and containment measures.

triage.headline_ja: 3日間で再び100人死亡 コンゴのエボラ疫情が急速に悪化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで急拡大し致死率約34%、ウガンダへの越境伝播も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダも記事に含まれるが対象国リストに無いためverified_locationsには含めていない。Africa CDCは史上最速拡大のエボラ流行と評価しており、感染は28日ごとに倍増する可能性があると警告。

article.articleHeadline: สาวปทุมธานีร้องถูกสุนัขจรจัดกัด หวั่นพิษสุนัขบ้า วอนรัฐเร่งแก้ก่อนเกิดเหตุซ้ำ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pathum Thani woman says she was bitten by a stray dog, fears rabies, urges the government to act quickly before another incident occurs.
article.articleSummary: Rabies risk in Pathum Thani, Thailand, after a 32-year-old woman was bitten on the left foot by a pack of stray dogs in Soi Klong Luang 1, Khlong Luang District, around 7:00 p.m. on July 7. The 4–5 dogs, known to chase motorcycles and bite residents, have no owner and are reportedly fed locally. Residents have petitioned authorities to remove the animals; responses reveal inter-agency jurisdiction issues: Pathum Thani Provincial Livestock Office and Bangkok’s Department of Livestock Development are willing to act, but Khlong Luang Municipality says capture requires the complainant to rehouse the dogs, and Rangsit City Municipality notes cross-district transfer is not allowed, needing formal referral. Although not in a three-district rabies surveillance area, the community fears exposure and urges swift removal of the dogs. The injured woman faces an eight-dose vaccination regimen, including rabies and tetanus, underscoring the public-health urgency. The incident occurred on 7 July, report published 10 July 2026. Keywords: rabies, outbreak, vaccination, stray dogs, Pathum Thani, Thailand.

triage.headline_ja: パトゥムターニー県の女性が野良犬に噛まれ、狂犬病を懸念し行政に迅速な対応を要請
triage.triage_reason: 単発の個別咬傷事例であり、行政管轄の問題が主な論点。集団感染や異常な流行拡大の兆候はなく、フルRRAを要する公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 野良犬による個別咬傷事件が主題で、行政の管轄争いが記事の焦点。狂犬病サーベイランス対象地域外とされているが、地域住民の不安と行政対応の遅れが継続的曝露リスクとして残る。集団感染や広域拡大の情報はなく、続報の必要性も低い。

article.articleHeadline: 腸病毒高峰還沒到 暑假疫情不降反升
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The enterovirus peak hasn't arrived yet; summer outbreaks are not falling but rising.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s enterovirus activity is rising this summer, defying the usual holiday decline. Last week’s emergency and outpatient visits reached 7,522, up 6.8% from the prior week, with no clear peak yet; officials expect the rise to continue for several weeks, possibly peaking around September. Domestic severe cases total 6 this year, including 1 death; breakdown: 4 cases of enterovirus D68, 1 Coxsackievirus A4, and 1 Coxsackievirus A16. D68 presents with fever, runny nose, and cough and can progress to pneumonia, meningitis, or limb weakness; there is no vaccine or specific antiviral. Preventive measures emphasize hand hygiene, cough etiquette, and avoiding crowded places. Regionally, neighboring countries—Vietnam, China, Japan, Korea, Thailand, Singapore, and Hong Kong—also report rising activity; Vietnam has over 55,000 cases since December, with 10 deaths, EV71 predominating among severe cases, especially in Ho Chi Minh City.

triage.headline_ja: エンテロウイルスのピークはまだ来ていない、夏休みの流行は減少せず増加している
triage.triage_reason: 台湾で例年の夏季減少パターンに反してエンテロウイルス感染が増加し死亡例も発生、ベトナムでも大規模流行(55,000例超・死亡10例)が進行中で、複数国で同時期に活動上昇が報告されており地域的拡大の懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾（対象国リスト外）だが、ベトナムについては具体的な症例数(55,000例超)・死亡者数(10例)・EV71優勢という詳細情報が記載されており実質的な発生国として扱った。中国・タイ・香港等は『近隣諸国でも活動上昇』との簡易言及のみで詳細情報がないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Health: Attacks leave 45 Ebola response, aid workers wounded
article.articleSummary: Ebola response and aid operations in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo are under intensified violence. Since mid-May, 45 response and aid workers have been wounded in 76 security incidents across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. On Monday, national health authorities reported 1,708 confirmed Ebola cases in these three provinces, with Boga Health Zone in Ituri now reporting cases. An attack at an Ebola treatment center in Butembo, North Kivu, damaged facilities. Health authorities, with UN OCHA, stress protection of health workers and facilities to sustain case detection, contact tracing and care. The outbreak has expanded geographically to Tshopo and Haut-Uele provinces, as patients move toward Kisangani and Wamba. Ituri remains in acute growth; North Kivu shows an active increase; South Kivu has had no new cases since May 26 and could be declared over soon, though the minister notes the outbreak remains very active.

triage.headline_ja: 保健：攻撃によりエボラ対応・支援活動従事者45人が負傷
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部でエボラ確定例1,708例、複数州への地理的拡大に加え、治安悪化により対応者が負傷するなど公衆衛生対応が著しく阻害されており、国際的拡大リスクも高い。
triage.notes: イタリア・ロンバルディア州が発生地域に含まれるが、記事本文はDRC国内（イツリ、北キブ、南キブ、トショパ、オートウエレ州）の状況のみを主題としており、イタリアでの発生事例は言及されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Лихорадка Эбола распространилась еще на две провинции ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola fever has spread to two more provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo has expanded its Ebola outbreak to Chopo and Upper Uele provinces, each reporting two cases, according to Health Minister Roger Kamba. The death toll is 625 with about 1,800 people affected overall. Ituri and North Kivu remain in the outbreak's acute phase. The flare, first detected in May in both the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, is linked to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there are no vaccines or therapies. Authorities continue to monitor transmission and potential imported or exported cases, noting prior cases in Upper Uele. The ongoing spread underscores the challenges of controlling Ebola in eastern Congo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国のさらに2州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国内で新たに2州に拡大し、死者625人に達しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも同株（Bundibugyoエボラウイルス）の症例が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・治療法が存在しない株であり、国際的な支援と監視の継続が求められる。

article.articleHeadline: Health experts to parents: Stay vigilant on Covid-19, don't panic
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 uptick in the Philippines prompts vigilance but no alarm, per the Pediatric Infectious Disease Society of the Philippines (PIDSP). They note community circulation and that true caseload may be higher due to fewer tests for respiratory symptoms. In Quezon City, confirmed cases rose 265.22% in three weeks (June 11–July 1) to 84; total QC cases this year reached 146, with no evidence of clustering or severe illness. Most children have mild disease, though infants and those with underlying conditions remain at higher risk. Preventive steps include staying home with respiratory symptoms, wearing masks in crowded or poorly ventilated indoor areas or when exposed, and avoiding unnecessary crowds if unwell or if COVID-19 is circulating locally. Symptomatic individuals should get tested, especially before returning to school/work or visiting high-risk individuals; seek medical care for breathing difficulties, persistent high fever, dehydration, or unusual sleepiness.

triage.headline_ja: 健康専門家、保護者へ：新型コロナウイルスに警戒を、しかしパニックにならないで
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン・ケソン市でCOVID-19症例が3週間で265%増加し地域内での持続的な伝播が確認されているが、重症例やクラスターは報告されておらず、社会的関心（メディア報道・専門家団体の注意喚起）は認められるため、続報確認を含めた初期スクリーニング対象とする。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既に風土病化しており、季節的な症例増加自体は珍しくないが、検査数減少による過小報告の可能性や小児・乳児への影響が指摘されている。重症化やクラスター発生の証拠はなく、専門家は『警戒するがパニックは不要』としている。続報でクラスター化や重症例の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: جمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية: ارتفاع ضحايا فيروس "إيبولا" إلى 625 وفاة وأوغندا تدخل دائرة الخطر
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: the Ebola virus death toll has risen to 625, and Uganda enters the danger zone.
article.articleSummary: As of July 10, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed 625 people, after authorities reported surpassing 600 deaths within 24 hours. The official statement notes an accelerated epidemic curve with rising fatalities. Regional concerns escalate as infections and deaths linked to Ebola have been reported in neighboring Uganda, signaling a potential expansion into central and eastern Africa. In response, the World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, designating the regional risk as very high and a cross-border threat requiring urgent international action.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラウイルスの死者数が625人に増加、ウガンダも危険地帯に突入
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱によるDRCでの死者数急増(625人)とウガンダへの越境拡大、WHOによるPHEIC宣言があり、IHR基準の複数該当及び国際的関心の高さからフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。WHOはPHEICを宣言しており、国際的な緊急対応が求められている。

article.articleHeadline: Potka CHC In-Charge Suspended After Cerebral Malaria Deaths
article.articleSummary: Five children died from cerebral malaria in Potka block, triggering administrative action against CHC Potka’s Medical Officer-in-Charge, Dr. Rajni Mahakud, who is suspended with immediate effect. Dr. Sukant Seat is appointed the new MOIC. An official inquiry reportedly found serious lapses in malaria prevention and control, citing delays in campaigns, weak disease surveillance, and inadequate preventive measures in affected villages. Mahakud has been directed to report to the Regional Deputy Director of Health Services, Dumka, as accountability is sought for negligence. The new MOIC must intensify malaria surveillance and ensure full implementation of prevention and treatment across the block. A special drive will include large-scale testing, prompt treatment, distribution of anti-malarials, fogging and insecticide spraying, and extensive public awareness. Residents should seek immediate care for fever, use mosquito nets, and maintain hygiene to curb breeding.

triage.headline_ja: 脳マラリアによる死亡を受けPotka地域保健所（CHC）所長が停職処分に
triage.triage_reason: インド・ジャールカンド州の一地域における既知の風土病（マラリア）による死亡と、それに伴う地方行政の人事対応に関するニュースであり、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威や拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: マラリアはインドの当該地域で毎年発生する風土病であり、本記事は死亡事例を受けた地方保健当局の管理責任・人事対応に焦点を当てたローカルニュース。国際的な拡大や渡航制限のリスクは見られない。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고, 에볼라 사망자 600명...누적 확진자 1759명 집계 - 동행미디어 시대
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 600 Ebola deaths... cumulative confirmed cases totaling 1,759 - Donghaeng Media Era
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. As of July 7, cumulative confirmed cases reach 1,759 with 600 deaths (case fatality 34.1%), and 285 recoveries. About 80% of contacts are being traced, but wide geographic spread and high mobility hinder containment. The outbreak was officially declared May 15; Uganda reports 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths, last Ugandan case reported June 21; several Ugandan cases linked to travel from DRC. WHO declared an international public health emergency on May 17. There are no approved vaccines or specific therapeutics for Bundibugyo ebolavirus; control relies on nonpharmaceutical measures. Africa CDC describes the outbreak as the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in Africa, with an estimated transmission rate of roughly 14 new confirmed cases per 10 infections. Transmission chains remain unclear in some areas, complicating containment.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴ、エボラ死者600人…累積確定患者1,759人集計
triage.triage_reason: WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言し、致死率34%・急速な拡大・ウガンダへの越境伝播が確認されており、IHR基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例確認あるが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。WHOはPHEIC相当の宣言を行っており、ワクチン・治療薬未承認のため対応が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: खसरे की दस्तक : सीतापुर के बगडोली में 6 बच्चे संक्रमित, स्वास्थ्य विभाग हाई अलर्ट पर
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles Knock: 6 Children Infected in Bagdoli, Sitapur; Health Department on High Alert
article.articleSummary: As of July 10, 2026, six children in Bagdoli village, Sitapur development block, Surguja district, Chhattisgarh, have tested positive for measles, prompting health department vigilance. After confirmation, district health teams conducted house-to-house screenings, and tracing and testing of contacts to prevent further spread. Unvaccinated children are identified as high-risk and placed under close surveillance. Officials urged parents to ensure timely vaccination and seek immediate care if fever, red rash, or measles-like symptoms appear. Medical teams are maintaining continuous surveillance across the area. The report notes laboratory confirmation of the six cases and emphasizes vaccination campaigns to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹の兆候：シータプル県バグドリ村で子供6人が感染、保健当局が厳戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: インドの一村落で麻疹6例が確認され保健当局が対応中だが、規模は限定的で国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。ワクチン未接種児への感染拡大可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 地方紙報道による小規模な麻疹クラスター事例。地元保健当局が接触者追跡とワクチン接種推進を実施中で、管理可能な範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Liên hợp quốc kêu gọi nỗ lực ngăn chặn dịch Ebola ở Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United Nations urges intensified efforts to curb the Ebola outbreak in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains severe, with Ituri province at the epicenter and spread to other provinces as conflict and population movement increase transmission risk. Since the outbreak began on May 15, 2026, 1,792 laboratory-confirmed cases have been reported and 625 deaths nationwide; 764 patients are currently in isolation or hospitalized, and 295 have recovered. Uganda has confirmed 20 Ebola cases linked to cross-border transmission. UN Under-Secretary-General for Humanitarian Affairs Tom G. Fletcher urged urgent, intensified action and greater access for health workers, relief personnel, and supplies, emphasizing this is a broader humanitarian crisis, not only a health emergency. Congo’s Health Minister Samuel Roger Kambacho says the outbreak remains in a high-activity phase, with peak timing uncertain due to dense populations and ongoing displacement.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、コンゴでのエボラ流行阻止に向けた取り組み強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行が継続し、ウガンダへの国境を越えた伝播も確認されており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、国境を越えた感染拡大の観点でリスク評価上は考慮すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Corona Alert: कोरोना वायरस फिर लौटा? 2 लोगों की मौत, 4 की रिपोर्ट पॉजिटिव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Corona Alert: Has the coronavirus returned again? 2 people have died, 4 have tested positive.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 re-emerged in Kadappa district, Andhra Pradesh, with four new RT-PCR–positive cases and two deaths reported as of 2026-07-10. The four positives are from different Kadappa areas; three are isolated at home, one is hospitalized in a Kadappa hospital's COVID ward. All four had two vaccine doses, with one having a booster. The two deaths occurred recently: a 60-year-old man who died after treatment at SVIMS, Tirupati and later CMC Vellore; he tested positive by RT-PCR and had diabetes and kidney disease. The second death was a 43-year-old man; infection confirmed by RT-PCR and chest CT. No prior health records were available for him. Samples from the four cases were sent to NIV Pune for genome sequencing to identify the variant; doctors suspect Omicron. Andhra Pradesh’s last COVID-19 death was in 2022; authorities have intensified surveillance in Kadappa.

triage.headline_ja: コロナアラート：コロナウイルスが再び戻ってきた？2人死亡、4人陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の局所的な再燃事例で死亡例もあるが、既存の風土病的疾患であり異常性は限定的。ゲノム解析結果待ちで続報を注視すべき。
triage.notes: Nipahは疾患名リストに含まれるが記事本文には言及なし。Andhra Pradesh州Kadappa地区での局地的COVID再燃で、2022年以来の死亡例。ゲノム解析結果（Omicron疑い）待ち。

article.articleHeadline: 盧寵茂料流感活躍程度未來數周續升　憂院舍員工疫苗接種率偏低
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lo Chung-mau: Influenza activity expected to rise in the next few weeks; concerns about low vaccination rates among care-home staff.
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity in Hong Kong is expected to rise in the coming weeks, with authorities monitoring closely. Unvaccinated children have a fivefold higher risk of death from influenza complications than vaccinated peers. The 2025/26 influenza vaccination program reached about 2.03 million doses; for 2026/27, procurement will diversify suppliers to ensure a sustainable vaccine supply. Elderly residents in care homes have vaccination rates around 80%, while care-home staff vaccination is only about 30%, raising concerns about bringing the virus into facilities. Maternal-child health centers will strengthen vaccination for infants aged 6 months to 2 years. Last year, 99% of schools participated in on-site vaccination, but the early weeks of the school year saw several severe pediatric flu cases. WHO determines strains early; Hong Kong typically receives vaccines in September and then conducts school vaccination, which requires nearly 200,000 doses.

triage.headline_ja: 盧寵茂:インフルエンザ活動は今後数週間で上昇する見込み、介護施設職員のワクチン接種率の低さを懸念
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザに関する通常の公衆衛生広報であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 香港政府当局による季節性インフルエンザワクチン接種率に関する定例的な注意喚起記事。香港はChina(1814991)に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 Again: भारत में कोरोना से मौत का नया मामला: संक्रमण से 2 लोगों की मौत, 4 की रिपोर्ट पॉजिटिव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Covid-19 Again: A new death due to coronavirus in India: 2 people died due to the infection, 4 tested positive.
article.articleSummary: Two COVID-19 deaths and four new infections were reported in Kadappa district, Andhra Pradesh. A 46-year-old man died despite high-dose antibiotics; four RT-PCR positives were detected in Kadappa, all with two vaccine doses and one booster in one case. Three patients had mild symptoms and remained in home isolation; one was hospitalized in a COVID ward. X-ray suggested pneumonia, and CT confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection. Containment steps, including sanitization and tracing of primary and secondary contacts, were initiated. Separately, two earlier COVID-19 deaths were reported: a 60-year-old man who died on June 28 at Christian Medical College Vellore after transfer from Sri Venkateswara Institute of Medical Sciences, and a 43-year-old with confirmed infection whose condition deteriorated. The previous COVID-19 death in Andhra Pradesh occurred in 2022.

triage.headline_ja: Covid-19 Again: インドでコロナによる新たな死亡例：感染により2人死亡、4人が陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の散発的な死亡例・感染例の報告であり、既知の疾患で管理体制も機能しているが、2022年以来の死亡例という点で地域的な動向として注視が必要。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既知の疾患であり既存の対応体制（隔離・接触者追跡）で管理されている。2022年以来の死亡例という点でアンドラプラデシュ州にとってはやや異例だが、国際的拡大やパンデミックポテンシャルの兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: 手足口病腸病毒︱香港手足口病爆170宗！非典型症狀腸病毒極易誤診　酒精搓手液殺不死 唯1物有效
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HFMD Enteroviruses | Hong Kong HFMD outbreak tops 170 cases! Enteroviruses with atypical symptoms are easily misdiagnosed; alcohol-based hand sanitizers won't kill them—only one thing is effective.
article.articleSummary: Hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) outbreaks linked to enteroviruses are surging in Hong Kong, with more than 170 elder-care home outbreaks reported by July 2. No HK EV71 or severe pediatric cases have been confirmed, but neighboring regions show rising activity: Taiwan reports 7,522 enterovirus ED visits with 6 severe cases including 1 death; Vietnam has about 55,000 cases and 10 deaths, EV71-driven; Guangdong and Shenzhen near 30,000 cases, with Shenzhen reporting school closures. Imported risk rises with travel to Taiwan, Vietnam, Japan, Korea, and Thailand. Enterovirus D68 can present atypically, lacking HFMD signs and causing rapid deterioration with pneumonia or meningitis, risking misdiagnosis. No antivirals or vaccines exist; treatment is supportive. Prevention hinges on thorough handwashing with soap and water for at least 20 seconds—alcohol sanitizers are ineffective. Precautions: wash hands on returning home, cover coughs, mask sick members, avoid crowds, and isolate when infected.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病・腸病毒｜香港の手足口病流行が170件超！非典型症状の腸病毒は誤診されやすく、アルコール消毒液では殺せない　有効なのは1つだけ
triage.triage_reason: 香港・中国広東省・深圳・ベトナムなど複数地域で手足口病／腸病毒（EV71等）の症例急増と死亡例が報告されており、国際的拡大の可能性と一定の重症度が認められるためフルリスク評価へ進めるべきと判断した。
triage.notes: タイ・台湾・日本・韓国は渡航先としてのリスク言及のみで、実際の発生国としての明確な記載はないため verified_locations から除外した。香港・広東省・深圳は中国（1814991）に統合。

article.articleHeadline: Menkes Targetkan Temuan Kasus Kusta Jadi 37 Ribu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minister of Health Sets Target for Leprosy Case Detections to 37,000.
article.articleSummary: Leprosy (Hansen's disease) in Indonesia. Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin targets boosting case finding to 37,000 annually, up from about 14,000 detected each year. The estimate suggests around 37,000 people may be living with leprosy nationwide. Speaking at the National Leprosy Conference 2026 in Jakarta on Friday, July 10, 2026, he warned that undetected cases continue to fuel transmission, risking new infections. He asserted that identifying and treating more cases can halt transmission and prevent disability among patients. He urged regional leaders nationwide to maximize case finding, noting that the most prolific finder will be invited to the Ministry of Health in November for National Health Day. Disease is caused by Mycobacterium leprae. The plan emphasizes early detection, prompt treatment, and reduction of transmission, with emphasis on Jakarta Pusat and broader Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: 保健相、ハンセン病症例発見数を年間3万7千件に引き上げる目標を設定
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病の症例発見強化に関する保健政策の発表であり、突発的な公衆衛生上の脅威や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: ハンセン病はインドネシアで既知の風土病であり、本記事は症例発見数向上のための保健省の目標設定に関する行政発表。緊急性のあるアウトブレイクではない。

article.articleHeadline: 上海一家人染疫瞞報 查出新冠等3種病毒 | 上海一家四口 | 感染新冠 | 隱瞞疫情
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Shanghai family infected but underreported; COVID-19 and two other viruses were detected | A four-member family in Shanghai | Infected with COVID-19 | Concealing the outbreak
article.articleSummary: Four-member Shanghai family on a Hong Kong–Macau trip fell ill and concealed their condition, boarding a flight back to Shanghai on July 3 while infected with COVID-19, Salmonella, and Coxsackievirus. The youngest son developed fever and vomiting; the daughter and husband soon followed with fever, and during the flight the young child experienced persistent diarrhea, reportedly contaminating seats, cushions, blankets, and cabin surfaces. After arrival, Shanghai hospitals confirmed infections with COVID-19, Salmonella, and Coxsackievirus. Macau authorities had flagged the febrile cluster and notified the airline; the aircraft was disinfected. Public criticism followed for hiding illness and endangering others. Chinese law could impose fines up to 50,000 yuan, and if the outbreak is caused or worsened, criminal penalties up to three years. This is an imported, multi-pathogen case involving one family.

triage.headline_ja: 上海の一家族が感染を隠蔽、新型コロナなど3種のウイルスが検出される｜上海の四人家族｜新型コロナ感染｜疫病隠蔽
triage.triage_reason: 香港・マカオ旅行後の一家4人が新型コロナ・サルモネラ・コクサッキーウイルスの感染を隠して航空機に搭乗し機内を汚染した事案で、隠蔽行為という異常性と社会的関心の高さからスクリーニング基準に該当するが、実際の公衆衛生への影響は一家族に限定的。
triage.notes: 本件は感染症の重症度や拡大リスクよりも、疾病隠蔽・渡航中の隔離違反という社会的・法的関心が中心。一家族内の事例であり、二次感染の報告は現時点でなし。続報でクラスター化の有無を確認する必要あり。
